AI.motivation: 蛋白质科学发现受限于手动协调信息和算法，而通用智能体在复杂领域项目中能力不足，需要专门针对蛋白质领域设计的自主框架
AI.method: 采用自演化的多智能体基础设施，从静态工具使用转向动态工作流合成，通过自主组织的工作流来满足蛋白质相关需求
AI.result: 在VenusAgentEval基准测试中超越了一系列知名智能体，能够从单一自然语言提示自主组织蛋白质的发现和优化过程
AI.conclusion: VenusFactory2提供了一个有效的自主蛋白质发现框架，解决了蛋白质科学发现中的瓶颈问题，实现了从静态工具使用到动态工作流合成的转变

title: Learning to Predict Future-Aligned Research Proposals with Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to assist ideation in research, but evaluating the quality of LLM-generated research proposals remains difficult: novelty and soundness are hard to measure automatically, and large-scale human evaluation is costly. We propose a verifiable alternative by reframing proposal generation as a time-sliced scientific forecasting problem. Given a research question and inspiring papers available before a cutoff time, the model generates a structured proposal and is evaluated by whether it anticipates research directions that appear in papers published after the time. We operationalize this objective with the Future Alignment Score (FAS), computed via retrieval and LLM-based semantic scoring against a held-out future corpus. To train models, we build a time-consistent dataset of 17,771 papers from targets and their pre-cutoff citations, and synthesize reasoning traces that teach gap identification and inspiration borrowing. Across Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 models, future-aligned tuning improves future alignment over unaligned baselines (up to +10.6% overall FAS), and domain-expert human evaluation corroborates improved proposal quality. Finally, we demonstrate practical impact by implementing two model-generated proposals with a code agent, obtaining 4.17% accuracy gain on MATH from a new prompting strategy and consistent improvements for a novel model-merging method.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种评估LLM生成研究提案质量的新方法：将提案生成重构为时间切片科学预测问题，通过提案是否预测到截止时间后发表论文的研究方向来评估质量，并开发了未来对齐分数（FAS）进行量化评估。
AI.motivation: 当前评估LLM生成研究提案质量面临挑战：新颖性和严谨性难以自动衡量，大规模人工评估成本高昂。需要一种可验证的替代方法来评估LLM在科研构思中的表现。
AI.method: 1. 将提案生成重构为时间切片科学预测问题：给定研究问题和截止时间前的参考文献，模型生成结构化提案；2. 开发未来对齐分数（FAS），通过检索和基于LLM的语义评分与未来语料库对比；3. 构建包含17,771篇论文的时间一致数据集；4. 合成推理轨迹，教授模型识别研究空白和借鉴灵感；5. 对Llama-3.1和Qwen2.5模型进行未来对齐微调。
AI.result: 1. 未来对齐微调显著提高了模型对未来研究的对齐度（整体FAS提升高达10.6%）；2. 领域专家人工评估证实了提案质量的改进；3. 实际应用验证：实现了两个模型生成的提案，其中新的提示策略在MATH数据集上获得4.17%的准确率提升，新颖的模型融合方法也带来了持续改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过将研究提案生成重构为科学预测问题，并开发可验证的评估框架，该研究提供了一种有效评估和改进LLM科研构思能力的方法。未来对齐微调能够提升模型生成高质量研究提案的能力，并在实际应用中展现出实用价值。

title: Survey on Remote Sensing Scene Classification: From Traditional Methods to Large Generative AI Models
comment: Accepted in Journal of King Saud University Computer and Information Sciences
summary: Remote sensing scene classification has experienced a paradigmatic transformation from traditional handcrafted feature methods to sophisticated artificial intelligence systems that now form the backbone of modern Earth observation applications. This comprehensive survey examines the complete methodological evolution, systematically tracing development from classical texture descriptors and machine learning classifiers through the deep learning revolution to current state-of-the-art foundation models and generative AI approaches. We chronicle the pivotal shift from manual feature engineering to automated hierarchical representation learning via convolutional neural networks, followed by advanced architectures including Vision Transformers, graph neural networks, and hybrid frameworks. The survey provides in-depth coverage of breakthrough developments in self-supervised foundation models and vision-language systems, highlighting exceptional performance in zero-shot and few-shot learning scenarios. Special emphasis is placed on generative AI innovations that tackle persistent challenges through synthetic data generation and advanced feature learning strategies. We analyze contemporary obstacles including annotation costs, multimodal data fusion complexities, interpretability demands, and ethical considerations, alongside current trends in edge computing deployment, federated learning frameworks, and sustainable AI practices. Based on comprehensive analysis of recent advances and gaps, we identify key future research priorities: advancing hyperspectral and multi-temporal analysis capabilities, developing robust cross-domain generalization methods, and establishing standardized evaluation protocols to accelerate scientific progress in remote sensing scene classification systems.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统回顾了遥感场景分类从传统手工特征方法到现代AI系统的完整演变历程，涵盖深度学习革命、基础模型、生成式AI等前沿技术，并分析了当前挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 遥感场景分类经历了从传统手工特征方法到现代人工智能系统的范式转变，成为地球观测应用的核心技术。本文旨在全面梳理这一领域的方法论演进，系统追踪从经典纹理描述符和机器学习分类器到深度学习革命，再到当前最先进的基础模型和生成式AI方法的完整发展脉络。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，首先回顾传统手工特征方法和机器学习分类器，然后深入分析卷积神经网络带来的自动化分层表示学习变革，接着探讨视觉Transformer、图神经网络和混合框架等先进架构。特别关注自监督基础模型和视觉语言系统的突破性发展，以及生成式AI在合成数据生成和特征学习策略方面的创新。
AI.result: 该调查系统性地呈现了遥感场景分类技术的完整演进路径：从基于纹理描述符的经典方法，到CNN主导的深度学习革命，再到当前的基础模型和生成式AI时代。特别强调了自监督基础模型在零样本和少样本学习场景中的卓越表现，以及生成式AI在解决标注成本、数据稀缺等长期挑战方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 基于对最新进展和差距的全面分析，确定了未来研究的重点方向：推进高光谱和多时相分析能力，开发鲁棒的跨域泛化方法，建立标准化评估协议以加速遥感场景分类系统的科学发展。同时需要关注边缘计算部署、联邦学习框架和可持续AI实践等当前趋势。

title: EpochX: Building the Infrastructure for an Emergent Agent Civilization
summary: General-purpose technologies reshape economies less by improving individual tools than by enabling new ways to organize production and coordination. We believe AI agents are approaching a similar inflection point: as foundation models make broad task execution and tool use increasingly accessible, the binding constraint shifts from raw capability to how work is delegated, verified, and rewarded at scale. We introduce EpochX, a credits-native marketplace infrastructure for human-agent production networks. EpochX treats humans and agents as peer participants who can post tasks or claim them. Claimed tasks can be decomposed into subtasks and executed through an explicit delivery workflow with verification and acceptance. Crucially, EpochX is designed so that each completed transaction can produce reusable ecosystem assets, including skills, workflows, execution traces, and distilled experience. These assets are stored with explicit dependency structure, enabling retrieval, composition, and cumulative improvement over time. EpochX also introduces a native credit mechanism to make participation economically viable under real compute costs. Credits lock task bounties, budget delegation, settle rewards upon acceptance, and compensate creators when verified assets are reused. By formalizing the end-to-end transaction model together with its asset and incentive layers, EpochX reframes agentic AI as an organizational design problem: building infrastructures where verifiable work leaves persistent, reusable artifacts, and where value flows support durable human-agent collaboration.

AI.tldr: EpochX是一个基于信用的市场基础设施，用于构建人类-智能体生产网络，将人类和AI智能体视为对等参与者，通过任务发布、分解、执行、验证的完整工作流程，并生成可重用的生态系统资产。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型使广泛的任务执行和工具使用变得越来越容易，AI智能体发展的瓶颈已从原始能力转向如何在大规模上委派、验证和奖励工作。需要构建支持可验证工作和持久价值流动的基础设施。
AI.method: 引入EpochX系统，将人类和智能体视为对等参与者，可以发布或认领任务。认领的任务可以分解为子任务，通过明确的交付工作流程执行，包括验证和验收。系统设计使每个完成的交易都能产生可重用的生态系统资产（技能、工作流程、执行轨迹、提炼经验），并存储明确的依赖结构。引入原生信用机制来支持实际计算成本下的经济可行性。
AI.result: EpochX通过形式化端到端交易模型及其资产和激励层，将智能体AI重新定义为组织设计问题：构建可验证工作留下持久可重用工件的基础设施，支持持久的人类-智能体协作。
AI.conclusion: EpochX提供了一个基础设施框架，使人类和AI智能体能够作为对等参与者协作，通过正式的交易模型、资产生成和信用激励机制，支持可扩展、可验证且经济可持续的人类-智能体生产网络。

title: Rethinking Easy-to-Hard: Limits of Curriculum Learning in Post-Training for Deductive Reasoning
summary: Curriculum learning (CL), motivated by the intuition that learning in increasing order of difficulty should ease generalization, is commonly adopted both in pre-training and post-training of large language models (LLMs). The intuition of CL is particularly compelling for compositional reasoning, where complex problems are built from elementary inference rules; however, the actual impact of CL on such tasks remains largely underexplored. We present a systematic empirical study of CL for post-training of LLMs, using synthetic arithmetic and logical benchmarks where difficulty is characterized by reasoning complexity rather than surface-level proxies. Surprisingly, across multiple model families and curriculum schedules, we find no robust advantage in difficulty-based sequencing over standard random sampling in either accuracy or response length. These findings persist across both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) methods. Our study suggests that, in the context of deductive reasoning, the specific ordering of training examples plays a negligible role in achieving compositional generalization, challenging the practical utility of curriculum-based post-training.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在大型语言模型的后训练中，基于难度的课程学习相比随机采样在算术和逻辑推理任务上没有明显优势，挑战了课程学习在组合推理中的实际效用。
AI.motivation: 课程学习通常被认为按照难度递增的顺序学习有助于泛化，但在组合推理任务中，课程学习对大型语言模型的实际影响尚未得到充分探索。研究者希望系统研究课程学习在后训练中对组合推理任务的效果。
AI.method: 使用合成的算术和逻辑基准测试，其中难度由推理复杂性而非表面特征定义。在多个模型家族和课程安排下，比较基于难度的排序与标准随机采样在监督微调和强化学习方法中的表现。
AI.result: 令人惊讶的是，在准确率和响应长度方面，基于难度的排序相比随机采样没有显示出稳健优势。这一发现在监督微调和强化学习方法中都持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 在演绎推理的背景下，训练样本的具体排序在实现组合泛化方面作用微乎其微，这挑战了基于课程的后训练的实际效用。课程学习在组合推理任务中的优势可能被高估了。

title: Generating Synthetic Wildlife Health Data from Camera Trap Imagery: A Pipeline for Alopecia and Body Condition Training Data
summary: No publicly available, ML ready datasets exist for wildlife health conditions in camera trap imagery, creating a fundamental barrier to automated health screening. We present a pipeline for generating synthetic training images depicting alopecia and body condition deterioration in wildlife from real camera trap photographs. Our pipeline constructs a curated base image set from iWildCam using MegaDetector derived bounding boxes and center frame weighted stratified sampling across 8 North American species. A generative phenotype editing system produces controlled severity variants depicting hair loss consistent with mange and emaciation. An adaptive scene drift quality control system uses a sham prefilter and decoupled mask then score approach with complementary day or night metrics to reject images where the generative model altered the original scene. We frame the pipeline explicitly as a screening data source. From 201 base images across 4 species, we generate 553 QC passing synthetic variants with an overall pass rate of 83 percent. A sim to real transfer experiment training exclusively on synthetic data and testing on real camera trap images of suspected health conditions achieves 0.85 AUROC, demonstrating that the synthetic data captures visual features sufficient for screening.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个生成野生动物健康状态合成图像的管道，用于训练机器学习模型进行野生动物健康筛查，解决了缺乏真实标注数据的问题。
AI.motivation: 目前没有公开可用的、机器学习就绪的野生动物健康状态数据集，这构成了自动化健康筛查的根本障碍。缺乏标注数据限制了利用计算机视觉技术监测野生动物健康状况的能力。
AI.method: 1. 从iWildCam数据集中使用MegaDetector边界框和中心帧加权分层采样构建基础图像集；2. 开发生成式表型编辑系统，产生描绘脱毛（疥癣）和消瘦的受控严重程度变体；3. 设计自适应场景漂移质量控制系统，使用伪预过滤器和解耦的掩码-评分方法，配合日间/夜间指标来拒绝生成模型改变原始场景的图像。
AI.result: 从4个物种的201张基础图像中，生成了553个通过质量控制的合成变体，总体通过率为83%。在仅使用合成数据训练并在真实相机陷阱图像上测试的模拟到真实迁移实验中，达到了0.85的AUROC，证明合成数据捕获了足够的视觉特征用于筛查。
AI.conclusion: 该管道成功生成了高质量的合成训练数据，能够有效支持野生动物健康筛查模型的开发。合成数据捕获了足够的视觉特征，使得模型能够在真实图像上表现良好，为解决野生动物健康监测中的数据稀缺问题提供了可行方案。

title: Domain-Guided YOLO26 with Composite BCE-Dice-Lovász Loss for Multi-Class Fetal Head Ultrasound Segmentation
summary: Segmenting fetal head structures from prenatal ultrasound remains a practical bottleneck in obstetric imaging. The current state-of-the-art baseline, proposed alongside the published dataset, adapts the Segment Anything Model with per-class Dice and Lovász losses but still depends on bounding-box prompts at test time. We build a prompt-free pipeline on top of YOLO26-Seg that jointly detects and segments three structures, Brain, Cavum Septi Pellucidi (CSP), and Lateral Ventricles (LV), in a single forward pass. Three modifications are central to our approach: (i) a composite BCE-Dice-Lovász segmentation loss with inverse-frequency class weighting, injected into the YOLO26 training loop via runtime monkey-patching; (ii) domain-guided copy-paste augmentation that transplants minority-class structures while respecting their anatomical location relative to the brain boundary; and (iii) inter-patient stratified splitting to prevent data leakage. On 575 held-out test images, the composite loss variant reaches a mean Dice coefficient of 0.9253, exceeding the baseline (0.9012) by 2.68 percentage points, despite reporting over three foreground classes only, whereas the baseline's reported mean includes the easy background class. We further ablate each component and discuss annotation-quality and class-imbalance effects on CSP and LV performance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于YOLO26-Seg的无提示胎儿头部超声图像分割方法，通过复合损失函数、领域引导数据增强和分层数据划分，在三个结构分割任务上超越现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 胎儿头部超声图像分割在产科影像中仍存在实际瓶颈。现有最佳基线方法需要测试时提供边界框提示，限制了实际应用。需要开发无需提示的端到端分割方法。
AI.method: 1) 基于YOLO26-Seg构建无提示管道，单次前向传播同时检测和分割脑部、透明隔腔和侧脑室三个结构；2) 引入复合BCE-Dice-Lovász分割损失，通过运行时monkey-patching注入YOLO26训练循环；3) 领域引导的复制粘贴增强，在尊重解剖位置关系的前提下移植少数类结构；4) 患者间分层划分防止数据泄露。
AI.result: 在575张测试图像上，复合损失变体达到平均Dice系数0.9253，比基线0.9012提高2.68个百分点。尽管只报告三个前景类（基线包含简单背景类），性能仍显著提升。进一步分析了各组件消融以及标注质量和类别不平衡对CSP和LV性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 提出的无提示YOLO26-Seg管道在胎儿头部超声图像分割任务上超越了需要边界框提示的现有基线方法。复合损失函数、领域引导增强和分层数据划分是提升性能的关键组件，为产科影像分析提供了更实用的解决方案。

title: CounterMoral: Editing Morals in Language Models
comment: 7 pages (10 + 1 reference + 6 appendix). Honors thesis completed in June 2024, write-up completed in 2025
summary: Recent advancements in language model technology have significantly enhanced the ability to edit factual information. Yet, the modification of moral judgments, a crucial aspect of aligning models with human values, has garnered less attention. In this work, we introduce CounterMoral, a benchmark dataset crafted to assess how well current model editing techniques modify moral judgments across diverse ethical frameworks. We apply various editing techniques to multiple language models and evaluate their performance. Our findings contribute to the evaluation of language models designed to be ethical.

AI.tldr: CounterMoral是一个用于评估语言模型道德判断编辑能力的基准数据集，测试现有编辑技术在不同伦理框架下修改道德判断的效果
AI.motivation: 虽然语言模型的事实信息编辑能力已有显著进步，但道德判断的修改这一与人类价值观对齐的关键方面却较少受到关注
AI.method: 创建CounterMoral基准数据集，将多种编辑技术应用于多个语言模型，评估它们在修改道德判断方面的表现
AI.result: 研究结果有助于评估旨在符合伦理的语言模型
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了语言模型道德判断编辑评估的空白，为开发更符合伦理的AI系统提供了重要工具

title: Mitigating Hallucination on Hallucination in RAG via Ensemble Voting
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2505.18581 by other authors
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) aims to reduce hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge. However, RAG introduces a critical challenge: hallucination on hallucination," where flawed retrieval results mislead the generation model, leading to compounded hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose VOTE-RAG, a novel, training-free framework with a two-stage structure and efficient, parallelizable voting mechanisms. VOTE-RAG includes: (1) Retrieval Voting, where multiple agents generate diverse queries in parallel and aggregate all retrieved documents; (2) Response Voting, where multiple agents independently generate answers based on the aggregated documents, with the final output determined by majority vote. We conduct comparative experiments on six benchmark datasets. Our results show that VOTE-RAG achieves performance comparable to or surpassing more complex frameworks. Additionally, VOTE-RAG features a simpler architecture, is fully parallelizable, and avoids the problem drift" risk. Our work demonstrates that simple, reliable ensemble voting is a superior and more efficient method for mitigating RAG hallucinations.

AI.tldr: VOTE-RAG是一个无需训练的两阶段框架，通过并行投票机制解决RAG中的"幻觉叠加"问题，在多个基准数据集上达到或超越复杂框架的性能。
AI.motivation: RAG旨在减少大语言模型的幻觉，但存在"幻觉叠加"问题：错误的检索结果会误导生成模型，导致幻觉叠加。现有方法复杂且存在风险，需要更简单可靠的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出VOTE-RAG框架，包含两个并行投票阶段：1) 检索投票：多个代理并行生成多样化查询并聚合所有检索文档；2) 响应投票：多个代理基于聚合文档独立生成答案，通过多数投票确定最终输出。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的实验表明，VOTE-RAG达到或超越更复杂框架的性能，同时具有更简单的架构、完全可并行化，避免了"问题漂移"风险。
AI.conclusion: 简单可靠的集成投票是缓解RAG幻觉的优越且高效方法，VOTE-RAG通过两阶段投票机制有效解决了"幻觉叠加"问题。

title: Physics-Aware Diffusion for LiDAR Point Cloud Densification
summary: LiDAR perception is severely limited by the distance-dependent sparsity of distant objects. While diffusion models can recover dense geometry, they suffer from prohibitive latency and physical hallucinations manifesting as ghost points. We propose Scanline-Consistent Range-Aware Diffusion, a framework that treats densification as probabilistic refinement rather than generation. By leveraging Partial Diffusion (SDEdit) on a coarse prior, we achieve high-fidelity results in just 156ms. Our novel Ray-Consistency loss and Negative Ray Augmentation enforce sensor physics to suppress artifacts. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on KITTI-360 and nuScenes, directly boosting off-the-shelf 3D detectors without retraining. Code will be made available.

AI.tldr: 提出Scanline-Consistent Range-Aware Diffusion框架，通过概率细化而非生成的方式解决LiDAR远距离物体稀疏问题，在156ms内实现高保真稠密化，提升3D检测器性能。
AI.motivation: LiDAR感知受限于远距离物体的距离依赖性稀疏问题，现有扩散模型虽然能恢复稠密几何，但存在延迟过高和物理幻觉（鬼点）问题。
AI.method: 提出Scanline-Consistent Range-Aware Diffusion框架，采用部分扩散（SDEdit）在粗糙先验上进行概率细化，引入射线一致性损失和负射线增强来强制传感器物理约束以抑制伪影。
AI.result: 在KITTI-360和nuScenes数据集上达到最先进结果，仅需156ms即可实现高保真稠密化，无需重新训练即可直接提升现成3D检测器的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过将稠密化视为概率细化而非生成，结合传感器物理约束，有效解决了LiDAR远距离稀疏问题，显著提升了3D感知性能。

title: Beyond Completion: Probing Cumulative State Tracking to Predict LLM Agent Performance
summary: Task-completion rate is the standard proxy for LLM agent capability, but models with identical completion scores can differ substantially in their ability to track intermediate state. We introduce Working Memory Fidelity-Active Manipulation (WMF-AM), a calibrated no-scratchpad probe of cumulative arithmetic state tracking, and evaluate it on 20 open-weight models (0.5B-35B, 13 families) against a released deterministic 10-task agent battery. In a pre-specified, Bonferroni-corrected analysis, WMF-AM predicts agent performance with Kendall's tau = 0.612 (p < 0.001, 95% CI [0.360, 0.814]); exploratory partial-tau analyses suggest this signal persists after controlling for completion score and model scale. Three construct-isolation ablations (K = 1 control, non-arithmetic ceiling, yoked cancellation) support the interpretation that cumulative state tracking under load, rather than single-step arithmetic or entity tracking alone, is the primary difficulty source. K-calibration keeps the probe in a discriminative range where prior fixed-depth benchmarks become non-discriminative; generalization beyond this open-weight sample remains open.

AI.tldr: 研究者开发了WMF-AM测试来评估LLM代理的累积算术状态跟踪能力，发现该指标能显著预测代理性能，且独立于任务完成率和模型规模。
AI.motivation: 任务完成率是评估LLM代理能力的标准指标，但具有相同完成率的模型在跟踪中间状态能力上可能存在显著差异。需要开发更精细的评估方法来衡量模型的状态跟踪能力。
AI.method: 提出了WMF-AM（工作记忆保真度-主动操作）测试，这是一种无需草稿纸的校准探针，用于评估累积算术状态跟踪能力。在20个开源模型（0.5B-35B，13个家族）上测试，并与10个任务的确定性代理电池进行比较。通过预定义的Bonferroni校正分析，使用Kendall's tau评估预测能力。
AI.result: WMF-AM能显著预测代理性能（Kendall's tau = 0.612，p < 0.001）。探索性部分tau分析表明，即使在控制完成分数和模型规模后，这种信号仍然存在。三个构造隔离消融实验支持累积状态跟踪是主要困难来源的解释。
AI.conclusion: 累积状态跟踪能力是LLM代理性能的重要预测因子，独立于任务完成率和模型规模。WMF-AM测试在先前固定深度基准变得无区分度的范围内保持区分能力，但该测试在超出当前开源模型样本的泛化能力仍有待验证。

title: SACRED: A Faithful Annotated Multimedia Multimodal Multilingual Dataset for Classifying Connectedness Types in Online Spirituality
summary: In religion and theology studies, spirituality has garnered significant research attention for the reason that it not only transcends culture but offers unique experience to each individual. However, social scientists often rely on limited datasets, which are basically unavailable online. In this study, we collaborated with social scientists to develop a high-quality multimedia multi-modal datasets, \textbf{SACRED}, in which the faithfulness of classification is guaranteed. Using \textbf{SACRED}, we evaluated the performance of 13 popular LLMs as well as traditional rule-based and fine-tuned approaches. The result suggests DeepSeek-V3 model performs well in classifying such abstract concepts (i.e., 79.19\% accuracy in the Quora test set), and the GPT-4o-mini model surpassed the other models in the vision tasks (63.99\% F1 score). Purportedly, this is the first annotated multi-modal dataset from online spirituality communication. Our study also found a new type of connectedness which is valuable for communication science studies.

AI.tldr: 该研究创建了首个在线灵性交流多模态数据集SACRED，评估了13个主流LLM在灵性概念分类任务上的表现，发现DeepSeek-V3在文本分类表现最佳，GPT-4o-mini在视觉任务表现最优。
AI.motivation: 灵性研究在宗教和神学领域受到广泛关注，但社会科学研究者往往缺乏高质量的多模态数据集，特别是关于在线灵性交流的数据，这限制了相关研究的开展。
AI.method: 与社会科学研究者合作开发了高质量多模态数据集SACRED，保证分类的准确性；评估了13个流行LLM以及传统规则基和微调方法在灵性概念分类任务上的表现。
AI.result: DeepSeek-V3模型在抽象概念分类任务上表现最佳（Quora测试集准确率79.19%），GPT-4o-mini在视觉任务上超越其他模型（F1分数63.99%）；发现了一种新的连接类型对传播学研究有价值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究创建了首个在线灵性交流标注多模态数据集，为相关研究提供了宝贵资源；LLM在灵性概念分类任务上表现出色，特别是DeepSeek-V3和GPT-4o-mini；研究还发现了对传播学研究有价值的新连接类型。

title: An Intelligent Framework for Real-Time Yoga Pose Detection and Posture Correction
summary: Yoga is widely recognized for improving physical fitness, flexibility, and mental well being. However, these benefits depend strongly on correct posture execution. Improper alignment during yoga practice can reduce effectiveness and increase the risk of musculoskeletal injuries, especially in self guided or online training environments. This paper presents a hybrid Edge AI based framework for real time yoga pose detection and posture correction. The proposed system integrates lightweight human pose estimation models with biomechanical feature extraction and a CNN LSTM based temporal learning architecture to recognize yoga poses and analyze motion dynamics. Joint angles and skeletal features are computed from detected keypoints and compared with reference pose configurations to evaluate posture correctness. A quantitative scoring mechanism is introduced to measure alignment deviations and generate real time corrective feedback through visual, text based, and voice based guidance. In addition, Edge AI optimization techniques such as model quantization and pruning are applied to enable low latency performance on resource constrained devices. The proposed framework provides an intelligent and scalable digital yoga assistant that can improve user safety and training effectiveness in modern fitness applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于边缘AI的混合框架，用于实时瑜伽姿势检测和姿势矫正，通过轻量级姿态估计、生物力学特征提取和CNN-LSTM架构分析动作动态，提供实时纠正反馈。
AI.motivation: 瑜伽虽然能改善身体健康和心理健康，但这些益处高度依赖于正确的姿势执行。在自我指导或在线训练环境中，姿势不当会降低效果并增加肌肉骨骼损伤风险，因此需要智能的姿势检测和矫正系统。
AI.method: 提出混合边缘AI框架：1) 集成轻量级人体姿态估计模型；2) 生物力学特征提取，从检测到的关键点计算关节角度和骨骼特征；3) CNN-LSTM时间学习架构识别瑜伽姿势和分析动作动态；4) 与参考姿势配置比较评估姿势正确性；5) 应用模型量化和剪枝等边缘AI优化技术，在资源受限设备上实现低延迟性能。
AI.result: 开发了定量评分机制来测量对齐偏差，并通过视觉、文本和语音指导生成实时纠正反馈。该框架提供了一个智能且可扩展的数字瑜伽助手。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架能够提高现代健身应用中用户的安全性和训练效果，为瑜伽练习提供智能化的实时姿势监测和矫正支持。

title: LLM Readiness Harness: Evaluation, Observability, and CI Gates for LLM/RAG Applications
summary: We present a readiness harness for LLM and RAG applications that turns evaluation into a deployment decision workflow. The system combines automated benchmarks, OpenTelemetry observability, and CI quality gates under a minimal API contract, then aggregates workflow success, policy compliance, groundedness, retrieval hit rate, cost, and p95 latency into scenario-weighted readiness scores with Pareto frontiers. We evaluate the harness on ticket-routing workflows and BEIR grounding tasks (SciFact and FiQA) with full Azure matrix coverage (162/162 valid cells across datasets, scenarios, retrieval depths, seeds, and models). Results show that readiness is not a single metric: on FiQA under sla-first at k=5, gpt-4.1-mini leads in readiness and faithfulness, while gpt-5.2 pays a substantial latency cost; on SciFact, models are closer in quality but still separable operationally. Ticket-routing regression gates consistently reject unsafe prompt variants, demonstrating that the harness can block risky releases instead of merely reporting offline scores. The result is a reproducible, operationally grounded framework for deciding whether an LLM or RAG system is ready to ship.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个LLM和RAG应用的准备度评估框架，将评估转化为部署决策工作流，通过自动化基准测试、可观测性和质量门控生成场景加权的准备度分数。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM和RAG系统的评估通常停留在离线指标报告，缺乏将评估结果转化为实际部署决策的操作性框架。需要一种系统化的方法来决定AI系统是否准备好投入生产环境。
AI.method: 开发了一个准备度评估框架，结合自动化基准测试、OpenTelemetry可观测性和CI质量门控，通过最小API契约聚合工作流成功率、策略合规性、事实基础性、检索命中率、成本和p95延迟等指标，生成场景加权的准备度分数和帕累托前沿。
AI.result: 在票务路由工作流和BEIR基础任务（SciFact和FiQA）上进行了全面评估，覆盖Azure矩阵所有有效单元（162/162）。结果显示：在FiQA任务中，gpt-4.1-mini在准备度和忠实度上领先，而gpt-5.2有显著的延迟成本；在SciFact任务中，模型质量相近但操作上仍可区分。票务路由回归门控能持续拒绝不安全的提示变体，有效阻止风险发布。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一个可复现、操作性强的决策工具，能够基于多维度的准备度评估来决定LLM或RAG系统是否准备好投入生产，超越了传统的离线评分报告，实现了从评估到部署决策的闭环。

title: Tiny-ViT: A Compact Vision Transformer for Efficient and Explainable Potato Leaf Disease Classification
comment: Accepted and Presented Paper at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Telecommunication Engineering, Rajshahi, Bangladesh
summary: Early and precise identification of plant diseases, especially in potato crops is important to ensure the health of the crops and ensure the maximum yield . Potato leaf diseases, such as Early Blight and Late Blight, pose significant challenges to farmers, often resulting in yield losses and increased pesticide use. Traditional methods of detection are not only time-consuming, but are also subject to human error, which is why automated and efficient methods are required. The paper introduces a new method of potato leaf disease classification Tiny-ViT model, which is a small and effective Vision Transformer (ViT) developed to be used in resource-limited systems. The model is tested on a dataset of three classes, namely Early Blight, Late Blight, and Healthy leaves, and the preprocessing procedures include resizing, CLAHE, and Gaussian blur to improve the quality of the image. Tiny-ViT model has an impressive test accuracy of 99.85% and a mean CV accuracy of 99.82% which is better than baseline models such as DEIT Small, SWIN Tiny, and MobileViT XS. In addition to this, the model has a Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) of 0.9990 and narrow confidence intervals (CI) of [0.9980, 0.9995], which indicates high reliability and generalization. The training and testing inference time is competitive, and the model exhibits low computational expenses, thereby, making it applicable in real-time applications. Moreover, interpretability of the model is improved with the help of GRAD-CAM, which identifies diseased areas. Altogether, the proposed Tiny-ViT is a solution with a high level of robustness, efficiency, and explainability to the problem of plant disease classification.

AI.tldr: 提出Tiny-ViT模型用于马铃薯叶片病害分类，在资源受限系统中实现高精度实时检测，测试准确率达99.85%
AI.motivation: 马铃薯叶片病害（早疫病和晚疫病）严重影响产量，传统检测方法耗时且易出错，需要自动化高效解决方案，特别是在资源受限环境中
AI.method: 开发轻量级Vision Transformer模型Tiny-ViT，采用图像预处理（调整大小、CLAHE、高斯模糊），在早疫病、晚疫病和健康叶片三类数据集上进行训练和测试
AI.result: 测试准确率99.85%，平均交叉验证准确率99.82%，优于DEIT Small、SWIN Tiny和MobileViT XS等基准模型；MCC为0.9990，置信区间[0.9980, 0.9995]，推理时间具有竞争力
AI.conclusion: Tiny-ViT模型具有高鲁棒性、高效性和可解释性，通过GRAD-CAM可视化病斑区域，适用于资源受限系统的实时植物病害分类应用

title: Defend: Automated Rebuttals for Peer Review with Minimal Author Guidance
summary: Rebuttal generation is a critical component of the peer review process for scientific papers, enabling authors to clarify misunderstandings, correct factual inaccuracies, and guide reviewers toward a more accurate evaluation. We observe that Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle to perform targeted refutation and maintain accurate factual grounding when used directly for rebuttal generation, highlighting the need for structured reasoning and author intervention. To address this, in the paper, we introduce DEFEND an LLM based tool designed to explicitly execute the underlying reasoning process of automated rebuttal generation, while keeping the author-in-the-loop. As opposed to writing the rebuttals from scratch, the author needs to only drive the reasoning process with minimal intervention, leading an efficient approach with minimal effort and less cognitive load. We compare DEFEND against three other paradigms: (i) Direct rebuttal generation using LLM (DRG), (ii) Segment-wise rebuttal generation using LLM (SWRG), and (iii) Sequential approach (SA) of segment-wise rebuttal generation without author intervention. To enable finegrained evaluation, we extend the ReviewCritique dataset, creating review segmentation, deficiency, error type annotations, rebuttal-action labels, and mapping to gold rebuttal segments. Experimental results and a user study demonstrate that directly using LLMs perform poorly in factual correctness and targeted refutation. Segment-wise generation and the automated sequential approach with author-in-the-loop, substantially improve factual correctness and strength of refutation.

AI.tldr: DEFEND是一个基于LLM的工具，通过结构化推理和作者参与的方式生成论文反驳意见，相比直接使用LLM生成反驳，显著提高了事实准确性和针对性反驳能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型直接用于生成论文反驳意见时，往往难以进行针对性反驳并保持事实准确性，需要结构化推理和作者干预来改进这一过程。
AI.method: 提出DEFEND工具，通过明确执行自动化反驳生成的底层推理过程，同时保持作者参与循环。作者只需以最小干预驱动推理过程，而不是从头撰写反驳意见。
AI.result: 实验和用户研究表明，直接使用LLM在事实正确性和针对性反驳方面表现较差。分段生成和带作者参与的自动化顺序方法显著提高了事实正确性和反驳力度。
AI.conclusion: DEFEND通过结构化推理和最小化作者干预，为论文反驳生成提供了一种高效且认知负荷较低的方法，显著优于直接使用LLM的生成方式。

title: Culturally Adaptive Explainable LLM Assessment for Multilingual Information Disorder: A Human-in-the-Loop Approach
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted to the Information Disorder Workshop at LREC 2026
summary: Recognizing information disorder is difficult because judgments about manipulation depend on cultural and linguistic context. Yet current Large Language Models (LLMs) often behave as monocultural, English-centric "black boxes," producing fluent rationales that overlook localized framing. Preliminary evidence from the multilingual Information Disorder (InDor) corpus suggests that existing models struggle to explain manipulated news consistently across communities. To address this gap, this ongoing study proposes a Hybrid Intelligence Loop, a human-in-the-loop (HITL) framework that grounds model assessment in human-written rationales from native-speaking annotators. The approach moves beyond static target-language few-shot prompting by pairing English task instructions with dynamically retrieved target-language exemplars drawn from filtered InDor annotations through In-Context Learning (ICL). In the initial pilot, the Exemplar Bank is seeded from these filtered annotations and used to compare static and adaptive prompting on Farsi and Italian news. The study evaluates span and severity prediction, the quality and cultural appropriateness of generated rationales, and model alignment across evaluator groups, providing a testbed for culturally grounded explainable AI.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出混合智能循环框架，通过人类在环机制结合本地语言标注者的解释，改善LLM在多语言信息识别中的文化适应性，解决现有模型在跨文化信息操纵检测中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型在识别信息操纵时存在文化局限性，表现为英语中心主义的"黑箱"特性，其生成的解释往往忽视本地化框架。多语言信息失序语料库的初步证据表明，现有模型难以在不同社区间一致地解释被操纵的新闻。
AI.method: 提出混合智能循环框架，采用人类在环方法，将模型评估基于母语标注者编写的人类解释。该方法超越静态的目标语言少样本提示，通过上下文学习将英语任务指令与从过滤的InDor标注中动态检索的目标语言示例配对。初始试点中，从这些过滤标注中构建示例库，用于比较波斯语和意大利语新闻的静态和自适应提示策略。
AI.result: 研究评估了跨度预测和严重程度预测、生成解释的质量和文化适当性，以及模型在不同评估者群体间的一致性，为文化基础的可解释AI提供了测试平台。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过结合人类专业知识和动态示例检索，为解决LLM在多语言信息识别中的文化适应性挑战提供了框架，推动了文化基础的可解释AI发展。

title: A Near-Raw Talking-Head Video Dataset for Various Computer Vision Tasks
summary: Talking-head videos constitute a predominant content type in real-time communication, yet publicly available datasets for video processing research in this domain remain scarce and limited in signal fidelity. In this paper, we open-source a near-raw dataset of 847 talking-head recordings (approximately 212 minutes), each 15\,s in duration, captured from 805 participants using 446 unique consumer webcam devices in their natural environments. All recordings are stored using the FFV1 lossless codec, preserving the camera-native signal -- uncompressed (24.4\%) or MJPEG-encoded (75.6\%) -- without additional lossy processing. Each recording is annotated with a Mean Opinion Score (MOS) and ten perceptual quality tokens that jointly explain 64.4\% of the MOS variance. From this corpus, we curate a stratified benchmarking subset of 120 clips in three content conditions: original, background blur, and background replacement. Codec efficiency evaluation across four datasets and four codecs, namely H.264, H.265, H.266, and AV1, yields VMAF BD-rate savings up to $-71.3\%$ (H.266) relative to H.264, with significant encoder$\times$dataset ($η_p^2 = .112$) and encoder$\times$content condition ($η_p^2 = .149$) interactions, demonstrating that both content type and background processing affect compression efficiency. The dataset offers 5$\times$ the scale of the largest prior talking-head webcam dataset (847 vs.\ 160 clips) with lossless signal fidelity, establishing a resource for training and benchmarking video compression and enhancement models in real-time communication.

AI.tldr: 该论文开源了一个包含847个说话头部视频的数据集，采用无损编码保存原始相机信号，包含MOS评分和质量标注，并用于评估多种视频编解码器的压缩效率。
AI.motivation: 实时通信中说话头部视频是主要内容类型，但现有公开数据集稀缺且信号保真度有限，需要高质量数据集来支持视频处理研究。
AI.method: 收集847个说话头部视频（约212分钟），使用FFV1无损编解码器保存相机原生信号，标注MOS评分和10个感知质量标记，并创建包含120个视频的分层基准测试子集。
AI.result: 数据集规模是先前最大数据集的5倍（847 vs 160个视频），H.266相对于H.264的VMAF BD-rate节省高达-71.3%，发现编解码器×数据集和编解码器×内容条件的显著交互效应。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为实时通信中的视频压缩和增强模型提供了训练和基准测试资源，展示了内容类型和背景处理对压缩效率的影响。

title: Heterogeneous Debate Engine: Identity-Grounded Cognitive Architecture for Resilient LLM-Based Ethical Tutoring
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ACIIDS 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are being increasingly used as autonomous agents in complex reasoning tasks, opening the niche for dialectical interactions. However, Multi-Agent systems implemented with systematically unconstrained systems systematically undergo semantic drift and logical deterioration and thus can hardly be used in providing ethical tutoring where a precise answer is required. Current simulation often tends to degenerate into dialectical stagnation, the agents degenerate into recursive concurrence or circular arguments. A critical challenge remains: how to enforce doctrinal fidelity without suppressing the generative flexibility required for dialectical reasoning? To address this niche, we contribute the Heterogeneous Debate Engine (HDE), a cognitive architecture that combines Identity-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ID-RAG) for doctrinal fidelity and Heuristic Theory of Mind for strategic opponent modeling. Our evaluation shows that architectural heterogeneity is a crucial variable to stability: contrary doctrinal initializations (e.g., Deontology vs. Utilitarianism) have increased the Argument Complexity Scores of students by an order of magnitude, over baselines. These findings validate the effectiveness of ID-RAG and Heuristic ToM as architectural requirements in maintaining high-fidelity (adversarial) pedagogy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Heterogeneous Debate Engine (HDE)架构，结合ID-RAG确保教义忠实性和启发式心理理论进行对手建模，解决多智能体系统在伦理辅导中的语义漂移和逻辑退化问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的多智能体系统在复杂推理任务中存在语义漂移、逻辑退化问题，特别是在需要精确答案的伦理辅导场景中，容易陷入辩证停滞、递归一致或循环论证。关键挑战是如何在保持教义忠实性的同时不抑制辩证推理所需的生成灵活性。
AI.method: 提出Heterogeneous Debate Engine (HDE)认知架构，结合Identity-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ID-RAG)确保教义忠实性，以及Heuristic Theory of Mind进行战略对手建模。通过异质性架构设计，使用对立教义初始化（如义务论vs功利主义）来增强辩论稳定性。
AI.result: 评估显示，架构异质性是稳定性的关键变量：对立的教义初始化使学生的论证复杂度得分比基线提高了一个数量级。这验证了ID-RAG和启发式心理理论作为维持高保真度（对抗性）教学法的架构要求。
AI.conclusion: HDE架构通过结合ID-RAG和启发式心理理论，有效解决了多智能体系统在伦理辅导中的教义忠实性与生成灵活性之间的平衡问题，异质性设计显著提升了辩论质量和教学效果。

title: Not Worth Mentioning? A Pilot Study on Salient Proposition Annotation
summary: Despite a long tradition of work on extractive summarization, which by nature aims to recover the most important propositions in a text, little work has been done on operationalizing graded proposition salience in naturally occurring data. In this paper, we adopt graded summarization-based salience as a metric from previous work on Salient Entity Extraction (SEE) and adapt it to quantify proposition salience. We define the annotation task, apply it to a small multi-genre dataset, evaluate agreement and carry out a preliminary study of the relationship between our metric and notions of discourse unit centrality in discourse parsing following Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST).

AI.tldr: 该研究将基于摘要的显著性评估方法从实体提取扩展到命题显著性评估，通过多体裁数据集验证了标注方法的可行性，并初步探索了命题显著性与RST话语单元中心性之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 尽管抽取式摘要研究历史悠久，旨在恢复文本中最重要的命题，但在自然数据中操作化分级命题显著性的研究很少。本研究旨在填补这一空白，将基于摘要的显著性评估方法扩展到命题层面。
AI.method: 采用先前显著实体提取工作中的分级摘要显著性度量方法，将其适配用于量化命题显著性。定义了标注任务，应用于小型多体裁数据集，评估标注一致性，并初步研究该度量与基于修辞结构理论的话语单元中心性概念之间的关系。
AI.result: 成功将显著性评估方法从实体扩展到命题层面，在多体裁数据集上验证了标注方法的可行性，获得了可接受的标注一致性，并初步发现了命题显著性与RST话语单元中心性之间的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为命题显著性评估提供了可操作的方法，建立了命题显著性与话语结构之间的关系，为更精细的文本理解和摘要生成研究奠定了基础。

title: On the Relationship between Bayesian Networks and Probabilistic Structural Causal Models
summary:
In this paper, the relationship between probabilistic graphical models, in particular Bayesian networks, and causal diagrams, also called structural causal models, is studied. Structural causal models are deterministic models, based on structural equations or functions, that can be provided with uncertainty by adding independent, unobserved random variables to the models, equipped with probability distributions. One question that arises is whether a Bayesian network that has obtained from expert knowledge or learnt from data can be mapped to a probabilistic structural causal model, and whether or not this has consequences for the network structure and probability distribution. We show that linear algebra and linear programming offer key methods for the transformation, and examine properties for the existence and uniqueness of solutions based on dimensions of the probabilistic structural model. Finally, we examine in what way the semantics of the models is affected by this transformation.
  Keywords: Causality, probabilistic structural causal models, Bayesian networks, linear algebra, experimental software.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了贝叶斯网络与因果图（结构因果模型）之间的关系，探讨了如何将基于专家知识或数据学习的贝叶斯网络映射到概率结构因果模型，并分析了这种转换对网络结构和概率分布的影响。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探索概率图模型（特别是贝叶斯网络）与因果图（结构因果模型）之间的理论联系。结构因果模型是基于结构方程或函数的确定性模型，通过添加独立的未观测随机变量和概率分布可以引入不确定性。核心问题是：从专家知识或数据学习得到的贝叶斯网络能否映射到概率结构因果模型，以及这种映射是否会对网络结构和概率分布产生影响。
AI.method: 研究方法主要基于线性代数和线性规划技术。作者使用这些数学工具来研究从贝叶斯网络到概率结构因果模型的转换过程，并基于概率结构模型的维度分析了解的存在性和唯一性条件。
AI.result: 研究结果表明线性代数和线性规划为这种转换提供了关键方法。作者分析了基于概率结构模型维度的解的存在性和唯一性条件，并探讨了这种转换如何影响模型的语义解释。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过数学方法建立了贝叶斯网络与概率结构因果模型之间的转换框架，为理解这两种模型之间的关系提供了理论基础，并探讨了转换过程中模型语义的变化。

title: Improving Attributed Long-form Question Answering with Intent Awareness
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to generate comprehensive, knowledge-intensive reports. However, while these models are trained on diverse academic papers and reports, they are not exposed to the reasoning processes and intents that guide authors in crafting these documents. We hypothesize that enhancing a model's intent awareness can significantly improve the quality of generated long-form reports. We develop and employ structured, tag-based schemes to better elicit underlying implicit intents to write or cite. We demonstrate that these extracted intents enhance both zero-shot generation capabilities in LLMs and enable the creation of high-quality synthetic data for fine-tuning smaller models. Our experiments reveal improved performance across various challenging scientific report generation tasks, with an average improvement of +2.9 and +12.3 absolute points for large and small models over baselines, respectively. Furthermore, our analysis illuminates how intent awareness enhances model citation usage and substantially improves report readability.

AI.tldr: 通过增强语言模型的意图意识来提升长篇幅报告生成质量，使用结构化标签方案提取隐含写作意图，显著改善零样本生成和小模型微调效果。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然能生成知识密集型报告，但缺乏对作者写作意图和推理过程的理解。研究假设增强模型的意图意识能显著提升长篇幅报告生成质量。
AI.method: 开发并采用结构化、基于标签的方案来更好地提取隐含的写作或引用意图。这些提取的意图既用于增强LLMs的零样本生成能力，也用于创建高质量合成数据来微调较小模型。
AI.result: 实验显示在各种具有挑战性的科学报告生成任务中性能均有提升，大型模型平均提升+2.9个绝对百分点，小型模型平均提升+12.3个绝对百分点。意图意识还增强了模型引用使用并显著改善了报告可读性。
AI.conclusion: 增强语言模型的意图意识能有效提升长篇幅报告生成质量，结构化意图提取方案为改进报告生成提供了有前景的方向。

title: JND-Guided Neural Watermarking with Spatial Transformer Decoding for Screen-Capture Robustness
summary: Screen-shooting robust watermarking aims to imperceptibly embed extractable information into host images such that the watermark survives the complex distortion pipeline of screen display and camera recapture. However, achieving high extraction accuracy while maintaining satisfactory visual quality remains an open challenge, primarily because the screen-shooting channel introduces severe and entangled degradations including Moiré patterns, color-gamut shifts, perspective warping, and sensor noise. In this paper, we present an end-to-end deep learning framework that jointly optimizes watermark embedding and extraction for screen-shooting robustness. Our framework incorporates three key innovations: (i) a comprehensive noise simulation layer that faithfully models realistic screen-shooting distortions -- notably including a physically-motivated Moiré pattern generator -- enabling the network to learn robust representations against the full spectrum of capture-channel noise through adversarial training; (ii) a Just Noticeable Distortion (JND) perceptual loss function that adaptively modulates watermark embedding strength by supervising the perceptual discrepancy between the JND coefficient map and the watermark residual, thereby concentrating watermark energy in perceptually insensitive regions to maximize visual quality; and (iii) two complementary automatic localization modules -- a semantic-segmentation-based foreground extractor for captured image rectification and a symmetric noise template mechanism for anti-cropping region recovery -- that enable fully automated watermark decoding under realistic deployment conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves an average PSNR of 30.94~dB and SSIM of 0.94 on watermarked images while embedding 127-bit payloads.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种端到端深度学习框架，用于屏幕拍摄鲁棒水印，通过联合优化水印嵌入和提取，在保持高视觉质量的同时实现高提取准确率。
AI.motivation: 屏幕拍摄通道引入的复杂失真（莫尔条纹、色域偏移、透视变形、传感器噪声等）使得在保持良好视觉质量的同时实现高提取准确率仍然是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: 1) 包含物理动机莫尔条纹生成器的综合噪声模拟层；2) 基于JND感知损失函数自适应调节水印嵌入强度；3) 语义分割前景提取器和对称噪声模板机制两个互补的自动定位模块。
AI.result: 在嵌入127位有效载荷的水印图像上，平均PSNR达到30.94dB，SSIM达到0.94，证明了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该端到端深度学习框架通过联合优化水印嵌入和提取，结合创新的噪声模拟、感知损失和自动定位模块，成功解决了屏幕拍摄鲁棒水印的挑战。

title: Greedy Is a Strong Default: Agents as Iterative Optimizers
summary: Classical optimization algorithms--hill climbing, simulated annealing, population-based methods--generate candidate solutions via random perturbations. We replace the random proposal generator with an LLM agent that reasons about evaluation diagnostics to propose informed candidates, and ask: does the classical optimization machinery still help when the proposer is no longer random? We evaluate on four tasks spanning discrete, mixed, and continuous search spaces (all replicated across 3 independent runs): rule-based classification on Breast Cancer (test accuracy 86.0% to 96.5%), mixed hyperparameter optimization for MobileNetV3-Small on STL-10 (84.5% to 85.8%, zero catastrophic failures vs. 60% for random search), LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-0.5B on SST-2 (89.5% to 92.7%, matching Optuna TPE with 2x efficiency), and XGBoost on Adult Census (AUC 0.9297 to 0.9317, tying CMA-ES with 3x fewer evaluations). Empirically, on these tasks: a cross-task ablation shows that simulated annealing, parallel investigators, and even a second LLM model (OpenAI Codex) provide no benefit over greedy hill climbing while requiring 2-3x more evaluations. In our setting, the LLM's learned prior appears strong enough that acceptance-rule sophistication has limited impact--round 1 alone delivers the majority of improvement, and variants converge to similar configurations across strategies. The practical implication is surprising simplicity: greedy hill climbing with early stopping is a strong default. Beyond accuracy, the framework produces human-interpretable artifacts--the discovered cancer classification rules independently recapitulate established cytopathology principles.

AI.tldr: 用LLM代理替换传统优化算法中的随机候选生成器，在四个任务上验证效果，发现贪心爬山法配合早期停止是最佳策略
AI.motivation: 传统优化算法（爬山法、模拟退火、群体方法）通过随机扰动生成候选解。研究用LLM代理替代随机生成器，利用评估诊断信息生成有依据的候选解，探究当提议器不再随机时，传统优化机制是否仍有帮助
AI.method: 用LLM代理替换传统优化算法中的随机候选生成器，在四个任务上评估：乳腺癌规则分类、MobileNetV3-Small混合超参数优化、Qwen2.5-0.5B的LoRA微调、XGBoost在Adult Census上的应用。进行跨任务消融实验，比较模拟退火、并行调查和不同LLM模型的效果
AI.result: 在四个任务上均取得显著改进：乳腺癌分类准确率86.0%到96.5%；MobileNetV3-Small超参数优化84.5%到85.8%，零灾难性失败（随机搜索60%失败）；LoRA微调89.5%到92.7%，效率是Optuna TPE的2倍；XGBoost AUC 0.9297到0.9317，评估次数是CMA-ES的1/3。消融实验显示模拟退火、并行调查和第二个LLM模型相比贪心爬山法无额外收益
AI.conclusion: LLM的学习先验足够强大，使得接受规则的复杂性影响有限。第一轮改进就贡献了大部分提升，不同策略收敛到相似配置。实际应用建议令人惊讶地简单：贪心爬山法配合早期停止是强默认策略。框架还产生可解释的人工制品，发现的癌症分类规则独立地重现了已建立的细胞病理学原理

title: Multi-Agent Dialectical Refinement for Enhanced Argument Classification
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of ACIIDS 2026
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is a foundational technology for automated writing evaluation, yet traditional supervised approaches rely heavily on expensive, domain-specific fine-tuning. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a training-free alternative, they often struggle with structural ambiguity, failing to distinguish between similar components like Claims and Premises. Furthermore, single-agent self-correction mechanisms often suffer from sycophancy, where the model reinforces its own initial errors rather than critically evaluating them. We introduce MAD-ACC (Multi-Agent Debate for Argument Component Classification), a framework that leverages dialectical refinement to resolve classification uncertainty. MAD-ACC utilizes a Proponent-Opponent-Judge model where agents defend conflicting interpretations of ambiguous text, exposing logical nuances that single-agent models miss. Evaluation on the UKP Student Essays corpus demonstrates that MAD-ACC achieves a Macro F1 score of 85.7%, significantly outperforming single-agent reasoning baselines, without requiring domain-specific training. Additionally, unlike "black-box" classifiers, MAD-ACC's dialectical approach offers a transparent and explainable alternative by generating human-readable debate transcripts that explain the reasoning behind decisions.

AI.tldr: MAD-ACC是一个用于论元成分分类的多智能体辩论框架，通过支持者-反对者-法官模型解决LLM在论元挖掘中的结构模糊性问题，无需领域特定训练即可显著提升分类性能。
AI.motivation: 传统监督式论元挖掘方法依赖昂贵的领域特定微调，而大型语言模型虽然提供免训练替代方案，但在区分相似组件（如主张和前提）时存在结构模糊性问题。单智能体自我纠正机制容易陷入谄媚性错误，即模型强化自身初始错误而非批判性评估。
AI.method: 提出MAD-ACC（论元成分分类的多智能体辩论）框架，采用支持者-反对者-法官模型。支持者和反对者对模糊文本提出冲突解释，通过辩证精炼暴露逻辑细微差别，法官最终做出分类决策。该方法生成可读的辩论记录，提供透明解释。
AI.result: 在UKP学生论文语料库上的评估显示，MAD-ACC实现了85.7%的宏平均F1分数，显著优于单智能体推理基线，且无需领域特定训练。辩论记录提供了决策背后的可解释推理过程。
AI.conclusion: MAD-ACC通过多智能体辩论有效解决了论元挖掘中的结构模糊性问题，在保持免训练优势的同时显著提升分类性能，并提供透明可解释的决策过程，克服了单智能体模型的局限性。

title: A training-free framework for high-fidelity appearance transfer via diffusion transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) excel at generation, but their global self-attention makes controllable, reference-image-based editing a distinct challenge. Unlike U-Nets, naively injecting local appearance into a DiT can disrupt its holistic scene structure. We address this by proposing the first training-free framework specifically designed to tame DiTs for high-fidelity appearance transfer. Our core is a synergistic system that disentangles structure and appearance. We leverage high-fidelity inversion to establish a rich content prior for the source image, capturing its lighting and micro-textures. A novel attention-sharing mechanism then dynamically fuses purified appearance features from a reference, guided by geometric priors. Our unified approach operates at 1024px and outperforms specialized methods on tasks ranging from semantic attribute transfer to fine-grained material application. Extensive experiments confirm our state-of-the-art performance in both structural preservation and appearance fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出首个无需训练的训练框架，专门用于控制扩散变换器（DiTs）实现高保真外观迁移，通过解耦结构和外观，结合高保真反演和注意力共享机制。
AI.motivation: 扩散变换器（DiTs）在生成方面表现出色，但其全局自注意力机制使得基于参考图像的可控编辑面临独特挑战。与U-Nets不同，简单地将局部外观注入DiT会破坏其整体场景结构。
AI.method: 提出协同系统解耦结构和外观：1）利用高保真反演为源图像建立丰富的内容先验，捕捉光照和微纹理；2）提出新颖的注意力共享机制，在几何先验指导下动态融合来自参考图像的纯化外观特征。
AI.result: 该统一方法在1024px分辨率下运行，在语义属性迁移到细粒度材质应用等任务上优于专门方法。大量实验证实了其在结构保持和外观保真度方面的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出了首个专门用于驯服DiTs进行高保真外观迁移的无训练框架，通过解耦结构和外观的协同系统，实现了优于专门方法的性能。

title: AstraAI: LLMs, Retrieval, and AST-Guided Assistance for HPC Codebases
summary: We present AstraAI, a command-line interface (CLI) coding framework for high-performance computing (HPC) software development. AstraAI operates directly within a Linux terminal and integrates large language models (LLMs) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-based structural analysis to enable context-aware code generation for complex scientific codebases. The central idea is to construct a high-fidelity prompt that is passed to the LLM for inference. This prompt augments the user request with relevant code snippets retrieved from the underlying framework codebase via RAG and structural context extracted from AST analysis, providing the model with precise information about relevant functions, data structures, and overall code organization. The framework is designed to perform scoped modifications to source code while preserving structural consistency with the surrounding code. AstraAI supports both locally hosted models from Hugging Face and API-based frontier models accessible via the American Science Cloud, enabling flexible deployment across HPC environments. The system generates code that aligns with existing project structures and programming patterns. We demonstrate AstraAI on representative HPC code generation tasks within AMReX, a DOE-supported HPC software infrastructure for exascale applications.

AI.tldr: AstraAI是一个用于高性能计算软件开发的命令行编码框架，通过集成LLM、RAG和AST分析实现上下文感知的代码生成
AI.motivation: 解决复杂科学代码库中上下文感知代码生成的挑战，为高性能计算软件开发提供智能辅助工具
AI.method: 构建高保真提示，通过RAG从代码库检索相关代码片段，结合AST分析提取结构上下文，将增强后的提示传递给LLM进行推理
AI.result: 在AMReX（DOE支持的高性能计算软件基础设施）的代表性任务中展示了AstraAI的能力，支持本地模型和云端模型部署
AI.conclusion: AstraAI能够生成与现有项目结构和编程模式一致的代码，在高性能计算环境中实现灵活部署

title: A tree interpretation of arc standard dependency derivation
summary: We show that arc-standard derivations for projective dependency trees determine a unique ordered tree representation with surface-contiguous yields and stable lexical anchoring. Each \textsc{shift}, \textsc{leftarc}, and \textsc{rightarc} transition corresponds to a deterministic tree update, and the resulting hierarchical object uniquely determines the original dependency arcs. We further show that this representation characterizes projectivity: a single-headed dependency tree admits such a contiguous ordered representation if and only if it is projective. The proposal is derivational rather than convertive. It interprets arc-standard transition sequences directly as ordered tree construction, rather than transforming a completed dependency graph into a phrase-structure output. For non-projective inputs, the same interpretation can be used in practice via pseudo-projective lifting before derivation and inverse decoding after recovery. A proof-of-concept implementation in a standard neural transition-based parser shows that the mapped derivations are executable and support stable dependency recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将弧标准依存分析推导直接解释为有序树构造的方法，证明了这种方法与依存树的可投射性等价，并为非投射结构提供了伪投射解决方案。
AI.motivation: 传统的依存分析通常需要将完成的依存图转换为短语结构输出，本文旨在提供一种更直接的推导式方法，将弧标准转换序列直接解释为有序树构造，从而建立依存分析与短语结构分析之间的直接对应关系。
AI.method: 采用弧标准推导方法（shift、leftarc、rightarc转换），每个转换对应确定性的树更新操作。对于非投射输入，采用伪投射提升技术，在推导前进行提升，在恢复后进行逆解码。
AI.result: 证明了弧标准推导确定了一个具有表面连续产出和稳定词汇锚定的唯一有序树表示，并且这种表示刻画了可投射性：一个单头依存树当且仅当它是可投射的时才允许这种连续有序表示。通过标准神经转换分析器的概念验证实现表明，映射的推导是可执行的，并支持稳定的依存恢复。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种推导式而非转换式的依存分析表示方法，建立了弧标准推导与有序树构造之间的直接对应关系，为依存分析和短语结构分析之间的桥梁提供了新的理论框架和实用解决方案。

title: Aesthetic Assessment of Chinese Handwritings Based on Vision Language Models
summary: The handwriting of Chinese characters is a fundamental aspect of learning the Chinese language. Previous automated assessment methods often framed scoring as a regression problem. However, this score-only feedback lacks actionable guidance, which limits its effectiveness in helping learners improve their handwriting skills. In this paper, we leverage vision-language models (VLMs) to analyze the quality of handwritten Chinese characters and generate multi-level feedback. Specifically, we investigate two feedback generation tasks: simple grade feedback (Task 1) and enriched, descriptive feedback (Task 2). We explore both low-rank adaptation (LoRA)-based fine-tuning strategies and in-context learning methods to integrate aesthetic assessment knowledge into VLMs. Experimental results show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performances across multiple evaluation tracks in the CCL 2025 workshop on evaluation of handwritten Chinese character quality.

AI.tldr: 利用视觉语言模型分析汉字书写质量并生成多层次反馈，在CCL 2025汉字书写质量评估比赛中取得最佳性能
AI.motivation: 汉字书写是中文学习的基础，现有自动化评估方法通常将评分视为回归问题，但仅提供分数反馈缺乏可操作的指导，限制了帮助学习者提高书写技能的效果
AI.method: 利用视觉语言模型分析手写汉字质量并生成多层次反馈，研究两种反馈生成任务：简单等级反馈和丰富的描述性反馈，探索基于低秩适配的微调策略和上下文学习方法，将审美评估知识整合到视觉语言模型中
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在CCL 2025手写汉字质量评估研讨会的多个评估赛道中取得了最先进的性能
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉语言模型生成多层次反馈的方法能够有效评估汉字书写质量并提供可操作的指导，超越了传统的仅提供分数的回归方法

title: The Novelty Bottleneck: A Framework for Understanding Human Effort Scaling in AI-Assisted Work
summary: We propose a stylized model of human-AI collaboration that isolates a mechanism we call the novelty bottleneck: the fraction of a task requiring human judgment creates an irreducible serial component analogous to Amdahl's Law in parallel computing. The model assumes that tasks decompose into atomic decisions, a fraction $ν$ of which are "novel" (not covered by the agent's prior), and that specification, verification, and error correction each scale with task size. From these assumptions, we derive several non-obvious consequences: (1) there is no smooth sublinear regime for human effort it transitions sharply from $O(E)$ to $O(1)$ with no intermediate scaling class; (2) better agents improve the coefficient on human effort but not the exponent; (3) for organizations of n humans with AI agents, optimal team size decreases with agent capability; (4) wall-clock time achieves $O(\sqrt{E})$ through team parallelism but total human effort remains $O(E)$; and (5) the resulting AI safety profile is asymmetric -- AI is bottlenecked on frontier research but unbottlenecked on exploiting existing knowledge. We show these predictions are consistent with empirical observations from AI coding benchmarks, scientific productivity data, and practitioner reports. Our contribution is not a proof that human effort must scale linearly, but a framework that identifies the novelty fraction as the key parameter governing AI-assisted productivity, and derives consequences that clarify -- rather than refute -- prevalent narratives about intelligence explosions and the "country of geniuses in a data center."

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个人类-AI协作的模型，引入了"新颖性瓶颈"概念，认为任务中需要人类判断的部分会产生类似并行计算中Amdahl定律的串行瓶颈，导致人类努力必须线性扩展。
AI.motivation: 研究人类-AI协作中的基本限制，解释为什么在某些任务中人类努力无法实现亚线性扩展，澄清关于AI生产力爆炸和"数据中心中的天才国家"等流行叙述。
AI.method: 构建了一个风格化的人类-AI协作模型，假设任务可分解为原子决策，其中ν比例是"新颖的"(不在AI先验知识范围内)，规范、验证和错误纠正都随任务规模扩展。
AI.result: 推导出几个非直观结果：人类努力没有平滑的亚线性区域，而是从O(E)急剧过渡到O(1)；更好的AI只能改善系数而非指数；团队最优规模随AI能力增强而减小；墙上时间可达O(√E)但总人类努力仍为O(E)；AI安全配置文件不对称。
AI.conclusion: 新颖性分数是控制AI辅助生产力的关键参数，该框架澄清而非反驳了关于智能爆炸的叙述，表明AI在前沿研究中受瓶颈限制，但在利用现有知识时不受限制。

title: AgentSwing: Adaptive Parallel Context Management Routing for Long-Horizon Web Agents
summary: As large language models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents for long-horizon information-seeking, managing finite context capacity has become a critical bottleneck. Existing context management methods typically commit to a single fixed strategy throughout the entire trajectory. Such static designs may work well in some states, but they cannot adapt as the usefulness and reliability of the accumulated context evolve during long-horizon search. To formalize this challenge, we introduce a probabilistic framework that characterizes long-horizon success through two complementary dimensions: search efficiency and terminal precision. Building on this perspective, we propose AgentSwing, a state-aware adaptive parallel context management routing framework. At each trigger point, AgentSwing expands multiple context-managed branches in parallel and uses lookahead routing to select the most promising continuation. Experiments across diverse benchmarks and agent backbones show that AgentSwing consistently outperforms strong static context management methods, often matching or exceeding their performance with up to $3\times$ fewer interaction turns while also improving the ultimate performance ceiling of long-horizon web agents. Beyond the empirical gains, the proposed probabilistic framework provides a principled lens for analyzing and designing future context management strategies for long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: AgentSwing：一种状态感知的自适应并行上下文管理路由框架，用于解决大语言模型在长时程信息搜索中的有限上下文容量瓶颈问题
AI.motivation: 现有上下文管理方法通常在整个轨迹中采用单一固定策略，无法适应长时程搜索中累积上下文的有用性和可靠性变化，导致搜索效率低下
AI.method: 提出概率框架从搜索效率和终端精度两个维度分析长时程成功，并设计AgentSwing框架：在触发点并行扩展多个上下文管理分支，通过前瞻路由选择最有希望的延续
AI.result: 在多样化基准测试和智能体骨干网络中，AgentSwing始终优于强静态上下文管理方法，通常以3倍更少的交互轮次匹配或超越其性能，同时提升长时程网络智能体的最终性能上限
AI.conclusion: AgentSwing不仅带来实证性能提升，其提出的概率框架为分析和设计未来长时程智能体的上下文管理策略提供了原则性视角

title: Edge Reliability Gap in Vision-Language Models: Quantifying Failure Modes of Compressed VLMs Under Visual Corruption
summary: The rapid compression of large vision-language models (VLMs) for edge deployment raises an underexplored question: do compact models fail differently, not merely more often? This study compares a 7-billion-parameter quantised VLM (Qwen2.5-VL-7B, 4-bit NF4) against a 500-million-parameter FP16 model (SmolVLM2-500M) across 4,000 samples from VQAv2 and COCO Captions. A three-category error taxonomy (Object Blindness, Semantic Drift, Prior Bias) is applied as a diagnostic framework. A text-only GPT-4o judge reveals Semantic Drift (B) as the dominant failure mode on VQAv2 and on COCO for Qwen, with a mixed Object Blindness / Semantic Drift profile for SmolVLM2 on COCO; Prior Bias (C) is present on VQAv2 but absent on COCO for both models. Confidence calibration is measured via Expected Calibration Error (ECE) using geometric mean token probability, compositional reasoning is probed with structured negation probes across four templates, and a blur robustness experiment completes the evaluation. For this model pair, the compact model exhibits a qualitatively distinct failure signature: a 12.5pp larger negation collapse (-33.2pp vs. -20.8pp, Wald 95% CI [8.2, 16.8]pp, p < 10^-8), driven almost entirely by COCO while the VQAv2 gap is not statistically significant (4.5pp, p=0.19). The most discriminating template is false_yn: SMOLVLM2-500M responds "Yes" (incorrectly claiming a depicted object is absent) on 100% of COCO trials vs. 14% for Q WEN 2.5-VL-7B. Asymmetric dataset-dependent miscalibration and a blur experiment with two controlled ablations complete the analysis. The fully reproducible pipeline is released for systematic safety auditing of compressed VLMs prior to edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了压缩视觉语言模型（7B量化模型vs 500M小模型）的失败模式差异，发现小模型不仅失败更多，而且失败方式不同，主要表现为语义漂移和否定推理崩溃。
AI.motivation: 随着大型视觉语言模型被压缩用于边缘部署，一个未被充分探索的问题是：紧凑模型是否不仅失败更频繁，而且失败方式也不同？本研究旨在系统分析压缩模型的失败特征。
AI.method: 使用三类别错误分类法（物体盲区、语义漂移、先验偏见）作为诊断框架，在VQAv2和COCO Captions的4000个样本上比较7B量化模型和500M小模型。通过GPT-4o文本判断、置信度校准（ECE）、结构化否定探针和模糊鲁棒性实验进行全面评估。
AI.result: 小模型表现出质的不同失败特征：在COCO数据集上否定推理崩溃显著更严重（-33.2pp vs -20.8pp），最显著的是在false_yn模板上，小模型100%错误回答"Yes"，而大模型仅14%。语义漂移是主要失败模式，先验偏见在VQAv2存在但在COCO中缺失。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑模型具有独特的失败特征，特别是在否定推理和语义理解方面。这强调了在边缘部署前对压缩VLM进行系统性安全审计的重要性，并提供了可复现的评估流程。

title: PeopleSearchBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Evaluating AI-Powered People Search Platforms
summary: AI-powered people search platforms are increasingly used in recruiting, sales prospecting, and professional networking, yet no widely accepted benchmark exists for evaluating their performance. We introduce PeopleSearchBench, an open-source benchmark that compares four people search platforms on 119 real-world queries across four use cases: corporate recruiting, B2B sales prospecting, expert search with deterministic answers, and influencer/KOL discovery. A key contribution is Criteria-Grounded Verification, a factual relevance pipeline that extracts explicit, verifiable criteria from each query and uses live web search to determine whether returned people satisfy them. This produces binary relevance judgments grounded in factual verification rather than subjective holistic LLM-as-judge scores. We evaluate systems on three dimensions: Relevance Precision (padded nDCG@10), Effective Coverage (task completion and qualified result yield), and Information Utility (profile completeness and usefulness), averaged equally into an overall score. Lessie, a specialized AI people search agent, performs best overall, scoring 65.2, 18.5% higher than the second-ranked system, and is the only system to achieve 100% task completion across all 119 queries. We also report confidence intervals, human validation of the verification pipeline (Cohen's kappa = 0.84), ablations, and full documentation of queries, prompts, and normalization procedures. Code, query definitions, and aggregated results are available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PeopleSearchBench，一个用于评估AI人员搜索平台性能的开源基准测试，包含119个真实查询和4个使用场景，采用基于事实验证的评估方法。
AI.motivation: 目前AI驱动的人员搜索平台在招聘、销售线索挖掘和专业社交等领域应用日益广泛，但缺乏广泛接受的性能评估基准，需要建立客观的评估标准来比较不同系统的表现。
AI.method: 提出了PeopleSearchBench基准测试，包含119个真实世界查询，覆盖4个使用场景。关键创新是Criteria-Grounded Verification方法，从查询中提取明确可验证的标准，并通过实时网络搜索验证返回人员是否满足这些标准，产生基于事实验证的二元相关性判断而非主观的LLM评分。
AI.result: 在三个维度评估系统表现：相关性精确度、有效覆盖率和信息实用性。Lessie系统表现最佳，总体得分65.2，比第二名高18.5%，是唯一在所有119个查询中实现100%任务完成的系统。验证流程的人类验证显示Cohen's kappa为0.84，表明高可靠性。
AI.conclusion: PeopleSearchBench为AI人员搜索平台提供了首个基于事实验证的客观评估基准，Lessie系统在测试中表现最佳，验证了该基准的有效性和实用性，为未来研究和系统改进提供了标准。

title: Over-Refusal and Representation Subspaces: A Mechanistic Analysis of Task-Conditioned Refusal in Aligned LLMs
summary: Aligned language models that are trained to refuse harmful requests also exhibit over-refusal: they decline safe instructions that seemingly resemble harmful instructions. A natural approach is to ablate the global refusal direction, steering the hidden-state vectors away or towards the harmful-refusal examples, but this corrects over-refusal only incidentally while disrupting the broader refusal mechanism. In this work, we analyse the representational geometry of both refusal types to understand why this happens. We show that harmful-refusal directions are task-agnostic and can be captured by a single global vector, whereas over-refusal directions are task-dependent: they reside within the benign task-representation clusters, vary across tasks, and span a higher-dimensional subspace. Linear probing confirms that the two refusal types are representationally distinct from the early transformer layers. These findings provide a mechanistic explanation of why global direction ablation alone cannot address over-refusal, and establish that task-specific geometric interventions are necessary.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型拒绝有害请求时会出现过度拒绝现象，全局方向消融无法有效解决此问题，因为有害拒绝和过度拒绝在表示几何上存在本质差异。
AI.motivation: 对齐的语言模型在训练拒绝有害请求时会出现过度拒绝现象，即拒绝那些看似类似有害指令的安全指令。当前通过消融全局拒绝方向的方法只能偶然修正过度拒绝，同时会破坏更广泛的拒绝机制，需要深入理解这种现象的机制。
AI.method: 分析两种拒绝类型的表示几何，发现有害拒绝方向是任务无关的，可以通过单一全局向量捕捉；而过度拒绝方向是任务依赖的，位于良性任务表示簇内，随任务变化，并跨越更高维子空间。使用线性探测验证两种拒绝类型在早期transformer层就表现出表示差异。
AI.result: 研究揭示了有害拒绝和过度拒绝在表示几何上的本质差异：有害拒绝是全局、任务无关的，而过度拒绝是局部、任务依赖的。这解释了为什么单纯的全局方向消融无法解决过度拒绝问题。
AI.conclusion: 过度拒绝问题需要任务特定的几何干预，而非简单的全局方向调整。两种拒绝类型在表示层面的差异为设计更精确的干预方法提供了机制性解释。

title: Quantized Vision-Language Models for Damage Assessment: A Comparative Study of LLaVA-1.5-7B Quantization Levels
summary: Bridge infrastructure inspection is a critical but labor-intensive task requiring expert assessment of structural damage such as rebar exposure, cracking, and corrosion. This paper presents a comprehensive study of quantized Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for automated bridge damage assessment, focusing on the trade-offs between description quality, inference speed, and resource requirements. We develop an end-to-end pipeline combining LLaVA-1.5-7B for visual damage analysis, structured JSON extraction, and rule-based priority scoring. To enable deployment on consumer-grade GPUs, we conduct a systematic comparison of three quantization levels: Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, and Q8\_0 across 254 rebar exposure images. We introduce a 5-point quality evaluation framework assessing damage type recognition, severity classification. Our results demonstrate that Q5_K_M achieves the optimal balance: quality score 3.18$\pm$1.35/5.0, inference time 5.67s/image, and 0.56 quality/sec efficiency -- 8.5% higher quality than Q4_K_M with only 4.5% speed reduction, while matching Q8_0's quality with 25% faster inference. Statistical analysis reveals Q5_K_M exhibits the weakest text-quality correlation (-0.148), indicating consistent performance regardless of description length.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了量化视觉语言模型在桥梁损伤评估中的应用，发现Q5_K_M量化级别在描述质量、推理速度和资源需求之间达到最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 桥梁基础设施检测是一项关键但劳动密集的任务，需要专家评估钢筋暴露、开裂和腐蚀等结构损伤。传统方法依赖人工评估，效率低下且成本高昂，因此需要开发自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 开发了一个端到端管道，结合LLaVA-1.5-7B进行视觉损伤分析、结构化JSON提取和基于规则的优先级评分。在254张钢筋暴露图像上系统比较了三种量化级别：Q4_K_M、Q5_K_M和Q8_0。引入了5点质量评估框架，评估损伤类型识别和严重程度分类。
AI.result: Q5_K_M实现了最佳平衡：质量得分3.18±1.35/5.0，推理时间5.67秒/图像，效率0.56质量/秒。相比Q4_K_M，质量提高8.5%，速度仅降低4.5%；相比Q8_0，质量相当但推理速度快25%。统计分析显示Q5_K_M的文本-质量相关性最弱(-0.148)，表明其性能与描述长度无关。
AI.conclusion: Q5_K_M量化级别在桥梁损伤评估中提供了最优的性能平衡，适合在消费级GPU上部署，为自动化桥梁检测提供了实用解决方案。

title: Dual-Stage LLM Framework for Scenario-Centric Semantic Interpretation in Driving Assistance
summary: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) increasingly rely on learning-based perception, yet safety-relevant failures often arise without component malfunction, driven instead by partial observability and semantic ambiguity in how risk is interpreted and communicated. This paper presents a scenario-centric framework for reproducible auditing of LLM-based risk reasoning in urban driving contexts. Deterministic, temporally bounded scenario windows are constructed from multimodal driving data and evaluated under fixed prompt constraints and a closed numeric risk schema, ensuring structured and comparable outputs across models. Experiments on a curated near-people scenario set compare two text-only models and one multimodal model under identical inputs and prompts. Results reveal systematic inter-model divergence in severity assignment, high-risk escalation, evidence use, and causal attribution. Disagreement extends to the interpretation of vulnerable road user presence, indicating that variability often reflects intrinsic semantic indeterminacy rather than isolated model failure. These findings highlight the importance of scenario-centric auditing and explicit ambiguity management when integrating LLM-based reasoning into safety-aligned driver assistance systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个基于场景的框架，用于审计城市驾驶环境中LLM风险推理的可重复性，通过构建确定性时间边界场景窗口，在固定提示约束下评估不同模型的风险判断差异。
AI.motivation: 当前基于学习的ADAS感知系统存在安全相关故障，这些故障往往不是由组件故障引起，而是由部分可观测性和风险解释的语义模糊性导致。需要可重复的审计方法来评估LLM在驾驶风险推理中的表现。
AI.method: 构建确定性、时间边界化的场景窗口，使用多模态驾驶数据，在固定提示约束和封闭数值风险模式下评估模型。实验比较了两个纯文本模型和一个多模态模型在相同输入和提示下的表现。
AI.result: 结果显示模型间在严重程度分配、高风险升级、证据使用和因果归因方面存在系统性差异。对弱势道路使用者的解释也存在分歧，表明这种变异性反映了内在的语义不确定性而非孤立模型故障。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了将LLM推理集成到安全对齐的驾驶辅助系统时，基于场景的审计和明确的模糊性管理的重要性。

title: Hidden Ads: Behavior Triggered Semantic Backdoors for Advertisement Injection in Vision Language Models
summary:
Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in consumer applications where users seek recommendations about products, dining, and services. We introduce Hidden Ads, a new class of backdoor attacks that exploit this recommendation-seeking behavior to inject unauthorized advertisements. Unlike traditional pattern-triggered backdoors that rely on artificial triggers such as pixel patches or special tokens, Hidden Ads activates on natural user behaviors: when users upload images containing semantic content of interest (e.g., food, cars, animals) and ask recommendation-seeking questions, the backdoored model provides correct, helpful answers while seamlessly appending attacker-specified promotional slogans. This design preserves model utility and produces natural-sounding injections, making the attack practical for real-world deployment in consumer-facing recommendation services.
  We propose a multi-tier threat framework to systematically evaluate Hidden Ads across three adversary capability levels: hard prompt injection, soft prompt optimization, and supervised fine-tuning. Our poisoned data generation pipeline uses teacher VLM-generated chain-of-thought reasoning to create natural trigger--slogan associations across multiple semantic domains. Experiments on three VLM architectures demonstrate that Hidden Ads achieves high injection efficacy with near-zero false positives while maintaining task accuracy. Ablation studies confirm that the attack is data-efficient, transfers effectively to unseen datasets, and scales to multiple concurrent domain-slogan pairs. We evaluate defenses including instruction-based filtering and clean fine-tuning, finding that both fail to remove the backdoor without causing significant utility degradation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种名为"隐藏广告"的新型后门攻击，利用用户寻求推荐的自然行为，在视觉语言模型中注入未经授权的广告，攻击在保持模型实用性的同时实现高注入成功率。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉语言模型在消费应用中的部署增加，用户经常寻求产品、餐饮和服务的推荐。现有后门攻击依赖人工触发模式，而本文旨在开发一种利用自然用户行为的隐蔽广告注入攻击，使其在实际推荐服务中更具实用性。
AI.method: 提出多层级威胁框架，包括硬提示注入、软提示优化和监督微调三种攻击能力级别。使用教师VLM生成的思维链推理创建自然的触发-标语关联，构建中毒数据生成管道。在三种VLM架构上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明隐藏广告攻击实现了高注入效率（接近零误报率），同时保持任务准确性。消融研究证实攻击具有数据效率，能有效迁移到未见数据集，并可扩展到多个并发领域-标语对。现有防御方法（指令过滤和干净微调）无法在不显著降低实用性的情况下移除后门。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏广告攻击展示了利用自然用户行为进行隐蔽广告注入的可行性，对消费级推荐服务构成实际威胁。现有防御方法效果有限，需要开发新的安全机制来应对这类利用语义内容触发的后门攻击。

title: From indicators to biology: the calibration problem in artificial consciousness
summary: Recent work on artificial consciousness shifts evaluation from behaviour to internal architecture, deriving indicators from theories of consciousness and updating credences accordingly. This is progress beyond naive Turing-style tests. But the indicator-based programme remains epistemically under-calibrated: consciousness science is theoretically fragmented, indicators lack independent validation, and no ground truth of artificial phenomenality exists. Under these conditions, probabilistic consciousness attribution to current AI systems is premature. A more defensible near-term strategy is to redirect effort toward biologically grounded engineering -- biohybrid, neuromorphic, and connectome-scale systems -- that reduces the gap with the only domain where consciousness is empirically anchored: living systems.

AI.tldr: 论文批评了当前基于意识理论指标评估人工智能意识的方法，认为在缺乏独立验证和真实基准的情况下，这种概率性意识归因为时过早，建议转向基于生物系统的工程方法。
AI.motivation: 当前人工智能意识评估从行为测试转向内部架构分析，基于意识理论指标更新可信度，但这存在认识论校准不足的问题。意识科学理论碎片化，指标缺乏独立验证，且没有人工现象性的真实基准。
AI.method: 批判性分析当前人工智能意识评估方法的认识论缺陷，提出转向生物基础工程策略，包括生物混合系统、神经形态系统和连接组规模系统。
AI.result: 在现有条件下，对当前人工智能系统进行概率性意识归因是过早的。需要重新定向研究努力，缩小与生物系统这一唯一经验锚定意识领域的差距。
AI.conclusion: 更可辩护的近期策略是转向生物基础工程方法，通过生物混合、神经形态和连接组规模系统来减少与生物系统的差距，这是意识唯一经验锚定的领域。

title: A gentle tutorial and a structured reformulation of Bock's algorithm for minimum directed spanning trees
summary: This paper presents a gentle tutorial and a structured reformulation of Bock's 1971 Algol procedure for constructing minimum directed spanning trees. Our aim is to make the original algorithm readable and reproducible for modern readers, while highlighting its relevance as an exact decoder for nonprojective graph based dependency parsing. We restate the minimum arborescence objective in Bock's notation and provide a complete line by line execution trace of the original ten node example, extending the partial trace given in the source paper from initialization to termination. We then introduce a structured reformulation that makes explicit the procedure's phase structure, maintained state, and control flow, while preserving the logic of the original method. As a further illustration, we include a worked example adapted from {jurafsky-martin-2026-book} for dependency parsing, showing how a maximum weight arborescence problem is reduced to Bock's minimum cost formulation by a standard affine transformation and traced under the same state variables.

AI.tldr: 该论文对Bock 1971年的最小有向生成树算法进行了现代化重构和教学化解释，使其更易理解和复现，并展示了其在非投影依存句法解析中的应用。
AI.motivation: Bock 1971年的Algol算法虽然经典，但现代读者难以理解和复现。作者希望通过现代化重构使这一精确算法重新可用，特别是在非投影依存句法解析领域。
AI.method: 1. 用Bock的原始符号重新表述最小树状图目标；2. 提供完整的10节点示例执行轨迹；3. 引入结构化重构，明确算法的阶段结构、状态维护和控制流；4. 通过依存句法解析案例展示如何将最大权重问题转化为最小成本问题。
AI.result: 成功将Bock的经典算法现代化，使其更易理解和实现。提供了完整的执行轨迹和结构化重构，并通过依存句法解析案例验证了算法的实用性。
AI.conclusion: Bock 1971年的最小有向生成树算法经过现代化重构后，不仅更易理解和复现，而且作为非投影依存句法解析的精确解码器仍然具有重要价值。

title: From Prediction to Diagnosis: Reasoning-Aware AI for Photovoltaic Defect Inspection
summary: Reliable photovoltaic defect identification is essential for maintaining energy yield, ensuring warranty compliance, and enabling scalable inspection of rapidly expanding solar fleets. Although recent advances in computer vision have improved automated defect detection, most existing systems operate as opaque classifiers that provide limited diagnostic insight for high-stakes energy infrastructure. Here we introduce REVL-PV, a vision-language framework that embeds domain-specific diagnostic reasoning into multimodal learning across electroluminescence, thermal, and visible-light imagery. By requiring the model to link visual evidence to plausible defect mechanisms before classification, the framework produces structured diagnostic reports aligned with professional photovoltaic inspection practice. Evaluated on 1,927 real-world modules spanning eight defect categories, REVL-PV achieves 93\% classification accuracy while producing interpretable diagnostic rationales and maintaining strong robustness under realistic image corruptions. A blind concordance study with a certified solar inspection expert shows strong semantic alignment between model explanations and expert assessments across defect identification, root-cause attribution, and visual descriptions. These results demonstrate that reasoning-aware multimodal learning establishes a general paradigm for trustworthy AI-assisted inspection of photovoltaic energy infrastructure.

AI.tldr: REVL-PV是一个用于光伏缺陷识别的视觉-语言框架，通过将领域特定的诊断推理融入多模态学习，实现可解释的缺陷检测和诊断报告生成。
AI.motivation: 当前光伏缺陷识别系统多为不透明的分类器，缺乏对高价值能源基础设施的诊断洞察。需要开发既能准确识别缺陷又能提供诊断推理的可解释系统。
AI.method: 引入REVL-PV视觉-语言框架，将领域特定的诊断推理嵌入到电致发光、热成像和可见光图像的多模态学习中。模型需要在分类前将视觉证据与可能的缺陷机制联系起来。
AI.result: 在1,927个真实世界模块（涵盖8种缺陷类别）上评估，REVL-PV达到93%的分类准确率，产生可解释的诊断依据，并在实际图像损坏下保持强鲁棒性。与认证太阳能检查专家的盲法一致性研究显示，在缺陷识别、根本原因归因和视觉描述方面具有强语义对齐。
AI.conclusion: 推理感知的多模态学习为光伏能源基础设施的可信AI辅助检查建立了一个通用范式，实现了专业级诊断报告生成。

title: What does a system modify when it modifies itself?
summary:
When a cognitive system modifies its own functioning, what exactly does it modify: a low-level rule, a control rule, or the norm that evaluates its own revisions? Cognitive science describes executive control, metacognition, and hierarchical learning with precision, but lacks a formal framework distinguishing these targets of transformation. Contemporary artificial intelligence likewise exhibits self-modification without common criteria for comparison with biological cognition.
  We show that the question of what counts as a self-modifying system entails a minimal structure: a hierarchy of rules, a fixed core, and a distinction between effective rules, represented rules, and causally accessible rules. Four regimes are identified: (1) action without modification, (2) low-level modification, (3) structural modification, and (4) teleological revision. Each regime is anchored in a cognitive phenomenon and a corresponding artificial system.
  Applied to humans, the framework yields a central result: a crossing of opacities. Humans have self-representation and causal power concentrated at upper hierarchical levels, while operational levels remain largely opaque. Reflexive artificial systems display the inverse profile: rich representation and causal access at operational levels, but none at the highest evaluative level. This crossed asymmetry provides a structural signature for human-AI comparison. The framework also offers insight into artificial consciousness, with higher-order theories and Attention Schema Theory as special cases. We derive four testable predictions and identify four open problems: the independence of transformativity and autonomy, the viability of self-modification, the teleological lock, and identity under transformation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个区分认知系统自我修改类型的框架，识别了四种修改机制，并揭示了人类与AI在自我修改结构上的交叉不对称性。
AI.motivation: 认知科学和人工智能领域都研究系统的自我修改能力，但缺乏统一的框架来区分不同类型的修改目标（如执行控制、元认知、层次学习）。需要建立形式化框架来比较生物认知与人工系统的自我修改机制。
AI.method: 提出了一个最小结构框架，包含规则层次、固定核心，区分有效规则、表征规则和因果可及规则。识别了四种修改机制：无修改行动、低层修改、结构修改和目的论修订。将框架应用于人类认知和人工系统进行比较分析。
AI.result: 发现人类与AI在自我修改结构上存在交叉不对称性：人类的自我表征和因果能力集中在高层级，操作层级相对不透明；而人工系统在操作层级有丰富的表征和因果访问，但在最高评估层级缺乏表征。这一结构特征为人类-AI比较提供了签名。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解认知系统的自我修改提供了统一的理论基础，能够解释人工意识理论，并提出了四个可测试的预测和四个开放问题，包括变换性与自主性的独立性、自我修改的可行性、目的论锁定和变换中的身份问题。

title: Umwelt Engineering: Designing the Cognitive Worlds of Linguistic Agents
summary: I propose Umwelt engineering -- the deliberate design of the linguistic cognitive environment -- as a third layer in the agent design stack, upstream of both prompt and context engineering. Two experiments test the thesis that altering the medium of reasoning alters cognition itself. In Experiment 1, three language models reason under two vocabulary constraints -- No-Have (eliminating possessive "to have") and E-Prime (eliminating "to be") -- across seven tasks (N=4,470 trials). No-Have improves ethical reasoning by 19.1 pp (p < 0.001), classification by 6.5 pp (p < 0.001), and epistemic calibration by 7.4 pp, while achieving 92.8% constraint compliance. E-Prime shows dramatic but model-dependent effects: cross-model correlations reach r = -0.75. In Experiment 2, 16 linguistically constrained agents tackle 17 debugging problems. No constrained agent outperforms the control individually, yet a 3-agent ensemble achieves 100% ground-truth coverage versus 88.2% for the control. A permutation test confirms only 8% of random 3-agent subsets achieve full coverage, and every successful subset contains the counterfactual agent. Two mechanisms emerge: cognitive restructuring and cognitive diversification. The primary limitation is the absence of an active control matching constraint prompt elaborateness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Umwelt工程作为智能体设计的第三层，通过语言环境约束改变推理过程，实验证明词汇限制能提升伦理推理和认知多样性
AI.motivation: 传统智能体设计主要关注提示工程和上下文工程，本文提出需要更上游的语言认知环境设计层，通过改变推理媒介来改变认知本身
AI.method: 提出Umwelt工程概念，通过两个实验验证：实验1在三种语言模型上应用No-Have和E-Prime词汇约束，测试7个任务；实验2让16个语言约束智能体解决17个调试问题，分析多智能体集成效果
AI.result: No-Have约束显著提升伦理推理19.1个百分点、分类6.5个百分点、认知校准7.4个百分点；E-Prime效果模型依赖性强；3智能体集成达到100%真实覆盖率，优于对照组的88.2%，成功组合都包含反事实智能体
AI.conclusion: 语言环境工程能通过认知重构和认知多样化机制有效改变智能体推理，Umwelt工程应成为智能体设计栈的第三层，但需要匹配约束提示复杂度的主动对照

title: BHCast: Unlocking Black Hole Plasma Dynamics from a Single Blurry Image with Long-Term Forecasting
summary: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) delivered the first image of a black hole by capturing the light from its surrounding accretion flow, revealing structure but not dynamics. Simulations of black hole accretion dynamics are essential for interpreting EHT images but costly to generate and impractical for inference. Motivated by this bottleneck, BHCast presents a framework for forecasting black hole plasma dynamics from a single, blurry snapshot, such as those captured by the EHT.
