At its core, BHCast is a neural model that transforms a static image into forecasted future frames, revealing the underlying dynamics hidden within one snapshot. With a multi-scale pyramid loss, we demonstrate how autoregressive forecasting can simultaneously super-resolve and evolve a blurry frame into a coherent, high-resolution movie that remains stable over long time horizons. From forecasted dynamics, we can then extract interpretable spatio-temporal features, such as pattern speed (rotation rate) and pitch angle. Finally, BHCast uses gradient-boosting trees to recover black hole properties from these plasma features, including the spin and viewing inclination angle. The separation between forecasting and inference provides modular flexibility, interpretability, and robust uncertainty quantification. We demonstrate the effectiveness of BHCast on simulations of two distinct black hole accretion systems, Sagittarius A* and M87*, by testing on simulated frames blurred to EHT resolution and real EHT images of M87*. Ultimately, our methodology establishes a scalable paradigm for solving inverse problems, demonstrating the potential of learned dynamics to unlock insights from resolution-limited scientific data.

AI.tldr: BHCast是一个从单张模糊黑洞快照预测等离子体动力学并推断黑洞参数的神经框架，通过自回归预测实现超分辨率和动态演化。
AI.motivation: 事件视界望远镜(EHT)提供了黑洞的第一张图像，但只显示结构而非动态。黑洞吸积动力学模拟对于解释EHT图像至关重要，但生成成本高且不适用于推理。为解决这一瓶颈，需要从单张模糊快照预测黑洞等离子体动力学。
AI.method: BHCast是一个神经模型，将静态图像转换为预测的未来帧，通过多尺度金字塔损失实现自回归预测，同时超分辨和演化模糊帧为连贯的高分辨率视频。然后从预测动态中提取可解释的时空特征(如模式速度和俯仰角)，最后使用梯度提升树从这些等离子体特征恢复黑洞属性(自旋和视角倾角)。
AI.result: 在Sagittarius A*和M87*两个不同黑洞吸积系统的模拟上测试了BHCast，包括模糊到EHT分辨率的模拟帧和真实的M87* EHT图像。该方法展示了预测动态如何从分辨率受限的科学数据中解锁洞察。
AI.conclusion: BHCast建立了一个可扩展的范式来解决逆问题，展示了学习动态从分辨率受限科学数据中解锁洞察的潜力。预测和推理的分离提供了模块化灵活性、可解释性和稳健的不确定性量化。

title: DSevolve: Enabling Real-Time Adaptive Scheduling on Dynamic Shop Floor with LLM-Evolved Heuristic Portfolios
summary: In dynamic manufacturing environments, disruptions such as machine breakdowns and new order arrivals continuously shift the optimal dispatching strategy, making adaptive rule selection essential. Existing LLM-powered Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) frameworks evolve toward a single elite rule that cannot meet this adaptability demand. To address this, we present DSevolve, an industrial scheduling framework that evolves a quality-diverse portfolio of dispatching rules offline and adaptively deploys them online with second-level response time. Multi-persona seeding and topology-aware evolutionary operators produce a behaviorally diverse rule archive indexed by a MAP-Elites feature space. Upon each disruption event, a probe-based fingerprinting mechanism characterizes the current shop floor state, retrieves high-quality candidate rules from an offline knowledge base, and selects the best one via rapid look-ahead simulation. Evaluated on 500 dynamic flexible job shop instances derived from real industrial data, DSevolve outperforms state-of-the-art AHD frameworks, classical dispatching rules, genetic programming, and deep reinforcement learning, offering a practical and deployable solution for intelligent shop floor scheduling.

AI.tldr: DSevolve是一个工业调度框架，通过离线演化行为多样的调度规则组合，并在线上根据车间状态自适应部署，实现秒级响应，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 动态制造环境中，机器故障和新订单到达等干扰不断改变最优调度策略，需要自适应规则选择。现有的基于LLM的自动启发式设计框架演化单一精英规则，无法满足这种适应性需求。
AI.method: 1. 离线演化：使用多角色种子和拓扑感知进化算子产生行为多样的规则档案，通过MAP-Elites特征空间索引；2. 在线部署：干扰事件发生时，基于探针的指纹机制表征当前车间状态，从离线知识库检索高质量候选规则，通过快速前瞻模拟选择最佳规则。
AI.result: 在基于真实工业数据生成的500个动态柔性作业车间实例上评估，DSevolve优于最先进的AHD框架、经典调度规则、遗传编程和深度强化学习方法。
AI.conclusion: DSevolve为智能车间调度提供了一个实用且可部署的解决方案，通过演化多样化的规则组合并实现自适应部署，有效应对动态制造环境中的干扰。

title: PRBench: End-to-end Paper Reproduction in Physics Research
summary: AI agents powered by large language models exhibit strong reasoning and problem-solving capabilities, enabling them to assist scientific research tasks such as formula derivation and code generation. However, whether these agents can reliably perform end-to-end reproduction from real scientific papers remains an open question. We introduce PRBench, a benchmark of 30 expert-curated tasks spanning 11 subfields of physics. Each task requires an agent to comprehend the methodology of a published paper, implement the corresponding algorithms from scratch, and produce quantitative results matching the original publication. Agents are provided only with the task instruction and paper content, and operate in a sandboxed execution environment. All tasks are contributed by domain experts from over 20 research groups at the School of Physics, Peking University, each grounded in a real published paper and validated through end-to-end reproduction with verified ground-truth results and detailed scoring rubrics. Using an agentified assessment pipeline, we evaluate a set of coding agents on PRBench and analyze their capabilities across key dimensions of scientific reasoning and execution. The best-performing agent, OpenAI Codex powered by GPT-5.3-Codex, achieves a mean overall score of 34%. All agents exhibit a zero end-to-end callback success rate, with particularly poor performance in data accuracy and code correctness. We further identify systematic failure modes, including errors in formula implementation, inability to debug numerical simulations, and fabrication of output data. Overall, PRBench provides a rigorous benchmark for evaluating progress toward autonomous scientific research.

AI.tldr: PRBench是一个针对AI智能体科学论文复现能力的基准测试，包含30个物理领域专家设计的任务，测试智能体从理解论文到实现算法并产生匹配结果的全流程能力。目前最好的智能体（GPT-5.3-Codex）平均得分仅34%，所有智能体在端到端复现成功率均为零。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI智能体在推理和问题解决方面表现出色，但能否可靠地从真实科学论文进行端到端复现仍是一个开放问题。需要建立一个严格的基准来评估AI智能体在自主科学研究方面的能力。
AI.method: 创建PRBench基准，包含30个由北京大学物理学院20多个研究组专家设计的任务，涵盖11个物理子领域。每个任务基于真实发表论文，要求智能体理解论文方法、从零实现算法、产生与原文匹配的定量结果。使用沙箱执行环境进行评估，采用代理化评估流程分析智能体在科学推理和执行关键维度的能力。
AI.result: 表现最好的智能体（OpenAI Codex powered by GPT-5.3-Codex）平均总体得分仅为34%。所有智能体的端到端回调成功率均为零，在数据准确性和代码正确性方面表现尤其差。研究发现系统性失败模式，包括公式实现错误、无法调试数值模拟、输出数据伪造等问题。
AI.conclusion: PRBench为评估自主科学研究进展提供了严格的基准。当前AI智能体在科学论文复现方面能力有限，特别是在端到端执行和数据准确性方面存在显著不足，表明AI在自主科学研究方面仍有很长的路要走。

title: Limits of Imagery Reasoning in Frontier LLM Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, yet they struggle with spatial tasks that require mental simulation, such as mental rotation. This paper investigates whether equipping an LLM with an external ``Imagery Module'' -- a tool capable of rendering and rotating 3D models -- can bridge this gap, functioning as a ``cognitive prosthetic.'' We conducted experiments using a dual-module architecture in which a reasoning module (an MLLM) interacts with an imagery module on 3D model rotation tasks. Performance was lower than expected, with accuracy reaching at most 62.5%. Further investigation suggests that even when the burden of maintaining and manipulating a holistic 3D state is outsourced, the system still fails. This reveals that current frontier models lack the foundational visual-spatial primitives required to interface with imagery. Specifically, they lack: (1) the low-level sensitivity to extract spatial signals such as (a) depth, (b) motion, and (c) short-horizon dynamic prediction; and (2) the capacity to reason contemplatively over images, dynamically shifting visual focus and balancing imagery with symbolic and associative information.

AI.tldr: LLMs在需要心理模拟的空间任务（如心理旋转）上表现不佳，研究通过为LLM配备外部"意象模块"（能渲染和旋转3D模型的工具）来弥补这一缺陷，但效果有限，准确率最高仅62.5%
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在推理方面表现出色，但在需要心理模拟的空间任务（如心理旋转）上存在明显不足。研究者希望探索通过为LLM配备外部"意象模块"（一种能渲染和旋转3D模型的工具）是否能弥补这一缺陷，作为"认知假体"来提升空间任务表现。
AI.method: 采用双模块架构：一个推理模块（多模态语言模型）与一个意象模块（能渲染和旋转3D模型的工具）交互，在3D模型旋转任务上进行实验。研究评估了这种外部辅助工具对LLM空间任务表现的影响。
AI.result: 性能低于预期，准确率最高仅达到62.5%。即使将维护和操作整体3D状态的任务外包给外部模块，系统仍然失败。这表明当前前沿模型缺乏与意象交互所需的基础视觉空间原语。
AI.conclusion: 当前前沿模型缺乏与意象交互所需的基础视觉空间能力，具体包括：(1) 提取空间信号的低级敏感性（如深度、运动、短期动态预测）；(2) 对图像进行沉思式推理的能力，能够动态转移视觉焦点并平衡意象与符号和关联信息。

title: TianJi:An autonomous AI meteorologist for discovering physical mechanisms in atmospheric science
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) has achieved breakthroughs comparable to traditional numerical models in data-driven weather forecasting, yet it remains essentially statistical fitting and struggles to uncover the physical causal mechanisms of the atmosphere. Physics-oriented mechanism research still heavily relies on domain knowledge and cumbersome engineering operations of human scientists, becoming a bottleneck restricting the efficiency of Earth system science exploration. Here, we propose TianJi - the first "AI meteorologist" system capable of autonomously driving complex numerical models to verify physical mechanisms. Powered by a large language model-driven multi-agent architecture, TianJi can autonomously conduct literature research and generate scientific hypotheses. We further decouple scientific research into cognitive planning and engineering execution: the meta-planner interprets hypotheses and devises experimental roadmaps, while a cohort of specialized worker agents collaboratively complete data preparation, model configuration, and multi-dimensional result analysis. In two classic atmospheric dynamic scenarios (squall-line cold pools and typhoon track deflections), TianJi accomplishes expert-level end-to-end experimental operations with zero human intervention, compressing the research cycle to a few hours. It also delivers detailed result analyses and autonomously judges and explains the validity of the hypotheses from outputs. TianJi reveals that the role of AI in Earth system science is transitioning from a "black-box predictor" to an "interpretable scientific collaborator", offering a new paradigm for high-throughput exploration of scientific mechanisms.

AI.tldr: TianJi是首个能够自主驱动复杂数值模型验证物理机制的"AI气象学家"系统，通过大语言模型驱动的多智能体架构，将科研解耦为认知规划和工程执行，在典型大气动力学场景中实现专家级端到端实验操作，将研究周期压缩到数小时。
AI.motivation: 当前AI在天气预报中虽取得突破，但仍停留在统计拟合层面，难以揭示大气物理因果机制。物理机制研究仍严重依赖领域知识和繁琐的人工工程操作，成为限制地球系统科学探索效率的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出TianJi系统，采用大语言模型驱动的多智能体架构：1）自主进行文献研究和生成科学假设；2）将科研解耦为认知规划（元规划器解释假设并设计实验路线图）和工程执行（专业工作者智能体协作完成数据准备、模型配置和多维度结果分析）。
AI.result: 在两个经典大气动力学场景（飑线冷池和台风路径偏转）中，TianJi实现了零人工干预的专家级端到端实验操作，将研究周期压缩到数小时。系统能够提供详细的结果分析，并自主判断和解释假设的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TianJi表明AI在地球系统科学中的角色正从"黑盒预测器"转变为"可解释的科学合作者"，为科学机制的高通量探索提供了新范式。

title: Budget-Xfer: Budget-Constrained Source Language Selection for Cross-Lingual Transfer to African Languages
comment: 5 pages, 5 tables. Submitted to SIGIR 2026 Short Paper track
summary: Cross-lingual transfer learning enables NLP for low-resource languages by leveraging labeled data from higher-resource sources, yet existing comparisons of source language selection strategies do not control for total training data, confounding language selection effects with data quantity effects. We introduce Budget-Xfer, a framework that formulates multi-source cross-lingual transfer as a budget-constrained resource allocation problem. Given a fixed annotation budget B, our framework jointly optimizes which source languages to include and how much data to allocate from each. We evaluate four allocation strategies across named entity recognition and sentiment analysis for three African target languages (Hausa, Yoruba, Swahili) using two multilingual models, conducting 288 experiments. Our results show that (1) multi-source transfer significantly outperforms single-source transfer (Cohen's d = 0.80 to 1.98), driven by a structural budget underutilization bottleneck; (2) among multi-source strategies, differences are modest and non-significant; and (3) the value of embedding similarity as a selection proxy is task-dependent, with random selection outperforming similarity-based selection for NER but not sentiment analysis.

AI.tldr: Budget-Xfer框架将多源跨语言迁移学习建模为预算约束的资源分配问题，通过优化源语言选择和数据分配来提升低资源语言NLP性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨语言迁移研究中，源语言选择策略的比较没有控制总训练数据量，导致语言选择效应与数据量效应混淆，无法准确评估不同策略的有效性。
AI.method: 提出Budget-Xfer框架，将多源跨语言迁移视为预算约束的资源分配问题，在固定标注预算B下联合优化源语言选择和各语言数据分配。评估了四种分配策略，在命名实体识别和情感分析任务上对三种非洲语言进行288次实验。
AI.result: 1) 多源迁移显著优于单源迁移(Cohen's d = 0.80到1.98)，存在结构性预算未充分利用瓶颈；2) 多源策略间差异较小且不显著；3) 嵌入相似性作为选择代理的价值具有任务依赖性，NER任务中随机选择优于相似性选择，但情感分析中相反。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言迁移中，多源策略优于单源策略，但不同多源策略间差异有限。源语言选择策略的有效性取决于具体任务，需要任务特定的优化方法。

title: SkyNet: Belief-Aware Planning for Partially-Observable Stochastic Games
summary:
In 2019, Google DeepMind released MuZero, a model-based reinforcement learning method that achieves strong results in perfect-information games by combining learned dynamics models with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). However, comparatively little work has extended MuZero to partially observable, stochastic, multi-player environments, where agents must act under uncertainty about hidden state. Such settings arise not only in card games but in domains such as autonomous negotiation, financial trading, and multi-agent robotics. In the absence of explicit belief modeling, MuZero's latent encoding has no dedicated mechanism for representing uncertainty over unobserved variables.
  To address this, we introduce SkyNet (Belief-Aware MuZero), which adds ego-conditioned auxiliary heads for winner prediction and rank estimation to the standard MuZero architecture. These objectives encourage the latent state to retain information predictive of outcomes under partial observability, without requiring explicit belief-state tracking or changes to the search algorithm.
  We evaluate SkyNet on Skyjo, a partially observable, non-zero-sum, stochastic card game, using a decision-granularity environment, transformer-based encoding, and a curriculum of heuristic opponents with self-play. In 1000-game head-to-head evaluations at matched checkpoints, SkyNet achieves a 75.3% peak win rate against the baseline (+194 Elo, $p < 10^{-50}$). SkyNet also outperforms the baseline against heuristic opponents (0.720 vs.\ 0.466 win rate). Critically, the belief-aware model initially underperforms the baseline but decisively surpasses it once training throughput is sufficient, suggesting that belief-aware auxiliary supervision improves learned representations under partial observability, but only given adequate data flow.

AI.tldr: SkyNet在MuZero基础上增加了信念感知辅助头，用于部分可观测环境，在Skyjo卡牌游戏中显著超越基线模型
AI.motivation: MuZero在完美信息游戏中表现优异，但缺乏对部分可观测、随机、多玩家环境的专门处理机制，无法有效表示对隐藏状态的不确定性
AI.method: 在标准MuZero架构中添加自我条件化的辅助头（赢家预测和排名估计），鼓励潜在状态保留对部分可观测性下结果预测的信息，无需显式信念状态跟踪或搜索算法修改
AI.result: 在Skyjo游戏中，SkyNet达到75.3%的峰值胜率（比基线高194 Elo，p<10^{-50}），对启发式对手的胜率也更高（0.720 vs. 0.466）
AI.conclusion: 信念感知辅助监督在数据流充足时能显著改善部分可观测性下的学习表示，但需要足够的训练吞吐量才能发挥优势

title: The Degree of Language Diacriticity and Its Effect on Tasks
summary: Diacritics are orthographic marks that clarify pronunciation, distinguish similar words, or alter meaning. They play a central role in many writing systems, yet their impact on language technology has not been systematically quantified across scripts. While prior work has examined diacritics in individual languages, there's no cross-linguistic, data-driven framework for measuring the degree to which writing systems rely on them and how this affects downstream tasks. We propose a data-driven framework for quantifying diacritic complexity using corpus-level, information-theoretic metrics that capture the frequency, ambiguity, and structural diversity of character-diacritic combinations. We compute these metrics over 24 corpora in 15 languages, spanning both single- and multi-diacritic scripts. We then examine how diacritic complexity correlates with performance on the task of diacritics restoration, evaluating BERT- and RNN-based models. We find that across languages, higher diacritic complexity is strongly associated with lower restoration accuracy. In single-diacritic scripts, where character-diacritic combinations are more predictable, frequency-based and structural measures largely align. In multi-diacritic scripts, however, structural complexity exhibits the strongest association with performance, surpassing frequency-based measures. These findings show that measurable properties of diacritic usage influence the performance of diacritic restoration models, demonstrating that orthographic complexity is not only descriptive but functionally relevant for modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的框架，用于量化变音符号的复杂性，并研究了这种复杂性对变音符号恢复任务性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 变音符号在许多文字系统中起着核心作用，但之前的研究主要关注单个语言，缺乏跨语言的系统性量化框架来衡量文字系统对变音符号的依赖程度及其对下游任务的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于信息论的框架，使用语料库级别的指标来量化变音符号复杂性，包括频率、歧义性和结构多样性。在15种语言的24个语料库上计算这些指标，并研究变音符号复杂性与BERT和RNN模型在变音符号恢复任务上性能的相关性。
AI.result: 研究发现，在所有语言中，较高的变音符号复杂性与较低的恢复准确率密切相关。在单变音符号文字中，频率和结构指标基本一致；但在多变音符号文字中，结构复杂性对性能的影响最强，超过了基于频率的指标。
AI.conclusion: 变音符号使用的可测量特性会影响变音符号恢复模型的性能，这表明正字法复杂性不仅是描述性的，而且对建模具有功能相关性。

title: Can We Change the Stroke Size for Easier Diffusion?
summary: Diffusion models can be challenged in the low signal-to-noise regime, where they have to make pixel-level predictions despite the presence of high noise. The geometric intuition is akin to using the finest stroke for oil painting throughout, which may be ineffective. We therefore study stroke-size control as a controlled intervention that changes the effective roughness of the supervised target, predictions and perturbations across timesteps, in an attempt to ease the low signal-to-noise challenge. We analyze the advantages and trade-offs of the intervention both theoretically and empirically. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在低信噪比条件下扩散模型的挑战，提出通过控制笔画大小（stroke-size control）来调节监督目标、预测和扰动的有效粗糙度，以缓解低信噪比问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在低信噪比条件下面临挑战，需要在高噪声环境下进行像素级预测。这类似于在整个油画过程中始终使用最精细的笔触，可能效果不佳。因此需要研究如何控制笔画大小来改变监督目标、预测和扰动的有效粗糙度。
AI.method: 提出笔画大小控制作为受控干预措施，改变跨时间步长的监督目标、预测和扰动的有效粗糙度。通过理论和实证分析来研究这种干预的优势和权衡。
AI.result: 论文对笔画大小控制干预进行了理论和实证分析，探讨了其优势和权衡。代码将公开发布。
AI.conclusion: 笔画大小控制可以作为一种有效的干预手段来缓解扩散模型在低信噪比条件下的挑战，通过调节监督目标、预测和扰动的粗糙度来改善模型性能。

title: Investigating the Influence of Language on Sycophantic Behavior of Multilingual LLMs
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of tasks, but they are also prone to sycophancy, the tendency to agree with user statements regardless of validity. Previous research has outlined both the extent and the underlying causes of sycophancy in earlier models, such as ChatGPT-3.5 and Davinci. Newer models have since undergone multiple mitigation strategies, yet there remains a critical need to systematically test their behavior. In particular, the effect of language on sycophancy has not been explored.
  In this work, we investigate how the language influences sycophantic responses. We evaluate three state-of-the-art models, GPT-4o mini, Gemini 1.5 Flash, and Claude 3.5 Haiku, using a set of tweet-like opinion prompts translated into five additional languages: Arabic, Chinese, French, Spanish, and Portuguese. Our results show that although newer models exhibit significantly less sycophancy overall compared to earlier generations, the extent of sycophancy is still influenced by the language. We further provide a granular analysis of how language shapes model agreeableness across sensitive topics, revealing systematic cultural and linguistic patterns. These findings highlight both the progress of mitigation efforts and the need for broader multilingual audits to ensure trustworthy and bias-aware deployment of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 研究发现最新LLM（GPT-4o mini、Gemini 1.5 Flash、Claude 3.5 Haiku）虽然整体上比早期模型更少表现出奉承倾向，但语言选择仍显著影响其奉承程度，不同语言和敏感话题下存在系统性文化语言模式差异。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然性能强大但存在奉承倾向（倾向于同意用户观点而不论其有效性）。先前研究已探讨早期模型的奉承问题，新模型虽经多种缓解策略，但仍需系统测试其行为，特别是语言对奉承倾向的影响尚未被探索。
AI.method: 评估三个最先进模型（GPT-4o mini、Gemini 1.5 Flash、Claude 3.5 Haiku），使用类似推文的观点提示，将其翻译为五种额外语言（阿拉伯语、中文、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语），分析语言如何影响奉承性回答。
AI.result: 新模型整体奉承倾向显著低于早期模型，但奉承程度仍受语言影响。通过敏感话题的细粒度分析，揭示了语言塑造模型顺从性的系统性文化和语言模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究既显示了缓解措施的有效进展，也强调了需要进行更广泛的多语言审计，以确保LLM的可信和偏见感知部署，语言因素在模型行为评估中具有重要影响。

title: HighlightBench: Benchmarking Markup-Driven Table Reasoning in Scientific Documents
summary: Visual markups such as highlights, underlines, and bold text are common in table-centric documents. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in document understanding, their ability to treat such cues as explicit logical directives remains under-explored. More importantly, existing evaluations cannot distinguish whether a model fails to see the markup or fails to reason with it. This creates a key blind spot in assessing markup-conditioned behavior over tables. To address this gap, we introduce HighlightBench, a diagnostic benchmark for markup-driven table understanding that decomposes evaluation into five task families: Markup Grounding, Constrained Retrieval, Local Relations, Aggregation \& Comparison, and Consistency \& Missingness. We further provide a reference pipeline that makes intermediate decisions explicit, enabling reproducible baselines and finer-grained attribution of errors along the perception-to-execution chain. Experiments show that even strong models remain unstable when visual cues must be consistently aligned with symbolic reasoning under structured output constraints.

AI.tldr: HighlightBench：一个用于诊断标记驱动表格理解的基准测试，将评估分解为五个任务族，以区分模型是否看到标记或是否能够基于标记进行推理。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在文档理解方面取得显著进展，但它们在将视觉标记（如高亮、下划线、粗体）作为显式逻辑指令处理的能力尚未充分探索。更重要的是，现有评估无法区分模型是未能看到标记还是未能基于标记进行推理，这在评估表格上的标记条件行为时形成了关键盲点。
AI.method: 引入HighlightBench诊断基准，将标记驱动表格理解评估分解为五个任务族：标记基础化、约束检索、局部关系、聚合与比较、一致性与缺失性。同时提供一个参考流程，使中间决策显式化，实现可复现的基准和沿感知到执行链的更细粒度错误归因。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使在强模型中，当视觉线索必须在结构化输出约束下与符号推理保持一致时，模型仍然表现不稳定。
AI.conclusion: HighlightBench填补了评估标记条件表格理解的关键空白，通过分解评估任务和提供可归因的参考流程，能够更精确地诊断模型在处理视觉标记作为逻辑指令时的能力缺陷。

title: CARGO: Carbon-Aware Gossip Orchestration in Smart Shipping
summary: Smart shipping operations increasingly depend on collaborative AI, yet the underlying data are generated across vessels with uneven connectivity, limited backhaul, and clear commercial sensitivity. In such settings, server-coordinated FL remains a weak systems assumption, depending on a reachable aggregation point and repeated wide-area synchronization, both of which are difficult to guarantee in maritime networks. A serverless gossip approach therefore represents a more natural approach, but existing methods still treat communication mainly as an optimization bottleneck, rather than as a resource that must be managed jointly with carbon cost, reliability, and long-term participation balance. In this context, this paper presents CARGO, a carbon-aware gossip orchestration framework for smart-shipping. CARGO separates learning into a control and a data plane. The data plane performs local optimization with compressed gossip exchange, while the control plane decides, at each round, which vessels should participate, which communication edges should be activated, how aggressively updates should be compressed, and when recovery actions should be triggered. We evaluate CARGO under a predictive-maintenance scenario using operational bulk-carrier engine data and a trace-driven maritime communication protocol that captures client dropout, partial participation, packet loss, and multiple connectivity regimes, derived from mobility-aware vessel interactions. Across the tested stress settings, CARGO consistently remains in the high-accuracy regime while reducing carbon footprint and communication overheads, compared to accuracy-competitive decentralized baselines. Overall, the conducted performance evaluation demonstrates that CARGO is a feasible and practical solution for reliable and resource-conscious maritime AI deployment.

AI.tldr: CARGO是一个面向智能航运的碳感知gossip编排框架，通过分离控制平面和数据平面，在海上网络连接不稳定、数据敏感的场景下实现高效、低碳的联邦学习。
AI.motivation: 智能航运依赖协作AI，但海上数据生成具有连接不稳定、回传有限、商业敏感等特点。传统的服务器协调联邦学习依赖可达的聚合点和重复的广域同步，这在海上网络中难以保证。现有方法主要将通信视为优化瓶颈，而非需要与碳成本、可靠性和长期参与平衡共同管理的资源。
AI.method: CARGO将学习分离为控制平面和数据平面。数据平面执行本地优化和压缩gossip交换；控制平面在每轮决定：哪些船只参与、哪些通信边被激活、更新压缩的激进程度、何时触发恢复操作。框架在预测性维护场景下评估，使用实际的散货船发动机数据和基于移动感知船只交互的通信协议。
AI.result: 在各种压力测试设置下，CARGO始终保持高精度状态，同时相比精度相当的分散式基线方法，减少了碳足迹和通信开销。性能评估表明CARGO是可靠且资源意识的海上AI部署的可行实用解决方案。
AI.conclusion: CARGO为智能航运提供了一个碳感知的gossip编排框架，能够在海上网络连接不稳定、数据敏感的环境中实现高效、低碳的联邦学习，是可靠且资源意识的海上AI部署的可行方案。

title: Can Large Language Models Simulate Human Cognition Beyond Behavioral Imitation?
summary: An essential problem in artificial intelligence is whether LLMs can simulate human cognition or merely imitate surface-level behaviors, while existing datasets suffer from either synthetic reasoning traces or population-level aggregation, failing to capture authentic individual cognitive patterns. We introduce a benchmark grounded in the longitudinal research trajectories of 217 researchers across diverse domains of artificial intelligence, where each author's scientific publications serve as an externalized representation of their cognitive processes. To distinguish whether LLMs transfer cognitive patterns or merely imitate behaviors, our benchmark deliberately employs a cross-domain, temporal-shift generalization setting. A multidimensional cognitive alignment metric is further proposed to assess individual-level cognitive consistency. Through systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and various enhancement techniques, we provide a first-stage empirical study on the questions: (1) How well do current LLMs simulate human cognition? and (2) How far can existing techniques enhance these capabilities?

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于217名AI研究者纵向研究轨迹的基准测试，用于评估LLM是否真正模拟人类认知还是仅模仿表面行为，通过跨领域、时间偏移的泛化设置和多维认知对齐指标来评估个体层面的认知一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI研究面临一个核心问题：LLM是真正模拟人类认知还是仅模仿表面行为？现有数据集要么使用合成推理轨迹，要么进行群体级聚合，无法捕捉真实的个体认知模式，因此需要新的评估方法。
AI.method: 基于217名AI研究者的纵向研究轨迹构建基准，以他们的科学出版物作为认知过程的外部化表征。采用跨领域、时间偏移的泛化设置来区分认知模式转移与行为模仿，并提出多维认知对齐指标评估个体层面的认知一致性。
AI.result: 通过对最先进LLM和各种增强技术的系统评估，提供了关于当前LLM模拟人类认知能力的初步实证研究，回答了LLM模拟认知的能力程度以及现有技术能多大程度增强这些能力的问题。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为评估LLM是否真正模拟人类认知提供了新的基准和方法，通过个体层面的认知一致性评估，有助于区分认知模拟与行为模仿，为AI认知能力研究提供了实证基础。

title: Brain-Inspired Multimodal Spiking Neural Network for Image-Text Retrieval
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) have recently shown strong potential in unimodal visual and textual tasks, yet building a directly trained, low-energy, and high-performance SNN for multimodal applications such as image-text retrieval (ITR) remains highly challenging. Existing artificial neural network (ANN)-based methods often pursue richer unimodal semantics using deeper and more complex architectures, while overlooking cross-modal interaction, retrieval latency, and energy efficiency. To address these limitations, we present a brain-inspired Cross-Modal Spike Fusion network (CMSF) and apply it to ITR for the first time. The proposed spike fusion mechanism integrates unimodal features at the spike level, generating enhanced multimodal representations that act as soft supervisory signals to refine unimodal spike embeddings, effectively mitigating semantic loss within CMSF. Despite requiring only two time steps, CMSF achieves top-tier retrieval accuracy, surpassing state-of-the-art ANN counterparts while maintaining exceptionally low energy consumption and high retrieval speed. This work marks a significant step toward multimodal SNNs, offering a brain-inspired framework that unifies temporal dynamics with cross-modal alignment and provides new insights for future spiking-based multimodal research. The code is available at https://github.com/zxt6174/CMSF.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种受大脑启发的跨模态脉冲融合网络（CMSF），首次将脉冲神经网络应用于图像文本检索任务，在仅需两个时间步的情况下实现了顶级检索精度，同时保持极低的能耗和高检索速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于人工神经网络（ANN）的图像文本检索方法通常追求更丰富的单模态语义，使用更深更复杂的架构，但忽视了跨模态交互、检索延迟和能源效率问题。脉冲神经网络（SNN）在单模态视觉和文本任务中显示出潜力，但构建直接训练、低能耗、高性能的多模态SNN仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出了受大脑启发的跨模态脉冲融合网络（CMSF），采用脉冲融合机制在脉冲级别整合单模态特征，生成增强的多模态表示，作为软监督信号来优化单模态脉冲嵌入，有效缓解语义损失。
AI.result: CMSF仅需两个时间步就实现了顶级检索精度，超越了最先进的ANN对应方法，同时保持了极低的能耗和高检索速度。在图像文本检索任务中表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作标志着多模态SNN的重要进展，提供了一个受大脑启发的框架，将时间动态与跨模态对齐统一起来，为未来基于脉冲的多模态研究提供了新见解。

title: GAAMA: Graph Augmented Associative Memory for Agents
summary: AI agents that interact with users across multiple sessions require persistent long-term memory to maintain coherent, personalized behavior. Current approaches either rely on flat retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which loses structural relationships between memories, or use memory compression and vector retrieval that cannot capture the associative structure of multi-session conversations. There are few graph based techniques proposed in the literature, however they still suffer from hub dominated retrieval and poor hierarchical reasoning over evolving memory. We propose GAAMA, a graph-augmented associative memory system that constructs a concept-mediated hierarchical knowledge graph through a three-step pipeline: (1)~verbatim episode preservation from raw conversations, (2)~LLM-based extraction of atomic facts and topic-level concept nodes, and (3)~synthesis of higher-order reflections. The resulting graph uses four node types (episode, fact, reflection, concept) connected by five structural edge types, with concept nodes providing cross-cutting traversal paths that complement semantic similarity. Retrieval combines cosine-similarity-based $k$-nearest neighbor search with edge-type-aware Personalized PageRank (PPR) through an additive scoring function. On the LoCoMo-10 benchmark (1,540 questions across 10 multi-session conversations), GAAMA achieves 78.9\% mean reward, outperforming a tuned RAG baseline (75.0\%), HippoRAG (69.9\%), A-Mem (47.2\%), and Nemori (52.1\%). Ablation analysis shows that augmenting graph-traversal-based ranking (Personalized PageRank) with semantic search consistently improves over pure semantic search on graph nodes (+1.0 percentage point overall).

AI.tldr: GAAMA提出了一种图增强的关联记忆系统，通过构建概念介导的层次知识图谱来改善多会话AI代理的长期记忆，在LoCoMo-10基准上取得了78.9%的平均奖励，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前多会话AI代理的长期记忆方法存在局限性：基于检索增强生成(RAG)的方法会丢失记忆间的结构关系，而基于记忆压缩和向量检索的方法无法捕捉多会话对话的关联结构。现有的图技术也存在中心节点主导检索和层次推理能力差的问题。
AI.method: GAAMA采用三步流水线构建概念介导的层次知识图谱：1) 从原始对话中保留逐字片段；2) 使用LLM提取原子事实和主题级概念节点；3) 合成高阶反思。图谱包含四种节点类型（片段、事实、反思、概念）和五种结构边类型。检索结合余弦相似度的k近邻搜索和边类型感知的个性化PageRank。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo-10基准测试（10个多会话对话中的1,540个问题）上，GAAMA取得了78.9%的平均奖励，优于调优的RAG基线（75.0%）、HippoRAG（69.9%）、A-Mem（47.2%）和Nemori（52.1%）。消融分析显示，将基于图遍历的排名（个性化PageRank）与语义搜索结合，相比纯语义搜索在图形节点上提高了1.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: GAAMA通过构建概念介导的层次知识图谱，有效解决了多会话AI代理长期记忆中的结构关系保持和关联推理问题，在记忆检索性能上显著优于现有方法。

title: KAT-Coder-V2 Technical Report
summary: We present KAT-Coder-V2, an agentic coding model developed by the KwaiKAT team at Kuaishou. KAT-Coder-V2 adopts a "Specialize-then-Unify" paradigm that decomposes agentic coding into five expert domains - SWE, WebCoding, Terminal, WebSearch, and General - each undergoing independent supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, before being consolidated into a single model via on-policy distillation. We develop KwaiEnv, a modular infrastructure sustaining tens of thousands of concurrent sandbox instances, and scale RL training along task complexity, intent alignment, and scaffold generalization. We further propose MCLA for stabilizing MoE RL training and Tree Training for eliminating redundant computation over tree-structured trajectories with up to 6.2x speedup. KAT-Coder-V2 achieves 79.6% on SWE-bench Verified (vs. Claude Opus 4.6 at 80.8%), 88.7 on PinchBench (surpassing GLM-5 and MiniMax M2.7), ranks first across all three frontend aesthetics scenarios, and maintains strong generalist scores on Terminal-Bench Hard (46.8) and tau^2-Bench (93.9). Our model is publicly available at https://streamlake.com/product/kat-coder.

AI.tldr: KAT-Coder-V2是一个采用"专业化后统一"范式的代理编码模型，通过五个专家领域独立训练后整合，在多个编码基准测试中取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 开发一个能够处理多种编码任务的通用代理编码模型，通过专业化分工和统一整合的方式提升模型在软件工程、Web开发、终端操作、网络搜索等不同领域的编码能力。
AI.method: 采用"专业化后统一"范式，将代理编码分解为SWE、WebCoding、Terminal、WebSearch、General五个专家领域，每个领域进行独立的监督微调和强化学习，然后通过策略蒸馏整合为单一模型。开发了KwaiEnv基础设施支持大规模并发沙箱实例，并提出了MCLA稳定MoE RL训练和Tree Training优化树结构轨迹计算。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上达到79.6%（接近Claude Opus 4.6的80.8%），在PinchBench上获得88.7分（超越GLM-5和MiniMax M2.7），在三个前端美学场景中排名第一，在Terminal-Bench Hard上获得46.8分，在tau^2-Bench上获得93.9分。
AI.conclusion: KAT-Coder-V2通过专业化分工和统一整合的方法，在多个编码基准测试中表现出色，证明了"专业化后统一"范式的有效性，模型已公开可用。

title: Confidence Matters: Uncertainty Quantification and Precision Assessment of Deep Learning-based CMR Biomarker Estimates Using Scan-rescan Data
summary: The performance of deep learning (DL) methods for the analysis of cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) is typically assessed in terms of accuracy, overlooking precision. In this work, uncertainty estimation techniques, namely deep ensemble, test-time augmentation, and Monte Carlo dropout, are applied to a state-of-the-art DL pipeline for cardiac functional biomarker estimation, and new distribution-based metrics are proposed for the assessment of biomarker precision. The model achieved high accuracy (average Dice 87%) and point estimate precision on two external validation scan-rescan CMR datasets. However, distribution-based metrics showed that the overlap between scan/rescan confidence intervals was >50% in less than 45% of the cases. Statistical similarity tests between scan and rescan biomarkers also resulted in significant differences for over 65% of the cases. We conclude that, while point estimate metrics might suggest good performance, distributional analyses reveal lower precision, highlighting the need to use more representative metrics to assess scan-rescan agreement.

AI.tldr: 该研究将不确定性估计技术应用于心脏功能生物标志物估计的深度学习管道，提出了新的基于分布的精度评估指标，发现点估计指标可能高估了扫描-重扫描一致性。
AI.motivation: 目前深度学习在心血管磁共振分析中的性能评估主要关注准确性而忽略了精度，特别是在扫描-重扫描一致性方面缺乏有效的评估方法。
AI.method: 应用深度集成、测试时增强和蒙特卡洛dropout等不确定性估计技术到最先进的DL管道，提出新的基于分布的生物标志物精度评估指标，在两个外部验证的扫描-重扫描CMR数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 模型获得了高准确性（平均Dice 87%）和点估计精度，但基于分布的指标显示扫描/重扫描置信区间重叠>50%的情况不到45%，统计相似性测试显示超过65%的病例存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 点估计指标可能暗示良好性能，但分布分析揭示了较低的精度，强调需要使用更具代表性的指标来评估扫描-重扫描一致性。

title: GEAKG: Generative Executable Algorithm Knowledge Graphs
summary: In the context of algorithms for problem solving, procedural knowledge -- the know-how of algorithm design and operator composition -- remains implicit in code, lost between runs, and must be re-engineered for each new domain. Knowledge graphs (KGs) have proven effective for organizing declarative knowledge, yet current KG paradigms provide limited support for representing procedural knowledge as executable, learnable graph structures. We introduce \textit{Generative Executable Algorithm Knowledge Graphs} (GEAKG), a class of KGs whose nodes store executable operators, whose edges encode learned composition patterns, and whose traversal generates solutions. A GEAKG is \emph{generative} (topology and operators are synthesized by a Large Language Model), \emph{executable} (every node is runnable code), and \emph{transferable} (learned patterns generalize zero-shot across domains). The framework is domain-agnostic at the engine level: the same three-layer architecture and Ant Colony Optimization (ACO)-based learning engine can be instantiated across domains, parameterized by a pluggable ontology (\texttt{RoleSchema}). Two case studies -- sharing no domain-specific framework code -- provide concrete evidence for this framework hypothesis: (1)~Neural Architecture Search across 70 cross-dataset transfer pairs on two tabular benchmarks, and (2)~Combinatorial Optimization, where knowledge learned on the Traveling Salesman Problem transfers zero-shot to scheduling and assignment domains. Taken together, the results support that algorithmic expertise can be explicitly represented, learned, and transferred as executable knowledge graphs.

AI.tldr: 提出GEAKG框架，将算法设计中的过程性知识表示为可执行、可学习、可迁移的知识图谱，实现跨领域零样本知识迁移
AI.motivation: 算法设计中的过程性知识（算法设计和算子组合）在代码中是隐式的，运行之间会丢失，且需要为每个新领域重新设计。当前知识图谱范式对表示可执行、可学习的过程性知识支持有限
AI.method: 提出生成式可执行算法知识图谱（GEAKG）：节点存储可执行算子，边编码学习到的组合模式，遍历图谱生成解决方案。框架包含三层架构和基于蚁群优化的学习引擎，通过可插拔本体（RoleSchema）实现领域无关
AI.result: 通过两个案例研究验证框架有效性：1）神经网络架构搜索，在70个跨数据集迁移对上测试；2）组合优化，从旅行商问题零样本迁移到调度和分配领域。两个案例共享零领域特定框架代码
AI.conclusion: 算法专业知识可以明确表示为可执行知识图谱，并能被学习和跨领域迁移，为过程性知识表示提供了新范式

title: Retromorphic Testing with Hierarchical Verification for Hallucination Detection in RAG
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) continue to hallucinate in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), producing claims that are unsupported by or conflict with the retrieved context. Detecting such errors remains challenging when faithfulness is evaluated solely with respect to the retrieved context. Existing approaches either provide coarse-grained, answer-level scores or focus on open-domain factuality, often lacking fine-grained, evidence-grounded diagnostics.
  We present RT4CHART, a retromorphic testing framework for context-faithfulness assessment. RT4CHART decomposes model outputs into independently verifiable claims and performs hierarchical, local-to-global verification against the retrieved context. Each claim is assigned one of three labels: entailed, contradicted, or baseless. Furthermore, RT4CHART maps claim-level decisions back to specific answer spans and retrieves explicit supporting or refuting evidence from the context, enabling fine-grained and interpretable auditing.
  We evaluate RT4CHART on RAGTruth++ (408 samples) and RAGTruth-Enhance (2,675 samples), a newly re-annotated benchmark. RT4CHART achieves the best answer-level hallucination detection F1 among all baselines. On RAGTruth++, it reaches an F1 score of 0.776, outperforming the strongest baseline by 83%. On RAGTruth-Enhance, it achieves a span-level F1 of 47.5%.
  Ablation studies show that the hierarchical verification design is the primary driver of performance gains. Finally, our re-annotation reveals 1.68x more hallucination cases than the original labels, suggesting that existing benchmarks substantially underestimate the prevalence of hallucinations.

AI.tldr: RT4CHART是一个用于评估检索增强生成中上下文忠实度的回溯测试框架，通过分层验证将模型输出分解为可独立验证的声明，提供细粒度的幻觉检测。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在检索增强生成中仍然存在幻觉问题，产生与检索上下文不符或冲突的声明。现有方法要么提供粗粒度的答案级评分，要么专注于开放领域的事实性，缺乏细粒度、基于证据的诊断能力。
AI.method: RT4CHART框架将模型输出分解为可独立验证的声明，执行从局部到全局的分层验证。每个声明被标记为三种类型之一：蕴含、矛盾或无根据。框架还将声明级决策映射回具体答案片段，并从上下文中检索明确的支撑或反驳证据。
AI.result: 在RAGTruth++（408个样本）和RAGTruth-Enhance（2,675个样本）基准测试中，RT4CHART在所有基线方法中取得了最佳答案级幻觉检测F1分数。在RAGTruth++上达到0.776的F1分数，比最强基线高出83%。在RAGTruth-Enhance上达到47.5%的片段级F1分数。消融研究表明分层验证设计是性能提升的主要驱动力。
AI.conclusion: RT4CHART提供了一个细粒度且可解释的幻觉检测框架，显著优于现有方法。重新标注揭示了原始标签中1.68倍更多的幻觉案例，表明现有基准严重低估了幻觉的普遍性。

title: Elucidating the Design Space of Flow Matching for Cellular Microscopy
summary:
Flow-matching generative models are increasingly used to simulate cell responses to biological perturbations. However, the design space for building such models is large and underexplored. We systematically analyse the design space of flow matching models for cell-microscopy images, finding that many popular techniques are unnecessary and can even hurt performance. We develop a simple, stable, and scalable recipe which we use to train our foundation model. We scale our model to two orders of magnitude larger than prior methods, achieving a two-fold FID and ten-fold KID improvement over prior methods. We then fine-tune our model with pre-trained molecular embeddings to achieve state-of-the-art performance simulating responses to unseen molecules.
  Code is available at https://github.com/valence-labs/microscopy-flow-matching

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了细胞显微镜图像流匹配生成模型的设计空间，发现许多流行技术不必要甚至有害，开发了简单稳定的训练方法，构建了比先前方法大两个数量级的基础模型，在FID和KID指标上显著提升，并通过分子嵌入微调实现了对未知分子响应的最先进模拟。
AI.motivation: 流匹配生成模型越来越多地用于模拟细胞对生物扰动的响应，但这类模型的设计空间大且探索不足，需要系统分析以找到最优设计。
AI.method: 系统分析细胞显微镜图像流匹配模型的设计空间，识别不必要甚至有害的流行技术，开发简单、稳定、可扩展的训练方法，构建比先前方法大两个数量级的基础模型，并使用预训练分子嵌入进行微调。
AI.result: 模型规模比先前方法大两个数量级，FID指标提升两倍，KID指标提升十倍，通过分子嵌入微调实现了对未知分子响应的最先进模拟性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统分析流匹配模型设计空间，开发了简单有效的训练方法，构建了高性能基础模型，在细胞显微镜图像生成和分子响应模拟方面实现了显著改进。

title: CARV: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Compositional Analogical Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Analogical reasoning tests a fundamental aspect of human cognition: mapping the relation from one pair of objects to another. Existing evaluations of this ability in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) overlook the ability to compose rules from multiple sources, a critical component of higher-order intelligence. To close this gap, we introduce CARV (Compositional Analogical Reasoning in Vision), a novel task together with a 5,500-sample dataset as the first diagnostic benchmark. We extend the analogy from a single pair to multiple pairs, which requires MLLMs to extract symbolic rules from each pair and compose new transformations. Evaluation on the state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals a striking performance gap: even Gemini-2.5 Pro achieving only 40.4% accuracy, far below human-level performance of 100%. Diagnostic analysis shows two consistent failure modes: (1) decomposing visual changes into symbolic rules, and (2) maintaining robustness under diverse or complex settings, highlighting the limitations of current MLLMs on this task.

AI.tldr: CARV是一个新的多模态大语言模型评估基准，专注于视觉类比推理的组合能力，要求模型从多个图像对中提取符号规则并组合新变换，现有MLLMs表现远低于人类水平。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在类比推理评估中忽视了从多个来源组合规则的能力，这是高阶智能的关键组成部分，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 提出CARV任务和包含5,500个样本的数据集，将类比从单对扩展到多对，要求模型从每个图像对中提取符号规则并组合新变换，对最先进的MLLMs进行评估。
AI.result: 最先进的MLLMs表现存在显著差距：即使是Gemini-2.5 Pro也仅达到40.4%准确率，远低于人类100%的水平。诊断分析显示两个一致的失败模式：将视觉变化分解为符号规则的能力不足，以及在多样化或复杂设置下保持鲁棒性的能力有限。
AI.conclusion: CARV揭示了当前MLLMs在组合视觉类比推理任务上的局限性，特别是在符号规则提取和复杂场景鲁棒性方面，为未来模型改进提供了重要诊断基准。

title: TailNLG: A Multilingual Benchmark Addressing Verbalization of Long-Tail Entities
summary: The automatic verbalization of structured knowledge is a key task for making knowledge graphs accessible to non-expert users and supporting retrieval-augmented generation systems. Although recent advances in Data-to-Text generation have improved multilingual coverage, little attention has been paid to potential biases in the verbalization of rare entities, frequently known as long-tail entities. In this work, we present the first systematic study of long-tail entities in Data-to-Text generation. We introduce TailNLG, a new multilingual benchmark in English, Italian, and Spanish, built from Wikidata and covering entities with varying levels of popularity. We evaluate three different families of large language models in zero-shot settings and compare their performance on rare versus common entities, as well as against the established WebNLG benchmark. Our results reveal a consistent bias against long-tail entities: embedding-based scores are lower, and model uncertainty is higher for rare entities. We further show that the impact of long-tail entities varies across models and languages, and that existing evaluation metrics do not consistently capture these differences, highlighting the need for more reliable evaluation frameworks.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统性地探讨了数据到文本生成中长尾实体（稀有实体）的偏见问题，创建了多语言基准TailNLG，并发现大语言模型在零样本设置下对稀有实体存在系统性偏见。
AI.motivation: 虽然数据到文本生成在多语言覆盖方面有所进展，但很少关注稀有实体（长尾实体）在文本化过程中可能存在的偏见。为了填补这一研究空白，作者进行了首个系统性研究。
AI.method: 1. 创建TailNLG基准：基于Wikidata构建，涵盖英语、意大利语和西班牙语，包含不同流行度级别的实体；2. 评估三种不同家族的大语言模型在零样本设置下的表现；3. 比较稀有实体与常见实体的性能差异；4. 与现有WebNLG基准进行对比。
AI.result: 1. 发现对长尾实体存在一致偏见：稀有实体的嵌入分数更低，模型不确定性更高；2. 长尾实体的影响因模型和语言而异；3. 现有评估指标不能一致地捕捉这些差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了数据到文本生成中对长尾实体的系统性偏见，表明需要更可靠的评估框架来准确评估模型在处理稀有实体时的性能。

title: SARL: Label-Free Reinforcement Learning by Rewarding Reasoning Topology
summary: Reinforcement learning has become central to improving large reasoning models, but its success still relies heavily on verifiable rewards or labeled supervision. This limits its applicability to open ended domains where correctness is ambiguous and cannot be verified. Moreover, reasoning trajectories remain largely unconstrained, and optimization towards final answer can favor early exploitation over generalization. In this work, we ask whether general reasoning ability can be improved by teaching models how to think (the structure of reasoning) rather than what to produce (the outcome of reasoning) and extend traditional RLVR to open ended settings. We introduce structure aware reinforcement learning (SARL), a label free framework that constructs a per response Reasoning Map from intermediate thinking steps and rewards its small world topology, inspired by complex networks and the functional organization of the human brain. SARL encourages reasoning trajectories that are both locally coherent and globally efficient, shifting supervision from destination to path. Our experiments on Qwen3-4B show SARL surpasses ground truth based RL and prior label free RL baselines, achieving the best average gain of 9.1% under PPO and 11.6% under GRPO on math tasks and 34.6% under PPO and 30.4% under GRPO on open ended tasks. Beyond good performance, SARL also exhibits lower KL divergence, higher policy entropy, indicating a more stable and exploratory training and generalized reasoning ability.

AI.tldr: SARL是一种无标签强化学习框架，通过构建推理地图并奖励其小世界拓扑结构来提升大模型的通用推理能力，而不是监督最终答案。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习在开放领域推理中存在局限性：依赖可验证的奖励或标注监督，无法处理正确性模糊的开放领域；推理轨迹缺乏约束，优化可能偏向早期利用而非泛化。
AI.method: 提出结构感知强化学习(SARL)：从中间思考步骤构建每个响应的推理地图，基于复杂网络和大脑功能组织理论，奖励其小世界拓扑结构，鼓励局部连贯且全局高效的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B上的实验显示，SARL在数学任务上比基于真实标签的RL和先前无标签RL基线平均提升9.1%(PPO)和11.6%(GRPO)，在开放任务上提升34.6%(PPO)和30.4%(GRPO)。同时表现出更低的KL散度和更高的策略熵。
AI.conclusion: SARL通过从监督目的地转向监督路径，在无标签情况下有效提升模型的通用推理能力，实现更稳定、探索性更强的训练和泛化推理能力。

title: Understanding Teacher Revisions of Large Language Model-Generated Feedback
comment: Accepted as full paper to the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate formative feedback for students, yet little is known about how teachers revise this feedback before it reaches learners. Teachers' revisions shape what students receive, making revision practices central to evaluating AI classroom tools. We analyze a dataset of 1,349 instances of AI-generated feedback and corresponding teacher-edited explanations from 117 teachers. We examine (i) textual characteristics associated with teacher revisions, (ii) whether revision decisions can be predicted from the AI feedback text, and (iii) how revisions change the pedagogical type of feedback delivered. First, we find that teachers accept AI feedback without modification in about 80% of cases, while edited feedback tends to be significantly longer and subsequently shortened by teachers. Editing behavior varies substantially across teachers: about 50% never edit AI feedback, and only about 10% edit more than two-thirds of feedback instances. Second, machine learning models trained only on the AI feedback text as input features, using sentence embeddings, achieve fair performance in identifying which feedback will be revised (AUC=0.75). Third, qualitative coding shows that when revisions occur, teachers often simplify AI-generated feedback, shifting it away from high-information explanations toward more concise, corrective forms. Together, these findings characterize how teachers engage with AI-generated feedback in practice and highlight opportunities to design feedback systems that better align with teacher priorities while reducing unnecessary editing effort.

AI.tldr: 研究分析教师如何修订AI生成的反馈：80%的AI反馈被教师直接接受，编辑后的反馈通常更长但会被教师缩短，教师编辑行为差异很大，机器学习模型能预测哪些反馈会被修订，修订通常将反馈简化为更简洁的纠正形式。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地为学生生成形成性反馈，但教师在这些反馈到达学生之前如何修订这些反馈尚不清楚。教师的修订决定了学生最终收到的内容，因此修订实践对于评估AI课堂工具至关重要。
AI.method: 分析了来自117位教师的1,349个AI生成反馈实例及相应的教师编辑解释。研究包括：(1)分析教师修订的文本特征，(2)使用机器学习模型（基于句子嵌入）仅从AI反馈文本预测修订决策，(3)通过定性编码分析修订如何改变反馈的教学类型。
AI.result:
1. 教师在大约80%的情况下直接接受AI反馈而不做修改；编辑后的反馈通常显著更长，但随后会被教师缩短；编辑行为在教师间差异很大：约50%的教师从不编辑AI反馈，只有约10%的教师编辑超过三分之二的反馈实例。
2. 仅使用AI反馈文本作为输入特征的机器学习模型在识别哪些反馈将被修订方面表现良好（AUC=0.75）。
3. 定性编码显示，当发生修订时，教师通常简化AI生成的反馈，将其从高信息量的解释转向更简洁的纠正形式。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现描述了教师在实践中如何与AI生成的反馈互动，并强调了设计反馈系统的机会，这些系统能更好地与教师优先事项对齐，同时减少不必要的编辑工作。

title: HeteroHub: An Applicable Data Management Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Embodied Agent System
summary: Heterogeneous Multi-Embodied Agent Systems involve coordinating multiple embodied agents with diverse capabilities to accomplish tasks in dynamic environments. This process requires the collection, generation, and consumption of massive, heterogeneous data, which primarily falls into three categories: static knowledge regarding the agents, tasks, and environments; multimodal training datasets tailored for various AI models; and high-frequency sensor streams. However, existing frameworks lack a unified data management infrastructure to support the real-world deployment of such systems. To address this gap, we present \textbf{HeteroHub}, a data-centric framework that integrates static metadata, task-aligned training corpora, and real-time data streams. The framework supports task-aware model training, context-sensitive execution, and closed-loop control driven by real-world feedback. In our demonstration, HeteroHub successfully coordinates multiple embodied AI agents to execute complex tasks, illustrating how a robust data management framework can enable scalable, maintainable, and evolvable embodied AI systems.

AI.tldr: HeteroHub是一个数据中心的框架，用于管理异构多具身智能体系统中的静态元数据、任务对齐训练语料和实时数据流，支持任务感知模型训练、上下文敏感执行和闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 异构多具身智能体系统需要在动态环境中协调具有不同能力的多个具身智能体完成任务，这涉及收集、生成和消费大量异构数据。现有框架缺乏统一的数据管理基础设施来支持此类系统的实际部署。
AI.method: 提出HeteroHub框架，集成静态元数据（关于智能体、任务和环境的静态知识）、任务对齐训练语料（为各种AI模型定制的多模态训练数据集）和实时数据流（高频传感器流）。
AI.result: 在演示中，HeteroHub成功协调了多个具身AI智能体执行复杂任务，展示了强大的数据管理框架如何实现可扩展、可维护和可演化的具身AI系统。
AI.conclusion: HeteroHub通过统一的数据管理基础设施解决了异构多具身智能体系统中的数据管理挑战，为实际部署提供了支持任务感知模型训练、上下文敏感执行和闭环控制的框架。

title: Conversational Agents and the Understanding of Human Language: Reflections on AI, LLMs, and Cognitive Science
summary: In this paper, we discuss the relationship between natural language processing by computers (NLP) and the understanding of the human language capacity, as studied by linguistics and cognitive science. We outline the evolution of NLP from its beginnings until the age of large language models, and highlight for each of its main paradigms some similarities and differences with theories of the human language capacity. We conclude that the evolution of language technology has not substantially deepened our understanding of how human minds process natural language, despite the impressive language abilities attained by current chatbots using artificial neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了计算机自然语言处理（NLP）与语言学、认知科学对人类语言能力理解之间的关系，分析了从NLP起源到大型语言模型时代的发展历程，指出尽管当前聊天机器人展现出令人印象深刻的语言能力，但语言技术的演进并未显著加深我们对人类大脑处理自然语言机制的理解。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探讨计算机自然语言处理技术发展与人类语言认知理解之间的关系，分析NLP各个主要范式与人类语言能力理论之间的相似性和差异，评估语言技术进步是否真正增进了我们对人类语言处理机制的认识。
AI.method: 通过历史回顾的方法，梳理NLP从起源到大型语言模型时代的发展历程，对每个主要范式（如基于规则的方法、统计方法、神经网络方法等）进行系统分析，比较这些技术范式与语言学、认知科学中关于人类语言能力的理论之间的异同。
AI.result: 研究发现，尽管NLP技术经历了显著演进，当前基于人工神经网络的聊天机器人也展现出令人印象深刻的语言能力，但语言技术的发展并未实质性地加深我们对人类大脑如何处理自然语言的理解。NLP的各个范式与人类语言认知理论之间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 计算机自然语言处理技术的演进，包括当前大型语言模型的发展，并未显著增进我们对人类语言处理机制的理解。尽管技术取得了巨大进步，但NLP范式与人类语言认知理论之间的根本差异仍然存在，技术发展本身并不等同于对人类语言能力的科学理解。

title: The Language of Touch: Translating Vibrations into Text with Dual-Branch Learning
summary: The standardization of vibrotactile data by IEEE P1918.1 workgroup has greatly advanced its applications in virtual reality, human-computer interaction and embodied artificial intelligence. Despite these efforts, the semantic interpretation and understanding of vibrotactile signals remain an unresolved challenge. In this paper, we make the first attempt to address vibrotactile captioning, {\it i.e.}, generating natural language descriptions from vibrotactile signals. We propose Vibrotactile Periodic-Aperiodic Captioning (ViPAC), a method designed to handle the intrinsic properties of vibrotactile data, including hybrid periodic-aperiodic structures and the lack of spatial semantics. Specifically, ViPAC employs a dual-branch strategy to disentangle periodic and aperiodic components, combined with a dynamic fusion mechanism that adaptively integrates signal features. It also introduces an orthogonality constraint and weighting regularization to ensure feature complementarity and fusion consistency. Additionally, we construct LMT108-CAP, the first vibrotactile-text paired dataset, using GPT-4o to generate five constrained captions per surface image from the popular LMT-108 dataset. Experiments show that ViPAC significantly outperforms the baseline methods adapted from audio and image captioning, achieving superior lexical fidelity and semantic alignment.

AI.tldr: ViPAC是首个解决触觉振动信号字幕生成的方法，通过双分支策略分离周期性/非周期性成分，结合动态融合机制，在首个触觉-文本配对数据集LMT108-CAP上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管IEEE P1918.1工作组已标准化触觉振动数据，但其语义解释和理解仍是未解决的挑战。本文首次尝试解决触觉振动字幕生成问题，即从触觉振动信号生成自然语言描述。
AI.method: 提出ViPAC方法，采用双分支策略分离周期性/非周期性成分，结合动态融合机制自适应整合信号特征。引入正交约束和加权正则化确保特征互补性和融合一致性。构建首个触觉-文本配对数据集LMT108-CAP，使用GPT-4o为LMT-108数据集中的每个表面图像生成五个约束性字幕。
AI.result: 实验表明，ViPAC显著优于从音频和图像字幕生成方法改编的基线方法，在词汇保真度和语义对齐方面表现优异。
AI.conclusion: ViPAC是首个解决触觉振动字幕生成的方法，能有效处理触觉振动数据的固有特性，包括混合周期性-非周期性结构和缺乏空间语义的问题，为触觉信号理解提供了新途径。

title: What an Autonomous Agent Discovers About Molecular Transformer Design: Does It Transfer?
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables; code and data at https://github.com/ewijaya/autoresearch-mol
summary: Deep learning models for drug-like molecules and proteins overwhelmingly reuse transformer architectures designed for natural language, yet whether molecular sequences benefit from different designs has not been systematically tested. We deploy autonomous architecture search via an agent across three sequence types (SMILES, protein, and English text as control), running 3,106 experiments on a single GPU. For SMILES, architecture search is counterproductive: tuning learning rates and schedules alone outperforms the full search (p = 0.001). For natural language, architecture changes drive 81% of improvement (p = 0.009). Proteins fall between the two. Surprisingly, although the agent discovers distinct architectures per domain (p = 0.004), every innovation transfers across all three domains with <1% degradation, indicating that the differences reflect search-path dependence rather than fundamental biological requirements. We release a decision framework and open-source toolkit for molecular modeling teams to choose between autonomous architecture search and simple hyperparameter tuning.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过自主架构搜索发现：对于SMILES分子序列，简单的超参数调优比架构搜索更有效；对于自然语言，架构改进贡献了81%的性能提升；蛋白质序列介于两者之间。令人惊讶的是，尽管不同领域发现了不同的架构，但这些创新在所有三个领域都能有效迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前药物样分子和蛋白质的深度学习模型大多直接复用为自然语言设计的transformer架构，但分子序列是否受益于不同的设计尚未得到系统测试。研究者希望探索不同序列类型（SMILES、蛋白质和英语文本）是否真正需要不同的神经网络架构。
AI.method: 使用自主架构搜索代理在三种序列类型（SMILES、蛋白质和英语文本作为对照）上进行实验，共运行了3,106个实验，所有实验在单个GPU上完成。通过比较架构搜索与简单超参数调优的效果来评估不同序列类型对架构设计的敏感性。
AI.result: 对于SMILES序列，架构搜索适得其反：仅调优学习率和调度策略就能超越完整搜索的效果（p = 0.001）。对于自然语言，架构改变贡献了81%的性能改进（p = 0.009）。蛋白质序列介于两者之间。尽管代理发现了每个领域不同的架构（p = 0.004），但每个创新都能在所有三个领域有效迁移，性能下降不到1%。
AI.conclusion: 不同序列类型发现的架构差异反映了搜索路径依赖性，而非基本的生物学需求。研究团队发布了决策框架和开源工具包，帮助分子建模团队在自主架构搜索和简单超参数调优之间做出选择。

title: Unblur-SLAM: Dense Neural SLAM for Blurry Inputs
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures (based on the document's total length and the final Figure 9 ). Accepted By CVPR 2026
summary: We propose Unblur-SLAM, a novel RGB SLAM pipeline for sharp 3D reconstruction from blurred image inputs. In contrast to previous work, our approach is able to handle different types of blur and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in the presence of both motion blur and defocus blur. Moreover, we adjust the computation effort with the amount of blur in the input image. As a first stage, our method uses a feed-forward image deblurring model for which we propose a suitable training scheme that can improve both tracking and mapping modules. Frames that are successfully deblurred by the feed-forward network obtain refined poses and depth through local-global multi-view optimization and loop closure. Frames that fail the first stage deblurring are directly modeled through the global 3DGS representation and an additional blur network to model multiple blurred sub-frames and simulate the blur formation process in 3D space, thereby learning sharp details and refined sub-frame poses. Experiments on several real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in both pose estimation and sharp reconstruction results of geometry and texture.

AI.tldr: Unblur-SLAM提出了一种新颖的RGB SLAM管道，能够从模糊图像输入中实现清晰的3D重建，支持处理运动模糊和散焦模糊，并根据输入图像的模糊程度调整计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有SLAM系统在面对模糊图像输入时性能下降，难以实现清晰的3D重建。不同类型的模糊（如运动模糊和散焦模糊）对SLAM系统构成挑战，需要一种能够处理各种模糊类型并实现高质量重建的方法。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：第一阶段使用前馈图像去模糊模型，通过专门的训练方案改进跟踪和建图模块；成功去模糊的帧通过局部-全局多视图优化和闭环进行姿态和深度优化；第一阶段去模糊失败的帧则通过全局3D高斯表示和额外的模糊网络直接建模，在3D空间中模拟模糊形成过程，学习清晰细节和精细的子帧姿态。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，该方法在姿态估计和几何纹理的清晰重建结果方面都取得了持续改进，表现出最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: Unblur-SLAM能够有效处理不同类型的模糊图像，实现高质量的3D重建，通过自适应计算策略和两阶段处理方法，在模糊条件下显著提升了SLAM系统的性能。

title: ProText: A benchmark dataset for measuring (mis)gendering in long-form texts
summary: We introduce ProText, a dataset for measuring gendering and misgendering in stylistically diverse long-form English texts. ProText spans three dimensions: Theme nouns (names, occupations, titles, kinship terms), Theme category (stereotypically male, stereotypically female, gender-neutral/non-gendered), and Pronoun category (masculine, feminine, gender-neutral, none). The dataset is designed to probe (mis)gendering in text transformations such as summarization and rewrites using state-of-the-art Large Language Models, extending beyond traditional pronoun resolution benchmarks and beyond the gender binary. We validated ProText through a mini case study, showing that even with just two prompts and two models, we can draw nuanced insights regarding gender bias, stereotyping, misgendering, and gendering. We reveal systematic gender bias, particularly when inputs contain no explicit gender cues or when models default to heteronormative assumptions.

AI.tldr: ProText是一个用于测量英语长文本中性别化和错误性别化的数据集，涵盖三个维度：主题名词、主题类别和代词类别，旨在探测大型语言模型在文本转换中的性别偏见问题。
AI.motivation: 传统代词解析基准测试存在局限性，无法全面评估大型语言模型在文本转换（如摘要和重写）中的性别偏见、刻板印象、错误性别化和性别化问题，特别是超越性别二元论的范畴。
AI.method: 创建ProText数据集，涵盖三个维度：主题名词（姓名、职业、头衔、亲属关系词）、主题类别（刻板印象男性、刻板印象女性、性别中性/非性别化）和代词类别（男性化、女性化、性别中性、无代词）。通过小型案例研究验证数据集，使用两个提示和两个模型进行分析。
AI.result: 即使仅使用两个提示和两个模型，也能获得关于性别偏见、刻板印象、错误性别化和性别化的细致洞察。研究发现系统性的性别偏见，特别是在输入中没有明确性别线索或模型默认采用异性恋规范假设时。
AI.conclusion: ProText数据集能够有效探测大型语言模型在文本转换中的性别相关问题，超越了传统代词解析基准测试和性别二元论的局限，揭示了模型在性别处理方面的系统性偏见。

title: Implicit neural representations for larval zebrafish brain microscopy: a reproducible benchmark on the MapZebrain atlas
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer continuous coordinate-based encodings for atlas registration, cross-modality resampling, sparse-view completion, and compact sharing of neuroanatomical data. Yet reproducible evaluation is lacking for high-resolution larval zebrafish microscopy, where preserving neuropil boundaries and fine neuronal processes is critical. We present a reproducible INR benchmark for the MapZebrain larval zebrafish brain atlas. Using a unified, seed-controlled protocol, we compare SIREN, Fourier features, Haar positional encoding, and a multi-resolution grid on 950 grayscale microscopy images, including atlas slices and single-neuron projections. Images are normalized with per-image (1,99) percentiles estimated from 10% of pixels in non-held-out columns, and spatial generalization is tested with a deterministic 40% column-wise hold-out along the X-axis. Haar and Fourier achieve the strongest macro-averaged reconstruction fidelity on held-out columns (about 26 dB), while the grid is moderately behind. SIREN performs worse in macro averages but remains competitive on area-weighted micro averages in the all-in-one regime. SSIM and edge-focused error further show that Haar and Fourier preserve boundaries more accurately. These results indicate that explicit spectral and multiscale encodings better capture high-frequency neuroanatomical detail than smoother-bias alternatives. For MapZebrain workflows, Haar and Fourier are best suited to boundary-sensitive tasks such as atlas registration, label transfer, and morphology-preserving sharing, while SIREN remains a lightweight baseline for background modelling or denoising.

AI.tldr: 该研究为MapZebrain斑马鱼脑图谱建立了可复现的隐式神经表示基准测试，比较了四种编码方法在950张显微图像上的表现，发现Haar和傅里叶编码在边界保持和重建保真度方面最优。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏针对高分辨率斑马鱼显微图像的可复现评估方法，而保持神经纤维边界和精细神经元结构对这些任务至关重要。研究旨在为MapZebrain图谱建立标准化的隐式神经表示基准。
AI.method: 使用统一的种子控制协议，在950张灰度显微图像上比较SIREN、傅里叶特征、Haar位置编码和多分辨率网格四种方法。采用确定性40%列保留测试空间泛化能力，图像归一化使用非保留列中10%像素估计的(1,99)百分位数。
AI.result: Haar和傅里叶编码在保留列上获得最强的宏观平均重建保真度（约26 dB），网格方法稍逊，SIREN在宏观平均上表现较差但在微观平均上仍有竞争力。SSIM和边缘误差分析显示Haar和傅里叶能更准确地保持边界。
AI.conclusion: 显式频谱和多尺度编码比平滑偏置方法能更好地捕捉高频神经解剖细节。对于MapZebrain工作流，Haar和傅里叶最适合边界敏感任务，而SIREN可作为背景建模或去噪的轻量级基线。

title: Beyond the Answer: Decoding the Behavior of LLMs as Scientific Reasoners
comment: Accepted at the Post-AGI Science and Society Workshop at ICLR 2026
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve increasingly sophisticated performance on complex reasoning tasks, current architectures serve as critical proxies for the internal heuristics of frontier models. Characterizing emergent reasoning is vital for long-term interpretability and safety. Furthermore, understanding how prompting modulates these processes is essential, as natural language will likely be the primary interface for interacting with AGI systems. In this work, we use a custom variant of Genetic Pareto (GEPA) to systematically optimize prompts for scientific reasoning tasks, and analyze how prompting can affect reasoning behavior. We investigate the structural patterns and logical heuristics inherent in GEPA-optimized prompts, and evaluate their transferability and brittleness. Our findings reveal that gains in scientific reasoning often correspond to model-specific heuristics that fail to generalize across systems, which we call "local" logic. By framing prompt optimization as a tool for model interpretability, we argue that mapping these preferred reasoning structures for LLMs is an important prerequisite for effectively collaborating with superhuman intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文使用GEPA方法优化科学推理任务的提示，发现性能提升往往对应模型特定的启发式方法，这些方法无法跨系统泛化，称为"局部逻辑"。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在复杂推理任务上表现日益成熟，理解其内部启发式方法对可解释性和安全性至关重要。同时，理解提示如何调节这些推理过程也很重要，因为自然语言可能是与AGI系统交互的主要接口。
AI.method: 使用自定义的遗传帕累托优化(GEPA)方法，系统性地优化科学推理任务的提示，分析提示如何影响推理行为。研究GEPA优化提示的结构模式和逻辑启发式，评估其可迁移性和脆弱性。
AI.result: 研究发现，科学推理性能的提升通常对应模型特定的启发式方法，这些方法无法跨系统泛化，作者称之为"局部逻辑"。这些优化的提示往往包含特定的结构模式和逻辑策略。
AI.conclusion: 通过将提示优化作为模型可解释性的工具，作者认为映射LLMs偏好的推理结构是有效与超人类智能协作的重要前提。理解这些局部逻辑对于长期的安全性和可解释性至关重要。

title: Model Capability Dominates: Inference-Time Optimization Lessons from AIMO 3
summary: Majority voting over multiple LLM attempts improves mathematical reasoning, but correlated errors limit the effective sample size. A natural fix: assign structurally different reasoning strategies to different voters to decorrelate errors. We test this Diverse Prompt Mixer in the AIMO~3 competition: 3 models, 23+ experiments, and 50 IMO-level problems on a single H100 80 GB with a 5-hour limit. Every intervention fails. High-temperature sampling already decorrelates errors sufficiently; weaker prompt strategies reduce per-attempt accuracy more than they reduce correlation. Across a 17-point model capability gap and every inference-time optimization we tried, model capability dominates by an order of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在数学推理任务中，通过多样化提示策略来减少LLM投票中的相关误差是无效的，因为模型能力差异比误差相关性对性能的影响大一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 虽然多数投票能提升LLM的数学推理能力，但相关误差限制了有效样本量。研究者希望通过为不同投票者分配结构不同的推理策略来减少误差相关性。
AI.method: 在AIMO~3竞赛中测试Diverse Prompt Mixer方法：使用3个模型，进行23+次实验，处理50个IMO级别问题，在单个H100 80GB GPU上5小时内完成。比较不同提示策略对误差相关性的影响。
AI.result: 所有干预措施都失败了。高温采样已经足够减少误差相关性；较弱的提示策略虽然减少了相关性，但更大幅度地降低了单次尝试的准确性。模型能力差异比任何推理时优化都重要一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 在数学推理任务中，模型能力是决定性能的主要因素，比减少误差相关性的策略重要得多。试图通过多样化提示策略来提升多数投票效果的努力是无效的。

title: arg-VU: Affordance Reasoning with Physics-Aware 3D Geometry for Visual Understanding in Robotic Surgery
summary: Affordance reasoning provides a principled link between perception and action, yet remains underexplored in surgical robotics, where tissues are highly deformable, compliant, and dynamically coupled with tool motion. We present arg-VU, a physics-aware affordance reasoning framework that integrates temporally consistent geometry tracking with constraint-induced mechanical modeling for surgical visual understanding. Surgical scenes are reconstructed using 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and converted into a temporally tracked surface representation. Extended Position-Based Dynamics (XPBD) embeds local deformation constraints and produces representative geometry points (RGPs) whose constraint sensitivities define anisotropic stiffness metrics capturing the local constraint-manifold geometry. Robotic tool poses in SE(3) are incorporated to compute rigidly induced displacements at RGPs, from which we derive two complementary measures: a physics-aware compliance energy that evaluates mechanical feasibility with respect to local deformation constraints, and a positional agreement score that captures motion alignment (as kinematic motion baseline). Experiments on surgical video datasets show that arg-VU yields more stable, physically consistent, and interpretable affordance predictions than kinematic baselines. These results demonstrate that physics-aware geometric representations enable reliable affordance reasoning for deformable surgical environments and support embodied robotic interaction.

AI.tldr: arg-VU是一个物理感知的affordance推理框架，通过结合时间一致的几何跟踪和约束诱导的机械建模，为手术视觉理解提供物理一致的affordance预测。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人领域中的affordance推理尚未充分探索，手术组织具有高度可变形、柔顺且与工具运动动态耦合的特性，需要物理感知的方法来可靠地连接感知与动作。
AI.method: 使用3D高斯泼溅进行手术场景重建并转换为时间跟踪的表面表示；采用扩展位置动力学嵌入局部变形约束并生成代表性几何点；通过约束敏感性定义各向异性刚度度量；结合SE(3)中的机器人工具位姿计算刚性诱导位移，推导物理感知的顺应性能量和位置一致性评分。
AI.result: 在手术视频数据集上的实验表明，arg-VU比运动学基线方法产生更稳定、物理一致且可解释的affordance预测，验证了物理感知几何表示在可变形手术环境中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知的几何表示能够为可变形手术环境实现可靠的affordance推理，并支持具身机器人交互，为手术机器人提供了连接感知与动作的物理一致框架。

title: Dogfight Search: A Swarm-Based Optimization Algorithm for Complex Engineering Optimization and Mountainous Terrain Path Planning
summary: Dogfight is a tactical behavior of cooperation between fighters. Inspired by this, this paper proposes a novel metaphor-free metaheuristic algorithm called Dogfight Search (DoS). Unlike traditional algorithms, DoS draws algorithmic framework from the inspiration, but its search mechanism is constructed based on the displacement integration equations in kinematics. Through experimental validation on CEC2017 and CEC2022 benchmark test functions, 10 real-world constrained optimization problems and mountainous terrain path planning tasks, DoS significantly outperforms 7 advanced competitors in overall performance and ranks first in the Friedman ranking. Furthermore, this paper compares the performance of DoS with 3 SOTA algorithms on the CEC2017 and CEC2022 benchmark test functions. The results show that DoS continues to maintain its lead, demonstrating strong competitiveness. The source code of DoS is available at https://ww2.mathworks.cn/matlabcentral/fileexchange/183519-dogfight-search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Dogfight Search (DoS)的新型无隐喻元启发式算法，灵感来源于战斗机协同作战的战术行为。该算法从灵感中提取算法框架，但搜索机制基于运动学中的位移积分方程构建。通过多组实验验证，DoS在整体性能上显著优于7个先进竞争对手，在Friedman排名中位列第一。
AI.motivation: 受战斗机协同作战战术行为的启发，本文旨在开发一种新型元启发式算法。传统算法往往依赖生物或自然现象的隐喻，而本文希望构建一个基于运动学原理的无隐喻算法，以提高优化性能。
AI.method: 提出Dogfight Search (DoS)算法，其算法框架从战斗机协同作战的战术行为中获取灵感，但搜索机制基于运动学中的位移积分方程构建。这是一种无隐喻的元启发式算法设计方法。
AI.result: 在CEC2017和CEC2022基准测试函数、10个现实世界约束优化问题以及山地地形路径规划任务上的实验验证表明，DoS在整体性能上显著优于7个先进竞争对手，在Friedman排名中位列第一。与3个SOTA算法的比较中，DoS继续保持领先地位，显示出强大的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Dogfight Search (DoS)是一种有效的无隐喻元启发式算法，基于运动学原理构建的搜索机制使其在多种优化问题上表现出卓越性能，具有强大的竞争力。算法源代码已在MATLAB中央文件交换平台公开。

title: What can LLMs tell us about the mechanisms behind polarity illusions in humans? Experiments across model scales and training steps
summary: I use the Pythia scaling suite (Biderman et al. 2023) to investigate if and how two well-known polarity illusions, the NPI illusion and the depth charge illusion, arise in LLMs. The NPI illusion becomes weaker and ultimately disappears as model size increases, while the depth charge illusion becomes stronger in larger models. The results have implications for human sentence processing: it may not be necessary to assume "rational inference" mechanisms that convert ill-formed sentences into well-formed ones to explain polarity illusions, given that LLMs cannot plausibly engage in this kind of reasoning, especially at the implicit level of next-token prediction. On the other hand, shallow, "good enough" processing and/or partial grammaticalization of prescriptively ungrammatical structures may both occur in LLMs. I propose a synthesis of different theoretical accounts that is rooted in the basic tenets of construction grammar.

AI.tldr: 研究使用Pythia缩放套件探究两种极性幻觉（NPI幻觉和深度电荷幻觉）在LLMs中的表现，发现NPI幻觉随模型增大而减弱消失，深度电荷幻觉则随模型增大而增强，对理解人类句子处理机制有启示。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究两种著名的极性幻觉（NPI幻觉和深度电荷幻觉）是否以及如何在大型语言模型中产生，以理解这些幻觉的认知机制，并为人类句子处理理论提供新的见解。
AI.method: 使用Pythia缩放套件（Biderman等人2023年开发）来研究不同规模的语言模型中两种极性幻觉的表现，通过系统性的模型规模变化来观察幻觉行为的变化模式。
AI.result: 研究发现NPI幻觉随着模型规模的增大而逐渐减弱并最终消失，而深度电荷幻觉则随着模型规模的增大而变得更加强烈，呈现出相反的规模效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，解释极性幻觉可能不需要假设"理性推理"机制，LLMs的浅层"足够好"处理和/或不规范结构的部分语法化可能同时存在，提出了基于构式语法基本原则的理论综合。

title: Envisioning global urban development with satellite imagery and generative AI
summary: Urban development has been a defining force in human history, shaping cities for centuries. However, past studies mostly analyze such development as predictive tasks, failing to reflect its generative nature. Therefore, this study designs a multimodal generative AI framework to envision sustainable urban development at a global scale. By integrating prompts and geospatial controls, our framework can generate high-fidelity, diverse, and realistic urban satellite imagery across the 500 largest metropolitan areas worldwide. It enables users to specify urban development goals, creating new images that align with them while offering diverse scenarios whose appearance can be controlled with text prompts and geospatial constraints. It also facilitates urban redevelopment practices by learning from the surrounding environment. Beyond visual synthesis, we find that it encodes and interprets latent representations of urban form for global cross-city learning, successfully transferring styles of urban environments across a global spatial network. The latent representations can also enhance downstream prediction tasks such as carbon emission prediction. Further, human expert evaluation confirms that our generated urban images are comparable to real urban images. Overall, this study presents innovative approaches for accelerated urban planning and supports scenario-based planning processes for worldwide cities.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个多模态生成式AI框架，用于在全球尺度上生成可持续城市发展愿景，能够为全球500个最大都市区生成高保真、多样化的城市卫星图像。
AI.motivation: 传统研究大多将城市发展分析为预测任务，未能反映其生成性本质。因此需要设计一个能够体现城市发展生成特性的框架，支持全球尺度的可持续城市发展愿景规划。
AI.method: 开发了一个多模态生成式AI框架，通过整合文本提示和地理空间控制，能够生成高保真、多样化且逼真的城市卫星图像。该框架允许用户指定城市发展目标，并基于周围环境学习支持城市再开发实践。
AI.result: 框架成功为全球500个最大都市区生成城市卫星图像，能够编码和解释城市形态的潜在表征，实现全球跨城市学习，并在城市环境风格迁移方面表现良好。潜在表征还能增强下游预测任务（如碳排放预测）。人类专家评估确认生成图像与真实城市图像相当。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为加速城市规划提供了创新方法，支持全球城市基于场景的规划过程，展示了生成式AI在城市发展愿景规划中的重要应用价值。

title: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
summary: The performance of large language model (LLM) systems depends not only on model weights, but also on their harness: the code that determines what information to store, retrieve, and present to the model. Yet harnesses are still designed largely by hand, and existing text optimizers are poorly matched to this setting because they compress feedback too aggressively. We introduce Meta-Harness, an outer-loop system that searches over harness code for LLM applications. It uses an agentic proposer that accesses the source code, scores, and execution traces of all prior candidates through a filesystem. On online text classification, Meta-Harness improves over a state-of-the-art context management system by 7.7 points while using 4x fewer context tokens. On retrieval-augmented math reasoning, a single discovered harness improves accuracy on 200 IMO-level problems by 4.7 points on average across five held-out models. On agentic coding, discovered harnesses surpass the best hand-engineered baselines on TerminalBench-2. Together, these results show that richer access to prior experience can enable automated harness engineering.

AI.tldr: Meta-Harness是一个用于自动搜索LLM应用harness代码的外层系统，通过访问源代码、评分和执行轨迹来优化LLM系统的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM系统的性能不仅取决于模型权重，还取决于其harness（决定存储、检索和呈现信息的代码）。然而，harness设计仍主要依赖手工，现有文本优化器在此场景下效果不佳，因为它们对反馈压缩过于激进。
AI.method: 引入Meta-Harness系统，通过一个能够访问源代码、评分和所有先前候选执行轨迹的代理提议器，在文件系统中搜索harness代码。该系统采用外层循环架构，利用丰富的先前经验进行自动化harness工程。
AI.result: 在在线文本分类任务中，Meta-Harness比最先进的上下文管理系统提高了7.7个点，同时使用4倍更少的上下文token。在检索增强的数学推理任务中，单个发现的harness在200个IMO级别问题上平均提高了4.7个点。在代理编码任务中，发现的harness超越了最佳手工设计的基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，对先前经验的更丰富访问能够实现自动化harness工程，显著提升LLM系统在各种任务上的性能表现。

title: KazByte: Adapting Qwen models to Kazakh via Byte-level Adapter
summary: Large language models fragment Kazakh text into many more tokens than equivalent English text, because their tokenizers were built for high-resource languages. This tokenizer tax inflates compute, shortens the effective context window, and weakens the model's grip on Kazakh morphology. We propose to bypass the tokenizer entirely by feeding raw bytes through a small adapter that learns to speak the internal language of a frozen Qwen2.5-7B. Once the adapter is trained, we freeze it and fine-tune only the attention layers of Qwen on Kazakh text. Our central hypothesis is that this two-stage process -- first teach the interface, then adapt the model -- should match or exceed the accuracy of the original Qwen2.5-7B on standard Kazakh benchmarks. This report describes the ByteKaz architecture and training protocol. Empirical validation is ongoing; this version stakes the design and hypotheses for the record.

AI.tldr: 提出ByteKaz架构，通过绕过分词器直接处理原始字节来改善哈萨克语在大型语言模型中的处理效率，避免因分词器导致的计算开销增加和上下文窗口缩短问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的分词器主要针对高资源语言设计，导致哈萨克语文本被分割成比同等英语文本更多的token，这增加了计算成本、缩短了有效上下文窗口，并削弱了模型对哈萨克语形态学的把握。
AI.method: 提出两阶段方法：首先训练一个小型适配器，学习将原始字节映射到冻结的Qwen2.5-7B模型的内部语言表示；然后冻结适配器，仅微调Qwen的注意力层来处理哈萨克语文本。
AI.result: 实证验证正在进行中，本文档主要记录了ByteKaz架构的设计和假设，旨在为后续研究提供基础。
AI.conclusion: 提出的ByteKaz方法有望在标准哈萨克语基准测试中达到或超过原始Qwen2.5-7B的准确性，通过绕过分词器直接处理字节来改善低资源语言的模型性能。

title: Dual-View Optical Flow for 4D Micro-Expression Recognition - A Multi-Stream Fusion Attention Approach
summary: Micro-expression recognition is vital for affective computing but remains challenging due to the extremely brief, low-intensity facial motions involved and the high-dimensional nature of 4D mesh data. To address these challenges, we introduce a dual-view optical flow approach that simplifies mesh processing by capturing each micro-expression sequence from two synchronized viewpoints and computing optical flow to represent motion. Our pipeline begins with view separation and sequence-wise face cropping to ensure spatial consistency, followed by automatic apex-frame detection based on peak motion intensity in both views. We decompose each sequence into onset-apex and apex-offset phases, extracting horizontal, vertical, and magnitude flow channels for each phase. These are fed into our Triple-Stream MicroAttNet, which employs a fusion attention module to adaptively weight modality-specific features and a squeeze-and-excitation block to enhance magnitude representations. Training uses focal loss to mitigate class imbalance and the Adam optimizer with early stopping. Evaluated on the multi-label 4DME dataset, comprising 24 subjects and five emotion categories, in the 4DMR IJCAI Workshop Challenge 2025, our method achieves a macro-UF1 score of 0.536, outperforming the official baseline by over 50\% and securing first place. Ablation studies confirm that both the fusion attention and SE components each contribute up to 3.6 points of UF1 gain. These results demonstrate that dual-view, phase-aware optical flow combined with multi-stream fusion yields a robust and interpretable solution for 4D micro-expression recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出双视角光流方法处理4D微表情识别，通过双视角同步捕捉、光流表示运动、自动顶点帧检测、相位分解，结合三流网络和注意力融合，在4DME数据集上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 微表情识别对情感计算至关重要，但由于面部动作极其短暂、强度低，且4D网格数据维度高，现有方法面临挑战。需要简化4D网格处理并有效捕捉微表情的细微运动特征。
AI.method: 1) 双视角光流：从两个同步视角捕捉微表情序列，计算光流表示运动；2) 预处理：视角分离、序列级人脸裁剪确保空间一致性；3) 自动顶点帧检测：基于双视角峰值运动强度；4) 相位分解：将序列分为起始-顶点和顶点-结束两个阶段；5) 三流网络(Triple-Stream MicroAttNet)：提取水平、垂直和幅度三个光流通道特征；6) 融合注意力模块：自适应加权模态特定特征；7) SE模块：增强幅度表示；8) 训练策略：使用焦点损失缓解类别不平衡，Adam优化器配合早停。
AI.result: 在4DME数据集(24个被试，5个情感类别)的4DMR IJCAI Workshop Challenge 2025中，获得宏观UF1分数0.536，比官方基线提升超过50%，排名第一。消融实验显示融合注意力和SE组件各自贡献高达3.6个UF1分数提升。
AI.conclusion: 双视角、相位感知的光流结合多流融合为4D微表情识别提供了鲁棒且可解释的解决方案。该方法有效简化了4D网格处理，通过双视角和相位分解增强了运动特征表示，注意力机制进一步提升了识别性能。

title: HumMusQA: A Human-written Music Understanding QA Benchmark Dataset
summary: The evaluation of music understanding in Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) requires a rigorously defined benchmark that truly tests whether models can perceive and interpret music, a standard that current data methodologies frequently fail to meet. This paper introduces a meticulously structured approach to music evaluation, proposing a new dataset of 320 hand-written questions curated and validated by experts with musical training, arguing that such focused, manual curation is superior for probing complex audio comprehension. To demonstrate the use of the dataset, we benchmark six state-of-the-art LALMs and additionally test their robustness to uni-modal shortcuts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的音乐理解评估基准，包含320个专家手工编写的问题，用于测试大型音频语言模型对音乐的感知和解释能力，并评估了6个最先进模型及其对单模态捷径的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前大型音频语言模型的音乐理解评估缺乏严谨的基准测试，现有数据方法无法真正测试模型是否能够感知和解释音乐。需要更专业、精心设计的评估标准来准确衡量模型的音乐理解能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种精心构建的音乐评估方法，创建了包含320个专家手工编写问题的数据集，这些问题经过音乐训练专家的策划和验证。使用该数据集对6个最先进的大型音频语言模型进行基准测试，并额外测试了它们对单模态捷径的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 通过专家手工策划的数据集对6个最先进的大型音频语言模型进行了基准测试，评估了它们在音乐理解任务上的表现，并分析了模型对单模态捷径的鲁棒性，为音乐理解评估提供了更可靠的基准。
AI.conclusion: 精心策划、专家验证的手工编写问题数据集是评估大型音频语言模型音乐理解能力的有效方法，能够更准确地测试模型的音频理解能力，为音乐理解评估提供了新的标准。

title: Beyond Textual Knowledge-Leveraging Multimodal Knowledge Bases for Enhancing Vision-and-Language Navigation
comment: Main paper (37 pages). Accepted for publication by the Information Processing and Management,Volume 63,Issue 6,September 2026,104766
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to navigate through complex unseen environments based on natural language instructions. However, existing methods often struggle to effectively capture key semantic cues and accurately align them with visual observations. To address this limitation, we propose Beyond Textual Knowledge (BTK), a VLN framework that synergistically integrates environment-specific textual knowledge with generative image knowledge bases. BTK employs Qwen3-4B to extract goal-related phrases and utilizes Flux-Schnell to construct two large-scale image knowledge bases: R2R-GP and REVERIE-GP. Additionally, we leverage BLIP-2 to construct a large-scale textual knowledge base derived from panoramic views, providing environment-specific semantic cues. These multimodal knowledge bases are effectively integrated via the Goal-Aware Augmentor and Knowledge Augmentor, significantly enhancing semantic grounding and cross-modal alignment. Extensive experiments on the R2R dataset with 7,189 trajectories and the REVERIE dataset with 21,702 instructions demonstrate that BTK significantly outperforms existing baselines. On the test unseen splits of R2R and REVERIE, SR increased by 5% and 2.07% respectively, and SPL increased by 4% and 3.69% respectively. The source code is available at https://github.com/yds3/IPM-BTK/.

AI.tldr: BTK框架通过整合环境特定文本知识和生成图像知识库，显著提升视觉语言导航性能，在R2R和REVERIE数据集上取得SOTA结果
AI.motivation: 现有VLN方法难以有效捕捉关键语义线索并准确对齐视觉观察，需要更好的跨模态对齐机制
AI.method: 提出BTK框架，使用Qwen3-4B提取目标相关短语，Flux-Schnell构建R2R-GP和REVERIE-GP图像知识库，BLIP-2构建全景视图文本知识库，通过Goal-Aware Augmentor和Knowledge Augmentor整合多模态知识
AI.result: 在R2R数据集（7,189轨迹）和REVERIE数据集（21,702指令）上显著超越现有基线，R2R测试未见分割SR提升5%、SPL提升4%，REVERIE测试未见分割SR提升2.07%、SPL提升3.69%
AI.conclusion: BTK框架通过协同整合环境特定文本知识和生成图像知识库，有效增强语义基础和跨模态对齐，显著提升VLN性能

title: Reward Hacking as Equilibrium under Finite Evaluation
