To address this, we present Marco DeepResearch, a deep research agent optimized with a verification-centric framework design at three levels: \textbf{(1)~QA Data Synthesis:} We introduce verification mechanisms to graph-based and agent-based QA synthesis to control question difficulty while ensuring answers are unique and correct; \textbf{(2)~Trajectory Construction:} We design a verification-driven trajectory synthesis method that injects explicit verification patterns into training trajectories; and \textbf{(3)~Test-time scaling:} We use Marco DeepResearch itself as a verifier at inference time and effectively improve performance on challenging questions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed Marco DeepResearch agent significantly outperforms 8B-scale deep research agents on most challenging benchmarks, such as BrowseComp and BrowseComp-ZH. Crucially, under a maximum budget of 600 tool calls, Marco DeepResearch even surpasses or approaches several 30B-scale agents, like Tongyi DeepResearch-30B.

AI.tldr: Marco DeepResearch是一个深度研究智能体，通过三层验证中心化框架设计优化：在QA数据合成中引入验证机制控制问题难度并确保答案正确性；在轨迹构建中注入显式验证模式；在测试时使用自身作为验证器。该智能体在挑战性基准测试中显著优于8B规模智能体，甚至在600次工具调用预算下接近或超越30B规模智能体。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体需要自主进行开放式调查，整合复杂信息检索和多步推理。为了在长时程任务中保持这种能力，训练和推理过程中的可靠验证至关重要。现有范式的主要瓶颈在于QA数据合成、轨迹构建和测试时扩展中缺乏显式验证机制，导致错误传播并降低整体性能。
AI.method: 提出Marco DeepResearch深度研究智能体，采用三层验证中心化框架设计：1) QA数据合成：在图基和智能体基QA合成中引入验证机制，控制问题难度并确保答案唯一正确；2) 轨迹构建：设计验证驱动的轨迹合成方法，在训练轨迹中注入显式验证模式；3) 测试时扩展：在推理时使用Marco DeepResearch自身作为验证器，提升挑战性问题性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Marco DeepResearch智能体在大多数挑战性基准测试（如BrowseComp和BrowseComp-ZH）上显著优于8B规模的深度研究智能体。在最大600次工具调用预算下，Marco DeepResearch甚至超越或接近多个30B规模智能体，如Tongyi DeepResearch-30B。
AI.conclusion: 验证中心化框架设计能有效提升深度研究智能体的性能，通过三层验证机制解决了现有范式中的关键瓶颈。Marco DeepResearch在资源受限情况下表现出色，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: VIRST: Video-Instructed Reasoning Assistant for SpatioTemporal Segmentation
summary: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment target objects in videos based on natural language descriptions. However, fixed keyframe-based approaches that couple a vision language model with a separate propagation module often fail to capture rapidly changing spatiotemporal dynamics and to handle queries requiring multi-step reasoning, leading to sharp performance drops on motion-intensive and reasoning-oriented videos beyond static RVOS benchmarks. To address these limitations, we propose VIRST (Video-Instructed Reasoning Assistant for Spatio-Temporal Segmentation), an end-to-end framework that unifies global video reasoning and pixel-level mask prediction within a single model. VIRST bridges semantic and segmentation representations through the Spatio-Temporal Fusion (STF), which fuses segmentation-aware video features into the vision-language backbone, and employs the Temporal Dynamic Anchor Updater to maintain temporally adjacent anchor frames that provide stable temporal cues under large motion, occlusion, and reappearance. This unified design achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse RVOS benchmarks under realistic and challenging conditions, demonstrating strong generalization to both referring and reasoning oriented settings. The code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/AIDASLab/VIRST.

AI.tldr: VIRST是一个端到端的视频指称分割框架，通过时空融合和动态锚点更新机制，在单一模型中统一全局视频推理和像素级掩码预测，显著提升了在运动密集和需要多步推理场景下的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于固定关键帧的RVOS方法通常将视觉语言模型与传播模块分离，难以捕捉快速变化的时空动态，也无法处理需要多步推理的查询，导致在运动密集和推理导向的视频上性能大幅下降。
AI.method: 提出VIRST端到端框架：1）通过时空融合（STF）将分割感知的视频特征融合到视觉语言骨干网络中，桥接语义和分割表示；2）使用时序动态锚点更新器维护时序相邻的锚点帧，在大运动、遮挡和重新出现情况下提供稳定的时序线索。
AI.result: 在多样化的RVOS基准测试中实现了最先进的结果，在现实和挑战性条件下表现出色，同时在指称和推理导向的设置中都展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VIRST通过统一全局视频推理和像素级掩码预测的端到端设计，有效解决了传统RVOS方法在动态场景和复杂推理任务中的局限性，为视频指称分割提供了更强大的解决方案。

title: Not Search, But Scan: Benchmarking MLLMs on Scan-Oriented Academic Paper Reasoning
summary: With the rapid progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), AI already performs well at literature retrieval and certain reasoning tasks, serving as a capable assistant to human researchers, yet it remains far from autonomous research. The fundamental reason is that current work on academic paper reasoning is largely confined to a search-oriented paradigm centered on pre-specified targets, with reasoning grounded in relevance retrieval, which struggles to support researcher-style full-document understanding, reasoning, and verification. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{ScholScan}, a new benchmark for academic paper reasoning. ScholScan introduces a scan-oriented task setting that asks models to read and cross-check entire papers like human researchers, scanning the document to identify consistency issues. The benchmark comprises 1,800 carefully annotated questions drawn from nine error categories across 13 natural-science domains and 715 papers, and provides detailed annotations for evidence localization and reasoning traces, together with a unified evaluation protocol. We assessed 15 models across 24 input configurations and conducted a fine-grained analysis of MLLM capabilities for all error categories. Across the board, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods yield no significant improvements, revealing systematic deficiencies of current MLLMs on scan-oriented tasks and underscoring the challenge posed by ScholScan. We expect ScholScan to be the leading and representative work of the scan-oriented task paradigm.

AI.tldr: ScholScan是一个新的学术论文推理基准，采用扫描导向的任务设置，要求模型像人类研究者一样阅读和交叉检查整篇论文，识别一致性错误，包含1,800个标注问题，覆盖9个错误类别和13个自然科学领域。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在学术论文推理方面主要局限于以搜索为导向的范式，基于相关性检索进行推理，难以支持研究者式的全文理解、推理和验证。需要建立新的基准来评估模型在扫描导向任务上的能力。
AI.method: 提出ScholScan基准，采用扫描导向的任务设置，要求模型阅读整篇论文并识别一致性错误。包含1,800个精心标注的问题，覆盖9个错误类别、13个自然科学领域和715篇论文，提供证据定位和推理轨迹的详细标注。
AI.result: 评估了15个模型在24种输入配置下的表现，发现检索增强生成方法没有显著改进，揭示了当前多模态大语言模型在扫描导向任务上的系统性缺陷，凸显了ScholScan带来的挑战。
AI.conclusion: ScholScan是扫描导向任务范式的领先和代表性工作，为评估模型在学术论文推理方面的能力提供了新的基准，揭示了当前模型的局限性，并指出了未来研究的方向。

title: LombardoGraphia: Automatic Classification of Lombard Orthography Variants
summary: Lombard, an underresourced language variety spoken by approximately 3.8 million people in Northern Italy and Southern Switzerland, lacks a unified orthographic standard. Multiple orthographic systems exist, creating challenges for NLP resource development and model training. This paper presents the first study of automatic Lombard orthography classification and LombardoGraphia, a curated corpus of 11,186 Lombard Wikipedia samples tagged across 9 orthographic variants, and models for automatic orthography classification. We curate the dataset, processing and filtering raw Wikipedia content to ensure text suitable for orthographic analysis. We train 24 traditional and neural classification models with various features and encoding levels. Our best models achieve 96.06% and 85.78% overall and average class accuracy, though performance on minority classes remains challenging due to data imbalance. Our work provides crucial infrastructure for building variety-aware NLP resources for Lombard.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次针对伦巴第语（意大利北部和瑞士南部的低资源语言）开发了自动正字法分类系统和LombardoGraphia语料库，包含11,186个维基百科样本，标注了9种正字法变体，最佳模型分类准确率达96.06%。
AI.motivation: 伦巴第语作为约380万人使用的低资源语言，缺乏统一的正字法标准，存在多种正字法系统，这给NLP资源开发和模型训练带来了挑战。需要建立基础设施来支持伦巴第语的变体感知NLP资源建设。
AI.method: 1. 创建LombardoGraphia语料库：从维基百科收集、处理和过滤11,186个伦巴第语样本，标注9种正字法变体；2. 训练24个传统和神经网络分类模型，使用不同特征和编码级别；3. 处理数据不平衡问题，特别是少数类别的分类挑战。
AI.result: 最佳模型整体准确率达到96.06%，平均类别准确率为85.78%。尽管在少数类别上的性能仍有挑战（由于数据不平衡），但该研究为伦巴第语NLP资源建设提供了关键基础设施。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次实现了伦巴第语自动正字法分类，创建了标准化的语料库和分类模型，为开发变体感知的伦巴第语NLP资源奠定了重要基础，有助于解决该语言因缺乏统一正字法标准带来的NLP挑战。

title: ChartNet: A Million-Scale, High-Quality Multimodal Dataset for Robust Chart Understanding
summary: Understanding charts requires models to jointly reason over geometric visual patterns, structured numerical data, and natural language -- a capability where current vision-language models (VLMs) remain limited. We introduce ChartNet, a high-quality, million-scale multimodal dataset designed to advance chart interpretation and reasoning. ChartNet leverages a novel code-guided synthesis pipeline to generate 1.5 million diverse chart samples spanning 24 chart types and 6 plotting libraries. Each sample consists of five aligned components: plotting code, rendered chart image, data table, natural language summary, and question-answering with reasoning, providing fine-grained cross-modal alignment. To capture the full spectrum of chart comprehension, ChartNet additionally includes specialized subsets encompassing human annotated data, real-world data, safety, and grounding. Moreover, a rigorous quality-filtering pipeline ensures visual fidelity, semantic accuracy, and diversity across chart representations. Fine-tuning on ChartNet consistently improves results across benchmarks, demonstrating its utility as large-scale supervision for multimodal models. As the largest open-source dataset of its kind, ChartNet aims to support the development of foundation models with robust and generalizable capabilities for data visualization understanding. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-granite/ChartNet

AI.tldr: ChartNet是一个百万规模的多模态图表数据集，通过代码引导的合成管道生成150万个多样化图表样本，包含代码、图像、数据表、自然语言摘要和问答推理五个对齐组件，旨在提升视觉语言模型对图表的理解和推理能力。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在联合推理几何视觉模式、结构化数值数据和自然语言方面存在局限，需要高质量的大规模多模态数据集来提升图表理解和推理能力。
AI.method: 采用新颖的代码引导合成管道生成150万个多样化图表样本，涵盖24种图表类型和6个绘图库。每个样本包含五个对齐组件：绘图代码、渲染图表图像、数据表、自然语言摘要和带推理的问答。还包括专门子集（人工标注数据、真实世界数据、安全性和基础性），并通过严格的质量过滤管道确保视觉保真度、语义准确性和多样性。
AI.result: 在ChartNet上进行微调能持续提升模型在多个基准测试中的表现，证明其作为大规模多模态监督数据的有效性。这是同类中最大的开源数据集。
AI.conclusion: ChartNet作为最大的开源多模态图表数据集，旨在支持开发具有强大且可泛化数据可视化理解能力的基础模型，推动图表解释和推理研究的发展。

title: Dynamic Dual-Granularity Skill Bank for Agentic RL
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) can benefit substantially from reusable experience, yet existing skill-based methods mainly extract trajectory-level guidance and often lack principled mechanisms for maintaining an evolving skill memory. We propose D2Skill, a dynamic dual-granularity skill bank for agentic RL that organizes reusable experience into task skills for high-level guidance and step skills for fine-grained decision support and error correction. D2Skill jointly trains the policy and skill bank through paired baseline and skill-injected rollouts under the same policy, using their performance gap to derive hindsight utility signals for both skill updating and policy optimization. Built entirely from training-time experience, the skill bank is continuously expanded through reflection and maintained with utility-aware retrieval and pruning. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 show that D2Skill consistently improves success rates over skill-free baselines by 10-20 points. Further ablations and analyses show that both dual-granularity skill modeling and dynamic skill maintenance are critical to these gains, while the learned skills exhibit higher utility, transfer across evaluation settings, and introduce only modest training overhead.

AI.tldr: D2Skill：一种用于智能体强化学习的动态双粒度技能库，通过任务技能和步骤技能组织可重用经验，利用性能差距生成后见效用信号进行联合优化，显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于技能的方法主要提取轨迹级指导，缺乏维护演化技能库的原则性机制。智能体强化学习需要更好的可重用经验组织方式，以提供多层次指导。
AI.method: 提出动态双粒度技能库D2Skill，包含任务技能（高层指导）和步骤技能（细粒度决策支持）。通过配对基线和技能注入的rollouts，利用性能差距生成后见效用信号，联合训练策略和技能库。技能库通过反思持续扩展，并通过效用感知的检索和修剪进行维护。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop任务上使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507模型，D2Skill相比无技能基线持续提升10-20个百分点的成功率。消融实验表明双粒度技能建模和动态技能维护对性能提升至关重要。
AI.conclusion: D2Skill通过动态双粒度技能库有效组织可重用经验，显著提升智能体强化学习性能。学习到的技能具有更高效用、可跨评估设置迁移，且训练开销适中。

title: Structural-Ambiguity-Aware Translation from Natural Language to Signal Temporal Logic
summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) is widely used to specify timed and safety-critical tasks for cyber-physical systems, but writing STL formulas directly is difficult for non-expert users. Natural language (NL) provides a convenient interface, yet its inherent structural ambiguity makes one-to-one translation into STL unreliable. In this paper, we propose an \textit{ambiguity-preserving} method for translating NL task descriptions into STL candidate formulas. The key idea is to retain multiple plausible syntactic analyses instead of forcing a single interpretation at the parsing stage. To this end, we develop a three-stage pipeline based on Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG): ambiguity-preserving $n$-best parsing, STL-oriented template-based semantic composition, and canonicalization with score aggregation. The proposed method outputs a deduplicated set of STL candidates with plausibility scores, thereby explicitly representing multiple possible formal interpretations of an ambiguous instruction. In contrast to existing one-best NL-to-logic translation methods, the proposed approach is designed to preserve attachment and scope ambiguity. Case studies on representative task descriptions demonstrate that the method generates multiple STL candidates for genuinely ambiguous inputs while collapsing unambiguous or canonically equivalent derivations to a single STL formula.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于组合范畴语法的三阶段管道方法，将自然语言任务描述翻译为信号时序逻辑公式时保留歧义性，输出带有可信度评分的候选公式集合。
AI.motivation: 信号时序逻辑(STL)在指定网络物理系统的时序和安全关键任务方面应用广泛，但非专家用户直接编写STL公式困难。自然语言提供了便利接口，但其固有的结构歧义性使得一对一翻译到STL不可靠。
AI.method: 基于组合范畴语法(CCG)的三阶段管道：1) 歧义保留的n-best解析；2) STL导向的基于模板的语义组合；3) 规范化和评分聚合。该方法输出去重后的STL候选公式集合，带有可信度评分。
AI.result: 在代表性任务描述的案例研究中，该方法对真正歧义的输入生成多个STL候选公式，同时对无歧义或规范等价的推导合并为单个STL公式。
AI.conclusion: 与现有的一对一自然语言到逻辑翻译方法相比，所提方法旨在保留附着和范围歧义，明确表示模糊指令的多种可能形式化解释。

title: Structural Graph Probing of Vision-Language Models
comment: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, yet how computation is organized across populations of neurons remains poorly understood. In this work, we study VLMs through the lens of neural topology, representing each layer as a within-layer correlation graph derived from neuron-neuron co-activations. This view allows us to ask whether population-level structure is behaviorally meaningful, how it changes across modalities and depth, and whether it identifies causally influential internal components under intervention. We show that correlation topology carries recoverable behavioral signal; moreover, cross-modal structure progressively consolidates with depth around a compact set of recurrent hub neurons, whose targeted perturbation substantially alters model output. Neural topology thus emerges as a meaningful intermediate scale for VLM interpretability: richer than local attribution, more tractable than full circuit recovery, and empirically tied to multimodal behavior. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/he-h/vlm-graph-probing.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过神经拓扑学视角分析视觉语言模型，发现神经元间的相关性图结构携带行为信号，跨模态结构随深度增加围绕核心枢纽神经元整合，这些枢纽神经元对模型输出有因果影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在多模态任务上表现优异，但神经元群体间的计算组织方式仍不明确。研究旨在探索VLM中神经元群体层面的结构是否具有行为意义，以及这种结构如何随模态和深度变化。
AI.method: 采用神经拓扑学方法，将每个层表示为基于神经元-神经元共激活的层内相关性图。通过这种视角研究群体层面的结构是否具有行为意义，分析结构在不同模态和深度下的变化，并识别干预下具有因果影响力的内部组件。
AI.result: 相关性拓扑结构携带可恢复的行为信号；跨模态结构随深度增加围绕一组紧凑的循环枢纽神经元逐渐整合；对这些枢纽神经元的有针对性扰动会显著改变模型输出。
AI.conclusion: 神经拓扑学为VLM可解释性提供了一个有意义的中间尺度：比局部归因更丰富，比完整电路恢复更易处理，且与多模态行为经验相关。

title: Exploring Cultural Variations in Moral Judgments with Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance across many tasks, but their ability to capture culturally diverse moral values remains unclear. In this paper, we examine whether LLMs mirror variations in moral attitudes reported by the World Values Survey (WVS) and the Pew Research Center's Global Attitudes Survey (PEW). We compare smaller monolingual and multilingual models (GPT-2, OPT, BLOOMZ, and Qwen) with recent instruction-tuned models (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemma-2-9b-it, and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct). Using log-probability-based \emph{moral justifiability} scores, we correlate each model's outputs with survey data covering a broad set of ethical topics. Our results show that many earlier or smaller models often produce near-zero or negative correlations with human judgments. In contrast, advanced instruction-tuned models achieve substantially higher positive correlations, suggesting they better reflect real-world moral attitudes. We provide a detailed regional analysis revealing that models align better with Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic (W.E.I.R.D.) nations than with other regions. While scaling model size and using instruction tuning improves alignment with cross-cultural moral norms, challenges remain for certain topics and regions. We discuss these findings in relation to bias analysis, training data diversity, information retrieval implications, and strategies for improving the cultural sensitivity of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了不同规模的语言模型在捕捉多元文化道德价值观方面的表现，发现先进的指令调优模型比早期/小型模型更能反映真实世界的道德态度，但模型对W.E.I.R.D.国家的对齐度优于其他地区。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在许多任务上表现优异，但其是否能够捕捉文化多元的道德价值观仍不明确。本研究旨在探究LLMs是否能够反映世界价值观调查和皮尤研究中心全球态度调查中报告的不同文化道德态度差异。
AI.method: 使用基于对数概率的道德可辩护性评分方法，将模型输出与世界价值观调查和皮尤研究中心全球态度调查数据进行相关性分析。比较了小型单语/多语模型（GPT-2、OPT、BLOOMZ、Qwen）与先进的指令调优模型（GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Gemma-2-9b-it、Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct）。
AI.result: 早期或小型模型与人类道德判断的相关性接近零或为负值，而先进的指令调优模型获得了显著更高的正相关性。区域分析显示，模型与W.E.I.R.D.（西方、教育发达、工业化、富裕、民主）国家的对齐度优于其他地区。
AI.conclusion: 扩大模型规模和采用指令调优能够改善模型与跨文化道德规范的对齐度，但在某些主题和地区仍存在挑战。研究讨论了这些发现对偏见分析、训练数据多样性、信息检索影响以及提高LLMs文化敏感性的策略意义。

title: Courtroom-Style Multi-Agent Debate with Progressive RAG and Role-Switching for Controversial Claim Verification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable for high-stakes claim verification due to hallucinations and shallow reasoning. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and multi-agent debate (MAD) address this, they are limited by one-pass retrieval and unstructured debate dynamics. We propose a courtroom-style multi-agent framework, PROClaim, that reformulates verification as a structured, adversarial deliberation. Our approach integrates specialized roles (e.g., Plaintiff, Defense, Judge) with Progressive RAG (P-RAG) to dynamically expand and refine the evidence pool during the debate. Furthermore, we employ evidence negotiation, self-reflection, and heterogeneous multi-judge aggregation to enforce calibration, robustness, and diversity. In zero-shot evaluations on the Check-COVID benchmark, PROClaim achieves 81.7% accuracy, outperforming standard multi-agent debate by 10.0 percentage points, with P-RAG driving the primary performance gains (+7.5 pp). We ultimately demonstrate that structural deliberation and model heterogeneity effectively mitigate systematic biases, providing a robust foundation for reliable claim verification. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/mnc13/PROClaim.

AI.tldr: PROClaim是一个法庭风格的多智能体框架，通过结构化对抗性辩论和渐进式检索增强生成，显著提升大语言模型在事实核查任务中的准确性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在高风险事实核查任务中存在幻觉和浅层推理问题，而现有的检索增强生成和多智能体辩论方法受限于一次性检索和非结构化辩论动态，需要更可靠的事实核查框架。
AI.method: 提出PROClaim框架：1) 法庭风格结构化辩论，包含原告、被告、法官等专业角色；2) 渐进式检索增强生成，在辩论过程中动态扩展和精炼证据池；3) 证据协商、自我反思和异构多法官聚合机制，确保校准、鲁棒性和多样性。
AI.result: 在Check-COVID基准测试的零样本评估中，PROClaim达到81.7%的准确率，比标准多智能体辩论高出10.0个百分点，其中渐进式检索增强生成贡献了主要性能提升（+7.5个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化辩论和模型异构性有效缓解了系统性偏见，为可靠的事实核查提供了稳健基础，证明了对抗性辩论和渐进式检索在提升大语言模型事实核查可靠性方面的有效性。

title: LightCtrl: Training-free Controllable Video Relighting
summary: Recent diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image relighting, and this success has quickly been extended to video relighting. However, existing methods offer limited explicit control over illumination in the relighted output. We present LightCtrl, the first controllable video relighting method that enables explicit control of video illumination through a user-supplied light trajectory in a training-free manner. Our approach combines pre-trained diffusion models: an image relighting model processes each frame individually, followed by a video diffusion prior to enhance temporal consistency. To achieve explicit control over dynamically varying lighting, we introduce two key components. First, a Light Map Injection module samples light trajectory-specific noise and injects it into the latent representation of the source video, improving illumination coherence with the conditional light trajectory. Second, a Geometry-Aware Relighting module dynamically combines RGB and normal map latents in the frequency domain to suppress the influence of the original lighting, further enhancing adherence to the input light trajectory. Experiments show that LightCtrl produces high-quality videos with diverse illumination changes that closely follow the specified light trajectory, demonstrating improved controllability over baseline methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/GVCLab/LightCtrl.

AI.tldr: LightCtrl是首个可控制的视频重照明方法，通过用户提供的灯光轨迹实现训练无关的显式照明控制，结合预训练扩散模型实现高质量、时间一致的重照明效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频重照明方法在重照明输出中对照明的显式控制有限，需要一种能够通过用户提供的灯光轨迹精确控制视频照明变化的方法。
AI.method: 结合预训练的图像重照明模型和视频扩散先验，引入两个关键组件：1) Light Map Injection模块注入灯光轨迹特定噪声到源视频潜在表示；2) Geometry-Aware Relighting模块在频域动态组合RGB和法线图潜在表示以抑制原始照明影响。
AI.result: 实验表明LightCtrl能生成高质量视频，产生多样化的照明变化，紧密遵循指定的灯光轨迹，相比基线方法展现出改进的可控性。
AI.conclusion: LightCtrl是首个实现训练无关、显式可控的视频重照明方法，通过创新的光照控制模块实现了对视频照明的精确控制，为视频编辑提供了新的可能性。

title: TIEG-Youpu Solution for NeurIPS 2022 WikiKG90Mv2-LSC
summary: WikiKG90Mv2 in NeurIPS 2022 is a large encyclopedic knowledge graph. Embedding knowledge graphs into continuous vector spaces is important for many practical applications, such as knowledge acquisition, question answering, and recommendation systems. Compared to existing knowledge graphs, WikiKG90Mv2 is a large scale knowledge graph, which is composed of more than 90 millions of entities. Both efficiency and accuracy should be considered when building graph embedding models for knowledge graph at scale. To this end, we follow the retrieve then re-rank pipeline, and make novel modifications in both retrieval and re-ranking stage. Specifically, we propose a priority infilling retrieval model to obtain candidates that are structurally and semantically similar. Then we propose an ensemble based re-ranking model with neighbor enhanced representations to produce final link prediction results among retrieved candidates. Experimental results show that our proposed method outperforms existing baseline methods and improves MRR of validation set from 0.2342 to 0.2839.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大规模知识图谱WikiKG90Mv2，提出了一种检索-重排序的两阶段方法，通过优先级填充检索模型和集成重排序模型，显著提升了链接预测性能。
AI.motivation: WikiKG90Mv2是一个包含超过9000万个实体的大规模百科全书知识图谱，将知识图谱嵌入连续向量空间对于知识获取、问答和推荐系统等实际应用至关重要。现有方法在处理如此大规模的知识图谱时，需要在效率和准确性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 采用检索-重排序的两阶段流水线：1) 提出优先级填充检索模型，获取结构和语义相似的候选实体；2) 提出基于集成的重排序模型，利用邻居增强表示在检索到的候选实体中产生最终的链接预测结果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于现有基线方法，将验证集的MRR从0.2342提升到0.2839，显著提高了链接预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 针对大规模知识图谱WikiKG90Mv2，提出的两阶段检索-重排序方法在效率和准确性方面都取得了良好效果，通过优先级填充检索和集成重排序模型有效提升了链接预测性能。

title: SceneExpander: Expanding 3D Scenes with Free-Form Inserted Views
summary: World building with 3D scene representations is increasingly important for content creation, simulation, and interactive experiences, yet real workflows are inherently iterative: creators must repeatedly extend an existing scene under user control. Motivated by this research gap, we study 3D scene expansion in a user-centric workflow: starting from a real scene captured by multi-view images, we extend its coverage by inserting an additional view synthesized by a generative model. Unlike simple object editing or style transfer in a fixed scene, the inserted view is often 3D-misaligned with the original reconstruction, introducing geometry shifts, hallucinated content, or view-dependent artifacts that break global multi-view consistency. To address the challenge, we propose SceneExpander, which applies test-time adaptation to a parametric feed-forward 3D reconstruction model with two complementary distillation signals: anchor distillation stabilizes the original scene by distilling geometric cues from the captured views, while inserted-view self-distillation preserves observation-supported predictions yet adapts latent geometry and appearance to accommodate the misaligned inserted view. Experiments on ETH scenes and online data demonstrate improved expansion behavior and reconstruction quality under misalignment.

AI.tldr: SceneExpander：通过测试时自适应和双重蒸馏信号解决3D场景扩展中的多视图一致性挑战
AI.motivation: 现实世界的内容创建工作流程本质上是迭代的，创作者需要反复扩展现有场景。当前研究缺乏对用户中心工作流程中3D场景扩展的关注，特别是当生成模型合成的新视图与原始重建存在3D不对齐时，会导致几何偏移、幻觉内容和视图相关伪影，破坏全局多视图一致性。
AI.method: 提出SceneExpander方法，对参数化前馈3D重建模型应用测试时自适应，采用两种互补的蒸馏信号：锚点蒸馏通过从捕获的视图中提取几何线索来稳定原始场景；插入视图自蒸馏保留观测支持的预测，同时调整潜在几何和外观以适应不对齐的插入视图。
AI.result: 在ETH场景和在线数据上的实验表明，该方法在不对齐情况下改善了扩展行为和重建质量。
AI.conclusion: SceneExpander通过双重蒸馏策略有效解决了3D场景扩展中的多视图一致性问题，为迭代式内容创建工作流程提供了实用的解决方案。

title: EarlySciRev: A Dataset of Early-Stage Scientific Revisions Extracted from LaTeX Writing Traces
summary: Scientific writing is an iterative process that generates rich revision traces, yet publicly available resources typically expose only final or near-final versions of papers. This limits empirical study of revision behaviour and evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for scientific writing. We introduce EarlySciRev, a dataset of early-stage scientific text revisions automatically extracted from arXiv LaTeX source files. Our key observation is that commented-out text in LaTeX often preserves discarded or alternative formulations written by the authors themselves. By aligning commented segments with nearby final text, we extract paragraph-level candidate revision pairs and apply LLM-based filtering to retain genuine revisions. Starting from 1.28M candidate pairs, our pipeline yields 578k validated revision pairs, grounded in authentic early drafting traces. We additionally provide a human-annotated benchmark for revision detection. EarlySciRev complements existing resources focused on late-stage revisions or synthetic rewrites and supports research on scientific writing dynamics, revision modelling, and LLM-assisted editing.

AI.tldr: EarlySciRev数据集：从arXiv LaTeX源码中自动提取早期科学文本修订的数据集，通过注释掉的文本获取作者真实的早期草稿修订痕迹
AI.motivation: 科学写作是一个迭代过程，但公开资源通常只展示最终或接近最终版本，这限制了对修订行为的实证研究以及大型语言模型在科学写作中的评估
AI.method: 利用LaTeX中注释掉的文本作为作者废弃或替代表述的痕迹，将注释段与附近的最终文本对齐，提取段落级候选修订对，并应用基于LLM的过滤来保留真实的修订
AI.result: 从128万候选对开始，经过处理流程得到57.8万经过验证的修订对，这些修订对基于真实的早期草稿痕迹，并提供了人工标注的修订检测基准
AI.conclusion: EarlySciRev补充了现有专注于后期修订或合成重写的资源，支持科学写作动态、修订建模和LLM辅助编辑的研究

title: EFlow: Fast Few-Step Video Generator Training from Scratch via Efficient Solution Flow
summary: Scaling video diffusion transformers is fundamentally bottlenecked by two compounding costs: the expensive quadratic complexity of attention per step, and the iterative sampling steps. In this work, we propose EFlow, an efficient few-step training framework, that tackles these bottlenecks simultaneously. To reduce sampling steps, we build on a solution-flow objective that learns a function mapping a noised state at time t to time s. Making this formulation computationally feasible and high-quality at video scale, however, demands two complementary innovations. First, we propose Gated Local-Global Attention, a token-droppable hybrid block which is efficient, expressive, and remains highly stable under aggressive random token-dropping, substantially reducing per-step compute. Second, we develop an efficient few-step training recipe. We propose Path-Drop Guided training to replace the expensive guidance target with a computationally cheap, weak path. Furthermore, we augment this with a Mean-Velocity Additivity regularizer to ensure high fidelity at extremely low step counts. Together, our EFlow enables a practical from-scratch training pipeline, achieving up to 2.5x higher training throughput over standard solution-flow, and 45.3x lower inference latency than standard iterative models with competitive performance on Kinetics and large-scale text-to-video datasets.

AI.tldr: EFlow是一个高效的少步训练框架，通过解决方案流目标减少采样步数，结合门控局部-全局注意力机制和路径丢弃引导训练，显著提升视频扩散模型的训练效率和推理速度。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散变换器的扩展面临两个主要瓶颈：注意力机制的二次复杂度计算成本高昂，以及迭代采样步骤过多。这两个问题相互叠加，限制了视频扩散模型的实际应用效率。
AI.method: 1. 采用解决方案流目标，学习从时间t的噪声状态到时间s的映射函数；2. 提出门控局部-全局注意力机制，支持令牌丢弃的混合块，在激进随机令牌丢弃下保持稳定；3. 开发高效的少步训练方案，包括路径丢弃引导训练和均值速度可加性正则化。
AI.result: EFlow实现了比标准解决方案流高2.5倍的训练吞吐量，比标准迭代模型低45.3倍的推理延迟，在Kinetics和大规模文本到视频数据集上保持竞争性性能。
AI.conclusion: EFlow通过同时解决注意力复杂度和采样步数两个瓶颈，为视频扩散变换器提供了实用的从头训练管道，显著提升了训练效率和推理速度。

title: GraphWalker: Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering via Synthetic Trajectory Curriculum
summary: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires an agent to iteratively interact with knowledge graphs (KGs), posing challenges in both training data scarcity and reasoning generalization. Specifically, existing approaches often restrict agent exploration: prompting-based methods lack autonomous navigation training, while current training pipelines usually confine reasoning to predefined trajectories. To this end, this paper proposes \textit{GraphWalker}, a novel agentic KGQA framework that addresses these challenges through \textit{Automated Trajectory Synthesis} and \textit{Stage-wise Fine-tuning}. GraphWalker adopts a two-stage SFT training paradigm: First, the agent is trained on structurally diverse trajectories synthesized from constrained random-walk paths, establishing a broad exploration prior over the KG; Second, the agent is further fine-tuned on a small set of expert trajectories to develop reflection and error recovery capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our stage-wise SFT paradigm unlocks a higher performance ceiling for a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) stage, enabling GraphWalker to achieve state-of-the-art performance on CWQ and WebQSP. Additional results on GrailQA and our constructed GraphWalkerBench confirm that GraphWalker enhances generalization to out-of-distribution reasoning paths. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/XuShuwenn/GraphWalker

AI.tldr: GraphWalker是一个新型的智能知识图谱问答框架，通过自动化轨迹合成和分阶段微调解决训练数据稀缺和推理泛化问题，在多个基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有智能知识图谱问答方法存在训练数据稀缺和推理泛化挑战：基于提示的方法缺乏自主导航训练，而现有训练流程通常将推理限制在预定义轨迹中。
AI.method: 采用两阶段监督微调训练范式：第一阶段通过约束随机游走路径合成的结构多样化轨迹训练代理，建立对知识图谱的广泛探索先验；第二阶段在少量专家轨迹上进一步微调，发展反思和错误恢复能力。
AI.result: 在CWQ和WebQSP基准测试中达到最先进性能，在GrailQA和自建的GraphWalkerBench上验证了对外分布推理路径的泛化能力增强。
AI.conclusion: GraphWalker通过自动化轨迹合成和分阶段微调有效解决了智能知识图谱问答中的训练数据稀缺和推理泛化问题，为轻量级强化学习阶段解锁了更高性能上限。

title: Compressing Transformer Language Models via Matrix Product Operator Decomposition: A Case Study on PicoGPT
summary: Transformer-based language models achieve strong performance across NLP tasks, but their quadratic parameter scaling with hidden dimension makes deployment on resource-constrained hardware expensive. We study Matrix Product Operator (MPO) decomposition as a principled compression method for transformers. MPO factorises weight matrices into chains of low-rank cores, with approximation quality controlled by the bond dimension chi. We replace every nn.Linear layer in PicoGPT, a GPT-2-style character-level language model with about 1M parameters, with an MPOLinear module parameterised as an MPO chain. Cores are initialised either by TT-SVD from pretrained dense weights or from random initialisation, and trained using standard PyTorch autograd without a custom backward pass. We derive balanced factorisation schemes for the five distinct weight shapes in PicoGPT and evaluate bond dimensions chi in {4, 8, 16, 32} on Tiny Shakespeare. MPO compression achieves up to 13x compression per transformer block at chi = 4. At chi = 16, the model uses 191,872 parameters instead of 1,020,224 while retaining 97.7% of baseline token accuracy (51.6% vs 52.8%). Reconstruction error follows the expected trend and is lower for three-site than two-site factorisations at the same bond dimension. The chi = 8 model gives the best accuracy per parameter, exceeding the dense baseline by 2.7x on this metric. These results show that MPO parameterisation is a practical and theoretically grounded alternative to low-rank methods and unstructured pruning for transformer compression.

AI.tldr: 使用矩阵乘积算子(MPO)分解压缩Transformer模型，在PicoGPT上实现最高13倍压缩，在保持97.7%基线准确率的同时参数减少81%
AI.motivation: Transformer语言模型虽然性能强大，但其参数随隐藏维度呈二次方增长，在资源受限硬件上部署成本高昂。需要一种理论基础的压缩方法来替代低秩方法和非结构化剪枝。
AI.method: 将PicoGPT（约100万参数的GPT-2风格字符级语言模型）中的每个nn.Linear层替换为MPOLinear模块，参数化为MPO链。核心通过TT-SVD从预训练权重初始化或随机初始化，使用标准PyTorch自动微分训练。为PicoGPT中的五种不同权重形状推导平衡分解方案，评估键维度χ在{4,8,16,32}下的性能。
AI.result: MPO压缩在χ=4时每个Transformer块实现最高13倍压缩。在χ=16时，模型使用191,872个参数而非1,020,224个，同时保持97.7%的基线token准确率（51.6% vs 52.8%）。χ=8模型在准确率/参数比上表现最佳，比密集基线高出2.7倍。重建误差符合预期趋势，三站点分解在相同键维度下比两站点分解误差更低。
AI.conclusion: MPO参数化是Transformer压缩的一种实用且理论基础坚实的替代方案，优于低秩方法和非结构化剪枝，在保持高性能的同时显著减少参数数量。

title: LLM Enhanced Action Recognition via Hierarchical Global-Local Skeleton-Language Model
summary: Skeleton-based human action recognition has achieved remarkable progress in recent years. However, most existing GCN-based methods rely on short-range motion topologies, which not only struggle to capture long-range joint dependencies and complex temporal dynamics but also limit cross-modal semantic alignment and understanding due to insufficient modeling of action semantics. To address these challenges, we propose a hierarchical global-local skeleton-language model (HocSLM), enabling the large action model be more representative of action semantics. First, we design a hierarchical global-local network (HGLNet) that consists of a composite-topology spatial module and a dual-path hierarchical temporal module. By synergistically integrating multi-level global and local modules, HGLNet achieves dynamically collaborative modeling at both global and local scales while preserving prior knowledge of human physical structure, significantly enhancing the model's representation of complex spatio-temporal relationships. Then, a large vision-language model (VLM) is employed to generate textual descriptions by passing the original RGB video sequences to this model, providing the rich action semantics for further training the skeleton-language model. Furthermore, we introduce a skeleton-language sequential fusion module by combining the features from HGLNet and the generated descriptions, which utilizes a skeleton-language model (SLM) for aligning skeletal spatio-temporal features and textual action descriptions precisely within a unified semantic space. The SLM model could significantly enhance the HGLNet's semantic discrimination capabilities and cross-modal understanding abilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed HocSLM achieves the state-of-the-art performance on three mainstream benchmark datasets: NTU RGB+D 60, NTU RGB+D 120, and Northwestern-UCLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层全局-局部骨架-语言模型（HocSLM），通过结合骨架动作识别与语言描述，增强动作语义表示和跨模态理解能力，在多个基准数据集上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于GCN的方法主要依赖短程运动拓扑，难以捕捉长距离关节依赖和复杂时间动态，且由于动作语义建模不足，限制了跨模态语义对齐和理解能力。
AI.method: 1. 设计分层全局-局部网络（HGLNet），包含复合拓扑空间模块和双路径分层时间模块；2. 使用大型视觉语言模型（VLM）从原始RGB视频生成文本描述；3. 引入骨架-语言序列融合模块，在统一语义空间中对齐骨架时空特征和文本动作描述。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D 60、NTU RGB+D 120和Northwestern-UCLA三个主流基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的HocSLM模型通过分层全局-局部建模和骨架-语言对齐，显著增强了动作语义表示能力和跨模态理解能力，在骨架动作识别任务中表现出优越性能。

title: Adaptive Block-Scaled Data Types
summary: NVFP4 has grown increasingly popular as a 4-bit format for quantizing large language models due to its hardware support and its ability to retain useful information with relatively few bits per parameter. However, the format is not without limitations: recent work has shown that NVFP4 suffers from its error distribution, resulting in large amounts of quantization error on near-maximal values in each group of 16 values. In this work, we leverage this insight to design new Adaptive Block-Scaled Data Types that can adapt to the distribution of their input values. For four-bit quantization, our proposed IF4 (Int/Float 4) data type selects between FP4 and INT4 representations for each group of 16 values, which are then scaled by an E4M3 scale factor as is done with NVFP4. The selected data type is denoted using the scale factor's sign bit, which is currently unused in NVFP4, and we apply the same insight to design formats for other bit-widths, including IF3 and IF6. When used to quantize language models, we find that IF4 outperforms existing 4-bit block-scaled formats, achieving lower loss during quantized training and achieving higher accuracy on many tasks in post-training quantization. We additionally design and evaluate an IF4 Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) unit to demonstrate that IF4 can be implemented efficiently in next-generation hardware accelerators. Our code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/fouroversix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的自适应块缩放数据类型IF4，它结合了FP4和INT4的优点，通过动态选择适合每组16个值的量化格式来减少量化误差，特别改善了NVFP4在处理接近最大值时的性能问题。
AI.motivation: NVFP4作为4位量化格式虽然受到硬件支持且能保留有用信息，但其误差分布存在问题，特别是在处理每组16个值中的接近最大值时会产生大量量化误差。这促使研究者设计能够适应输入值分布的自适应数据类型。
AI.method: 提出IF4（Int/Float 4）数据类型，为每组16个值在FP4和INT4表示之间进行选择，然后使用E4M3缩放因子进行缩放。选择的数据类型通过当前NVFP4中未使用的缩放因子符号位来表示。该方法扩展到其他位宽，包括IF3和IF6。
AI.result: IF4在量化语言模型时优于现有的4位块缩放格式，在量化训练期间实现更低的损失，在后训练量化中在许多任务上获得更高的准确性。此外设计了IF4乘累加单元，证明IF4可以在下一代硬件加速器中高效实现。
AI.conclusion: IF4作为一种自适应块缩放数据类型，通过智能选择FP4或INT4表示来减少量化误差，在保持硬件效率的同时显著提升了4位量化的性能，为下一代AI加速器提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: SJD-VP: Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Verification Prediction for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) has emerged as a promising method for accelerating autoregressive image generation. Despite its potential, existing SJD approaches often suffer from the low acceptance rate issue of speculative tokens due to token selection ambiguity. Recent works attempt to mitigate this issue primarily from the relaxed token verification perspective but fail to fully exploit the iterative dynamics of decoding. In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis and make a novel observation that tokens whose probabilities increase are more likely to match the verification-accepted and correct token. Based on this, we propose a novel Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Verification Prediction (SJD-VP). The key idea is to leverage the change in token probabilities across iterations to guide sampling, favoring tokens whose probabilities increase. This effectively predicts which tokens are likely to pass subsequent verification, boosting the acceptance rate. In particular, our SJD-VP is plug-and-play and can be seamlessly integrated into existing SJD methods. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our SJD-VP method consistently accelerates autoregressive decoding while improving image generation quality.

AI.tldr: SJD-VP通过预测验证通过概率来提升推测式Jacob解码的接受率，加速自回归图像生成
AI.motivation: 现有推测式Jacob解码方法存在接受率低的问题，主要原因是token选择模糊性。虽然近期研究尝试从放宽token验证角度缓解此问题，但未能充分利用解码的迭代动态特性。
AI.method: 提出SJD-VP方法，利用token概率在迭代过程中的变化来指导采样，偏好概率增加的token。该方法能有效预测哪些token可能通过后续验证，从而提升接受率。SJD-VP是即插即用的，可无缝集成到现有SJD方法中。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SJD-VP方法在提升图像生成质量的同时，能持续加速自回归解码过程。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用token概率变化的动态特性来预测验证通过概率，SJD-VP有效解决了推测式Jacob解码中的低接受率问题，实现了更高效的图像生成。

title: The Geometry of Robustness: Optimizing Loss Landscape Curvature and Feature Manifold Alignment for Robust Finetuning of Vision-Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning approaches for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face a critical three-way trade-off between In-Distribution (ID) accuracy, Out-of-Distribution (OOD) generalization, and adversarial robustness. Existing robust fine-tuning strategies resolve at most two axes of this trade-off. Generalization-preserving methods retain ID/OOD performance but leave models vulnerable to adversarial attacks, while adversarial training improves robustness to targeted attacks but degrades ID/OOD accuracy. Our key insight is that the robustness trade-off stems from two geometric failures: sharp, anisotropic minima in parameter space and unstable feature representations that deform under perturbation. To address this, we propose GRACE (Gram-aligned Robustness via Adaptive Curvature Estimation), a unified fine-tuning framework that jointly regularizes the parameter-space curvature and feature-space invariance for VLMs. Grounded in Robust PAC-Bayes theory, GRACE employs adaptive weight perturbations scaled by local curvature to promote flatter minima, combined with a feature alignment loss that maintains representation consistency across clean, adversarial, and OOD inputs. On ImageNet fine-tuning of CLIP models, GRACE simultaneously improves ID accuracy by 10.8%, and adversarial accuracy by 13.5% while maintaining 57.0% OOD accuracy (vs. 57.4% zero-shot baseline). Geometric analysis confirms that GRACE converges to flatter minima without feature distortion across distribution shifts, providing a principled step toward generalized robustness in foundation VLMs.

AI.tldr: GRACE框架通过联合正则化参数空间曲率和特征空间不变性，解决了视觉语言模型微调中的三向权衡问题，同时提升了ID准确性、OOD泛化性和对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型微调方法面临ID准确性、OOD泛化性和对抗鲁棒性之间的三向权衡问题。现有方法最多只能解决其中两个维度，要么保留ID/OOD性能但易受对抗攻击，要么提升对抗鲁棒性但降低ID/OOD准确性。
AI.method: 提出GRACE框架，基于鲁棒PAC-Bayes理论，联合正则化参数空间曲率和特征空间不变性。使用自适应权重扰动（按局部曲率缩放）来促进平坦最小值，并结合特征对齐损失来保持干净输入、对抗输入和OOD输入之间的表示一致性。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上微调CLIP模型时，GRACE同时将ID准确性提升10.8%，对抗准确性提升13.5%，同时保持57.0%的OOD准确性（vs. 57.4%的零样本基线）。几何分析证实GRACE收敛到更平坦的最小值，且在分布偏移下没有特征失真。
AI.conclusion: GRACE通过解决参数空间和特征空间的几何失效问题，为视觉语言模型提供了统一的微调框架，实现了ID准确性、OOD泛化和对抗鲁棒性的同时提升，是迈向基础视觉语言模型广义鲁棒性的原则性步骤。

title: Weakly Convex Ridge Regularization for 3D Non-Cartesian MRI Reconstruction
summary: While highly accelerated non-Cartesian acquisition protocols significantly reduce scan time, they often entail long reconstruction delays. Deep learning based reconstruction methods can alleviate this, but often lack stability and robustness to distribution shifts. As an alternative, we train a rotation invariant weakly convex ridge regularizer (WCRR). The resulting variational reconstruction approach is benchmarked against state of the art methods on retrospectively simulated data and (out of distribution) on prospective GoLF SPARKLING and CAIPIRINHA acquisitions. Our approach consistently outperforms widely used baselines and achieves performance comparable to Plug and Play reconstruction with a state of the art 3D DRUNet denoiser, while offering substantially improved computational efficiency and robustness to acquisition changes. In summary, WCRR unifies the strengths of principled variational methods and modern deep learning based approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种旋转不变弱凸脊正则化器（WCRR），用于加速非笛卡尔MRI重建，在保持计算效率的同时，实现了与最先进方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 虽然高度加速的非笛卡尔采集协议显著减少了扫描时间，但通常伴随着较长的重建延迟。基于深度学习的重建方法可以缓解这一问题，但往往缺乏稳定性和对分布变化的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 训练一个旋转不变的弱凸脊正则化器（WCRR），并将其应用于变分重建方法中。该方法结合了传统变分方法的原理和现代深度学习方法的优势。
AI.result: 在回顾性模拟数据和（分布外）前瞻性GoLF SPARKLING和CAIPIRINHA采集数据上，WCRR方法始终优于广泛使用的基线方法，性能与使用最先进3D DRUNet去噪器的Plug and Play重建相当，同时显著提高了计算效率和对采集变化的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: WCRR统一了原理性变分方法和现代基于深度学习方法的优势，为加速MRI重建提供了一种高效、鲁棒的解决方案。

title: RiskProp: Collision-Anchored Self-Supervised Risk Propagation for Early Accident Anticipation
summary: Accident anticipation aims to predict impending collisions from dashcam videos and trigger early alerts. Existing methods rely on binary supervision with manually annotated "anomaly onset" frames, which are subjective and inconsistent, leading to inaccurate risk estimation. In contrast, we propose RiskProp, a novel collision-anchored self-supervised risk propagation paradigm for early accident anticipation, which removes the need for anomaly onset annotations and leverages only the reliably annotated collision frame. RiskProp models temporal risk evolution through two observation-driven losses: first, since future frames contain more definitive evidence of an impending accident, we introduce a future-frame regularization loss that uses the model's next-frame prediction as a soft target to supervise the current frame, enabling backward propagation of risk signals; second, inspired by the empirical trend of rising risk before accidents, we design an adaptive monotonic constraint to encourage a non-decreasing progression over time. Experiments on CAP and Nexar demonstrate that RiskProp achieves state-of-the-art performance and produces smoother, more discriminative risk curves, improving both early anticipation and interpretability.

AI.tldr: RiskProp是一种基于碰撞锚定的自监督风险传播范式，用于早期事故预测，无需异常开始标注，仅使用可靠标注的碰撞帧，通过未来帧正则化和自适应单调约束实现风险信号传播。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖主观且不一致的"异常开始"帧人工标注，导致风险估计不准确。需要一种无需异常开始标注、仅使用可靠碰撞帧标注的方法来改进早期事故预测。
AI.method: 提出RiskProp范式：1) 未来帧正则化损失：使用模型下一帧预测作为软目标监督当前帧，实现风险信号向后传播；2) 自适应单调约束：鼓励风险随时间非递减，符合事故发生前风险上升的经验趋势。
AI.result: 在CAP和Nexar数据集上的实验表明，RiskProp达到最先进性能，产生更平滑、更具区分度的风险曲线，同时改进了早期预测能力和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: RiskProp通过自监督风险传播范式有效解决了现有方法对主观异常开始标注的依赖问题，实现了更准确、更可靠的早期事故预测，具有更好的性能和可解释性。

title: LightMover: Generative Light Movement with Color and Intensity Controls
comment: CVPR 2026. 10 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables in main paper; supplementary material included
summary: We present LightMover, a framework for controllable light manipulation in single images that leverages video diffusion priors to produce physically plausible illumination changes without re-rendering the scene. We formulate light editing as a sequence-to-sequence prediction problem in visual token space: given an image and light-control tokens, the model adjusts light position, color, and intensity together with resulting reflections, shadows, and falloff from a single view. This unified treatment of spatial (movement) and appearance (color, intensity) controls improves both manipulation and illumination understanding. We further introduce an adaptive token-pruning mechanism that preserves spatially informative tokens while compactly encoding non-spatial attributes, reducing control sequence length by 41% while maintaining editing fidelity. To train our framework, we construct a scalable rendering pipeline that generates large numbers of image pairs across varied light positions, colors, and intensities while keeping the scene content consistent with the original image. LightMover enables precise, independent control over light position, color, and intensity, and achieves high PSNR and strong semantic consistency (DINO, CLIP) across different tasks.

AI.tldr: LightMover是一个利用视频扩散先验的单图像可控光照编辑框架，通过视觉token空间中的序列到序列预测实现物理合理的光照变化，无需重新渲染场景。
AI.motivation: 传统光照编辑方法通常需要重新渲染场景或缺乏物理合理性，而现有基于扩散的方法难以同时控制光照的空间位置和外观属性。需要一种能够从单视图图像实现物理合理光照编辑的统一框架。
AI.method: 将光照编辑建模为视觉token空间中的序列到序列预测问题，使用光照控制token调整位置、颜色和强度。引入自适应token剪枝机制，保留空间信息token同时紧凑编码非空间属性。通过可扩展渲染流程生成大量图像对进行训练。
AI.result: LightMover实现了对光照位置、颜色和强度的精确独立控制，在PSNR和语义一致性（DINO、CLIP）指标上表现优异。自适应token剪枝机制将控制序列长度减少了41%同时保持编辑保真度。
AI.conclusion: LightMover框架通过统一处理空间和外观控制，实现了从单视图图像进行物理合理光照编辑的能力，为可控光照操作提供了有效解决方案。

title: MultiLoc: Multi-view Guided Relative Pose Regression for Fast and Robust Visual Re-Localization
summary: Relative Pose Regression (RPR) generalizes well to unseen environments, but its performance is often limited due to pairwise and local spatial views. To this end, we propose MultiLoc, a novel multi-view guided RPR model trained at scale, equipping relative pose regression with globally consistent spatial and geometric understanding. Specifically, our method jointly fuses multiple reference views and their associated camera poses in a single forward pass, enabling accurate zero-shot pose estimation with real-time efficiency. To reliably supply informative context, we further propose a co-visibility-driven retrieval strategy for geometrically relevant reference view selection. MultiLoc establishes a new benchmark in visual re-localization, consistently outperforming existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) relative pose regression (RPR) methods across diverse datasets, including WaySpots, Cambridge Landmarks, and Indoor6. Furthermore, MultiLoc's pose regressor exhibits SOTA performance in relative pose estimation, surpassing RPR, feature matching and non-regression-based techniques on the MegaDepth-1500, ScanNet-1500, and ACID benchmarks. These results demonstrate robust domain generalization of MultiLoc across indoor, outdoor and natural environments. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: MultiLoc：一种多视图引导的相对姿态回归模型，通过融合多个参考视图及其相机姿态，实现零样本姿态估计，在多个数据集上超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 传统相对姿态回归（RPR）方法虽然泛化性好，但性能受限于成对和局部空间视图的限制，需要全局一致的空间和几何理解。
AI.method: 提出MultiLoc模型，在单次前向传播中联合融合多个参考视图及其相机姿态；设计共可见性驱动的检索策略选择几何相关的参考视图。
AI.result: 在WaySpots、Cambridge Landmarks、Indoor6等数据集上建立视觉重定位新基准；在MegaDepth-1500、ScanNet-1500、ACID基准上超越RPR、特征匹配和非回归方法。
AI.conclusion: MultiLoc在室内、室外和自然环境中展现出强大的领域泛化能力，实现了实时高效的零样本姿态估计。

title: Inference-Time Structural Reasoning for Compositional Vision-Language Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at image-text retrieval yet persistently fail at compositional reasoning, distinguishing captions that share the same words but differ in relational structure. We present, a unified evaluation and augmentation framework benchmarking four architecturally diverse VLMs,CLIP, BLIP, LLaVA, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking,on the Winoground benchmark under plain and scene-graph-augmented regimes. We introduce a dependency-based TextSceneGraphParser (spaCy) extracting subject-relation-object triples, and a Graph Asymmetry Scorer using optimal bipartite matching to inject structural relational priors. Caption ablation experiments (subject-object masking and swapping) reveal that Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking achieves a group score of 62.75, far above all encoder-based models, while a proposed multi-turn SG filtering strategy further lifts it to 66.0, surpassing prior open-source state-of-the-art. We analyze the capability augmentation tradeoff and find that SG augmentation benefits already capable models while providing negligible or negative gains for weaker baselines. Code: https://github.com/amartyacodes/Inference-Time-Structural-Reasoning-for-Compositional-Vision-Language-Understanding

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个统一的评估和增强框架，用于测试四种不同架构的视觉语言模型在组合推理任务上的表现，通过场景图增强策略提升模型的结构化关系理解能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在图像-文本检索方面表现出色，但在组合推理方面持续失败，难以区分具有相同词汇但关系结构不同的描述。需要评估现有模型在结构化关系理解上的局限性，并探索增强策略。
AI.method: 1) 建立统一评估框架，在Winoground基准上测试CLIP、BLIP、LLaVA和Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking四种模型；2) 开发基于依赖关系的TextSceneGraphParser提取主谓宾三元组；3) 使用最优二分匹配的图不对称评分器注入结构关系先验；4) 提出多轮场景图过滤策略；5) 进行标题消融实验（主语-宾语掩码和交换）。
AI.result: 1) Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking获得62.75的组分数，远超所有编码器模型；2) 多轮场景图过滤策略将其提升至66.0，超过先前开源SOTA；3) 场景图增强对已有能力的模型有益，但对较弱基线模型增益有限甚至为负；4) 揭示了能力增强的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了结构化关系先验注入对提升视觉语言模型组合推理能力的有效性，特别是对已有一定能力的模型效果显著。提出的场景图增强框架为改进模型的结构化理解提供了新方向，但需要针对不同模型能力水平进行差异化策略设计。

title: Reasoning-Driven Anomaly Detection and Localization with Image-Level Supervision
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable reasoning and perceptual abilities for anomaly detection. However, most approaches remain confined to image-level anomaly detection and textual reasoning, while pixel-level localization still relies on external vision modules and dense annotations. In this work, we activate the intrinsic reasoning potential of MLLMs to perform anomaly detection, pixel-level localization, and interpretable reasoning solely from image-level supervision, without any auxiliary components or pixel-wise labels. Specifically, we propose Reasoning-Driven Anomaly Localization (ReAL), which extracts anomaly-related tokens from the autoregressive reasoning process and aggregates their attention responses to produce pixel-level anomaly maps. We further introduce a Consistency-Guided Reasoning Optimization (CGRO) module that leverages reinforcement learning to align reasoning tokens with visual attentions, resulting in more coherent reasoning and accurate anomaly localization. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves anomaly detection, localization, and interpretability. Remarkably, despite relying solely on image-level supervision, our approach achieves performance competitive with MLLM-based methods trained under dense pixel-level supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/YizhouJin313/ReADL.

AI.tldr: ReAL方法利用多模态大语言模型的内在推理能力，仅通过图像级监督实现异常检测、像素级定位和可解释推理，无需外部视觉模块或像素级标注。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM方法主要局限于图像级异常检测和文本推理，像素级定位仍需依赖外部视觉模块和密集标注，限制了方法的实用性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出Reasoning-Driven Anomaly Localization (ReAL)，从自回归推理过程中提取异常相关token并聚合其注意力响应生成像素级异常图；引入Consistency-Guided Reasoning Optimization (CGRO)模块，利用强化学习对齐推理token与视觉注意力，实现更一致的推理和准确的异常定位。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准测试中显著提升了异常检测、定位和可解释性；仅使用图像级监督即达到与基于密集像素级监督的MLLM方法相竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: ReAL方法成功激活了MLLM的内在推理潜力，仅通过图像级监督即可实现端到端的异常检测、像素级定位和可解释推理，为弱监督异常检测提供了新思路。

title: Communicating about Space: Language-Mediated Spatial Integration Across Partial Views
summary: Humans build shared spatial understanding by communicating partial, viewpoint-dependent observations. We ask whether Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can do the same, aligning distinct egocentric views through dialogue to form a coherent, allocentric mental model of a shared environment. To study this systematically, we introduce COSMIC, a benchmark for Collaborative Spatial Communication. In this setting, two static MLLM agents observe a 3D indoor environment from different viewpoints and exchange natural-language messages to solve spatial queries. COSMIC contains 899 diverse scenes and 1250 question-answer pairs spanning five tasks. We find a consistent capability hierarchy, MLLMs are most reliable at identifying shared anchor objects across views, perform worse on relational reasoning, and largely fail at building globally consistent maps, performing near chance, even for the frontier models. Moreover, we find thinking capability yields consistent gains in anchor grounding, but is insufficient for higher-level spatial communication. To contextualize model behavior, we additionally collect 250 human-human dialogues. Humans achieve 95% aggregate accuracy, leaving significant room for improvement for even the best performing model Gemini-3-Pro-Thinking which achieves 72% aggregate accuracy. Moreover, human conversations become increasingly specific as partners converge on a shared mental model, whereas model dialogues continue to explore new possibilities rather than converging, consistent with a limited ability to build and maintain a robust shared mental model. Our code and data is available at https://github.com/ankursikarwar/Cosmic

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了COSMIC基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型通过对话对齐不同视角、构建共享空间理解的能力，发现模型在锚点识别上表现较好，但在关系推理和全局一致性地图构建上表现较差，与人类表现存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 研究多模态大语言模型是否能够像人类一样，通过交流部分、视角依赖的观察来构建共享的空间理解，即通过对话对齐不同的自我中心视角，形成连贯的、他中心的心理模型。
AI.method: 引入COSMIC基准测试，包含899个多样化场景和1250个问答对，涵盖五个任务。两个静态MLLM代理从不同视角观察3D室内环境，通过自然语言消息交换来解决空间查询。同时收集了250个人类-人类对话作为对比。
AI.result: 发现一致的能力层次：MLLM在识别跨视角共享锚点对象上最可靠，在关系推理上表现较差，在构建全局一致性地图上基本失败（接近随机水平）。思考能力在锚点定位上有帮助，但对高级空间通信不足。人类达到95%的总体准确率，而最佳模型Gemini-3-Pro-Thinking仅达到72%。人类对话随着共享心理模型的建立而变得更加具体，而模型对话则继续探索新可能性而非收敛。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型在通过对话构建共享空间理解方面能力有限，特别是在高级空间推理和全局一致性地图构建方面存在显著不足，与人类表现有较大差距，为未来研究提供了改进方向。

title: Incentivizing Temporal-Awareness in Egocentric Video Understanding Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently shown strong performance in visual understanding, yet they often lack temporal awareness, particularly in egocentric settings where reasoning depends on the correct ordering and evolution of events. This deficiency stems in part from training objectives that fail to explicitly reward temporal reasoning and instead rely on frame-level spatial shortcuts. To address this limitation, we propose Temporal Global Policy Optimization (TGPO), a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) algorithm designed to incentivize temporal awareness in MLLMs. TGPO contrasts model outputs generated from temporally ordered versus shuffled video frames to derive calibrated, globally normalized reward signals that explicitly favor temporally coherent reasoning. Integrated with GRPO and GSPO, TGPO supports cold-start RL training and effectively suppresses spatial shortcut behaviors learned by existing MLLMs. Experiments across five egocentric video benchmarks demonstrate that TGPO consistently improves temporal grounding and causal coherence, outperforming prior RL-based video reasoning approaches. Our results suggest that TGPO offers a simple and scalable pathway toward temporally robust MLLMs for egocentric video understanding.

AI.tldr: TGPO是一种强化学习算法，通过对比有序与乱序视频帧的模型输出来激励多模态大语言模型的时间感知能力，提升自我中心视频理解中的时序推理性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在视觉理解方面表现良好，但在自我中心视频理解中缺乏时间感知能力，主要因为训练目标未能明确奖励时序推理，而是依赖帧级空间捷径。
AI.method: 提出Temporal Global Policy Optimization (TGPO)，这是一种基于可验证奖励的强化学习算法。通过对比模型在时序有序视频帧和乱序视频帧上的输出，计算经过校准的全局归一化奖励信号，明确偏好时序一致的推理。TGPO与GRPO和GSPO集成，支持冷启动强化学习训练，有效抑制现有MLLM学习的空间捷径行为。
AI.result: 在五个自我中心视频基准测试中，TGPO持续提升了时间定位和因果一致性，优于先前的基于强化学习的视频推理方法。
AI.conclusion: TGPO为构建具有时间鲁棒性的多模态大语言模型提供了一条简单且可扩展的路径，特别适用于自我中心视频理解任务。

title: LongCat-Next: Lexicalizing Modalities as Discrete Tokens
summary: The prevailing Next-Token Prediction (NTP) paradigm has driven the success of large language models through discrete autoregressive modeling. However, contemporary multimodal systems remain language-centric, often treating non-linguistic modalities as external attachments, leading to fragmented architectures and suboptimal integration. To transcend this limitation, we introduce Discrete Native Autoregressive (DiNA), a unified framework that represents multimodal information within a shared discrete space, enabling a consistent and principled autoregressive modeling across modalities. A key innovation is the Discrete Native Any-resolution Visual Transformer (dNaViT), which performs tokenization and de-tokenization at arbitrary resolutions, transforming continuous visual signals into hierarchical discrete tokens. Building on this foundation, we develop LongCat-Next, a native multimodal model that processes text, vision, and audio under a single autoregressive objective with minimal modality-specific design. As an industrial-strength foundation model, it excels at seeing, painting, and talking within a single framework, achieving strong performance across a wide range of multimodal benchmarks. In particular, LongCat-Next addresses the long-standing performance ceiling of discrete vision modeling on understanding tasks and provides a unified approach to effectively reconcile the conflict between understanding and generation. As an attempt toward native multimodality, we open-source the LongCat-Next and its tokenizers, hoping to foster further research and development in the community. GitHub: https://github.com/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Next

AI.tldr: DiNA框架通过共享离散空间统一多模态表示，LongCat-Next模型在单一自回归目标下处理文本、视觉和音频，突破离散视觉建模性能瓶颈，实现理解与生成的统一。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态系统仍以语言为中心，将非语言模态作为外部附件处理，导致架构碎片化和次优集成。需要超越这一限制，实现真正的原生多模态建模。
AI.method: 提出DiNA统一框架，在共享离散空间中表示多模态信息；开发dNaViT视觉Transformer，在任意分辨率下进行标记化和去标记化；构建LongCat-Next原生多模态模型，在单一自回归目标下处理文本、视觉和音频。
AI.result: LongCat-Next作为工业级基础模型，在单一框架内实现看、画、说功能，在广泛多模态基准测试中表现优异，突破了离散视觉建模在理解任务上的性能瓶颈，有效调和理解与生成之间的冲突。
AI.conclusion: DiNA框架和LongCat-Next模型代表了向原生多模态的重要尝试，通过共享离散空间和统一自回归建模，为多模态AI提供了更一致和原则性的方法，有望推动该领域的研究和发展。

title: MotionRFT: Unified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion generation has advanced with diffusion- and flow-based generative models, yet supervised pretraining remains insufficient to align models with high-level objectives such as semantic consistency, realism, and human preference. Existing post-training methods have key limitations: they (1) target a specific motion representation, such as joints, (2) optimize a particular aspect, such as text-motion alignment, and may compromise other factors; and (3) incur substantial computational overhead, data dependence, and coarse-grained optimization. We present a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that comprises a heterogeneous-representation, multi-dimensional reward model, MotionReward, and an efficient, fine-grained fine-tuning method, EasyTune. To obtain a unified semantics representation, MotionReward maps heterogeneous motions into a shared semantic space anchored by text, enabling multidimensional reward learning; Self-refinement Preference Learning further enhances semantics without additional annotations. For efficient and effective fine-tuning, we identify the recursive gradient dependence across denoising steps as the key bottleneck, and propose EasyTune, which optimizes step-wise rather than over the full trajectory, yielding dense, fine-grained, and memory-efficient updates. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our framework, achieving FID 0.132 at 22.10 GB peak memory for MLD model and saving up to 15.22 GB over DRaFT. It reduces FID by 22.9% on joint-based ACMDM, and achieves a 12.6% R-Precision gain and 23.3% FID improvement on rotation-based HY Motion. Our project page with code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MotionReward和EasyTune框架，通过强化学习微调解决文本到动作生成中的语义一致性、真实性和人类偏好对齐问题，相比现有方法更高效且支持异构表示。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到动作生成方法（基于扩散和流模型）的监督预训练不足以对齐高级目标如语义一致性、真实性和人类偏好。现有后训练方法存在三个关键限制：针对特定动作表示（如关节）、优化特定方面（如文本-动作对齐）可能损害其他因素、计算开销大且优化粒度粗。
AI.method: 提出强化微调框架：1) MotionReward：异构表示多维奖励模型，将异构动作映射到以文本为锚点的共享语义空间，实现多维奖励学习；通过自精炼偏好学习增强语义；2) EasyTune：高效细粒度微调方法，识别去噪步骤间的递归梯度依赖是关键瓶颈，提出逐步骤优化而非完整轨迹优化，实现密集、细粒度、内存高效的更新。
AI.result: 实验验证框架有效性：MLD模型达到FID 0.132（峰值内存22.10 GB），比DRaFT节省15.22 GB内存；在基于关节的ACMDM上FID降低22.9%；在基于旋转的HY Motion上R-Precision提升12.6%，FID改善23.3%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的强化微调框架成功解决了文本到动作生成中的语义对齐、真实性和偏好问题，通过异构表示奖励模型和高效微调方法实现了更好的性能与效率平衡。

title: CDH-Bench: A Commonsense-Driven Hallucination Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Fidelity in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on many benchmarks, yet a basic reliability question remains underexplored: when visual evidence conflicts with commonsense, do models follow what is shown or what commonsense suggests? A characteristic failure in this setting is that the model overrides visual evidence and outputs the commonsense alternative. We term this phenomenon \textbf{commonsense-driven hallucination} (CDH). To evaluate it, we introduce \textbf{CDH-Bench}, a benchmark designed to create explicit \textbf{visual evidence--commonsense conflicts}. CDH-Bench covers three dimensions: \textit{counting anomalies}, \textit{relational anomalies}, and \textit{attribute anomalies}. We evaluate frontier VLMs under \textit{binary Question Answering (QA)} and \textit{multiple-choice QA}, and report metrics including \textit{Counterfactual Accuracy} (CF-Acc), \textit{Commonsense Accuracy} (CS-Acc), \textit{Counterfactual Accuracy Drop} (CFAD), \textit{Commonsense Collapse Rate} (CCR), and \textit{Relative Prior Dependency} (RPD). Results show that even strong models remain vulnerable to prior-driven normalization under visual evidence--commonsense conflict. CDH-Bench provides a controlled diagnostic of visual fidelity under visual evidence--commonsense conflict.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"常识驱动幻觉"概念，构建CDH-Bench基准测试视觉语言模型在视觉证据与常识冲突时的可靠性问题
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在基准测试中表现良好，但一个基本可靠性问题尚未充分探索：当视觉证据与常识冲突时，模型是遵循所显示的内容还是常识建议？
AI.method: 引入CDH-Bench基准，设计视觉证据-常识冲突场景，涵盖计数异常、关系异常和属性异常三个维度，评估前沿视觉语言模型在二元问答和多选题问答中的表现
AI.result: 结果显示即使强模型在视觉证据-常识冲突下仍然容易受到先验驱动的规范化影响，CDH-Bench提供了在视觉证据-常识冲突下视觉保真度的受控诊断
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了视觉语言模型中存在的常识驱动幻觉问题，提出了系统评估方法，为理解模型在视觉证据与常识冲突时的行为提供了诊断工具

title: Let Triggers Control: Frequency-Aware Dropout for Effective Token Control
comment: CVPR 2026 P13N: Personalization in Generative AI workshop
summary: Text-to-image models such as Stable Diffusion have achieved unprecedented levels of high-fidelity visual synthesis. As these models advance, personalization of generative models -- commonly facilitated through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with a dedicated trigger token -- has become a significant area of research. Previous works have naively assumed that fine-tuning with a single trigger token to represent new concepts. However, this often results in poor controllability, where the trigger token alone fails to reliably evoke the intended concept. We attribute this issue to the frequent co-occurrence of the trigger token with the surrounding context during fine-tuning, which entangles their representations and compromises the token's semantic distinctiveness. To disentangle this, we propose Frequency-Aware Dropout (FAD) -- a novel regularization technique that improves prompt controllability without adding new parameters. FAD consists of two key components: co-occurrence analysis and curriculum-inspired scheduling. Qualitative and quantitative analyses across token-based diffusion models (SD~1.5 and SDXL) and natural language--driven backbones (FLUX and Qwen-Image) demonstrate consistent gains in prompt fidelity, stylistic precision, and user-perceived quality. Our method provides a simple yet effective dropout strategy that enhances controllability and personalization in text-to-image generation. Notably, it achieves these improvements without introducing additional parameters or architectural modifications, making it readily applicable to existing models with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为频率感知丢弃（FAD）的新正则化技术，用于解决文本到图像模型中基于LoRA个性化时触发令牌与上下文纠缠的问题，从而提高提示可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LoRA的个性化方法通常假设使用单个触发令牌来表示新概念，但由于训练过程中触发令牌与上下文频繁共现，导致它们的表示纠缠在一起，从而损害了令牌的语义区分性，使得触发令牌无法可靠地唤起预期概念，导致可控性差。
AI.method: 提出了频率感知丢弃（FAD）方法，包含两个关键组件：共现分析和课程式调度。该方法通过分析触发令牌与上下文的共现频率，在训练过程中动态调整丢弃策略，从而解耦它们的表示，提高触发令牌的语义独立性。
AI.result: 在多种文本到图像模型（SD 1.5、SDXL、FLUX、Qwen-Image）上的定性和定量分析表明，FAD在提示保真度、风格精度和用户感知质量方面都取得了显著提升，且无需引入额外参数或架构修改。
AI.conclusion: FAD是一种简单有效的丢弃策略，能够显著提升文本到图像生成中的可控性和个性化能力，同时保持计算开销最小，易于应用到现有模型中。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucinations in Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Models
summary: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) models have demonstrated impressive capability in complex visual reasoning tasks. Unfortunately, recent studies reveal that they suffer from severe hallucination problems due to diminished visual attention during the generation process. However, visual attention decay is a well-studied problem in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Considering the fundamental differences in reasoning processes between MCoT models and traditional LVLMs, we raise a basic question: Whether MCoT models have unique causes of hallucinations? To answer this question, we systematically investigate the hallucination patterns of MCoT models and find that fabricated texts are primarily generated in associative reasoning steps, which we term divergent thinking. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a simple yet effective strategy that can effectively localize divergent thinking steps and intervene in the decoding process to mitigate hallucinations. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing methods by a large margin. More importantly, our proposed method can be conveniently integrated with other hallucination mitigation methods and further boost their performance. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ASGO-MM/MCoT-hallucination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现多模态思维链模型存在独特的幻觉问题，主要源于联想推理步骤中的发散思维，并提出了一种简单有效的干预策略来定位和缓解这些幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多模态思维链模型在复杂视觉推理任务中表现出色，但近期研究发现它们存在严重的幻觉问题。虽然视觉注意力衰减是大型视觉语言模型的已知问题，但考虑到MCoT模型与传统LVLM在推理过程上的根本差异，本文旨在探究MCoT模型是否具有独特的幻觉成因。
AI.method: 系统研究MCoT模型的幻觉模式，发现幻觉主要产生于联想推理步骤（发散思维）。基于这一发现，提出一种简单有效的策略：定位发散思维步骤并在解码过程中进行干预以缓解幻觉。该方法可方便地与其他幻觉缓解方法集成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法大幅优于现有方法。更重要的是，所提出的方法可以方便地与其他幻觉缓解方法集成，并进一步提升它们的性能。
AI.conclusion: MCoT模型存在独特的幻觉成因，主要源于联想推理步骤中的发散思维。通过定位和干预这些发散思维步骤，可以有效缓解幻觉问题，且该方法具有良好的兼容性和扩展性。

title: ResAdapt: Adaptive Resolution for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve stronger visual understanding by scaling input fidelity, yet the resulting visual token growth makes jointly sustaining high spatial resolution and long temporal context prohibitive. We argue that the bottleneck lies not in how post-encoding representations are compressed but in the volume of pixels the encoder receives, and address it with ResAdapt, an Input-side adaptation framework that learns how much visual budget each frame should receive before encoding. ResAdapt couples a lightweight Allocator with an unchanged MLLM backbone, so the backbone retains its native visual-token interface while receiving an operator-transformed input. We formulate allocation as a contextual bandit and train the Allocator with Cost-Aware Policy Optimization (CAPO), which converts sparse rollout feedback into a stable accuracy-cost learning signal. Across budget-controlled video QA, temporal grounding, and image reasoning tasks, ResAdapt improves low-budget operating points and often lies on or near the efficiency-accuracy frontier, with the clearest gains on reasoning-intensive benchmarks under aggressive compression. Notably, ResAdapt supports up to 16x more frames at the same visual budget while delivering over 15% performance gain. Code is available at https://github.com/Xnhyacinth/ResAdapt.

AI.tldr: ResAdapt是一种输入侧自适应框架，通过轻量级分配器动态决定每帧应获得的视觉预算，在保持MLLM骨干不变的同时提升多模态大语言模型在有限视觉预算下的时空理解能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型通过提高输入保真度来增强视觉理解能力，但由此产生的视觉token增长使得同时维持高空间分辨率和长时序上下文变得困难。作者认为瓶颈不在于编码后表示的压缩，而在于编码器接收的像素量。
AI.method: 提出ResAdapt框架，包含一个轻量级分配器和一个不变的MLLM骨干。分配器在编码前决定每帧应获得的视觉预算，将分配问题建模为上下文多臂赌博机问题，使用成本感知策略优化（CAPO）进行训练，将稀疏的rollout反馈转化为稳定的精度-成本学习信号。
AI.result: 在预算控制的视频问答、时序定位和图像推理任务中，ResAdapt改善了低预算操作点，通常位于或接近效率-精度前沿，在激进压缩下的推理密集型基准测试中提升最明显。在相同视觉预算下支持多达16倍帧数，同时带来超过15%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: ResAdapt通过输入侧自适应有效解决了MLLM中视觉token增长带来的时空理解瓶颈问题，在有限视觉预算下显著提升了模型的时空理解能力，为高效多模态理解提供了新思路。

title: HD-VGGT: High-Resolution Visual Geometry Transformer
summary: High-resolution imagery is essential for accurate 3D reconstruction, as many geometric details only emerge at fine spatial scales. Recent feed-forward approaches, such as the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), have demonstrated the ability to infer scene geometry from large collections of images in a single forward pass. However, scaling these models to high-resolution inputs remains challenging: the number of tokens in transformer architectures grows rapidly with both image resolution and the number of views, leading to prohibitive computational and memory costs. Moreover, we observe that visually ambiguous regions, such as repetitive patterns, weak textures, or specular surfaces, often produce unstable feature tokens that degrade geometric inference, especially at higher resolutions. We introduce HD-VGGT, a dual-branch architecture for efficient and robust high-resolution 3D reconstruction. A low-resolution branch predicts a coarse, globally consistent geometry, while a high-resolution branch refines details via a learned feature upsampling module. To handle unstable tokens, we propose Feature Modulation, which suppresses unreliable features early in the transformer. HD-VGGT leverages high-resolution images and supervision without full-resolution transformer costs, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: HD-VGGT：一种双分支架构，通过低分辨率分支预测全局一致的粗略几何，高分辨率分支通过特征上采样模块细化细节，并引入特征调制机制抑制不稳定特征，实现高效高分辨率3D重建。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像对3D重建至关重要，但现有前馈方法（如VGGT）在处理高分辨率输入时面临挑战：Transformer架构的token数量随图像分辨率和视图数量快速增长，导致计算和内存成本过高；视觉模糊区域（如重复模式、弱纹理或镜面表面）产生不稳定特征token，在高分辨率下会降低几何推理质量。
AI.method: 提出HD-VGGT双分支架构：1）低分辨率分支预测全局一致的粗略几何；2）高分辨率分支通过学习的特征上采样模块细化细节；3）引入特征调制机制，在Transformer早期抑制不可靠特征；4）利用高分辨率图像和监督，避免全分辨率Transformer的高昂成本。
AI.result: HD-VGGT在保持高效计算的同时，实现了最先进的重建质量，能够有效处理高分辨率输入，抑制不稳定特征的影响，提升几何细节的恢复精度。
AI.conclusion: HD-VGGT通过创新的双分支架构和特征调制机制，解决了高分辨率3D重建中的计算效率和特征稳定性问题，为高质量几何细节恢复提供了有效解决方案。

title: EuraGovExam: A Multilingual Multimodal Benchmark from Real-World Civil Service Exams
summary: We present EuraGovExam, a multilingual and multimodal benchmark sourced from real-world civil service examinations across five representative Eurasian regions: South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, India, and the European Union. Designed to reflect the authentic complexity of public-sector assessments, the dataset contains over 8,000 high-resolution scanned multiple-choice questions covering 17 diverse academic and administrative domains. Unlike existing benchmarks, EuraGovExam embeds all question content--including problem statements, answer choices, and visual elements--within a single image, providing only a minimal standardized instruction for answer formatting. This design demands that models perform layout-aware, cross-lingual reasoning directly from visual input. All items are drawn from real exam documents, preserving rich visual structures such as tables, multilingual typography, and form-like layouts. Evaluation results show that even state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs) achieve only 86% accuracy, underscoring the benchmark's difficulty and its power to diagnose the limitations of current models. By emphasizing cultural realism, visual complexity, and linguistic diversity, EuraGovExam establishes a new standard for evaluating VLMs in high-stakes, multilingual, image-grounded settings. It also supports practical applications in e-governance, public-sector document analysis, and equitable exam preparation.

AI.tldr: EuraGovExam是一个多语言多模态基准数据集，基于五个欧亚地区真实公务员考试构建，包含8000多道高分辨率扫描选择题，要求模型直接从视觉输入进行布局感知的跨语言推理。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法反映公共部门评估的真实复杂性，缺乏文化真实性、视觉复杂性和语言多样性。需要建立能够评估视觉语言模型在高风险、多语言、图像基础场景中表现的新标准。
AI.method: 从韩国、日本、台湾、印度和欧盟的真实公务员考试文档中收集数据，将所有问题内容（包括问题陈述、答案选项和视觉元素）嵌入单一图像中，仅提供最小标准化指令用于答案格式化，保留表格、多语言排版和表单式布局等丰富视觉结构。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，即使最先进的视觉语言模型也只能达到86%的准确率，凸显了该基准的难度及其诊断当前模型局限性的能力。
AI.conclusion: EuraGovExam通过强调文化真实性、视觉复杂性和语言多样性，为评估视觉语言模型在高风险、多语言、图像基础场景中的表现建立了新标准，支持电子政务、公共部门文档分析和公平考试准备等实际应用。

title: NimbusGS: Unified 3D Scene Reconstruction under Hybrid Weather
summary: We present NimbusGS, a unified framework for reconstructing high-quality 3D scenes from degraded multi-view inputs captured under diverse and mixed adverse weather conditions. Unlike existing methods that target specific weather types, NimbusGS addresses the broader challenge of generalization by modeling the dual nature of weather: a continuous, view-consistent medium that attenuates light, and dynamic, view-dependent particles that cause scattering and occlusion. To capture this structure, we decompose degradations into a global transmission field and per-view particulate residuals. The transmission field represents static atmospheric effects shared across views, while the residuals model transient disturbances unique to each input. To enable stable geometry learning under severe visibility degradation, we introduce a geometry-guided gradient scaling mechanism that mitigates gradient imbalance during the self-supervised optimization of 3D Gaussian representations. This physically grounded formulation allows NimbusGS to disentangle complex degradations while preserving scene structure, yielding superior geometry reconstruction and outperforming task-specific methods across diverse and challenging weather conditions. Code is available at https://github.com/lyy-ovo/NimbusGS.

AI.tldr: NimbusGS是一个从多种恶劣天气条件下的退化多视角输入重建高质量3D场景的统一框架，通过建模天气的双重性质（连续介质和动态粒子）来提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常针对特定天气类型，缺乏处理混合恶劣天气条件下3D场景重建的泛化能力。需要解决在严重能见度退化下稳定学习几何结构的问题。
AI.method: 将天气退化分解为全局传输场（跨视角共享的静态大气效应）和每视角颗粒残差（各视角特有的瞬时干扰）。引入几何引导的梯度缩放机制，在3D高斯表示的自监督优化中缓解梯度不平衡问题。
AI.result: NimbusGS能够解耦复杂退化同时保持场景结构，在多样且具有挑战性的天气条件下实现优越的几何重建，超越了特定任务方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过物理基础的建模方法，解决了从混合恶劣天气输入中重建高质量3D场景的泛化挑战，为实际应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Diagnosing and Repairing Unsafe Channels in Vision-Language Models via Causal Discovery and Dual-Modal Safety Subspace Projection
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved impressive performance across multimodal understanding and reasoning tasks, yet their internal safety mechanisms remain opaque and poorly controlled. In this work, we present a comprehensive framework for diagnosing and repairing unsafe channels within LVLMs (CARE). We first perform causal mediation analysis to identify neurons and layers that are causally responsible for unsafe behaviors. Based on these findings, we introduce a dual-modal safety subspace projection method that learns generalized safety subspaces for both visual and textual modalities through generalized eigen-decomposition between benign and malicious activations. During inference, activations are dynamically projected toward these safety subspaces via a hybrid fusion mechanism that adaptively balances visual and textual corrections, effectively suppressing unsafe features while preserving semantic fidelity. Extensive experiments on multiple safety benchmarks demonstrate that our causal-subspace repair framework significantly enhances safety robustness without degrading general multimodal capabilities, outperforming prior activation steering and alignment-based baselines. Additionally, our method exhibits good transferability, defending against unseen attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出CARE框架，通过因果中介分析识别LVLMs中的不安全通道，并利用双模态安全子空间投影方法修复这些通道，在保持语义保真度的同时增强模型安全性。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在多模态理解和推理任务中表现出色，但其内部安全机制不透明且难以控制，需要开发系统性的诊断和修复方法来增强模型安全性。
AI.method: 1) 使用因果中介分析识别导致不安全行为的神经元和层；2) 通过良性/恶意激活之间的广义特征分解学习视觉和文本模态的广义安全子空间；3) 推理时通过混合融合机制将激活动态投影到安全子空间，自适应平衡视觉和文本修正。
AI.result: 在多个安全基准测试中，CARE框架显著增强了安全鲁棒性，且不降低通用多模态能力，优于先前的激活引导和对齐基线方法，并展现出良好的可迁移性，能够防御未见攻击。
AI.conclusion: 提出的因果子空间修复框架为LVLMs提供了一种有效的安全增强方法，通过识别和修复不安全通道，在保持模型性能的同时显著提升安全性，具有实际应用价值。

title: SaSaSaSa2VA: 2nd Place of the 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Track
summary: Referring video object segmentation (RVOS) commonly grounds targets in videos based on static textual cues. MeViS benchmark extends this by incorporating motion-centric expressions (referring & reasoning motion expressions) and introducing no-target queries. Extending SaSaSa2VA, where increased input frames and [SEG] tokens already strengthen the Sa2VA backbone, we adopt a simple yet effective target existence-aware verification mechanism, leading to Still Awesome SaSaSa2VA (SaSaSaSa2VA). Despite its simplicity, the method achieves a final score of 89.19 in the 5th PVUW Challenge (MeViS-Text Track), securing 2nd place. Both quantitative results and ablations suggest that this existence-aware verification strategy is sufficient to unlock strong performance on motion-centric referring tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SaSaSaSa2VA方法，通过目标存在感知验证机制改进视频目标分割，在MeViS基准测试中获得第二名
AI.motivation: 传统的视频目标分割主要基于静态文本线索，而MeViS基准引入了运动中心表达（包含运动指代和推理）和无目标查询，需要更强大的方法来处理这些挑战
AI.method: 在SaSaSa2VA基础上，采用简单但有效的目标存在感知验证机制，形成Still Awesome SaSaSaSa2VA方法。该方法通过增加输入帧和[SEG]标记来增强Sa2VA骨干网络
AI.result: 在第5届PVUW挑战赛（MeViS-Text Track）中获得最终得分89.19，排名第二。定量结果和消融实验表明该方法在运动中心指代任务上表现优异
AI.conclusion: 目标存在感知验证策略虽然简单，但足以在运动中心指代任务上实现强大性能，为处理MeViS基准中的运动表达和无目标查询提供了有效解决方案

title: Zero-shot Vision-Language Reranking for Cross-View Geolocalization
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to XXV ISPRS Congress
summary: Cross-view geolocalization (CVGL) systems, while effective at retrieving a list of relevant candidates (high Recall@k), often fail to identify the single best match (low Top-1 accuracy). This work investigates the use of zero-shot Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as rerankers to address this gap. We propose a two-stage framework: state-of-the-art (SOTA) retrieval followed by VLM reranking. We systematically compare two strategies: (1) Pointwise (scoring candidates individually) and (2) Pairwise (comparing candidates relatively). Experiments on the VIGOR dataset show a clear divergence: all pointwise methods cause a catastrophic drop in performance or no change at all. In contrast, a pairwise comparison strategy using LLaVA improves Top-1 accuracy over the strong retrieval baseline. Our analysis concludes that, these VLMs are poorly calibrated for absolute relevance scoring but are effective at fine-grained relative visual judgment, making pairwise reranking a promising direction for enhancing CVGL precision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用零样本视觉语言模型作为重排序器来提升跨视角地理定位系统的Top-1准确率，发现成对比较策略优于逐点评分方法。
AI.motivation: 跨视角地理定位系统虽然能有效检索相关候选（高Recall@k），但在识别最佳匹配（低Top-1准确率）方面表现不佳。本研究旨在探索使用零样本视觉语言模型作为重排序器来解决这一差距。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：先使用最先进的检索方法，再用视觉语言模型重排序。系统比较两种策略：(1) 逐点方法（单独评分候选）和(2) 成对方法（相对比较候选）。在VIGOR数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 实验显示明显差异：所有逐点方法导致性能灾难性下降或无变化。相反，使用LLaVA的成对比较策略相比强检索基线提高了Top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型在绝对相关性评分方面校准不佳，但在细粒度相对视觉判断方面有效，使得成对重排序成为提升跨视角地理定位精度的有前景方向。

title: Seeing the Scene Matters: Revealing Forgetting in Video Understanding Models with a Scene-Aware Long-Video Benchmark
summary: Long video understanding (LVU) remains a core challenge in multimodal learning.
