Although recent vision-language models (VLMs) have made notable progress, existing benchmarks mainly focus on either fine-grained perception or coarse summarization, offering limited insight into temporal understanding over long contexts. In this work, we define a scene as a coherent segment of a video in which both visual and semantic contexts remain consistent, aligning with human perception. This leads us to a key question: can current VLMs reason effectively over long, scene-level contexts? To answer this, we introduce a new benchmark, SceneBench, designed to provide scene-level challenges. Our evaluation reveals a sharp drop in accuracy when VLMs attempt to answer scene-level questions, indicating significant forgetting of long-range context. To further validate these findings, we propose Scene Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Scene-RAG), which constructs a dynamic scene memory by retrieving and integrating relevant context across scenes. This Scene-RAG improves VLM performance by +2.50%, confirming that current models still struggle with long-context retention. We hope SceneBench will encourage future research toward VLMs with more robust, human-like video comprehension.

AI.tldr: SceneBench是一个新的长视频理解基准测试，专注于场景级推理，发现现有视觉语言模型在长上下文记忆方面存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解基准主要关注细粒度感知或粗粒度摘要，缺乏对长上下文时间理解的深入洞察。作者提出场景作为视频中视觉和语义上下文保持一致的一致片段，并探讨当前视觉语言模型能否在场景级长上下文中有效推理。
AI.method: 1. 定义场景为视频中视觉和语义上下文保持一致的一致片段；2. 构建SceneBench基准测试，提供场景级挑战；3. 提出Scene Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Scene-RAG)方法，通过检索和整合跨场景的相关上下文构建动态场景记忆。
AI.result: 评估显示，当视觉语言模型尝试回答场景级问题时，准确率急剧下降，表明存在显著的长范围上下文遗忘。Scene-RAG方法将视觉语言模型性能提升了+2.50%，证实当前模型在长上下文保留方面仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在长视频场景级理解方面存在显著局限性，SceneBench基准测试为未来研究提供了重要方向，鼓励开发具有更鲁棒、更类人视频理解能力的视觉语言模型。

title: TrackMAE: Video Representation Learning via Track Mask and Predict
summary: Masked video modeling (MVM) has emerged as a simple and scalable self-supervised pretraining paradigm, but only encodes motion information implicitly, limiting the encoding of temporal dynamics in the learned representations. As a result, such models struggle on motion-centric tasks that require fine-grained motion awareness. To address this, we propose TrackMAE, a simple masked video modeling paradigm that explicitly uses motion information as a reconstruction signal. In TrackMAE, we use an off-the-shelf point tracker to sparsely track points in the input videos, generating motion trajectories. Furthermore, we exploit the extracted trajectories to improve random tube masking with a motion-aware masking strategy. We enhance video representations learned in both pixel and feature semantic reconstruction spaces by providing a complementary supervision signal in the form of motion targets. We evaluate on six datasets across diverse downstream settings and find that TrackMAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art video self-supervised learning baselines, learning more discriminative and generalizable representations. Code available at https://github.com/rvandeghen/TrackMAE

AI.tldr: TrackMAE是一种改进的掩码视频建模方法，通过显式使用运动信息作为重建信号，解决了传统MVM方法在运动感知任务上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统掩码视频建模方法仅隐式编码运动信息，限制了时间动态的学习，导致在需要细粒度运动感知的任务上表现不佳。
AI.method: 使用现有点追踪器稀疏追踪视频中的点生成运动轨迹，利用提取的轨迹改进随机管状掩码策略，在像素和特征语义重建空间中提供运动目标作为补充监督信号。
AI.result: 在六个不同下游任务数据集上评估，TrackMAE始终优于最先进的视频自监督学习基线，学习到更具区分性和泛化能力的表示。
AI.conclusion: TrackMAE通过显式利用运动信息作为重建目标，有效提升了掩码视频建模的性能，特别是在运动中心任务上表现优异。

title: Human-Centric Perception for Child Sexual Abuse Imagery
comment: submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security (TIFS)
summary: Law enforcement agencies and non-gonvernmental organizations handling reports of Child Sexual Abuse Imagery (CSAI) are overwhelmed by large volumes of data, requiring the aid of automation tools. However, defining sexual abuse in images of children is inherently challenging, encompassing sexually explicit activities and hints of sexuality conveyed by the individual's pose, or their attire. CSAI classification methods often rely on black-box approaches, targeting broad and abstract concepts such as pornography. Thus, our work is an in-depth exploration of tasks from the literature on Human-Centric Perception, across the domains of safe images, adult pornography, and CSAI, focusing on targets that enable more objective and explainable pipelines for CSAI classification in the future. We introduce the Body-Keypoint-Part Dataset (BKPD), gathering images of people from varying age groups and sexual explicitness to approximate the domain of CSAI, along with manually curated hierarchically structured labels for skeletal keypoints and bounding boxes for person and body parts, including head, chest, hip, and hands. We propose two methods, namely BKP-Association and YOLO-BKP, for simultaneous pose estimation and detection, with targets associated per individual for a comprehensive decomposed representation of each person. Our methods are benchmarked on COCO-Keypoints and COCO-HumanParts, as well as our human-centric dataset, achieving competitive results with models that jointly perform all tasks. Cross-domain ablation studies on BKPD and a case study on RCPD highlight the challenges posed by sexually explicit domains. Our study addresses previously unexplored targets in the CSAI domain, paving the way for novel research opportunities.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对儿童性虐待图像分类的挑战，提出了BKPD数据集和两种同时进行姿态估计与检测的方法，为CSA领域提供了更客观、可解释的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 执法机构和非政府组织在处理儿童性虐待图像报告时面临数据量大、分类困难的挑战。现有方法多为黑盒方法，针对抽象概念如色情内容，难以准确定义儿童性虐待。需要更客观、可解释的管道来改善CSA分类。
AI.method:
1. 引入BKPD数据集：收集不同年龄组和性暴露程度的人物图像，包含手动标注的层次化标签，包括骨骼关键点和人物及身体部位（头、胸、臀、手）的边界框。
2. 提出两种方法：BKP-Association和YOLO-BKP，用于同时进行姿态估计和检测，为每个人提供全面的分解表示。
AI.result:
1. 在COCO-Keypoints、COCO-HumanParts和BKPD数据集上进行了基准测试，取得了与联合执行所有任务的模型相竞争的结果。
2. 在BKPD上的跨域消融研究和RCPD上的案例研究突出了性暴露领域带来的挑战。
3. 方法在CSA领域探索了先前未探索的目标。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入BKPD数据集和两种新方法，为儿童性虐待图像分类提供了更客观、可解释的解决方案，解决了该领域先前未探索的目标，为未来的研究开辟了新的机会。

title: Complet4R: Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction
summary: We introduce Complet4R, a novel end-to-end framework for Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction, which aims to recover temporally coherent and geometrically complete reconstruction for dynamic scenes. Our method formalizes the task of Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction as a unified framework of reconstruction and completion, by directly accumulating full contexts onto each frame. Unlike previous approaches that rely on pairwise reconstruction or local motion estimation, Complet4R utilizes a decoder-only transformer to operate all context globally directly from sequential video input, reconstructing a complete geometry for every single timestamp, including occluded regions visible in other frames. Our method demonstrates the state-of-the-art performance on our proposed benchmark for Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction and the 3D Point Tracking task. Code will be released to support future research.

AI.tldr: Complet4R是一个端到端的几何完整4D重建框架，通过全局上下文累积实现动态场景的时序一致、几何完整的重建。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖成对重建或局部运动估计，难以恢复动态场景中每个时间戳的完整几何结构，特别是被遮挡区域。
AI.method: 使用仅解码器的transformer从序列视频输入中全局操作所有上下文，将几何完整4D重建任务形式化为重建和补全的统一框架，直接为每个时间戳累积完整上下文。
AI.result: 在提出的几何完整4D重建基准和3D点跟踪任务上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: Complet4R通过全局上下文累积实现了动态场景的时序一致、几何完整的4D重建，包括其他帧中可见的遮挡区域。

title: Dual-Path Learning based on Frequency Structural Decoupling and Regional-Aware Fusion for Low-Light Image Super-Resolution
summary: Low-light image super-resolution (LLISR) is essential for restoring fine visual details and perceptual quality under insufficient illumination conditions with ubiquitous low-resolution devices. Although pioneer methods achieve high performance on single tasks, they solve both tasks in a serial manner, which inevitably leads to artifact amplification, texture suppression, and structural degradation. To address this, we propose Decoupling then Perceive (DTP), a novel frequency-aware framework that explicitly separates luminance and texture into semantically independent components, enabling specialized modeling and coherent reconstruction. Specifically, to adaptively separate the input into low-frequency luminance and high-frequency texture subspaces, we propose a Frequency-aware Structural Decoupling (FSD) mechanism, which lays a solid foundation for targeted representation learning and reconstruction. Based on the decoupled representation, a Semantics-specific Dual-path Representation (SDR) learning strategy that performs targeted enhancement and reconstruction for each frequency component is further designed, facilitating robust luminance adjustment and fine-grained texture recovery. To promote structural consistency and perceptual alignment in the reconstructed output, building upon this dual-path modeling, we further introduce a Cross-frequency Semantic Recomposition (CSR) module that selectively integrates the decoupled representations. Extensive experiments on the most widely used LLISR benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our DTP framework, improving $+$1.6\% PSNR, $+$9.6\% SSIM, and $-$48\% LPIPS compared to the most state-of-the-art (SOTA) algorithm. Codes are released at https://github.com/JXVision/DTP.

AI.tldr: 提出DTP框架，通过频率感知结构解耦将低光图像分离为低频亮度与高频纹理分量，分别进行针对性增强与重建，显著提升低光超分辨率性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法以串行方式处理低光图像超分辨率任务，导致伪影放大、纹理抑制和结构退化问题。需要一种能够显式分离亮度与纹理分量并进行针对性建模的方法。
AI.method: 提出DTP框架：1) 频率感知结构解耦(FSD)机制自适应分离低频亮度与高频纹理分量；2) 语义特定双路径表示(SDR)学习策略分别增强和重建各频率分量；3) 跨频率语义重组(CSR)模块选择性整合解耦表示。
AI.result: 在主流LLISR基准测试中，DTP框架相比最先进的算法提升PSNR 1.6%、SSIM 9.6%、LPIPS降低48%，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: DTP框架通过频率感知的解耦-感知范式，有效解决了低光超分辨率中的伪影放大和纹理抑制问题，实现了更优的视觉细节恢复和感知质量提升。

title: Difference Feedback: Generating Multimodal Process-Level Supervision for VLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) are increasingly aligned via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)-style training. However, relying solely on terminal outcome rewards yields sparse credit assignment in multi-step reasoning, weakening the linkage between visual evidence and intermediate steps and often causing unstable optimization and visual hallucinations. We propose Differential Feedback, which automatically constructs token/step-level supervision masks by repairing erroneous reasoning trajectories, explicitly marking the key positions that require correction. Without costly large-scale step-by-step human annotations, our method enables process-level visual alignment and can be seamlessly integrated into existing GRPO-like frameworks. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks including MMMStar and MathVista show an average 3% improvement under matched compute budgets. Our approach offers an effective, low-cost solution for accurate vision--reasoning process alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出Differential Feedback方法，通过修复错误推理轨迹自动构建token/步级监督掩码，解决VLMs在GRPO训练中因稀疏奖励导致的视觉证据与中间步骤脱节问题，实现低成本的过程级视觉对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型通过GRPO风格训练进行对齐，但仅依赖终端结果奖励会导致多步推理中的稀疏信用分配问题，削弱视觉证据与中间步骤的联系，引发不稳定优化和视觉幻觉。
AI.method: 提出Differential Feedback方法，通过自动修复错误推理轨迹来构建token/步级监督掩码，明确标记需要修正的关键位置，无需大规模人工标注即可实现过程级视觉对齐，并能无缝集成到现有GRPO框架中。
AI.result: 在MMMStar和MathVista等多模态推理基准测试中，在相同计算预算下平均提升3%性能，为准确的视觉推理过程对齐提供了有效且低成本的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: Differential Feedback方法通过自动构建精细监督信号，有效解决了VLMs在GRPO训练中的稀疏奖励问题，实现了低成本的过程级视觉对齐，显著提升了多模态推理性能。

title: Unsafe by Reciprocity: How Generation-Understanding Coupling Undermines Safety in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Text-to-Image (T2I) models have led to the emergence of Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs), where multimodal understanding and image generation are tightly integrated within a shared architecture. Prior studies suggest that such reciprocity enhances cross-functionality performance through shared representations and joint optimization. However, the safety implications of this tight coupling remain largely unexplored, as existing safety research predominantly analyzes understanding and generation functionalities in isolation. In this work, we investigate whether cross-functionality reciprocity itself constitutes a structural source of vulnerability in UMMs. We propose RICE: Reciprocal Interaction-based Cross-functionality Exploitation, a novel attack paradigm that explicitly exploits bidirectional interactions between understanding and generation. Using this framework, we systematically evaluate Generation-to-Understanding (G-U) and Understanding-to-Generation (U-G) attack pathways, demonstrating that unsafe intermediate signals can propagate across modalities and amplify safety risks. Extensive experiments show high Attack Success Rates (ASR) in both directions, revealing previously overlooked safety weaknesses inherent to UMMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RICE攻击框架，利用统一多模态模型中理解与生成功能间的双向交互进行跨功能攻击，揭示了这种紧密耦合带来的安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型将多模态理解和图像生成紧密集成在共享架构中，现有研究认为这种互惠性通过共享表示和联合优化增强了跨功能性能，但其安全影响尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出RICE（Reciprocal Interaction-based Cross-functionality Exploitation）攻击范式，系统评估生成到理解（G-U）和理解到生成（U-G）两种攻击路径，利用理解与生成功能间的双向交互传播不安全信号。
AI.result: 实验显示在两个攻击方向上均实现了高攻击成功率，揭示了统一多模态模型中先前被忽视的安全弱点，表明跨功能互惠性本身构成了结构性漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态模型中理解与生成功能的紧密耦合带来了新的安全风险，跨功能互惠性可能成为结构性漏洞源，需要在模型设计中考虑这种安全影响。

title: EVA: Bridging Performance and Human Alignment in Hard-Attention Vision Models for Image Classification
summary: Optimizing vision models purely for classification accuracy can impose an alignment tax, degrading human-like scanpaths and limiting interpretability. We introduce EVA, a neuroscience-inspired hard-attention mechanistic testbed that makes the performance-human-likeness trade-off explicit and adjustable. EVA samples a small number of sequential glimpses using a minimal fovea-periphery representation with CNN-based feature extractor and integrates variance control and adaptive gating to stabilize and regulate attention dynamics. EVA is trained with the standard classification objective without gaze supervision. On CIFAR-10 with dense human gaze annotations, EVA improves scanpath alignment under established metrics such as DTW, NSS, while maintaining competitive accuracy. Ablations show that CNN-based feature extraction drives accuracy but suppresses human-likeness, whereas variance control and gating restore human-aligned trajectories with minimal performance loss. We further validate EVA's scalability on ImageNet-100 and evaluate scanpath alignment on COCO-Search18 without COCO-Search18 gaze supervision or finetuning, where EVA yields human-like scanpaths on natural scenes without additional training. Overall, EVA provides a principled framework for trustworthy, human-interpretable active vision.

AI.tldr: EVA是一个神经科学启发的硬注意力机制测试平台，通过显式调节性能与人类相似性的权衡，在保持分类准确性的同时生成更符合人类扫描路径的视觉模型。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉模型单纯优化分类准确率可能导致对齐代价，降低扫描路径的人类相似性和可解释性。需要一种能够显式调节性能与人类相似性权衡的框架。
AI.method: EVA采用神经科学启发的硬注意力机制，使用最小化的中央凹-周边表示和CNN特征提取器，通过方差控制和自适应门控来稳定和调节注意力动态，仅使用标准分类目标训练而无注视监督。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上，EVA在DTW、NSS等指标上改善了扫描路径对齐，同时保持竞争性准确率。在ImageNet-100上验证了可扩展性，在COCO-Search18上无需额外训练也能生成人类相似扫描路径。
AI.conclusion: EVA为可信赖、人类可解释的主动视觉提供了一个原则性框架，通过显式调节性能与人类相似性的权衡，实现了更好的对齐效果。

title: Learning to Focus and Precise Cropping: A Reinforcement Learning Framework with Information Gaps and Grounding Loss for MLLMs
summary: To enhance the perception and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models in complex visual scenes, recent research has introduced agent-based workflows. In these works, MLLMs autonomously utilize image cropping tool to analyze regions of interest for question answering. While existing training strategies, such as those employing supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, have made significant progress, our empirical analysis reveals a key limitation. We demonstrate the model's strong reliance on global input and its weak dependence on the details within the cropped region. To address this issue, we propose a novel two-stage reinforcement learning framework that does not require trajectory supervision. In the first stage, we introduce the ``Information Gap" mechanism by adjusting the granularity of the global image. This mechanism trains the model to answer questions by focusing on cropped key regions, driven by the information gain these regions provide. The second stage further enhances cropping precision by incorporating a grounding loss, using a small number of bounding box annotations. Experiments show that our method significantly enhances the model's attention to cropped regions, enabling it to achieve state-of-the-art performance on high-resolution visual question-answering benchmarks. Our method provides a more efficient approach for perceiving and reasoning fine-grained details in MLLMs. Code is available at: https://github.com/XuanPu-Z/LFPC.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种两阶段强化学习框架，通过"信息差距"机制和接地损失，解决多模态大语言模型在复杂视觉场景中过度依赖全局输入而忽视裁剪区域细节的问题，显著提升了模型对裁剪区域的关注度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于代理的多模态大语言模型训练策略存在关键局限性：模型过度依赖全局输入，对裁剪区域内的细节依赖较弱，这限制了模型在复杂视觉场景中的感知和推理能力。
AI.method: 提出两阶段强化学习框架：第一阶段引入"信息差距"机制，通过调整全局图像粒度，训练模型基于裁剪关键区域的信息增益来回答问题；第二阶段通过少量边界框标注引入接地损失，进一步提升裁剪精度。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法显著增强了模型对裁剪区域的注意力，在高分辨率视觉问答基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为多模态大语言模型感知和推理细粒度细节提供了更高效的途径，无需轨迹监督即可有效解决模型对裁剪区域细节依赖不足的问题。

title: TerraSeg: Self-Supervised Ground Segmentation for Any LiDAR
summary: LiDAR perception is fundamental to robotics, enabling machines to understand their environment in 3D. A crucial task for LiDAR-based scene understanding and navigation is ground segmentation. However, existing methods are either handcrafted for specific sensor configurations or rely on costly per-point manual labels, severely limiting their generalization and scalability. To overcome this, we introduce TerraSeg, the first self-supervised, domain-agnostic model for LiDAR ground segmentation. We train TerraSeg on OmniLiDAR, a unified large-scale dataset that aggregates and standardizes data from 12 major public benchmarks. Spanning almost 22 million raw scans across 15 distinct sensor models, OmniLiDAR provides unprecedented diversity for learning a highly generalizable ground model. To supervise training without human annotations, we propose PseudoLabeler, a novel module that generates high-quality ground and non-ground labels through self-supervised per-scan runtime optimization. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that, despite using no manual labels, TerraSeg achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes, SemanticKITTI, and Waymo Perception while delivering real-time performance. Our code and model weights are publicly available.

AI.tldr: TerraSeg是首个自监督、领域无关的LiDAR地面分割模型，在OmniLiDAR大规模数据集上训练，无需人工标注，在多个基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR地面分割方法要么针对特定传感器配置手工设计，要么依赖昂贵的人工标注点云数据，这严重限制了方法的泛化能力和可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出TerraSeg自监督模型，使用OmniLiDAR统一大规模数据集（12个公共基准，15种传感器，2200万原始扫描）。通过PseudoLabeler模块在运行时进行自监督优化，生成高质量的地面和非地面伪标签来监督训练。
AI.result: 尽管不使用人工标注，TerraSeg在nuScenes、SemanticKITTI和Waymo Perception等基准测试中达到了最先进的性能，同时实现了实时处理能力。
AI.conclusion: TerraSeg展示了自监督学习在LiDAR地面分割任务中的有效性，通过大规模多样化数据和创新的伪标签生成方法，实现了领域无关的高性能地面分割。

title: Falcon Perception
summary:
Perception-centric systems are typically implemented with a modular encoder-decoder pipeline: a vision backbone for feature extraction and a separate decoder (or late-fusion module) for task prediction. This raises a central question: is this architectural separation essential or can a single early-fusion stack do both perception and task modeling at scale? We introduce Falcon Perception, a unified dense Transformer that processes image patches and text tokens in a shared parameter space from the first layer, using a hybrid attention pattern (bidirectional among image tokens, causal for prediction tokens) to combine global visual context with autoregressive, variable-length instance generation. To keep dense outputs practical, Falcon Perception retains a lightweight token interface and decodes continuous spatial outputs with specialized heads, enabling parallel high-resolution mask prediction.
  Our design promotes simplicity: we keep a single scalable backbone and shift complexity toward data and training signals, adding only small heads where outputs are continuous and dense. On SA-Co, Falcon Perception improves mask quality to 68.0 Macro-F$_1$ compared to 62.3 of SAM3. We also introduce PBench, a benchmark targeting compositional prompts (OCR, spatial constraints, relations) and dense long-context regimes, where the model shows better gains. Finally, we extend the same early-fusion recipe to Falcon OCR: a compact 300M-parameter model which attains 80.3% on olmOCR and 88.64 on OmniDocBench.

AI.tldr: Falcon Perception是一个统一的密集Transformer模型，通过早期融合架构处理图像和文本，在共享参数空间中同时进行感知和任务建模，在多个基准测试中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统感知系统采用模块化的编码器-解码器架构，将特征提取和任务预测分离。本文探讨这种架构分离是否必要，能否通过单一早期融合堆栈在大规模上同时完成感知和任务建模。
AI.method: 提出Falcon Perception统一密集Transformer，在共享参数空间中从第一层开始处理图像块和文本标记，采用混合注意力模式（图像标记双向，预测标记因果），结合全局视觉上下文和自回归可变长度实例生成。通过轻量级标记接口和专用头解码连续空间输出。
AI.result: 在SA-Co基准上，Falcon Perception将掩码质量提升至68.0 Macro-F1（SAM3为62.3）。在PBench基准（针对组合提示和密集长上下文）上表现更佳。Falcon OCR（300M参数）在olmOCR上达到80.3%，在OmniDocBench上达到88.64。
AI.conclusion: 早期融合架构可以替代传统的模块化编码器-解码器设计，通过单一可扩展骨干网络实现感知和任务建模的统一，将复杂性转移到数据和训练信号，保持模型简洁性。

title: STRIDE: When to Speak Meets Sequence Denoising for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Recent progress in video large language models (Video-LLMs) has enabled strong offline reasoning over long and complex videos. However, real-world deployments increasingly require streaming perception and proactive interaction, where video frames arrive online and the system must decide not only what to respond, but also when to respond. In this work, we revisit proactive activation in streaming video as a structured sequence modeling problem, motivated by the observation that temporal transitions in streaming video naturally form span-structured activation patterns. To capture this span-level structure, we model activation signals jointly over a sliding temporal window and update them iteratively as new frames arrive. We propose STRIDE (Structured Temporal Refinement with Iterative DEnoising), which employs a lightweight masked diffusion module at the activation interface to jointly predict and progressively refine activation signals across the window. Extensive experiments on diverse streaming benchmarks and downstream models demonstrate that STRIDE shows more reliable and temporally coherent proactive responses, significantly improving when-to-speak decision quality in online streaming scenarios.

AI.tldr: STRIDE：一种用于流式视频主动激活的结构化时序细化方法，通过掩码扩散模块在滑动窗口内联合预测和逐步优化激活信号，提升在线流式场景中"何时说话"的决策质量。
AI.motivation: 现实世界部署需要流式感知和主动交互，视频帧在线到达，系统不仅要决定如何响应，还要决定何时响应。流式视频中的时间转换自然形成跨度结构的激活模式，需要捕捉这种跨度级结构。
AI.method: 将流式视频中的主动激活建模为结构化序列建模问题，在滑动时间窗口上联合建模激活信号，并随着新帧到达迭代更新。提出STRIDE方法，在激活接口处使用轻量级掩码扩散模块，在窗口内联合预测并逐步细化激活信号。
AI.result: 在多样化的流式基准测试和下游模型上的广泛实验表明，STRIDE显示出更可靠和时间一致的主动响应，显著提高了在线流式场景中"何时说话"的决策质量。
AI.conclusion: STRIDE通过结构化时序细化和迭代去噪，有效解决了流式视频中的主动激活问题，为视频大语言模型在实时流式场景中的应用提供了更好的决策能力。

title: Bridging Visual Representation and Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has substantially enhanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models in abstract reasoning tasks. However, its application to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remains constrained by a structural representational bottleneck. Existing approaches generally lack explicit modeling and effective utilization of visual information, preventing visual representations from being tightly coupled with the reinforcement learning optimization process and thereby limiting further improvements in multimodal reasoning performance. To address this limitation, we propose KAWHI (Key-Region Aligned Weighted Harmonic Incentive), a plug-and-play reward reweighting mechanism that explicitly incorporates structured visual information into uniform reward policy optimization methods (e.g., GRPO and GSPO). The method adaptively localizes semantically salient regions through hierarchical geometric aggregation, identifies vision-critical attention heads via structured attribution, and performs paragraph-level credit reallocation to align spatial visual evidence with semantically decisive reasoning steps. Extensive empirical evaluations on diverse reasoning benchmarks substantiate KAWHI as a general-purpose enhancement module, consistently improving the performance of various uniform reward optimization methods. Project page: KAWHI (https://kawhiiiileo.github.io/KAWHI_PAGE/)

AI.tldr: KAWHI是一种即插即用的奖励重加权机制，通过将结构化视觉信息融入统一奖励策略优化方法，解决LVLMs在RLVR中的视觉表示瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏对视觉信息的显式建模和有效利用，导致视觉表示无法与强化学习优化过程紧密耦合，限制了多模态推理性能的进一步提升。
AI.method: 通过层次几何聚合自适应定位语义显著区域，通过结构化归因识别视觉关键注意力头，并进行段落级信用重分配，使空间视觉证据与语义决定性推理步骤对齐。
AI.result: 在多样化推理基准上的广泛实证评估表明，KAWHI作为通用增强模块，能持续提升各种统一奖励优化方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: KAWHI有效解决了LVLMs在RLVR中的视觉表示瓶颈，为多模态推理性能提升提供了有效的解决方案。

title: LVRPO: Language-Visual Alignment with GRPO for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: Unified multimodal pretraining has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling language and vision within a single foundation model. However, existing approaches largely rely on implicit or indirect alignment signals and remain suboptimal for simultaneously supporting multimodal understanding and generation, particularly in settings that require fine-grained language-visual reasoning and controllable generation. In this work, we propose LVRPO, a language-visual reinforcement-based preference optimization framework that explicitly aligns language and visual representations using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Instead of introducing additional alignment losses at the representation level, LVRPO directly optimizes multimodal model behaviors through preference-driven reinforcement signals, encouraging consistent and semantically grounded interactions between language and vision across both understanding and generation tasks. This formulation enables effective alignment without requiring auxiliary encoders or handcrafted cross-modal objectives, and naturally extends to diverse multimodal capabilities. Empirically, LVRPO consistently outperforms strong unified-pretraining baselines on a broad suite of benchmarks spanning multimodal understanding, generation, and reasoning.

AI.tldr: LVRPO是一个基于语言-视觉强化偏好优化的框架，通过Group Relative Policy Optimization显式对齐语言和视觉表示，无需额外对齐损失或辅助编码器，在理解和生成任务上均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一多模态预训练方法主要依赖隐式或间接的对齐信号，在同时支持多模态理解和生成方面仍不理想，特别是在需要细粒度语言-视觉推理和可控生成的场景中。
AI.method: 提出LVRPO框架，使用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）显式对齐语言和视觉表示。该方法不引入表示层的额外对齐损失，而是通过偏好驱动的强化信号直接优化多模态模型行为，鼓励语言和视觉在理解和生成任务中保持一致且语义基础的交互。
AI.result: LVRPO在广泛的多模态理解、生成和推理基准测试中，持续优于强大的统一预训练基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LVRPO框架通过强化偏好优化实现了有效的语言-视觉对齐，无需辅助编码器或手工设计的跨模态目标，自然地扩展到多样化的多模态能力，在理解和生成任务上均取得优异表现。

title: Decompose, Mix, Adapt: A Unified Framework for Parameter-Efficient Neural Network Recombination and Compression
summary: Parameter Recombination (PR) methods aim to efficiently compose the weights of a neural network for applications like Parameter-Efficient FineTuning (PEFT) and Model Compression (MC), among others. Most methods typically focus on one application of PR, which can make composing them challenging. For example, when deploying a large model you may wish to compress the model and also quickly adapt to new settings. However, PEFT methods often can still contain millions of parameters. This may be small compared to the original model size, but can be problematic in resource constrained deployments like edge devices, where they take a larger portion of the compressed model's parameters. To address this, we present Coefficient-gated weight Recombination by Interpolated Shared basis Projections (CRISP), a general approach that seamlessly integrates multiple PR tasks within the same framework. CRISP accomplishes this by factorizing pretrained weights into basis matrices and their component mixing projections. Sharing basis matrices across layers and adjusting its size enables us to perform MC, whereas the mixer weight's small size (fewer than 200 in some experiments) enables CRISP to support PEFT. Experiments show CRISP outperforms methods from prior work capable of dual-task applications by 4-5\% while also outperforming the state-of-the-art in PEFT by 1.5\% and PEFT+MC combinations by 1\%. Our code is available on the repository: https://github.com/appledora/CRISP-CVPR26.

AI.tldr: CRISP提出了一种通用的参数重组框架，通过将预训练权重分解为基础矩阵和混合投影，同时支持参数高效微调和模型压缩两种任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数重组方法通常只专注于单一应用（如PEFT或MC），这使得组合应用变得困难。在资源受限的部署场景（如边缘设备）中，即使PEFT方法包含数百万参数，相对于压缩后的模型仍然占比过大，需要同时实现模型压缩和快速适应。
AI.method: CRISP将预训练权重分解为基础矩阵和组件混合投影。通过跨层共享基础矩阵并调整其大小实现模型压缩，而混合器权重的小尺寸（某些实验中少于200个参数）则支持参数高效微调。
AI.result: CRISP在双任务应用上比先前方法提升4-5%，在PEFT上比SOTA提升1.5%，在PEFT+MC组合上提升1%。
AI.conclusion: CRISP提供了一个统一的框架，能够无缝集成多个参数重组任务，在资源受限的部署场景中实现了模型压缩和快速适应的双重目标。

title: Mind the Shape Gap: A Benchmark and Baseline for Deformation-Aware 6D Pose Estimation of Agricultural Produce
summary: Accurate 6D pose estimation for robotic harvesting is fundamentally hindered by the biological deformability and high intra-class shape variability of agricultural produce. Instance-level methods fail in this setting, as obtaining exact 3D models for every unique piece of produce is practically infeasible, while category-level approaches that rely on a fixed template suffer significant accuracy degradation when the prior deviates from the true instance geometry. To bridge such lack of robustness to deformation, we introduce PEAR (Pose and dEformation of Agricultural pRoduce), the first benchmark providing joint 6D pose and per-instance 3D deformation ground truth across 8 produce categories, acquired via a robotic manipulator for high annotation accuracy. Using PEAR, we show that state-of-the-art methods suffer up to 6x performance degradation when faced with the inherent geometric deviations of real-world produce. Motivated by this finding, we propose SEED (Simultaneous Estimation of posE and Deformation), a unified RGB-only framework that jointly predicts 6D pose and explicit lattice deformations from a single image across multiple produce categories. Trained entirely on synthetic data with generative texture augmentation applied at the UV level, SEED outperforms MegaPose on 6 out of 8 categories under identical RGB-only conditions, demonstrating that explicit shape modeling is a critical step toward reliable pose estimation in agricultural robotics.

AI.tldr: PEAR是首个提供农产品6D位姿和3D形变联合标注的基准，SEED是基于RGB图像联合预测6D位姿和显式网格形变的统一框架，在8个农产品类别中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 农业机器人采摘中的6D位姿估计面临农产品生物可变形性和类内形状变异性的根本挑战。实例级方法不切实际（无法为每个农产品获取精确3D模型），而类别级方法在模板与真实实例几何形状偏离时精度显著下降。
AI.method: 提出PEAR基准，通过机器人操作器获取8个农产品类别的6D位姿和每实例3D形变标注；提出SEED框架，基于RGB图像联合预测6D位姿和显式网格形变，完全在合成数据上训练，并在UV级别应用生成纹理增强。
AI.result: 现有方法在面对真实农产品几何偏差时性能下降高达6倍；SEED在相同RGB-only条件下，在8个类别中的6个上优于MegaPose，证明显式形状建模对农业机器人可靠位姿估计至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 显式形状建模是提高农业机器人位姿估计可靠性的关键步骤，PEAR基准和SEED框架为解决农产品可变形性和形状变异性的挑战提供了有效方案。

title: AI-Powered Facial Mask Removal Is Not Suitable For Biometric Identification
summary: Recently, crowd-sourced online criminal investigations have used generative-AI to enhance low-quality visual evidence. In one high-profile case, social-media users circulated an "AI-unmasked" image of a federal agent involved in a fatal shooting, fueling a wide-spread misidentification. In response to this and similar incidents, we conducted a large-scale analysis evaluating the efficacy and risks of commercial AI-powered facial unmasking, specifically assessing whether the resulting faces can be reliably matched to true identities.

AI.tldr: 研究评估商业AI面部去遮挡技术的有效性和风险，发现在高调案件中AI生成的"去遮挡"图像导致大规模错误识别
AI.motivation: 近期众包在线刑事调查使用生成式AI增强低质量视觉证据，导致一起高调案件中社交媒体用户传播联邦探员的"AI去遮挡"图像，引发大规模错误识别。为应对此类事件，需要评估商业AI面部去遮挡技术的有效性和风险。
AI.method: 进行大规模分析，评估商业AI驱动的面部去遮挡技术，具体评估生成的"去遮挡"面部能否可靠匹配真实身份
AI.result: 研究发现AI生成的"去遮挡"面部图像可能导致错误识别，特别是在高调案件中，如联邦探员被错误识别的情况
AI.conclusion: 商业AI面部去遮挡技术存在显著风险，可能引发大规模错误识别，需要对其有效性和可靠性进行审慎评估

title: SpatialStack: Layered Geometry-Language Fusion for 3D VLM Spatial Reasoning
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with reliable 3D spatial reasoning, a core capability for embodied and physical AI systems. This limitation arises from their inability to capture fine-grained 3D geometry and spatial relationships. While recent efforts have introduced multi-view geometry transformers into VLMs, they typically fuse only the deep-layer features from vision and geometry encoders, discarding rich hierarchical signals and creating a fundamental bottleneck for spatial understanding. To overcome this, we propose SpatialStack, a general hierarchical fusion framework that progressively aligns vision, geometry, and language representations across the model hierarchy. Moving beyond conventional late-stage vision-geometry fusion, SpatialStack stacks and synchronizes multi-level geometric features with the language backbone, enabling the model to capture both local geometric precision and global contextual semantics. Building upon this framework, we develop VLM-SpatialStack, a model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple 3D spatial reasoning benchmarks. Extensive experiments and ablations demonstrate that our multi-level fusion strategy consistently enhances 3D understanding and generalizes robustly across diverse spatial reasoning tasks, establishing SpatialStack as an effective and extensible design paradigm for vision-language-geometry integration in next-generation multimodal physical AI systems.

AI.tldr: SpatialStack是一个分层融合框架，通过跨模型层次渐进对齐视觉、几何和语言表示，解决了VLM在3D空间推理中的瓶颈问题，显著提升了3D理解能力。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在3D空间推理方面仍存在困难，这限制了它们在具身和物理AI系统中的核心能力。现有方法通常只在深层融合视觉和几何特征，丢弃了丰富的层次信号，形成了空间理解的根本瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出SpatialStack分层融合框架，超越传统的后期视觉-几何融合，通过堆叠和同步多层次几何特征与语言主干，使模型能够同时捕捉局部几何精度和全局上下文语义。基于此框架开发了VLM-SpatialStack模型。
AI.result: VLM-SpatialStack在多个3D空间推理基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。广泛的实验和消融研究表明，多层次融合策略持续增强3D理解能力，并在多样化的空间推理任务中展现出稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SpatialStack为下一代多模态物理AI系统中的视觉-语言-几何集成建立了一个有效且可扩展的设计范式，解决了VLM在3D空间推理方面的核心限制。

title: Towards Emotion Recognition with 3D Pointclouds Obtained from Facial Expression Images
comment: 18 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for publication at IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing
summary: Facial Emotion Recognition is a critical research area within Affective Computing due to its wide-ranging applications in Human Computer Interaction, mental health assessment and fatigue monitoring. Current FER methods predominantly rely on Deep Learning techniques trained on 2D image data, which pose significant privacy concerns and are unsuitable for continuous, real-time monitoring. As an alternative, we propose High-Frequency Wireless Sensing (HFWS) as an enabler of continuous, privacy-aware FER, through the generation of detailed 3D facial pointclouds via on-person sensors embedded in wearables. We present arguments supporting the privacy advantages of HFWS over traditional 2D imaging, particularly under increasingly stringent data protection regulations. A major barrier to adopting HFWS for FER is the scarcity of labeled 3D FER datasets. Towards addressing this issue, we introduce a FLAME-based method to generate 3D facial pointclouds from existing public 2D datasets. Using this approach, we create AffectNet3D, a 3D version of the AffectNet database. To evaluate the quality and usability of the generated data, we design a pointcloud refinement pipeline focused on isolating the facial region, and train the popular PointNet++ model on the refined pointclouds. Fine-tuning the model on a small subset of the unseen 3D FER dataset BU-3DFE yields a classification accuracy exceeding 70%, comparable to oracle-level performance. To further investigate the potential of HFWS-based FER for continuous monitoring, we simulate wearable sensing conditions by masking portions of the generated pointclouds. Experimental results show that models trained on AffectNet3D and fine-tuned with just 25% of BU-3DFE outperform those trained solely on BU-3DFE. These findings highlight the viability of our pipeline and support the feasibility of continuous, privacy-aware FER via wearable HFWS systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于高频无线传感的隐私保护3D面部情绪识别方法，通过生成3D点云数据集AffectNet3D，在有限真实数据下实现70%以上分类准确率
AI.motivation: 传统基于2D图像的FER方法存在隐私问题且不适合连续实时监测，需要开发隐私保护、适合连续监测的替代方案
AI.method: 使用高频无线传感生成3D面部点云，提出基于FLAME的方法从现有2D数据集生成3D点云数据集AffectNet3D，设计点云精炼流程，使用PointNet++模型训练
AI.result: 在BU-3DFE数据集上微调后分类准确率超过70%，与oracle性能相当；使用仅25%的BU-3DFE数据微调的模型优于完全在BU-3DFE上训练的模型
AI.conclusion: 验证了基于可穿戴高频无线传感系统实现连续、隐私保护的面部情绪识别的可行性，为隐私敏感的FER应用提供了新途径

title: LOME: Learning Human-Object Manipulation with Action-Conditioned Egocentric World Model
summary: Learning human-object manipulation presents significant challenges due to its fine-grained and contact-rich nature of the motions involved. Traditional physics-based animation requires extensive modeling and manual setup, and more importantly, it neither generalizes well across diverse object morphologies nor scales effectively to real-world environment. To address these limitations, we introduce LOME, an egocentric world model that can generate realistic human-object interactions as videos conditioned on an input image, a text prompt, and per-frame human actions, including both body poses and hand gestures. LOME injects strong and precise action guidance into object manipulation by jointly estimating spatial human actions and the environment contexts during training. After finetuning a pretrained video generative model on videos of diverse egocentric human-object interactions, LOME demonstrates not only high action-following accuracy and strong generalization to unseen scenarios, but also realistic physical consequences of hand-object interactions, e.g., liquid flowing from a bottle into a mug after executing a ``pouring'' action. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our video-based framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image based and video-based action-conditioned methods and Image/Text-to-Video (I/T2V) generative model in terms of both temporal consistency and motion control. LOME paves the way for photorealistic AR/VR experiences and scalable robotic training, without being limited to simulated environments or relying on explicit 3D/4D modeling.

AI.tldr: LOME是一个以自我为中心的世界模型，能够根据输入图像、文本提示和每帧人体动作生成逼真的人-物交互视频，解决了传统物理动画在泛化性和扩展性方面的限制。
AI.motivation: 传统基于物理的动画需要大量建模和手动设置，且无法很好地泛化到不同的物体形态，也难以扩展到真实世界环境。人-物交互具有细粒度和接触密集的特性，现有方法难以处理。
AI.method: LOME通过联合估计空间人体动作和环境上下文，将精确的动作指导注入到物体操作中。在多样化的自我中心人-物交互视频上微调预训练的视频生成模型。
AI.result: LOME展现出高动作跟随精度和对未见场景的强泛化能力，能够生成逼真的手-物交互物理效果（如液体从瓶子倒入杯子）。在时间一致性和运动控制方面显著优于现有图像和视频方法。
AI.conclusion: LOME为逼真的AR/VR体验和可扩展的机器人训练开辟了新途径，无需局限于模拟环境或依赖显式的3D/4D建模。

title: JaWildText: A Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Japanese Scene Text Understanding
summary: Japanese scene text poses challenges that multilingual benchmarks often fail to capture, including mixed scripts, frequent vertical writing, and a character inventory far larger than the Latin alphabet. Although Japanese is included in several multilingual benchmarks, these resources do not adequately capture the language-specific complexities. Meanwhile, existing Japanese visual text datasets have primarily focused on scanned documents, leaving in-the-wild scene text underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce JaWildText, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) on Japanese scene text understanding. JaWildText contains 3,241 instances from 2,961 images newly captured in Japan, with 1.12 million annotated characters spanning 3,643 unique character types. It comprises three complementary tasks that vary in visual organization, output format, and writing style: (i) Dense Scene Text Visual Question Answering (STVQA), which requires reasoning over multiple pieces of visual text evidence; (ii) Receipt Key Information Extraction (KIE), which tests layout-aware structured extraction from mobile-captured receipts; and (iii) Handwriting OCR, which evaluates page-level transcription across various media and writing directions. We evaluate 14 open-weight VLMs and find that the best model achieves an average score of 0.64 across the three tasks. Error analyses show recognition remains the dominant bottleneck, especially for kanji. JaWildText enables fine-grained, script-aware diagnosis of Japanese scene text capabilities, and will be released with evaluation code.

AI.tldr: JaWildText是一个专门针对日语场景文本理解的诊断基准，包含3,241个实例、2,961张日本实地拍摄的图像，涵盖三个互补任务：密集场景文本视觉问答、收据关键信息提取和手写OCR。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言基准无法充分捕捉日语场景文本的特定复杂性（混合文字、垂直书写、庞大字符集），而现有日语视觉文本数据集主要关注扫描文档，缺乏对真实场景文本的探索。
AI.method: 构建包含3,241个实例、2,961张日本实地拍摄图像的数据集，标注112万个字符、3,643个独特字符类型，设计三个互补任务：密集场景文本视觉问答、收据关键信息提取和手写OCR。
AI.result: 评估14个开源视觉语言模型，最佳模型在三个任务上的平均得分仅为0.64。错误分析显示识别仍然是主要瓶颈，特别是对于汉字（kanji）的识别。
AI.conclusion: JaWildText填补了日语场景文本理解评估的空白，能够进行细粒度、文字感知的诊断，将公开发布评估代码，有助于推动日语场景文本理解技术的发展。

title: From None to All: Self-Supervised 3D Reconstruction via Novel View Synthesis
summary: In this paper, we introduce NAS3R, a self-supervised feed-forward framework that jointly learns explicit 3D geometry and camera parameters with no ground-truth annotations and no pretrained priors. During training, NAS3R reconstructs 3D Gaussians from uncalibrated and unposed context views and renders target views using its self-predicted camera parameters, enabling self-supervised training from 2D photometric supervision. To ensure stable convergence, NAS3R integrates reconstruction and camera prediction within a shared transformer backbone regulated by masked attention, and adopts a depth-based Gaussian formulation that facilitates well-conditioned optimization. The framework is compatible with state-of-the-art supervised 3D reconstruction architectures and can incorporate pretrained priors or intrinsic information when available. Extensive experiments show that NAS3R achieves superior results to other self-supervised methods, establishing a scalable and geometry-aware paradigm for 3D reconstruction from unconstrained data. Code and models are publicly available at https://ranrhuang.github.io/nas3r/.

AI.tldr: NAS3R是一个自监督的前馈框架，无需地面真值标注或预训练先验，联合学习显式3D几何和相机参数，通过2D光度监督从无标定、无姿态的上下文视图重建3D高斯并渲染目标视图。
AI.motivation: 解决从无约束数据（无标定、无姿态的视图）进行3D重建的问题，避免对地面真值标注或预训练先验的依赖，实现完全自监督的几何感知3D重建。
AI.method: 采用共享的Transformer主干网络，通过掩码注意力机制联合调节重建和相机预测；使用基于深度的3D高斯表示以促进良好条件的优化；从无标定上下文视图重建3D高斯，并使用自预测的相机参数渲染目标视图。
AI.result: NAS3R在自监督方法中取得了优越的结果，能够与最先进的监督3D重建架构兼容，并在有可用信息时可以整合预训练先验或内在信息。
AI.conclusion: NAS3R建立了一个可扩展且几何感知的范式，用于从无约束数据进行3D重建，展示了自监督学习在3D几何理解方面的潜力。

title: Beyond Dataset Distillation: Lossless Dataset Concentration via Diffusion-Assisted Distribution Alignment
summary: The high cost and accessibility problem associated with large datasets hinder the development of large-scale visual recognition systems. Dataset Distillation addresses these problems by synthesizing compact surrogate datasets for efficient training, storage, transfer, and privacy preservation. The existing state-of-the-art diffusion-based dataset distillation methods face three issues: lack of theoretical justification, poor efficiency in scaling to high data volumes, and failure in data-free scenarios. To address these issues, we establish a theoretical framework that justifies the use of diffusion models by proving the equivalence between dataset distillation and distribution matching, and reveals an inherent efficiency limit in the dataset distillation paradigm. We then propose a Dataset Concentration (DsCo) framework that uses a diffusion-based Noise-Optimization (NOpt) method to synthesize a small yet representative set of samples, and optionally augments the synthetic data via "Doping", which mixes selected samples from the original dataset with the synthetic samples to overcome the efficiency limit of dataset distillation. DsCo is applicable in both data-accessible and data-free scenarios, achieving SOTA performances for low data volumes, and it extends well to high data volumes, where it nearly reduces the dataset size by half with no performance degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DsCo框架，通过扩散模型的噪声优化方法合成小型代表性数据集，并可选地通过"Doping"混合原始数据样本来克服数据集蒸馏的效率限制，在数据可访问和无数据场景下均能实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模视觉识别系统的发展受到大型数据集高成本和可访问性问题的阻碍。现有基于扩散的数据集蒸馏方法存在三个问题：缺乏理论依据、扩展到高数据量时效率低下、在无数据场景下失败。
AI.method: 建立理论框架证明数据集蒸馏与分布匹配的等价性，揭示数据集蒸馏范式的内在效率限制。提出DsCo框架，使用基于扩散的噪声优化方法合成小型代表性样本集，并可选地通过"Doping"将原始数据集中的选定样本与合成样本混合。
AI.result: DsCo在低数据量下实现SOTA性能，并很好地扩展到高数据量，几乎将数据集大小减半且无性能下降。适用于数据可访问和无数据两种场景。
AI.conclusion: DsCo框架通过理论证明和实际方法解决了现有扩散基数据集蒸馏方法的问题，提供了一种高效的数据集压缩方案，为大规模视觉识别系统的开发提供了实用解决方案。

title: MolmoPoint: Better Pointing for VLMs with Grounding Tokens
summary: Grounding has become a fundamental capability of vision-language models (VLMs). Most existing VLMs point by generating coordinates as part of their text output, which requires learning a complicated coordinate system and results in a high token count. Instead, we propose a more intuitive pointing mechanism that directly selects the visual tokens that contain the target concept. Our model generates a special pointing token that cross-attends to the input image or video tokens and selects the appropriate one. To make this model more fine-grained, we follow these pointing tokens with an additional special token that selects a fine-grained subpatch within the initially selected region, and then a third token that specifies a location within that subpatch. We further show that performance improves by generating points sequentially in a consistent order, encoding the relative position of the previously selected point, and including a special no-more-points class when selecting visual tokens. Using this method, we set a new state-of-the-art on image pointing (70.7% on PointBench), set a new state-of-the-art among fully open models on GUI pointing (61.1% on ScreenSpotPro), and improve video pointing (59.1% human preference win rate vs. a text coordinate baseline) and tracking (+6.3% gain on Molmo2Track). We additionally show that our method achieves much higher sample efficiency and discuss the qualitative differences that emerge from this design change.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的视觉语言模型指向机制，通过直接选择包含目标概念的视觉标记而非生成坐标，实现了更直观的指向方式，在图像、GUI和视频指向任务上取得了新的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型通常通过生成坐标来实现指向功能，这种方法需要学习复杂的坐标系系统且产生大量标记。作者希望开发更直观的指向机制，通过直接选择视觉标记来简化模型学习过程。
AI.method: 提出了一种三层级的指向机制：1) 生成特殊指向标记，通过交叉注意力选择包含目标概念的视觉标记；2) 使用额外标记在选定区域内选择细粒度子块；3) 第三个标记指定子块内的具体位置。采用顺序生成、编码先前点相对位置、包含"无更多点"类别等策略提升性能。
AI.result: 在图像指向任务上达到70.7%的PointBench得分（新SOTA）；在GUI指向任务上达到61.1%的ScreenSpotPro得分（完全开源模型中的新SOTA）；视频指向任务获得59.1%的人类偏好胜率；跟踪任务获得+6.3%的Molmo2Track增益。同时实现了更高的样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 提出的直接选择视觉标记的指向机制比传统的坐标生成方法更直观有效，在多个视觉指向任务上取得了显著性能提升，同时具有更好的样本效率，代表了视觉语言模型指向能力的重要进展。

title: Estimating the Impact of COVID-19 on Travel Demand in Houston Area Using Deep Learning and Satellite Imagery
summary: Considering recent advances in remote sensing satellite systems and computer vision algorithms, many satellite sensing platforms and sensors have been used to monitor the condition and usage of transportation infrastructure systems. The level of details that can be detected increases significantly with the increase of ground sample distance (GSD), which is around 15 cm - 30 cm for high-resolution satellite images. In this study, we analyzed data acquired from high-resolution satellite imagery to provide insights, predictive signals, and trend for travel demand estimation. More specifically, we estimate the impact of COVID-19 in the metropolitan area of Houston using satellite imagery from Google Earth Engine datasets. We developed a car-counting model through Detectron2 and Faster R-CNN to monitor the presence of cars within different locations (i.e., university, shopping mall, community plaza, restaurant, supermarket) before and during the COVID-19. The results show that the number of cars detected at these selected locations reduced on average 30% in 2020 compared with the previous year 2019. The results also show that satellite imagery provides rich information for travel demand and economic activity estimation. Together with advanced computer vision and deep learning algorithms, it can generate reliable and accurate information for transportation agency decision makers.

AI.tldr: 利用高分辨率卫星影像和深度学习模型（Detectron2/Faster R-CNN）监测休斯顿都市区COVID-19前后车辆数量变化，发现2020年相比2019年车辆平均减少30%，证明卫星影像可用于旅行需求和经济活动估计。
AI.motivation: 随着遥感卫星系统和计算机视觉算法的发展，高分辨率卫星影像（GSD约15-30厘米）能够提供更详细的交通基础设施监测。研究旨在利用卫星影像分析COVID-19对休斯顿都市区旅行需求的影响，为交通机构决策提供可靠信息。
AI.method: 使用Google Earth Engine数据集的高分辨率卫星影像，开发基于Detectron2和Faster R-CNN的车辆计数模型，监测COVID-19前后不同地点（大学、购物中心、社区广场、餐厅、超市）的车辆存在情况。
AI.result: 结果显示，2020年相比2019年，选定地点的检测车辆数量平均减少30%。卫星影像为旅行需求和经济活动估计提供了丰富信息，结合先进计算机视觉和深度学习算法能够生成可靠准确的决策支持数据。
AI.conclusion: 卫星影像结合深度学习算法能够有效监测交通活动变化，特别是在COVID-19等重大事件期间。这种方法为交通机构决策者提供了可靠的工具，可用于旅行需求估计和经济活动分析。

title: MDPBench: A Benchmark for Multilingual Document Parsing in Real-World Scenarios
summary: We introduce Multilingual Document Parsing Benchmark, the first benchmark for multilingual digital and photographed document parsing. Document parsing has made remarkable strides, yet almost exclusively on clean, digital, well-formatted pages in a handful of dominant languages. No systematic benchmark exists to evaluate how models perform on digital and photographed documents across diverse scripts and low-resource languages. MDPBench comprises 3,400 document images spanning 17 languages, diverse scripts, and varied photographic conditions, with high-quality annotations produced through a rigorous pipeline of expert model labeling, manual correction, and human verification. To ensure fair comparison and prevent data leakage, we maintain separate public and private evaluation splits. Our comprehensive evaluation of both open-source and closed-source models uncovers a striking finding: while closed-source models (notably Gemini3-Pro) prove relatively robust, open-source alternatives suffer dramatic performance collapse, particularly on non-Latin scripts and real-world photographed documents, with an average drop of 17.8% on photographed documents and 14.0% on non-Latin scripts. These results reveal significant performance imbalances across languages and conditions, and point to concrete directions for building more inclusive, deployment-ready parsing systems. Source available at https://github.com/Yuliang-Liu/MultimodalOCR.

AI.tldr: MDPBench是首个多语言文档解析基准测试，涵盖17种语言、多种文字和不同拍摄条件，评估显示闭源模型相对稳健，而开源模型在非拉丁文字和实拍文档上性能大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 当前文档解析研究主要集中在少数主流语言的干净、数字化、格式良好的文档上，缺乏系统性的基准测试来评估模型在不同文字和低资源语言上的表现，特别是在数字化和实拍文档条件下的性能。
AI.method: 构建包含3,400个文档图像的数据集，涵盖17种语言、多种文字和不同拍摄条件，通过专家模型标注、人工修正和人工验证的严格流程生成高质量标注，并设置公开和私有评估分割以防止数据泄露。
AI.result: 闭源模型（特别是Gemini3-Pro）表现相对稳健，而开源模型在非拉丁文字和实拍文档上性能大幅下降，平均在实拍文档上下降17.8%，在非拉丁文字上下降14.0%，显示出跨语言和跨条件的显著性能不平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了当前文档解析系统在多语言和多样化条件下的性能不平衡问题，为构建更具包容性和部署就绪的解析系统指明了具体方向。

title: Fully Spiking Neural Networks with Target Awareness for Energy-Efficient UAV Tracking
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), characterized by their event-driven computation and low power consumption, have shown great potential for energy-efficient visual tracking on unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). However, existing efficient SNN-based trackers heavily rely on costly event cameras, limiting their deployment on UAVs. To address this limitation, we propose STATrack, an efficient fully spiking neural network framework for UAV visual tracking using RGB inputs only. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to investigate spiking neural networks for UAV visual tracking tasks. To mitigate the weakening of target features by background tokens, we propose adaptively maximizing the mutual information between templates and features. Extensive experiments on four widely used UAV tracking benchmarks demonstrate that STATrack achieves competitive tracking performance while maintaining low energy consumption.

AI.tldr: STATrack是首个用于无人机视觉跟踪的全脉冲神经网络框架，仅使用RGB输入，无需昂贵的事件相机，在保持低能耗的同时实现竞争性跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有高效的SNN跟踪器严重依赖昂贵的事件相机，限制了在无人机上的部署。为了解决这一限制，需要开发仅使用RGB输入的高效全脉冲神经网络框架。
AI.method: 提出STATrack框架，采用自适应最大化模板与特征之间互信息的方法，缓解背景标记对目标特征的弱化问题。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的无人机跟踪基准测试中，STATrack实现了竞争性的跟踪性能，同时保持了低能耗。
AI.conclusion: STATrack是首个用于无人机视觉跟踪的脉冲神经网络研究，证明了仅使用RGB输入即可实现高效跟踪，为无人机上的低功耗视觉跟踪提供了新方案。

title: Streamlined Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection aims to localize and recognize all human-object interactions in an image, including those unseen during training. Existing approaches usually rely on the collaboration between a conventional HOI detector and a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to recognize unseen HOI categories. However, feature fusion in this paradigm is challenging due to significant gaps in cross-model representations. To address this issue, we introduce SL-HOI, a StreamLined open-vocabulary HOI detection framework based solely on the powerful DINOv3 model. Our design leverages the complementary strengths of DINOv3's components: its backbone for fine-grained localization and its text-aligned vision head for open-vocabulary interaction classification. Moreover, to facilitate smooth cross-attention between the interaction queries and the vision head's output, we propose first feeding both the interaction queries and the backbone image tokens into the vision head, effectively bridging their representation gaps. All DINOv3 parameters in our approach are frozen, with only a small number of learnable parameters added, allowing a fast adaptation to the HOI detection task. Extensive experiments show that SL-HOI achieves state-of-the-art performance on both the SWiG-HOI and HICO-DET benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our streamlined model architecture. Code is available at https://github.com/MPI-Lab/SL-HOI.

AI.tldr: SL-HOI是一个基于DINOv3的开放词汇人机交互检测框架，通过利用DINOv3的互补组件实现细粒度定位和开放词汇交互分类，无需额外视觉语言模型，在多个基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇HOI检测方法通常依赖传统HOI检测器和视觉语言模型的协作，但由于跨模型表示存在显著差距，特征融合具有挑战性。需要一种更流畅的融合方法来提升检测性能。
AI.method: 提出SL-HOI框架，仅基于DINOv3模型，利用其骨干网络进行细粒度定位，文本对齐视觉头进行开放词汇交互分类。通过将交互查询和骨干图像标记同时输入视觉头，实现平滑的跨注意力机制，有效桥接表示差距。所有DINOv3参数冻结，仅添加少量可学习参数。
AI.result: 在SWiG-HOI和HICO-DET基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，证明了该流线型模型架构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SL-HOI通过充分利用DINOv3的互补组件，避免了传统方法中跨模型特征融合的挑战，为开放词汇HOI检测提供了一种高效且性能优越的解决方案。

title: DiffAttn: Diffusion-Based Drivers' Visual Attention Prediction with LLM-Enhanced Semantic Reasoning
summary: Drivers' visual attention provides critical cues for anticipating latent hazards and directly shapes decision-making and control maneuvers, where its absence can compromise traffic safety. To emulate drivers' perception patterns and advance visual attention prediction for intelligent vehicles, we propose DiffAttn, a diffusion-based framework that formulates this task as a conditional diffusion-denoising process, enabling more accurate modeling of drivers' attention. To capture both local and global scene features, we adopt Swin Transformer as encoder and design a decoder that combines a Feature Fusion Pyramid for cross-layer interaction with dense, multi-scale conditional diffusion to jointly enhance denoising learning and model fine-grained local and global scene contexts. Additionally, a large language model (LLM) layer is incorporated to enhance top-down semantic reasoning and improve sensitivity to safety-critical cues. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that DiffAttn achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance, surpassing most video-based, top-down-feature-driven, and LLM-enhanced baselines. Our framework further supports interpretable driver-centric scene understanding and has the potential to improve in-cabin human-machine interaction, risk perception, and drivers' state measurement in intelligent vehicles.

AI.tldr: DiffAttn：基于扩散模型的驾驶员视觉注意力预测框架，通过条件扩散去噪过程建模驾驶员注意力，结合Swin Transformer编码器、特征融合金字塔和LLM层，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 驾驶员视觉注意力对预测潜在危险至关重要，直接影响决策和控制操作，注意力缺失会危及交通安全。现有方法在建模驾驶员注意力方面存在局限，需要更准确的预测框架来模拟驾驶员感知模式。
AI.method: 提出DiffAttn框架，将驾驶员注意力预测任务建模为条件扩散去噪过程。采用Swin Transformer作为编码器捕获局部和全局场景特征，设计包含特征融合金字塔的解码器进行跨层交互，结合密集多尺度条件扩散联合增强去噪学习。引入LLM层增强自上而下的语义推理，提高对安全关键线索的敏感性。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集上的实验表明，DiffAttn实现了最先进的性能，超越了大多数基于视频的、自上而下特征驱动的和LLM增强的基线方法。框架支持可解释的以驾驶员为中心的场景理解。
AI.conclusion: DiffAttn框架能够更准确地建模驾驶员视觉注意力，具有改善智能车辆中人机交互、风险感知和驾驶员状态测量的潜力，为智能车辆感知系统提供了有效解决方案。

title: Chat-Scene++: Exploiting Context-Rich Object Identification for 3D LLM
summary: Recent advancements in multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for 3D scene understanding. However, existing methods struggle with fine-grained object grounding and contextual reasoning, limiting their ability to interpret and interact with complex 3D environments. In this paper, we present Chat-Scene++, an MLLM framework that represents 3D scenes as context-rich object sequences. By structuring scenes as sequences of objects with contextual semantics, Chat-Scene++ enables object-centric representation and interaction. It decomposes a 3D scene into object representations paired with identifier tokens, allowing LLMs to follow instructions across diverse 3D vision-language tasks. To capture inter-object relationships and global semantics, Chat-Scene++ extracts context-rich object features using large-scale pre-trained 3D scene-level and 2D image-level encoders, unlike the isolated per-object features in Chat-Scene. Its flexible object-centric design also supports grounded chain-of-thought (G-CoT) reasoning, enabling the model to distinguish objects at both category and spatial levels during multi-step inference. Without the need for additional task-specific heads or fine-tuning, Chat-Scene++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on five major 3D vision-language benchmarks: ScanRefer, Multi3DRefer, Scan2Cap, ScanQA, and SQA3D. These results highlight its effectiveness in scene comprehension, object grounding, and spatial reasoning. Additionally, without reconstructing 3D worlds through computationally expensive processes, we demonstrate its applicability to real-world scenarios using only 2D inputs.

AI.tldr: Chat-Scene++是一个多模态大语言模型框架，通过将3D场景表示为上下文丰富的对象序列，实现了细粒度对象定位和上下文推理，在多个3D视觉语言基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在3D场景理解方面存在局限性，特别是在细粒度对象定位和上下文推理方面表现不足，难以解释和交互复杂的3D环境。
AI.method: 将3D场景表示为上下文丰富的对象序列，使用大规模预训练的3D场景级和2D图像级编码器提取对象特征，支持基于对象的表示和交互，并实现接地思维链推理。
AI.result: 在ScanRefer、Multi3DRefer、Scan2Cap、ScanQA和SQA3D五个主要3D视觉语言基准测试中达到最先进性能，无需特定任务头部或微调。
AI.conclusion: Chat-Scene++通过对象中心的场景表示方法，有效提升了3D场景理解、对象定位和空间推理能力，并展示了仅使用2D输入在真实场景中的适用性。

title: SGS-Intrinsic: Semantic-Invariant Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Indoor Inverse Rendering
summary: We present SGS-Intrinsic, an indoor inverse rendering framework that works well for sparse-view images. Unlike existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) based methods that focus on object-centric reconstruction and fail to work under sparse view settings, our method allows to achieve high-quality geometry reconstruction and accurate disentanglement of material and illumination. The core idea is to construct a dense and geometry-consistent Gaussian semantic field guided by semantic and geometric priors, providing a reliable foundation for subsequent inverse rendering. Building upon this, we perform material-illumination disentanglement by combining a hybrid illumination model and material prior to effectively capture illumination-material interactions. To mitigate the impact of cast shadows and enhance the robustness of material recovery, we introduce illumination-invariant material constraint together with a deshadowing model. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that our method consistently improves both reconstruction fidelity and inverse rendering quality over existing 3DGS-based inverse rendering approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/GrumpySloths/SGS_Intrinsic.github.io.

AI.tldr: SGS-Intrinsic是一个基于3D高斯泼溅的室内逆向渲染框架，能够在稀疏视角图像下实现高质量的几何重建和准确的材质-光照解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于3D高斯泼溅的逆向渲染方法主要针对物体中心重建，在稀疏视角设置下效果不佳。需要一种能够在稀疏视角下同时实现高质量几何重建和准确材质-光照解耦的方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建由语义和几何先验引导的密集且几何一致的高斯语义场；2) 结合混合光照模型和材质先验进行材质-光照解耦；3) 引入光照不变材质约束和去阴影模型来减轻投射阴影影响。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在重建保真度和逆向渲染质量方面均优于现有的基于3DGS的逆向渲染方法。
AI.conclusion: SGS-Intrinsic框架成功解决了稀疏视角下的室内逆向渲染问题，通过语义-几何引导的高斯场和有效的材质-光照解耦机制，实现了高质量的几何重建和准确的材质恢复。

title: SPROUT: A Scalable Diffusion Foundation Model for Agricultural Vision
summary: Vision Foundation Models (VFM) pre-trained on large-scale unlabeled data have achieved remarkable success on general computer vision tasks, yet typically suffer from significant domain gaps when applied to agriculture. In this context, we introduce $SPROUT$ ($S$calable $P$lant $R$epresentation model via $O$pen-field $U$nsupervised $T$raining), a multi-crop, multi-task agricultural foundation model trained via diffusion denoising. SPROUT leverages a VAE-free Pixel-space Diffusion Transformer to learn rich, structure-aware representations through denoising and enabling efficient end-to-end training. We pre-train SPROUT on a curated dataset of 2.6 million high-quality agricultural images spanning diverse crops, growth stages, and environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPROUT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art web-pretrained and agricultural foundation models across a wide range of downstream tasks, while requiring substantially lower pre-training cost. The code and model are available at https://github.com/UTokyo-FieldPhenomics-Lab/SPROUT.

AI.tldr: SPROUT是一个通过扩散去噪训练的多作物、多任务农业基础模型，在260万张高质量农业图像上预训练，在多种下游任务中优于现有模型，且预训练成本更低。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型在大规模无标签数据上预训练取得了显著成功，但在农业领域应用时存在显著的领域差距。为了解决这一问题，需要专门针对农业领域的基础模型。
AI.method: 使用无VAE的像素空间扩散变换器，通过扩散去噪学习丰富、结构感知的表示，支持高效端到端训练。在包含多样作物、生长阶段和环境的260万张高质量农业图像数据集上进行预训练。
AI.result: SPROUT在广泛的下游任务中一致优于最先进的网络预训练和农业基础模型，同时需要显著更低的预训练成本。
AI.conclusion: SPROUT是一个有效的农业基础模型，通过扩散去噪训练在农业领域取得了优异性能，为农业视觉任务提供了强大的基础表示。

title: EdgeDiT: Hardware-Aware Diffusion Transformers for Efficient On-Device Image Generation
comment: Accepted at the Mobile AI Workshop, CVPR 2026
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) have established a new state-of-the-art in high-fidelity image synthesis; however, their massive computational complexity and memory requirements hinder local deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. In this paper, we introduce EdgeDiT, a family of hardware-efficient generative transformers specifically engineered for mobile Neural Processing Units (NPUs), such as the Qualcomm Hexagon and Apple Neural Engine (ANE). By leveraging a hardware-aware optimization framework, we systematically identify and prune structural redundancies within the DiT backbone that are particularly taxing for mobile data-flows. Our approach yields a series of lightweight models that achieve a 20-30% reduction in parameters, a 36-46% decrease in FLOPs, and a 1.65-fold reduction in on-device latency without sacrificing the scaling advantages or the expressive capacity of the original transformer architecture. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that EdgeDiT offers a superior Pareto-optimal trade-off between Frechet Inception Distance (FID) and inference latency compared to both optimized mobile U-Nets and vanilla DiT variants. By enabling responsive, private, and offline generative AI directly on-device, EdgeDiT provides a scalable blueprint for transitioning large-scale foundation models from high-end GPUs to the palm of the user.

AI.tldr: EdgeDiT：针对移动NPU优化的轻量级扩散变换器，在保持生成质量的同时显著降低计算复杂度和延迟
AI.motivation: 扩散变换器（DiT）在高质量图像合成方面表现出色，但其巨大的计算复杂度和内存需求阻碍了在资源受限的边缘设备上的本地部署
AI.method: 通过硬件感知优化框架，系统性地识别并剪裁DiT主干中对移动数据流特别消耗的结构冗余，设计了一系列轻量级模型
AI.result: EdgeDiT实现了20-30%的参数减少、36-46%的FLOPs降低以及1.65倍的设备端延迟减少，同时保持了原始变换器架构的扩展优势和表达能力
AI.conclusion: EdgeDiT在FID和推理延迟之间提供了优越的帕累托最优权衡，为实现响应式、私密且离线的设备端生成AI提供了可扩展的蓝图

title: TokenDial: Continuous Attribute Control in Text-to-Video via Spatiotemporal Token Offsets
summary: We present TokenDial, a framework for continuous, slider-style attribute control in pretrained text-to-video generation models. While modern generators produce strong holistic videos, they offer limited control over how much an attribute changes (e.g., effect intensity or motion magnitude) without drifting identity, background, or temporal coherence. TokenDial is built on the observation: additive offsets in the intermediate spatiotemporal visual patch-token space form a semantic control direction, where adjusting the offset magnitude yields coherent, predictable edits for both appearance and motion dynamics. We learn attribute-specific token offsets without retraining the backbone, using pretrained understanding signals: semantic direction matching for appearance and motion-magnitude scaling for motion. We demonstrate TokenDial's effectiveness on diverse attributes and prompts, achieving stronger controllability and higher-quality edits than state-of-the-art baselines, supported by extensive quantitative evaluation and human studies.

AI.tldr: TokenDial是一个在预训练文本到视频生成模型中实现连续滑块式属性控制的框架，通过调整视觉补丁标记空间的偏移量来控制属性变化强度，同时保持身份、背景和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现代文本到视频生成器虽然能产生整体质量不错的视频，但在控制属性变化强度（如效果强度或运动幅度）方面存在局限，容易导致身份漂移、背景变化或时间不连贯的问题。
AI.method: 基于中间时空视觉补丁标记空间中加性偏移形成语义控制方向的观察，TokenDial在不重新训练主干网络的情况下学习特定属性的标记偏移，使用预训练的理解信号：外观的语义方向匹配和运动的幅度缩放。
AI.result: TokenDial在多种属性和提示上表现出色，相比最先进的基线方法，实现了更强的可控性和更高质量的编辑效果，得到了广泛的定量评估和人类研究的支持。
AI.conclusion: TokenDial框架通过调整视觉补丁标记空间的偏移量，为预训练文本到视频生成模型提供了连续、滑块式的属性控制能力，在保持视频一致性的同时实现了精细的属性调整。

title: GeoHCC: Local Geometry-Aware Hierarchical Context Compression for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity real-time rendering, its prohibitive storage overhead severely hinders practical deployment. Recent anchor-based 3DGS compression schemes reduce redundancy through context modeling, yet overlook explicit geometric dependencies, leading to structural degradation and suboptimal rate-distortion performance. In this paper, we propose GeoHCC, a geometry-aware 3DGS compression framework that incorporates inter-anchor geometric correlations into anchor pruning and entropy coding for compact representation. We first introduce Neighborhood-Aware Anchor Pruning (NAAP), which evaluates anchor importance via weighted neighborhood feature aggregation and merges redundant anchors into salient neighbors, yielding a compact yet geometry-consistent anchor set. Building upon this optimized structure, we further develop a hierarchical entropy coding scheme, in which coarse-to-fine priors are exploited through a lightweight Geometry-Guided Convolution (GG-Conv) operator to enable spatially adaptive context modeling and rate-distortion optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GeoHCC effectively resolves the structure preservation bottleneck, maintaining superior geometric integrity and rendering fidelity over state-of-the-art anchor-based approaches.

AI.tldr: GeoHCC是一个几何感知的3D高斯泼溅压缩框架，通过引入锚点间几何相关性来提升压缩效果，解决现有方法忽略几何依赖导致结构退化的问题。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅技术虽然能实现高保真实时渲染，但其巨大的存储开销严重阻碍了实际部署。现有的基于锚点的压缩方案通过上下文建模减少冗余，但忽略了显式的几何依赖关系，导致结构退化和次优的率失真性能。
AI.method: 提出GeoHCC框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 邻域感知锚点剪枝(NAAP)，通过加权邻域特征聚合评估锚点重要性，将冗余锚点合并到显著邻居中；2) 分层熵编码方案，利用轻量级几何引导卷积(GG-Conv)算子实现从粗到细的先验利用，支持空间自适应上下文建模和率失真优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GeoHCC有效解决了结构保持瓶颈，在几何完整性和渲染保真度方面优于最先进的基于锚点的方法。
AI.conclusion: GeoHCC通过将锚点间几何相关性纳入锚点剪枝和熵编码，实现了紧凑且几何一致的3D高斯泼溅表示，显著提升了压缩性能。

title: OmniColor: A Unified Framework for Multi-modal Lineart Colorization
summary: Lineart colorization is a critical stage in professional content creation, yet achieving precise and flexible results under diverse user constraints remains a significant challenge. To address this, we propose OmniColor, a unified framework for multi-modal lineart colorization that supports arbitrary combinations of control signals. Specifically, we systematically categorize guidance signals into two types: spatially-aligned conditions and semantic-reference conditions. For spatially-aligned inputs, we employ a dual-path encoding strategy paired with a Dense Feature Alignment loss to ensure rigorous boundary preservation and precise color restoration. For semantic-reference inputs, we utilize a VLM-only encoding scheme integrated with a Temporal Redundancy Elimination mechanism to filter repetitive information and enhance inference efficiency. To resolve potential input conflicts, we introduce an Adaptive Spatial-Semantic Gating module that dynamically balances multi-modal constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that OmniColor achieves superior controllability, visual quality, and temporal stability, providing a robust and practical solution for lineart colorization. The source code and dataset will be open at https://github.com/zhangxulu1996/OmniColor.

AI.tldr: OmniColor是一个统一的多模态线稿着色框架，支持任意控制信号组合，通过双路径编码、VLM编码和自适应门控模块实现精确可控的着色效果。
AI.motivation: 专业内容创作中线稿着色是关键阶段，但在多样化用户约束下实现精确灵活的结果仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法难以同时处理多种控制信号并保持高质量输出。
AI.method: 1. 将引导信号系统分类为空间对齐条件和语义参考条件；2. 对空间对齐输入采用双路径编码策略和密集特征对齐损失；3. 对语义参考输入采用VLM-only编码方案和时序冗余消除机制；4. 引入自适应空间-语义门控模块动态平衡多模态约束。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，OmniColor在可控性、视觉质量和时序稳定性方面表现优异，为线稿着色提供了稳健实用的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: OmniColor是一个统一的多模态线稿着色框架，能够有效处理任意控制信号组合，在保持边界精确性和色彩恢复的同时提高推理效率，是专业内容创作的强大工具。

title: CiQi-Agent: Aligning Vision, Tools and Aesthetics in Multimodal Agent for Cultural Reasoning on Chinese Porcelains
summary: The connoisseurship of antique Chinese porcelain demands extensive historical expertise, material understanding, and aesthetic sensitivity, making it difficult for non-specialists to engage. To democratize cultural-heritage understanding and assist expert connoisseurship, we introduce CiQi-Agent -- a domain-specific Porcelain Connoisseurship Agent for intelligent analysis of antique Chinese porcelain. CiQi-Agent supports multi-image porcelain inputs and enables vision tool invocation and multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, performing fine-grained connoisseurship analysis across six attributes: dynasty, reign period, kiln site, glaze color, decorative motif, and vessel shape. Beyond attribute classification, it captures subtle visual details, retrieves relevant domain knowledge, and integrates visual and textual evidence to produce coherent, explainable connoisseurship descriptions. To achieve this capability, we construct a large-scale, expert-annotated dataset CiQi-VQA, comprising 29,596 porcelain specimens, 51,553 images, and 557,940 visual question--answering pairs, and further establish a comprehensive benchmark CiQi-Bench aligned with the previously mentioned six attributes. CiQi-Agent is trained through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and a tool-augmented reasoning framework that integrates two categories of tools: a vision tool and multimodal retrieval tools. Experimental results show that CiQi-Agent (7B) outperforms all competitive open- and closed-source models across all six attributes on CiQi-Bench, achieving on average 12.2\% higher accuracy than GPT-5. The model and dataset have been released and are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SII-Monument-Valley/CiQi-VQA.

AI.tldr: CiQi-Agent是一个专门用于中国古陶瓷鉴定的智能代理，通过多模态检索增强生成和视觉工具调用，在六个关键属性上进行细粒度分析，显著优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 中国古陶瓷鉴定需要深厚的历史知识、材料理解和美学敏感度，这对非专业人士构成了障碍。为了普及文化遗产理解和辅助专家鉴定，需要开发专门的智能代理系统。
AI.method: 构建了大规模专家标注数据集CiQi-VQA（29,596件标本，51,553张图像，557,940个视觉问答对），建立CiQi-Bench基准。通过监督微调、强化学习和工具增强推理框架训练CiQi-Agent，集成视觉工具和多模态检索工具。
AI.result: CiQi-Agent（7B）在CiQi-Bench的所有六个属性上均优于所有竞争的开源和闭源模型，平均准确率比GPT-5高出12.2%。
AI.conclusion: CiQi-Agent成功实现了对中国古陶瓷的智能鉴定分析，通过多模态方法和工具集成显著提升了鉴定性能，为文化遗产理解和专家辅助提供了有效工具。

title: MV-RoMa: From Pairwise Matching into Multi-View Track Reconstruction
summary: Establishing consistent correspondences across images is essential for 3D vision tasks such as structure-from-motion (SfM), yet most existing matchers operate in a pairwise manner, often producing fragmented and geometrically inconsistent tracks when their predictions are chained across views. We propose MV-RoMa, a multi-view dense matching model that jointly estimates dense correspondences from a source image to multiple co-visible targets. Specifically, we design an efficient model architecture which avoids high computational cost of full cross-attention for multi-view feature interaction: (i) multi-view encoder that leverages pair-wise matching results as a geometric prior, and (ii) multi-view matching refiner that refines correspondences using pixel-wise attention. Additionally, we propose a post-processing strategy that integrates our model's consistent multi-view correspondences as high-quality tracks for SfM. Across diverse and challenging benchmarks, MV-RoMa produces more reliable correspondences and substantially denser, more accurate 3D reconstructions than existing sparse and dense matching methods. Project page: https://icetea-cv.github.io/mv-roma/.

AI.tldr: MV-RoMa是一个多视角稠密匹配模型，通过联合估计源图像到多个共视目标图像的稠密对应关系，解决了传统成对匹配方法在跨视图链接时产生的碎片化和几何不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 现有匹配方法大多是成对匹配，当在多个视图间链接预测时会产生碎片化和几何不一致的轨迹，这对于SfM等3D视觉任务至关重要。需要一种能够直接进行多视角稠密匹配的方法。
AI.method: 设计了高效的多视角模型架构：1) 多视角编码器利用成对匹配结果作为几何先验；2) 多视角匹配细化器使用像素级注意力细化对应关系。还提出了后处理策略，将模型的一致多视角对应关系整合为SfM的高质量轨迹。
AI.result: 在多样化和具有挑战性的基准测试中，MV-RoMa相比现有稀疏和稠密匹配方法，产生了更可靠的对应关系和显著更稠密、更准确的3D重建结果。
AI.conclusion: MV-RoMa通过联合多视角稠密匹配方法，有效解决了传统成对匹配的局限性，为3D视觉任务提供了更一致、更可靠的对应关系，显著提升了3D重建的质量。

title: Domain-Invariant Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Large pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP have transformed computer vision by aligning images and text in a shared feature space, enabling robust zero-shot transfer via prompting. Soft-prompting, such as Context Optimization (CoOp), effectively adapts these models for downstream recognition tasks by learning a set of context vectors. However, CoOp lacks explicit mechanisms for handling domain shifts across unseen distributions. To address this, we propose Domain-invariant Context Optimization (DiCoOp), an extension of CoOp optimized for domain generalization. By employing an adversarial training approach, DiCoOp forces the model to learn domain-invariant prompts while preserving discriminative power for classification. Experimental results show that DiCoOp consistently surpasses CoOp in domain generalization tasks across diverse visual domains.

AI.tldr: DiCoOp扩展了CoOp的软提示学习方法，通过对抗训练使模型学习领域不变的提示，在领域泛化任务中表现优于CoOp。
AI.motivation: 现有的软提示学习方法如CoOp虽然能有效适应下游识别任务，但缺乏处理未见分布领域偏移的显式机制，需要改进以适应领域泛化需求。
AI.method: 提出领域不变上下文优化(DiCoOp)，采用对抗训练方法，强制模型学习领域不变的提示，同时保持分类的判别能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DiCoOp在多种视觉领域的领域泛化任务中持续超越CoOp。
AI.conclusion: DiCoOp通过对抗训练学习领域不变提示，有效解决了CoOp在领域泛化方面的局限性，提升了模型在未见分布上的表现。

title: Navigating the Mirage: A Dual-Path Agentic Framework for Robust Misleading Chart Question Answering
summary: Despite the success of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), misleading charts remain a significant challenge due to their deceptive visual structures and distorted data representations. We present ChartCynics, an agentic dual-path framework designed to unmask visual deception via a "skeptical" reasoning paradigm. Unlike holistic models, ChartCynics decouples perception from verification: a Diagnostic Vision Path captures structural anomalies (e.g., inverted axes) through strategic ROI cropping, while an OCR-Driven Data Path ensures numerical grounding. To resolve cross-modal conflicts, we introduce an Agentic Summarizer optimized via a two-stage protocol: Oracle-Informed SFT for reasoning distillation and Deception-Aware GRPO for adversarial alignment. This pipeline effectively penalizes visual traps and enforces logical consistency. Evaluations on two benchmarks show that ChartCynics achieves 74.43% and 64.55% accuracy, providing an absolute performance boost of ~29% over the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, outperforming state-of-the-art proprietary models. Our results demonstrate that specialized agentic workflows can grant smaller open-source models superior robustness, establishing a new foundation for trustworthy chart interpretation.

AI.tldr: ChartCynics是一个双路径代理框架，通过"怀疑式"推理范式来检测图表中的视觉欺骗，将感知与验证解耦，在基准测试中比Qwen3-VL-8B骨干网络提升约29%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型取得了成功，但具有误导性的图表仍然是一个重大挑战，因为它们具有欺骗性的视觉结构和扭曲的数据表示。现有的整体模型难以有效应对图表中的视觉欺骗问题。
AI.method: ChartCynics采用双路径框架：诊断视觉路径通过战略性的感兴趣区域裁剪来捕捉结构异常（如反转坐标轴），OCR驱动数据路径确保数值基础。为解决跨模态冲突，引入了代理总结器，通过两阶段协议优化：Oracle-Informed SFT用于推理蒸馏，Deception-Aware GRPO用于对抗性对齐。
AI.result: 在两个基准测试中，ChartCynics分别达到74.43%和64.55%的准确率，相比Qwen3-VL-8B骨干网络提供约29%的绝对性能提升，超越了最先进的专有模型。
AI.conclusion: 专门的代理工作流程可以使较小的开源模型获得卓越的鲁棒性，为可信的图表解释建立了新的基础，证明了针对视觉欺骗问题的专业化方法的价值。

title: PANDORA: Pixel-wise Attention Dissolution and Latent Guidance for Zero-Shot Object Removal
summary: Removing objects from natural images is challenging due to difficulty of synthesizing semantically coherent content while preserving background integrity. Existing methods often rely on fine-tuning, prompt engineering, or inference-time optimization, yet still suffer from texture inconsistency, rigid artifacts, weak foreground-background disentanglement, and poor scalability for multi-object removal. We propose a novel zero-shot object removal framework, namely PANDORA, that operates directly on pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models, requiring no fine-tuning, prompts, or optimization. We propose Pixel-wise Attention Dissolution to remove object by nullifying the most correlated attention keys for masked pixels, effectively eliminating the object from self-attention flow and allowing background context to dominate reconstruction. We further introduce Localized Attentional Disentanglement Guidance to steer denoising toward latent manifolds favorable to clean object removal. Together, these components enable precise, non-rigid, prompt-free, and scalable multi-object erasure in a single pass. Experiments demonstrate superior visual fidelity and semantic plausibility compared to state-of-the-art methods. The project page is available at https://vdkhoi20.github.io/PANDORA.

AI.tldr: PANDORA是一个无需微调、提示或优化的零样本物体移除框架，通过像素级注意力消解和局部注意力解缠引导，在预训练扩散模型中实现多物体精确擦除。
AI.motivation: 现有物体移除方法存在纹理不一致、刚性伪影、前景背景分离弱、多物体移除扩展性差等问题，需要微调、提示工程或推理时优化，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出像素级注意力消解，通过消除掩码像素最相关的注意力键值来从自注意力流中移除物体；引入局部注意力解缠引导，将去噪过程导向有利于干净物体移除的潜在流形。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比现有最先进方法，PANDORA在视觉保真度和语义合理性方面表现更优，能够实现精确、非刚性、无需提示且可扩展的多物体擦除。
AI.conclusion: PANDORA框架在无需微调、提示或优化的情况下，实现了高质量的零样本物体移除，解决了现有方法的局限性，为图像编辑提供了更实用的解决方案。

title: Learning to See through Illumination Extremes with Event Streaming in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) perform strong vision-language reasoning under standard conditions but fail in extreme illumination, where RGB inputs lose irrevocable structure and semantics. We propose Event-MLLM, an event-enhanced model that performs all-light visual reasoning by dynamically fusing event streams with RGB frames. Two key components drive our approach: an Illumination Indicator - a learnable signal derived from a DINOv2 branch that represents exposure degradation and adaptively modulates event-RGB fusion - and an Illumination Correction Loss that aligns fused features with non-degraded (normal-light) semantics in the latent space, compensating for information lost in extreme lighting. We curate the first multi-illumination event-instruction corpus for MLLMs, with 2,241 event-RGB samples (around 6 QA pairs each) across diverse scenes and 17 brightness rates (0.05x - 20x), plus an instruct-following benchmark for reasoning, counting, and fine-grained recognition under extreme lighting. Experiments show that Event-MLLM markedly outperforms general-purpose, illumination-adaptive, and event-only baselines, setting a new state of the art in robust multimodal perception and reasoning under challenging illumination.

AI.tldr: Event-MLLM：一种通过动态融合事件流与RGB帧实现全光照视觉推理的事件增强多模态大语言模型，在极端光照条件下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态大语言模型在标准光照条件下表现良好，但在极端光照条件下（如过暗或过亮）RGB输入会丢失不可恢复的结构和语义信息，导致视觉推理失败。
AI.method: 提出Event-MLLM模型，包含两个关键组件：1）光照指示器——从DINOv2分支派生的可学习信号，表示曝光退化并自适应调节事件-RGB融合；2）光照校正损失——在潜在空间中对齐融合特征与正常光照语义，补偿极端光照下丢失的信息。
AI.result: 创建了首个用于MLLM的多光照事件指令语料库，包含2,241个事件-RGB样本（约6个问答对每个）和17种亮度级别。实验表明Event-MLLM在极端光照下的推理、计数和细粒度识别任务上显著优于通用、光照自适应和纯事件基线模型。
AI.conclusion: Event-MLLM通过事件流与RGB帧的动态融合，结合光照指示器和校正损失机制，在挑战性光照条件下实现了鲁棒的多模态感知和推理，为极端光照环境下的视觉理解设立了新的技术标杆。

title: TGIF2: Extended Text-Guided Inpainting Forgery Dataset & Benchmark
comment: 33 pages, accepted at Journal on Information Security
