summary: Generative AI has made text-guided inpainting a powerful image editing tool, but at the same time a growing challenge for media forensics. Existing benchmarks, including our text-guided inpainting forgery (TGIF) dataset, show that image forgery localization (IFL) methods can localize manipulations in spliced images but struggle not in fully regenerated (FR) images, while synthetic image detection (SID) methods can detect fully regenerated images but cannot perform localization. With new generative inpainting models emerging and the open problem of localization in FR images remaining, updated datasets and benchmarks are needed. We introduce TGIF2, an extended version of TGIF, that captures recent advances in text-guided inpainting and enables a deeper analysis of forensic robustness. TGIF2 augments the original dataset with edits generated by FLUX.1 models, as well as with random non-semantic masks. Using the TGIF2 dataset, we conduct a forensic evaluation spanning IFL and SID, including fine-tuning IFL methods on FR images and generative super-resolution attacks. Our experiments show that both IFL and SID methods degrade on FLUX.1 manipulations, highlighting limited generalization. Additionally, while fine-tuning improves localization on FR images, evaluation with random non-semantic masks reveals object bias. Furthermore, generative super-resolution significantly weakens forensic traces, demonstrating that common image enhancement operations can undermine current forensic pipelines. In summary, TGIF2 provides an updated dataset and benchmark, which enables new insights into the challenges posed by modern inpainting and AI-based image enhancements. TGIF2 is available at https://github.com/IDLabMedia/tgif-dataset.

AI.tldr: TGIF2是TGIF数据集的扩展版本，包含FLUX.1模型生成的文本引导修复图像和随机非语义掩码，用于评估图像伪造定位和合成图像检测方法的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI的发展，文本引导修复成为强大的图像编辑工具，但对媒体取证构成挑战。现有基准显示图像伪造定位方法难以处理完全重生成图像，而合成图像检测方法无法定位。需要更新的数据集和基准来评估现代修复模型的取证鲁棒性。
AI.method: 扩展TGIF数据集，添加FLUX.1模型生成的编辑图像和随机非语义掩码。使用TGIF2进行取证评估，包括图像伪造定位和合成图像检测方法的测试，对IFL方法在完全重生成图像上进行微调，并进行生成式超分辨率攻击实验。
AI.result: IFL和SID方法在FLUX.1操作上性能下降，显示有限泛化能力。微调能改善完全重生成图像的定位，但随机非语义掩码评估揭示对象偏差。生成式超分辨率显著削弱取证痕迹，表明常见图像增强操作会破坏当前取证流程。
AI.conclusion: TGIF2提供了更新的数据集和基准，能够深入分析现代修复和AI图像增强技术带来的取证挑战。该数据集可用于评估和改进取证方法的鲁棒性。

title: Structured Observation Language for Efficient and Generalizable Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to navigate complex environments by following natural language instructions, which typically demands tight fusion of visual and language modalities. Existing VLN methods often convert raw images into visual tokens or implicit features, requiring large-scale visual pre-training and suffering from poor generalization under environmental variations (e.g., lighting, texture). To address these issues, we propose SOL-Nav (Structured Observation Language for Navigation), a novel framework that translates egocentric visual observations into compact structured language descriptions for efficient and generalizable navigation. Specifically, we divide RGB-D images into a N*N grid, extract representative semantic, color, and depth information for each grid cell to form structured text, and concatenate this with the language instruction as pure language input to a pre-trained language model (PLM). Experimental results on standard VLN benchmarks (R2R, RxR) and real-world deployments demonstrate that SOL-Nav significantly reduces the model size and training data dependency, fully leverages the reasoning and representation capabilities of PLMs, and achieves strong generalization to unseen environments.

AI.tldr: SOL-Nav将视觉导航中的图像转换为结构化语言描述，使用纯语言输入到预训练语言模型中，减少视觉预训练需求并提升泛化能力
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言导航方法通常将原始图像转换为视觉token或隐式特征，需要大规模视觉预训练，且在环境变化（如光照、纹理）下泛化能力差
AI.method: 将RGB-D图像划分为N*N网格，为每个网格单元提取代表性语义、颜色和深度信息形成结构化文本描述，与语言指令拼接作为纯语言输入到预训练语言模型
AI.result: 在标准VLN基准测试（R2R、RxR）和实际部署中，SOL-Nav显著减小模型规模、降低训练数据依赖，充分利用PLM的推理和表示能力，在未见环境中实现强泛化
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉观察转换为结构化语言描述，SOL-Nav提供了一种高效且可泛化的导航框架，减少了对大规模视觉预训练的依赖

title: Why Aggregate Accuracy is Inadequate for Evaluating Fairness in Law Enforcement Facial Recognition Systems
comment: 9 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. Position paper with empirical subgroup analysis highlighting limitations of aggregate accuracy in fairness evaluation
summary: Facial recognition systems are increasingly deployed in law enforcement and security contexts, where algorithmic decisions can carry significant societal consequences. Despite high reported accuracy, growing evidence demonstrates that such systems often exhibit uneven performance across demographic groups, leading to disproportionate error rates and potential harm. This paper argues that aggregate accuracy is an insufficient metric for evaluating the fairness and reliability of facial recognition systems in high-stakes environments. Through analysis of subgroup-level error distribution, including false positive rate (FPR) and false negative rate (FNR), the paper demonstrates how aggregate performance metrics can obscure critical disparities across demographic groups. Empirical observations show that systems with similar overall accuracy can exhibit substantially different fairness profiles, with subgroup error rates varying significantly despite a single aggregate metric. The paper further examines the operational risks associated with accuracy-centric evaluation practices in law enforcement applications, where misclassification may result in wrongful suspicion or missed identification. It highlights the importance of fairness-aware evaluation approaches and model-agnostic auditing strategies that enable post-deployment assessment of real-world systems. The findings emphasise the need to move beyond accuracy as a primary metric and adopt more comprehensive evaluation frameworks for responsible AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 面部识别系统在执法应用中存在人口统计学群体间的性能差异，总体准确率不足以评估系统公平性，需要更全面的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 面部识别系统在执法和安全领域广泛应用，算法决策具有重大社会影响。尽管报告准确率高，但证据表明这些系统在不同人口统计学群体间存在性能差异，导致不成比例的错误率和潜在危害。
AI.method: 通过分析子群体级别的错误分布（包括假阳性率和假阴性率），研究总体性能指标如何掩盖不同人口统计学群体间的关键差异。采用公平感知的评估方法和模型无关的审计策略，支持部署后对实际系统的评估。
AI.result: 实证观察显示，具有相似总体准确率的系统可能表现出显著不同的公平性特征，子群体错误率在单一总体指标下存在显著差异。准确率中心评估方法在执法应用中存在操作风险，误分类可能导致错误怀疑或漏识别。
AI.conclusion: 需要超越准确率作为主要指标，采用更全面的评估框架来负责任地部署AI系统，强调公平性评估和模型无关审计策略的重要性。

title: A Robust Low-Rank Prior Model for Structured Cartoon-Texture Image Decomposition with Heavy-Tailed Noise
comment: This paper introduces a robust model for cartoon-texture image decomposition with heavy-tailed noise. It has 11 figures and 4 tables
summary: Cartoon-texture image decomposition is a fundamental yet challenging problem in image processing. A significant hurdle in achieving accurate decomposition is the pervasive presence of noise in the observed images, which severely impedes robust results. To address the challenging problem of cartoon-texture decomposition in the presence of heavy-tailed noise, we in this paper propose a robust low-rank prior model. Our approach departs from conventional models by adopting the Huber loss function as the data-fidelity term, rather than the traditional $\ell_2$-norm, while retaining the total variation norm and nuclear norm to characterize the cartoon and texture components, respectively. Given the inherent structure, we employ two implementable operator splitting algorithms, tailored to different degradation operators. Extensive numerical experiments, particularly on image restoration tasks under high-intensity heavy-tailed noise, efficiently demonstrate the superior performance of our model.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Huber损失函数的鲁棒低秩先验模型，用于处理含重尾噪声的卡通-纹理图像分解问题
AI.motivation: 卡通-纹理图像分解是图像处理中的基本但具有挑战性的问题。现有方法在处理含噪声图像时效果不佳，特别是重尾噪声会严重影响分解的鲁棒性。需要开发能够有效处理噪声干扰的分解模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种鲁棒低秩先验模型：1) 使用Huber损失函数作为数据保真项（替代传统的ℓ2范数）；2) 保留总变差范数刻画卡通分量；3) 保留核范数刻画纹理分量；4) 针对不同退化算子设计了两种可实现的算子分裂算法。
AI.result: 通过大量数值实验，特别是在高强度重尾噪声下的图像恢复任务中，该模型表现出优越的性能，能够有效处理噪声干扰并获得准确的分解结果。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于Huber损失的鲁棒低秩先验模型能够有效解决含重尾噪声的卡通-纹理图像分解问题，在噪声环境下表现出比传统方法更好的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: AdaptToken: Entropy-based Adaptive Token Selection for MLLM Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding remains challenging for Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to high memory costs and context-length limits. Prior approaches mitigate this by scoring and selecting frames/tokens within short clips, but they lack a principled mechanism to (i) compare relevance across distant video clips and (ii) stop processing once sufficient evidence has been gathered. We propose AdaptToken, a training-free framework that turns an MLLM's self-uncertainty into a global control signal for long-video token selection. AdaptToken splits a video into groups, extracts cross-modal attention to rank tokens within each group, and uses the model's response entropy to estimate each group's prompt relevance. This entropy signal enables a global token budget allocation across groups and further supports early stopping (AdaptToken-Lite), skipping the remaining groups when the model becomes sufficiently certain. Across four long-video benchmarks (VideoMME, LongVideoBench, LVBench, and MLVU) and multiple base MLLMs (7B-72B), AdaptToken consistently improves accuracy (e.g., +6.7 on average over Qwen2.5-VL 7B) and continues to benefit from extremely long inputs (up to 10K frames), while AdaptToken-Lite reduces inference time by about half with comparable performance. Project page: https://haozheqi.github.io/adapt-token

AI.tldr: AdaptToken是一个无需训练的框架，利用多模态大语言模型的自不确定性作为全局控制信号，通过熵估计视频片段相关性，实现长视频的token选择和早期停止处理。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解对多模态大语言模型具有挑战性，因为存在高内存成本和上下文长度限制。现有方法通过评分和选择短片段内的帧/token来缓解，但缺乏跨远距离视频片段比较相关性和在收集足够证据后停止处理的机制。
AI.method: AdaptToken将视频分成组，提取跨模态注意力来对每组内的token进行排名，并使用模型的响应熵来估计每组与提示的相关性。这个熵信号支持跨组的全局token预算分配，并进一步支持早期停止（AdaptToken-Lite），当模型变得足够确定时跳过剩余组。
AI.result: 在四个长视频基准测试（VideoMME、LongVideoBench、LVBench和MLVU）和多个基础MLLM（7B-72B）上，AdaptToken持续提高准确性（例如，在Qwen2.5-VL 7B上平均提高+6.7），并能从极长输入（最多10K帧）中受益，而AdaptToken-Lite将推理时间减少约一半，同时保持可比性能。
AI.conclusion: AdaptToken通过将模型的自不确定性转化为全局控制信号，有效解决了长视频理解中的token选择和早期停止问题，在保持或提高性能的同时显著降低了计算成本。

title: On-the-fly Repulsion in the Contextual Space for Rich Diversity in Diffusion Transformers
comment: Conditionally accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026. Project page: https://contextual-repulsion.github.io/
summary: Modern Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable semantic alignment, yet they often suffer from a significant lack of variety, converging on a narrow set of visual solutions for any given prompt. This typicality bias presents a challenge for creative applications that require a wide range of generative outcomes. We identify a fundamental trade-off in current approaches to diversity: modifying model inputs requires costly optimization to incorporate feedback from the generative path. In contrast, acting on spatially-committed intermediate latents tends to disrupt the forming visual structure, leading to artifacts. In this work, we propose to apply repulsion in the Contextual Space as a novel framework for achieving rich diversity in Diffusion Transformers. By intervening in the multimodal attention channels, we apply on-the-fly repulsion during the transformer's forward pass, injecting the intervention between blocks where text conditioning is enriched with emergent image structure. This allows for redirecting the guidance trajectory after it is structurally informed but before the composition is fixed. Our results demonstrate that repulsion in the Contextual Space produces significantly richer diversity without sacrificing visual fidelity or semantic adherence. Furthermore, our method is uniquely efficient, imposing a small computational overhead while remaining effective even in modern "Turbo" and distilled models where traditional trajectory-based interventions typically fail.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种在上下文空间中应用排斥力的新方法，以解决文本到图像扩散模型中多样性不足的问题，能够在保持视觉质量和语义一致性的同时显著增加生成结果的多样性。
AI.motivation: 现代文本到图像扩散模型虽然语义对齐效果显著，但存在典型性偏差问题，对于同一提示词往往收敛到狭窄的视觉解决方案集合，缺乏多样性，这对需要广泛生成结果的创意应用构成了挑战。
AI.method: 提出在上下文空间中应用排斥力的新框架，通过干预扩散变换器的多模态注意力通道，在变换器前向传播过程中实时应用排斥力。干预在文本条件与新兴图像结构融合的块之间进行，允许在结构信息形成后但构图固定前重新引导生成轨迹。
AI.result: 该方法在上下文空间中应用排斥力能够产生显著更丰富的多样性，同时不牺牲视觉保真度或语义一致性。该方法计算开销小，即使在现代"Turbo"和蒸馏模型中仍然有效，而传统的基于轨迹的干预方法在这些模型中通常会失败。
AI.conclusion: 通过在上下文空间中应用排斥力，该方法成功解决了文本到图像扩散模型的多样性不足问题，提供了一种高效且有效的解决方案，能够在保持高质量生成的同时显著增加输出结果的多样性。

title: You Only Erase Once: Erasing Anything without Bringing Unexpected Content
summary: We present YOEO, an approach for object erasure. Unlike recent diffusion-based methods which struggle to erase target objects without generating unexpected content within the masked regions due to lack of sufficient paired training data and explicit constraint on content generation, our method allows to produce high-quality object erasure results free of unwanted objects or artifacts while faithfully preserving the overall context coherence to the surrounding content. We achieve this goal by training an object erasure diffusion model on unpaired data containing only large-scale real-world images, under the supervision of a sundries detector and a context coherence loss that are built upon an entity segmentation model. To enable more efficient training and inference, a diffusion distillation strategy is employed to train for a few-step erasure diffusion model. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art object erasure methods. Code will be available at https://zyxunh.github.io/YOEO-ProjectPage/.

AI.tldr: YOEO是一种基于扩散模型的对象擦除方法，通过使用非配对数据和上下文一致性损失，在保持场景连贯性的同时有效擦除目标对象，避免生成意外内容。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散的对象擦除方法由于缺乏足够的配对训练数据和明确的内容生成约束，在擦除目标对象时容易在掩码区域内生成意外内容，需要更好的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 在仅包含大规模真实世界图像的非配对数据上训练对象擦除扩散模型；2) 基于实体分割模型构建杂物检测器和上下文一致性损失进行监督；3) 采用扩散蒸馏策略训练少步擦除扩散模型以提高效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在对象擦除任务上优于现有最先进方法，能够生成高质量的对象擦除结果，避免生成不需要的对象或伪影，同时忠实保持与周围内容的整体上下文连贯性。
AI.conclusion: YOEO方法通过创新的非配对训练策略和上下文一致性约束，有效解决了扩散模型在对象擦除中的内容生成问题，实现了高质量的对象擦除效果。

title: Clore: Interactive Pathology Image Segmentation with Click-based Local Refinement
summary: Recent advancements in deep learning-based interactive segmentation methods have significantly improved pathology image segmentation. Most existing approaches utilize user-provided positive and negative clicks to guide the segmentation process. However, these methods primarily rely on iterative global updates for refinement, which lead to redundant re-prediction and often fail to capture fine-grained structures or correct subtle errors during localized adjustments. To address this limitation, we propose the Click-based Local Refinement (Clore) pipeline, a simple yet efficient method designed to enhance interactive segmentation. The key innovation of Clore lies in its hierarchical interaction paradigm: the initial clicks drive global segmentation to rapidly outline large target regions, while subsequent clicks progressively refine local details to achieve precise boundaries. This approach not only improves the ability to handle fine-grained segmentation tasks but also achieves high-quality results with fewer interactions. Experimental results on four datasets demonstrate that Clore achieves the best balance between segmentation accuracy and interaction cost, making it an effective solution for efficient and accurate interactive pathology image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出Clore交互分割方法，通过分层交互范式：初始点击进行全局分割，后续点击逐步局部细化，在减少交互次数的同时提高病理图像分割精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的交互分割方法主要依赖用户提供的正负点击进行迭代全局更新，导致冗余重复预测，难以捕捉细粒度结构或修正局部细微错误。
AI.method: 提出Click-based Local Refinement (Clore)管道，采用分层交互范式：初始点击驱动全局分割快速勾勒大目标区域，后续点击逐步细化局部细节以实现精确边界。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验结果表明，Clore在分割精度和交互成本之间达到了最佳平衡，能够以更少的交互次数获得高质量结果。
AI.conclusion: Clore是一种简单高效的交互分割方法，通过分层交互范式显著提升了处理细粒度分割任务的能力，为高效准确的病理图像交互分割提供了有效解决方案。

title: OPRO: Orthogonal Panel-Relative Operators for Panel-Aware In-Context Image Generation
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. 16 pages, 9 figures. Includes Supplementary Material
summary: We introduce a parameter-efficient adaptation method for panel-aware in-context image generation with pre-trained diffusion transformers. The key idea is to compose learnable, panel-specific orthogonal operators onto the backbone's frozen positional encodings. This design provides two desirable properties: (1) isometry, which preserves the geometry of internal features, and (2) same-panel invariance, which maintains the model's pre-trained intra-panel synthesis behavior. Through controlled experiments, we demonstrate that the effectiveness of our adaptation method is not tied to a specific positional encoding design but generalizes across diverse positional encoding regimes. By enabling effective panel-relative conditioning, the proposed method consistently improves in-context image-based instructional editing pipelines, including state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种参数高效的自适应方法，用于基于预训练扩散变换器的面板感知上下文图像生成，通过可学习的面板特定正交算子组合到骨干网络的冻结位置编码上。
AI.motivation: 为了在预训练扩散变换器中实现面板感知的上下文图像生成，需要一种参数高效的自适应方法，既能保持模型预训练的内部特征几何结构，又能维持模型在相同面板内的合成行为。
AI.method: 将可学习的、面板特定的正交算子组合到骨干网络的冻结位置编码上，这种设计提供两个理想特性：等距性（保持内部特征的几何结构）和同面板不变性（维持模型预训练的相同面板内合成行为）。
AI.result: 通过受控实验证明，该自适应方法的有效性不依赖于特定的位置编码设计，而是能够泛化到不同的位置编码机制。通过实现有效的面板相对条件化，该方法持续改进了基于上下文图像的指令编辑流程，包括最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的参数高效自适应方法通过正交算子组合到冻结位置编码上，实现了面板感知的上下文图像生成，在保持模型预训练特性的同时，有效改进了图像编辑流程。

title: OpenDPR: Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Vision-Centric Diffusion-Guided Prototype Retrieval for Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) seeks to recognize arbitrary changes of interest by enabling generalization beyond a fixed set of predefined classes. We reformulate OVCD as a two-stage pipeline: first generate class-agnostic change proposals using visual foundation models (VFMs) such as SAM and DINOv2, and then perform category identification with vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP. We reveal that category identification errors are the primary bottleneck of OVCD, mainly due to the limited ability of VLMs based on image-text matching to represent fine-grained land-cover categories. To address this, we propose OpenDPR, a training-free vision-centric diffusion-guided prototype retrieval framework. OpenDPR leverages diffusion models to construct diverse prototypes for target categories offline, and to perform similarity retrieval with change proposals in the visual space during inference. The secondary bottleneck lies in change localization, due to the inherent lack of change priors in VFMs. To bridge this gap, we design a spatial-to-change weakly supervised change detection module named S2C to adapt their strong spatial modeling capabilities for change localization. Integrating the pretrained S2C into OpenDPR leads to an optional weakly supervised variant named OpenDPR-W, which further improves OVCD with minimal supervision. Experimental results on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve state-of-the-art performance under both supervision modes. Code is available at https://github.com/guoqi2002/OpenDPR.

AI.tldr: OpenDPR：一种无需训练、基于扩散引导原型检索的开放词汇变化检测框架，通过视觉中心化方法解决类别识别瓶颈，并引入空间到变化的弱监督模块提升变化定位能力。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇变化检测（OVCD）旨在识别任意感兴趣的变化，超越预定义类别限制。研究发现现有方法的主要瓶颈在于类别识别错误（VLMs对细粒度地物类别表征能力有限）和变化定位不足（VFMs缺乏变化先验知识）。
AI.method: 1. 提出OpenDPR框架：两阶段流程（生成类别无关变化提案 + 类别识别）；2. 使用扩散模型离线构建目标类别多样化原型，在推理时进行视觉空间相似性检索；3. 设计S2C模块：空间到变化的弱监督变化检测，将VFMs的空间建模能力适配到变化定位；4. 集成S2C形成OpenDPR-W弱监督变体。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法在两种监督模式下均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: OpenDPR通过视觉中心的扩散引导原型检索有效解决了OVCD中的类别识别瓶颈，结合S2C模块进一步提升了变化定位能力，为开放词汇变化检测提供了有效的训练免费解决方案。

title: V-CAST: Video Curvature-Aware Spatio-Temporal Pruning for Efficient Video Large Language Models
summary: Video large language models (VideoLLMs) show strong capability in video understanding, yet long-context inference is still dominated by massive redundant visual tokens in the prefill stage. We revisit token compression for VideoLLMs under a tight budget and identify a key bottleneck, namely insufficient spatio-temporal information coverage. Existing methods often introduce discontinuous coverage through coarse per-frame allocation or scene segmentation, and token merging can further misalign spatio-temporal coordinates under MRoPE-style discrete (t,h,w) bindings. To address these issues, we propose V-CAST (Video Curvature-Aware Spatio-Temporal Pruning), a training-free, plug-and-play pruning policy for long-context video inference. V-CAST casts token compression as a trajectory approximation problem and introduces a curvature-guided temporal allocation module that routes per-frame token budgets to semantic turns and event boundaries. It further adopts a dual-anchor spatial selection mechanism that preserves high-entropy visual evidence without attention intervention, while keeping retained tokens at their original coordinates to maintain positional alignment. Extensive experiments across multiple VideoLLMs of different architectures and scales demonstrate that V-CAST achieves 98.6% of the original performance, outperforms the second-best method by +1.1% on average, and reduces peak memory and total latency to 86.7% and 86.4% of vanilla Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: V-CAST是一种无需训练、即插即用的视频大语言模型长上下文推理剪枝方法，通过曲率引导的时间分配和双锚点空间选择机制，在保持98.6%原始性能的同时显著降低内存和延迟。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型在长上下文推理中存在大量冗余视觉token，现有方法存在时空信息覆盖不足、坐标错位等问题，需要一种更有效的token压缩方案。
AI.method: 将token压缩视为轨迹逼近问题，采用曲率引导的时间分配模块将每帧token预算分配到语义转折点和事件边界，并使用双锚点空间选择机制保留高熵视觉证据，同时保持token原始坐标位置对齐。
AI.result: 在多种架构和规模的VideoLLMs上实验表明，V-CAST达到原始性能的98.6%，平均优于次优方法+1.1%，将峰值内存和总延迟分别降低到Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct原始版本的86.7%和86.4%。
AI.conclusion: V-CAST通过曲率感知的时空剪枝策略，有效解决了视频大语言模型长上下文推理中的token冗余问题，在保持高性能的同时显著提升了推理效率。

title: Amped: Adaptive Multi-stage Non-edge Pruning for Edge Detection
summary: Edge detection is a fundamental image analysis task that underpins numerous high-level vision applications. Recent advances in Transformer architectures have significantly improved edge quality by capturing long-range dependencies, but this often comes with computational overhead. Achieving higher pixel-level accuracy requires increased input resolution, further escalating computational cost and limiting practical deployment. Building on the strong representational capacity of recent Transformer-based edge detectors, we propose an Adaptive Multi-stage non-edge Pruning framework for Edge Detection(Amped). Amped identifies high-confidence non-edge tokens and removes them as early as possible to substantially reduce computation, thus retaining high accuracy while cutting GFLOPs and accelerating inference with minimal performance loss. Moreover, to mitigate the structural complexity of existing edge detection networks and facilitate their integration into real-world systems, we introduce a simple yet high-performance Transformer-based model, termed Streamline Edge Detector(SED). Applied to both existing detectors and our SED, the proposed pruning strategy provides a favorable balance between accuracy and efficiency-reducing GFLOPs by up to 40% with only a 0.4% drop in ODS F-measure. In addition, despite its simplicity, SED achieves a state-of-the-art ODS F-measure of 86.5%. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出Amped框架和SED模型，通过自适应多阶段非边缘剪枝减少Transformer边缘检测器的计算量，同时保持高精度，实现精度与效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: Transformer架构在边缘检测中能捕捉长距离依赖关系，但计算开销大。高像素级精度需要更高分辨率输入，进一步增加计算成本，限制实际部署。需要在保持Transformer强大表征能力的同时减少计算量。
AI.method: 提出自适应多阶段非边缘剪枝框架(Amped)，识别高置信度非边缘token并尽早移除，大幅减少计算量。同时提出简单高效的Transformer边缘检测模型SED，结构简洁便于实际系统集成。
AI.result: 剪枝策略可将GFLOPs减少达40%，ODS F-measure仅下降0.4%。SED模型达到86.5%的ODS F-measure，达到最先进水平。在精度和效率之间取得了良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: Amped框架和SED模型为Transformer边缘检测器提供了有效的精度-效率平衡方案，剪枝策略显著减少计算量，SED模型在保持简单结构的同时达到最先进性能，有利于实际部署。

title: A Benchmarking Methodology to Assess Open-Source Video Large Language Models in Automatic Captioning of News Videos
summary: News videos are among the most prevalent content types produced by television stations and online streaming platforms, yet generating textual descriptions to facilitate indexing and retrieval largely remains a manual process. Video Large Language Models (VidLLMs) offer significant potential to automate this task, but a comprehensive evaluation in the news domain is still lacking. This work presents a comparative study of eight state-of-the-art open-source VidLLMs for automatic news video captioning, evaluated on two complementary benchmark datasets: a Chilean TV news corpus (approximately 1,345 clips) and a BBC News corpus (9,838 clips). We employ lexical metrics (METEOR, ROUGE-L), semantic metrics (BERTScore, CLIPScore, Text Similarity, Mean Reciprocal Rank), and two novel fidelity metrics proposed in this work: the Thematic Fidelity Score (TFS) and Entity Fidelity Score (EFS). Our analysis reveals that standard metrics exhibit limited discriminative power for news video captioning due to surface-form dependence, static-frame insensitivity, and function-word inflation. TFS and EFS address these gaps by directly assessing thematic structure preservation and named-entity coverage in the generated captions. Results show that Gemma~3 achieves the highest overall performance across both datasets and most evaluation dimensions, with Qwen-VL as a consistent runner-up.

AI.tldr: 该研究对8种开源视频大语言模型在新闻视频字幕生成任务上进行了比较评估，使用两个新闻数据集和多种评估指标，发现标准指标在新闻领域存在局限性，并提出了新的保真度指标。
AI.motivation: 新闻视频内容广泛但字幕生成仍依赖人工，视频大语言模型有自动化潜力，但在新闻领域缺乏全面评估。
AI.method: 使用8种最先进的开源视频大语言模型，在两个新闻数据集（智利电视新闻和BBC新闻）上进行评估，采用词汇指标、语义指标和两种新提出的保真度指标（主题保真度得分和实体保真度得分）。
AI.result: 标准评估指标在新闻视频字幕生成中判别力有限，存在表面形式依赖、静态帧不敏感和功能词膨胀问题；新提出的TFS和EFS指标能更好评估主题结构保持和命名实体覆盖；Gemma~3在两个数据集和大多数评估维度上表现最佳，Qwen-VL为稳定亚军。
AI.conclusion: 视频大语言模型在新闻视频字幕生成方面具有实用潜力，但需要专门针对新闻领域特点的评估指标；新提出的保真度指标能更准确评估模型性能；Gemma~3是目前该任务的最佳选择。

title: Test-Time Instance-Specific Parameter Composition: A New Paradigm for Adaptive Generative Modeling
summary: Existing generative models, such as diffusion and auto-regressive networks, are inherently static, relying on a fixed set of pretrained parameters to handle all inputs. In contrast, humans flexibly adapt their internal generative representations to each perceptual or imaginative context. Inspired by this capability, we introduce Composer, a new paradigm for adaptive generative modeling based on test-time instance-specific parameter composition. Composer generates input-conditioned parameter adaptations at inference time, which are injected into the pretrained model's weights, enabling per-input specialization without fine-tuning or retraining. Adaptation occurs once prior to multi-step generation, yielding higher-quality, context-aware outputs with minimal computational and memory overhead. Experiments show that Composer substantially improves performance across diverse generative models and use cases, including lightweight/quantized models and test-time scaling. By leveraging input-aware parameter composition, Composer establishes a new paradigm for designing generative models that dynamically adapt to each input, moving beyond static parameterization.

AI.tldr: Composer提出了一种新的自适应生成建模范式，通过测试时实例特定的参数组合，使生成模型能够根据每个输入动态调整参数，而不是依赖固定的预训练参数。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型（如扩散模型和自回归网络）本质上是静态的，依赖固定的预训练参数处理所有输入。而人类能够灵活地根据每个感知或想象情境调整内部生成表征。受此启发，作者希望开发能够根据输入动态适应的生成模型。
AI.method: Composer基于测试时实例特定的参数组合。它在推理时生成输入条件化的参数适配，将这些适配注入预训练模型的权重中，实现每个输入的专门化，无需微调或重新训练。适配在生成多步之前一次性完成，计算和内存开销最小。
AI.result: 实验表明，Composer显著提高了各种生成模型和用例的性能，包括轻量化/量化模型和测试时扩展。通过利用输入感知的参数组合，Composer能够产生更高质量、上下文感知的输出。
AI.conclusion: Composer通过输入感知的参数组合，建立了一种新的生成模型设计范式，使模型能够动态适应每个输入，超越了静态参数化的限制。

title: Gated Condition Injection without Multimodal Attention: Towards Controllable Linear-Attention Transformers
summary: Recent advances in diffusion-based controllable visual generation have led to remarkable improvements in image quality. However, these powerful models are typically deployed on cloud servers due to their large computational demands, raising serious concerns about user data privacy. To enable secure and efficient on-device generation, we explore in this paper controllable diffusion models built upon linear attention architectures, which offer superior scalability and efficiency, even on edge devices. Yet, our experiments reveal that existing controllable generation frameworks, such as ControlNet and OminiControl, either lack the flexibility to support multiple heterogeneous condition types or suffer from slow convergence on such linear-attention models. To address these limitations, we propose a novel controllable diffusion framework tailored for linear attention backbones like SANA. The core of our method lies in a unified gated conditioning module working in a dual-path pipeline, which effectively integrates multi-type conditional inputs, such as spatially aligned and non-aligned cues. Extensive experiments on multiple tasks and benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art controllable generation performance based on linear-attention models, surpassing existing methods in terms of fidelity and controllability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对线性注意力架构的新型可控扩散框架，解决了现有方法在边缘设备上部署时的隐私、效率和灵活性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于扩散的可控视觉生成模型通常部署在云端服务器，存在用户数据隐私风险。虽然线性注意力架构在边缘设备上具有更好的可扩展性和效率，但现有可控生成框架（如ControlNet和OminiControl）要么缺乏支持多种异构条件类型的灵活性，要么在线性注意力模型上收敛缓慢。
AI.method: 提出了一种专为线性注意力骨干网络（如SANA）设计的可控扩散框架。核心是一个在双路径管道中工作的统一门控条件模块，能够有效整合多种类型的条件输入，包括空间对齐和非对齐的线索。
AI.result: 在多个任务和基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该方法基于线性注意力模型实现了最先进的可控生成性能，在保真度和可控性方面超越了现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在边缘设备上实现安全高效的可控视觉生成提供了一种有效的解决方案，通过专门设计的线性注意力框架解决了隐私保护和计算效率的平衡问题。

title: Customized Visual Storytelling with Unified Multimodal LLMs
comment: Paper accepted to the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Generative AI for Storytelling (CVPRW)
summary: Multimodal story customization aims to generate coherent story flows conditioned on textual descriptions, reference identity images, and shot types. While recent progress in story generation has shown promising results, most approaches rely on text-only inputs. A few studies incorporate character identity cues (e.g., facial ID), but lack broader multimodal conditioning. In this work, we introduce VstoryGen, a multimodal framework that integrates descriptions with character and background references to enable customizable story generation. To enhance cinematic diversity, we introduce shot-type control via parameter-efficient prompt tuning on movie data, enabling the model to generate sequences that more faithfully reflect cinematic grammar. To evaluate our framework, we establish two new benchmarks that assess multimodal story customization from the perspectives of character and scene consistency, text-visual alignment, and shot-type control. Experiments demonstrate that VstoryGen achieves improved consistency and cinematic diversity compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: VstoryGen是一个多模态故事定制框架，通过整合文本描述、角色参考图像、背景参考和镜头类型控制，生成具有一致性和电影多样性的故事序列。
AI.motivation: 现有故事生成方法大多依赖纯文本输入，少数方法虽然包含角色身份线索（如面部ID），但缺乏更广泛的多模态条件控制。需要开发能够整合多种模态输入以实现可定制故事生成的框架。
AI.method: 提出VstoryGen多模态框架，整合文本描述、角色参考图像和背景参考。通过基于电影数据的参数高效提示调优引入镜头类型控制，使模型能更忠实地反映电影语法。
AI.result: 建立了两个新的基准测试，从角色和场景一致性、文本-视觉对齐以及镜头类型控制角度评估多模态故事定制。实验表明VstoryGen相比现有方法在一致性和电影多样性方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: VstoryGen通过整合多模态输入和镜头类型控制，实现了改进的故事定制能力，在一致性和电影多样性方面优于现有方法，为多模态故事生成提供了有效框架。

title: Ink Detection from Surface Topography of the Herculaneum Papyri
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Currently under review
summary: Reading the Herculaneum papyri is challenging because both the scrolls and the ink, which is carbon-based, are carbonized. In X-ray radiography and tomography, ink detection typically relies on density- or composition-driven contrast, but carbon ink on carbonized papyrus provides little attenuation contrast. Building on the morphological hypothesis, we show that the surface morphology of written regions contains enough signal to distinguish ink from papyrus. To this end, we train machine learning models on three-dimensional optical profilometry from mechanically opened Herculaneum papyri to separate inked and uninked areas. We further quantify how lateral sampling governs learnability and how a native-resolution model behaves on coarsened inputs. We show that high-resolution topography alone contains a usable signal for ink detection. Diminishing segmentation performance with decreasing lateral resolution provides insight into the characteristic spatial scales that must be resolved on our dataset to exploit the morphological signal. These findings inform spatial resolution targets for morphology-based reading of closed scrolls through X-ray tomography.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过机器学习分析赫库兰尼姆莎草纸的三维光学轮廓数据，证明仅凭高分辨率表面形态就能区分碳墨与碳化莎草纸区域，为通过X射线断层扫描读取未展开卷轴提供了空间分辨率目标。
AI.motivation: 赫库兰尼姆莎草纸的读取面临重大挑战，因为卷轴和碳基墨水都已碳化，在X射线成像中缺乏足够的衰减对比度。需要寻找新的方法来检测碳墨在碳化莎草纸上的存在。
AI.method: 研究采用机器学习方法，在机械展开的赫库兰尼姆莎草纸上训练三维光学轮廓测量模型，区分有墨和无墨区域。量化了横向采样对可学习性的影响，并分析了原生分辨率模型在粗化输入上的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现高分辨率地形数据本身包含可用于墨水检测的信号。随着横向分辨率降低，分割性能逐渐下降，这揭示了在数据集中必须解析的特征空间尺度，以利用形态信号。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为通过X射线断层扫描进行基于形态学的封闭卷轴读取提供了空间分辨率目标，证明表面形态学是检测碳墨在碳化莎草纸上存在的可行方法。

title: Look, Compare and Draw: Differential Query Transformer for Automatic Oil Painting
summary: This work introduces a new approach to automatic oil painting that emphasizes the creation of dynamic and expressive brushstrokes. A pivotal challenge lies in mitigating the duplicate and common-place strokes, which often lead to less aesthetic outcomes. Inspired by the human painting process, \ie, observing, comparing, and drawing, we incorporate differential image analysis into a neural oil painting model, allowing the model to effectively concentrate on the incremental impact of successive brushstrokes. To operationalize this concept, we propose the Differential Query Transformer (DQ-Transformer), a new architecture that leverages differentially derived image representations enriched with positional encoding to guide the stroke prediction process. This integration enables the model to maintain heightened sensitivity to local details, resulting in more refined and nuanced stroke generation. Furthermore, we incorporate adversarial training into our framework, enhancing the accuracy of stroke prediction and thereby improving the overall realism and fidelity of the synthesized paintings. Extensive qualitative evaluations, complemented by a controlled user study, validate that our DQ-Transformer surpasses existing methods in both visual realism and artistic authenticity, typically achieving these results with fewer strokes. The stroke-by-stroke painting animations are available on our project website.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于差分图像分析和Transformer架构的自动油画生成方法，通过关注连续笔触的增量变化来避免重复笔触，生成更具动态感和表现力的油画作品。
AI.motivation: 传统自动油画生成方法存在笔触重复和平庸的问题，导致美学效果不佳。受人类绘画过程中观察、比较、绘制三个步骤的启发，需要一种能够关注连续笔触增量变化的方法来提升油画生成质量。
AI.method: 提出差分查询Transformer（DQ-Transformer）架构，将差分图像分析与位置编码结合，引导笔触预测过程。同时引入对抗训练来提高笔触预测的准确性，增强生成油画的真实感和保真度。
AI.result: 通过广泛的定性评估和受控用户研究验证，DQ-Transformer在视觉真实性和艺术真实性方面均优于现有方法，通常使用更少的笔触就能达到更好的效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过差分图像分析和Transformer架构的结合，成功解决了自动油画生成中的笔触重复问题，实现了更具动态感和表现力的油画生成，为数字艺术创作提供了新的技术途径。

title: TIR-Agent: Training an Explorative and Efficient Agent for Image Restoration
summary: Vision-language agents that orchestrate specialized tools for image restoration (IR) have emerged as a promising method, yet most existing frameworks operate in a training-free manner. They rely on heuristic task scheduling and exhaustive tool traversal, resulting in sub-optimal restoration paths and prohibitive computational cost. We argue that the core bottleneck lies in the absence of a learned policy to make decision, as a vision-language model cannot efficiently handle degradation-aware task ordering and tool composition. To this end, we propose TIR-Agent, a trainable image restoration agent that performs a direct tool-calling policy through a two-stage training pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL). Two key designs underpin effective RL training: (i) a random perturbation strategy applied to the SFT data, which broadens the policy's exploration over task schedules and tool compositions, and (ii) a multi-dimensional adaptive reward mechanism that dynamically re-weights heterogeneous image quality metrics to mitigate reward hacking. To support high-throughput, asynchronous GPU-based tool invocation during training, we further develop a globally shared model-call pool. Experiments on both in-domain and out-of-domain degradations show that TIR-Agent outperforms 12 baselines, including 6 all-in-one models, 3 training-free agents, and 3 proprietary models, and achieves over 2.5$\times$ inference speedup by eliminating redundant tool executions.

AI.tldr: TIR-Agent：一种可训练的视觉语言图像修复智能体，通过两阶段训练（监督微调+强化学习）学习直接工具调用策略，相比现有训练免费方法，在修复质量和推理速度上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言图像修复智能体大多采用训练免费方式，依赖启发式任务调度和穷举工具遍历，导致修复路径次优且计算成本过高。核心瓶颈在于缺乏学习策略来做出决策，因为视觉语言模型无法高效处理退化感知的任务排序和工具组合。
AI.method: 提出TIR-Agent，采用两阶段训练管道：1）监督微调（SFT）阶段；2）强化学习（RL）阶段。关键设计包括：对SFT数据应用随机扰动策略以扩展策略探索范围，以及多维度自适应奖励机制动态调整异构图像质量指标的权重以防止奖励黑客。此外开发了全局共享模型调用池以支持训练期间的高吞吐量异步GPU工具调用。
AI.result: 在域内和域外退化测试中，TIR-Agent优于12个基线方法（包括6个一体化模型、3个训练免费智能体和3个专有模型），并通过消除冗余工具执行实现了超过2.5倍的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: TIR-Agent通过可学习的工具调用策略有效解决了现有训练免费图像修复智能体的局限性，在修复质量和计算效率方面均取得了显著提升，为智能图像修复系统提供了新的解决方案。

title: Data Organization Matters in Multimodal Instruction Tuning: A Controlled Study of Capability Trade-offs
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform strongly on general visual understanding, diagram and chart reasoning, and document-centric perception. However, these abilities are learned from heterogeneous supervision sources with very different task structures and learning demands, and the effect of their temporal organization during training remains underexplored. We study whether data organization affects the trade-off among general understanding, structured reasoning, and fine-grained OCR/document understanding in multimodal instruction tuning. To isolate this factor, we use a controlled three-stage training framework in which the backbone, trainable modules, and optimization pipeline are fixed across all runs, and only the temporal arrangement of post-alignment supervision is changed. We compare four strategies: direct mixture, curriculum training, balanced sampling, and reverse curriculum. Experiments on general visual instruction following, diagram reasoning, chart reasoning, scene-text question answering, and document question answering show that data organization is a first-order design variable in multimodal adaptation. Curriculum training gives the best overall trade-off and the strongest structured reasoning performance. Balanced sampling is better for OCR-oriented capability but weakens the broader capability balance. Reverse curriculum performs worst in both final performance and optimization stability. Training-dynamics analysis further suggests that building general understanding and reasoning before introducing OCR-intensive supervision leads to smoother optimization and faster convergence. These findings highlight data scheduling as an explicit design dimension for multimodal model adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了多模态大语言模型训练中数据组织方式对性能平衡的影响，发现课程训练策略在整体能力平衡和结构化推理方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型从异构监督源学习多种能力，但数据组织的时间安排对能力平衡的影响尚未充分探索。研究旨在确定数据组织是否影响通用理解、结构化推理和细粒度OCR/文档理解之间的权衡。
AI.method: 采用受控的三阶段训练框架，固定骨干网络、可训练模块和优化流程，仅改变后对齐监督的时间安排。比较四种策略：直接混合、课程训练、平衡采样和反向课程训练。在多个任务上进行实验评估。
AI.result: 课程训练提供最佳整体权衡和最强的结构化推理性能；平衡采样在OCR导向能力上更好但削弱了更广泛的能力平衡；反向课程训练在最终性能和优化稳定性方面表现最差。训练动态分析表明，在引入OCR密集型监督前建立通用理解和推理能力能带来更平滑的优化和更快收敛。
AI.conclusion: 数据组织是多模态适应的首要设计变量，数据调度应作为多模态模型适应的显式设计维度。课程训练策略在平衡多种能力方面最为有效。

title: RHO: Robust Holistic OSM-Based Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project page: https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/RHO
summary: Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization (MCVGL) aims to estimate the 3-DoF camera pose (position and heading) by matching ground and satellite images. In this work, instead of pinhole and satellite images, we study robust MCVGL using holistic panoramas and OpenStreetMap (OSM). To this end, we establish a large-scale MCVGL benchmark dataset, CV-RHO, with over 2.7M images under different weather and lighting conditions, as well as sensor noise. Furthermore, we propose a model termed RHO with a two-branch Pin-Pan architecture for accurate visual localization. A Split-Undistort-Merge (SUM) module is introduced to address the panoramic distortion, and a Position-Orientation Fusion (POF) mechanism is designed to enhance the localization accuracy. Extensive experiments prove the value of our CV-RHO dataset and the effectiveness of the RHO model, with a significant performance gain up to 20% compared with the state-of-the-art baselines. Project page: https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/RHO.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种使用全景图像和OpenStreetMap进行度量级跨视角地理定位的新方法，建立了CV-RHO大规模基准数据集，并设计了RHO模型，在性能上比现有方法提升高达20%。
AI.motivation: 传统度量级跨视角地理定位（MCVGL）主要使用针孔相机图像和卫星图像，本文研究使用全景图像和OpenStreetMap（OSM）来实现更鲁棒的MCVGL，以应对不同天气、光照条件和传感器噪声的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了RHO模型，采用双分支Pin-Pan架构：1）引入Split-Undistort-Merge（SUM）模块处理全景图像畸变；2）设计Position-Orientation Fusion（POF）机制提升定位精度；3）建立了包含270万张图像的大规模CV-RHO基准数据集。
AI.result: 实验证明CV-RHO数据集具有重要价值，RHO模型在度量级跨视角地理定位任务中表现出色，相比现有最先进基线方法性能提升高达20%。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过全景图像和OpenStreetMap实现了鲁棒的度量级跨视角地理定位，提出的CV-RHO数据集和RHO模型为相关研究提供了重要基准和技术方案，显著提升了地理定位的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: When Surfaces Lie: Exploiting Wrinkle-Induced Attention Shift to Attack Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional cross-modal understanding across various tasks, including zero-shot classification, image captioning, and visual question answering. However, their robustness to physically plausible non-rigid deformations-such as wrinkles on flexible surfaces-remains poorly understood. In this work, we propose a parametric structural perturbation method inspired by the mechanics of three-dimensional fabric wrinkles. Specifically, our method generates photorealistic non-rigid perturbations by constructing multi-scale wrinkle fields and integrating displacement field distortion with surface-consistent appearance variations. To achieve an optimal balance between visual naturalness and adversarial effectiveness, we design a hierarchical fitness function in a low-dimensional parameter space and employ an optimization-based search strategy. We evaluate our approach using a two-stage framework: perturbations are first optimized on a zero-shot classification proxy task and subsequently assessed for transferability on generative tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly degrades the performance of various state-of-the-art VLMs, consistently outperforming baselines in both image captioning and visual question-answering tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于织物褶皱力学的参数化结构扰动方法，用于评估视觉语言模型对非刚性形变的鲁棒性，并在图像描述和视觉问答任务中显著降低了SOTA模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 虽然视觉语言模型在各种跨模态任务中表现出色，但其对物理上合理的非刚性形变（如柔性表面褶皱）的鲁棒性尚未得到充分研究。作者旨在填补这一空白，探索VLMs对这类形变的脆弱性。
AI.method: 提出参数化结构扰动方法：1）基于三维织物褶皱力学构建多尺度褶皱场；2）结合位移场扭曲和表面一致的外观变化生成逼真的非刚性扰动；3）设计低维参数空间中的分层适应度函数；4）采用基于优化的搜索策略平衡视觉自然性和对抗效果。
AI.result: 实验采用两阶段评估框架：先在零样本分类代理任务上优化扰动，然后在生成任务上评估可迁移性。结果显示，该方法显著降低了多种SOTA视觉语言模型的性能，在图像描述和视觉问答任务中均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了视觉语言模型对物理合理非刚性形变的脆弱性，提出的参数化结构扰动方法能有效评估模型鲁棒性，为未来开发更稳健的跨模态系统提供了重要洞见。

title: RINO: Rotation-Invariant Non-Rigid Correspondences
comment: 17 pages, 36 Figures, Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Dense 3D shape correspondence remains a central challenge in computer vision and graphics as many deep learning approaches still rely on intermediate geometric features or handcrafted descriptors, limiting their effectiveness under non-isometric deformations, partial data, and non-manifold inputs. To overcome these issues, we introduce RINO, an unsupervised, rotation-invariant dense correspondence framework that effectively unifies rigid and non-rigid shape matching. The core of our method is the novel RINONet, a feature extractor that integrates vector-based SO(3)-invariant learning with orientation-aware complex functional maps to extract robust features directly from raw geometry. This allows for a fully end-to-end, data-driven approach that bypasses the need for shape pre-alignment or handcrafted features. Extensive experiments show unprecedented performance of RINO across challenging non-rigid matching tasks, including arbitrary poses, non-isometry, partiality, non-manifoldness, and noise.

AI.tldr: RINO是一个无监督的旋转不变密集对应框架，通过RINONet特征提取器结合向量SO(3)不变学习和方向感知复杂功能映射，直接从原始几何中提取鲁棒特征，无需形状预对齐或手工特征。
AI.motivation: 现有密集3D形状对应方法大多依赖中间几何特征或手工描述符，在非等距变形、部分数据和非流形输入下效果有限，需要克服这些限制。
AI.method: 提出RINO框架，核心是RINONet特征提取器，整合向量SO(3)不变学习和方向感知复杂功能映射，实现端到端数据驱动方法，无需形状预对齐或手工特征。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的非刚性匹配任务中表现出前所未有的性能，包括任意姿态、非等距性、部分性、非流形性和噪声情况。
AI.conclusion: RINO通过统一的旋转不变框架有效解决了刚性与非刚性形状匹配问题，为密集3D对应提供了强大的端到端解决方案。

title: GS3LAM: Gaussian Semantic Splatting SLAM
summary: Recently, the multi-modal fusion of RGB, depth, and semantics has shown great potential in dense Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). However, a prerequisite for generating consistent semantic maps is the availability of dense, efficient, and scalable scene representations. Existing semantic SLAM systems based on explicit representations are often limited by resolution and an inability to predict unknown areas. Conversely, implicit representations typically rely on time-consuming ray tracing, failing to meet real-time requirements. Fortunately, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a promising representation that combines the efficiency of point-based methods with the continuity of geometric structures. To this end, we propose GS3LAM, a Gaussian Semantic Splatting SLAM framework that processes multimodal data to render consistent, dense semantic maps in real-time. GS3LAM models the scene as a Semantic Gaussian Field (SG-Field) and jointly optimizes camera poses and the field via multimodal error constraints. Furthermore, a Depth-adaptive Scale Regularization (DSR) scheme is introduced to resolve misalignments between scale-invariant Gaussians and geometric surfaces. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, we propose a Random Sampling-based Keyframe Mapping (RSKM) strategy, which demonstrates superior performance over common local covisibility optimization methods. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that GS3LAM achieves increased tracking robustness, superior rendering quality, and enhanced semantic precision compared to state-of-the-art methods. Source code is available at https://github.com/lif314/GS3LAM.

AI.tldr: GS3LAM是一个基于3D高斯泼溅的语义SLAM框架，通过多模态融合实现实时、稠密的语义地图构建，解决了现有显式表示分辨率有限和隐式表示实时性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有语义SLAM系统存在局限性：基于显式表示的系统受限于分辨率和无法预测未知区域；基于隐式表示的系统依赖耗时的光线追踪，无法满足实时性要求。3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)结合了点云方法的效率和几何结构的连续性，为语义SLAM提供了有前景的表示方法。
AI.method: 1. 将场景建模为语义高斯场(SG-Field)；2. 通过多模态误差约束联合优化相机位姿和语义场；3. 引入深度自适应尺度正则化(DSR)解决尺度不变高斯与几何表面的不对齐问题；4. 提出基于随机采样的关键帧映射(RSKM)策略缓解灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，GS3LAM相比最先进方法具有：1. 更高的跟踪鲁棒性；2. 更优的渲染质量；3. 增强的语义精度。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: GS3LAM成功地将3D高斯泼溅应用于语义SLAM，实现了实时、稠密、一致的语义地图构建，解决了现有方法的局限性，在多模态融合、尺度对齐和灾难性遗忘缓解方面提出了创新解决方案。

title: Inference-time Trajectory Optimization for Manga Image Editing
summary: We present an inference-time adaptation method that tailors a pretrained image editing model to each input manga image using only the input image itself. Despite recent progress in pretrained image editing, such models often underperform on manga because they are trained predominantly on natural-image data. Re-training or fine-tuning large-scale models on manga is, however, generally impractical due to both computational cost and copyright constraints. To address this issue, our method slightly corrects the generation trajectory at inference time so that the input image can be reconstructed more faithfully under an empty prompt. Experimental results show that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines while incurring only negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出一种推理时自适应方法，仅使用输入图像本身就能将预训练图像编辑模型适配到每个输入漫画图像，无需重新训练或微调。
AI.motivation: 预训练图像编辑模型主要在自然图像数据上训练，对漫画图像表现不佳。重新训练或微调大型模型在漫画数据上不切实际，因为计算成本高且存在版权限制。
AI.method: 在推理时轻微修正生成轨迹，使输入图像在空提示下能够更忠实地重建。这种方法仅需输入图像本身，计算开销极小。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该方法在漫画图像编辑任务上持续优于现有基线方法，同时仅产生可忽略的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 提出的推理时自适应方法有效解决了预训练模型在漫画图像上的性能不足问题，无需重新训练或微调，具有实用性和高效性。

title: Diversity Matters: Dataset Diversification and Dual-Branch Network for Generalized AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: The rapid proliferation of AI-generated images, powered by generative adversarial networks (GANs), diffusion models, and other synthesis techniques, has raised serious concerns about misinformation, copyright violations, and digital security. However, detecting such images in a generalized and robust manner remains a major challenge due to the vast diversity of generative models and data distributions. In this work, we present \textbf{Diversity Matters}, a novel framework that emphasizes data diversity and feature domain complementarity for AI-generated image detection. The proposed method introduces a feature-domain similarity filtering mechanism that discards redundant or highly similar samples across both inter-class and intra-class distributions, ensuring a more diverse and representative training set. Furthermore, we propose a dual-branch network that combines CLIP features from the pixel domain and the frequency domain to jointly capture semantic and structural cues, leading to improved generalization against unseen generative models and adversarial conditions. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves cross-model and cross-dataset performance compared to existing methods. \textbf{Diversity Matters} highlights the critical role of data and feature diversity in building reliable and robust detectors against the rapidly evolving landscape of synthetic content.

AI.tldr: 提出Diversity Matters框架，通过数据多样性和特征域互补性改进AI生成图像检测，引入特征域相似性过滤机制和双分支网络，显著提升跨模型和跨数据集的检测性能。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像的快速扩散引发了虚假信息、版权侵犯和数字安全问题，但由于生成模型和数据分布的多样性，实现通用且鲁棒的检测仍然面临重大挑战。
AI.method: 1. 特征域相似性过滤机制：丢弃跨类内和类间分布中冗余或高度相似的样本，确保训练集更具多样性和代表性；2. 双分支网络：结合像素域和频域的CLIP特征，共同捕捉语义和结构线索。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法相比现有方法显著提高了跨模型和跨数据集的性能，证明了数据多样性和特征多样性在构建可靠鲁棒检测器中的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: Diversity Matters框架强调了数据和特征多样性在应对快速发展的合成内容领域中的重要性，为构建可靠且鲁棒的AI生成图像检测器提供了有效解决方案。

title: Tracking without Seeing: Geospatial Inference using Encrypted Traffic from Distributed Nodes
summary: Accurate observation of dynamic environments traditionally relies on synthesizing raw, signal-level information from multiple distributed sensors. This work investigates an alternative approach: performing geospatial inference using only encrypted packet-level information, without access to the raw sensory data. We further explore how this indirect information can be fused with directly available sensory data to extend overall inference capabilities. We introduce GraySense, a learning-based framework that performs geospatial object tracking by analyzing encrypted wireless video transmission traffic, such as packet sizes, from cameras with inaccessible streams. GraySense leverages the inherent relationship between scene dynamics and transmitted packet sizes to infer object motion. The framework consists of two stages: (1) a Packet Grouping module that identifies frame boundaries and estimates frame sizes from encrypted network traffic, and (2) a Tracker module, based on a Transformer encoder with a recurrent state, which fuses indirect packet-based inputs with optional direct camera-based inputs to estimate the object's position. Extensive experiments with realistic videos from the CARLA simulator and emulated networks under varying conditions show that GraySense achieves 2.33 meters tracking error (Euclidean distance) without raw signal access, within the dimensions of tracked objects (4.61m x 1.93m). To our knowledge, this capability has not been previously demonstrated, expanding the use of latent signals for sensing.

AI.tldr: GraySense框架通过分析加密无线视频传输流量（如数据包大小）进行地理空间物体跟踪，无需访问原始视频流，结合可选直接摄像头输入实现2.33米跟踪误差
AI.motivation: 传统动态环境观测依赖多个分布式传感器的原始信号级信息融合，本研究探索仅使用加密数据包级信息进行地理空间推理的替代方法，并研究如何将这种间接信息与直接可用传感器数据融合以扩展整体推理能力
AI.method: 提出GraySense学习框架，利用场景动态与传输数据包大小之间的固有关系推断物体运动。框架包含两个阶段：(1) 数据包分组模块识别帧边界并估计帧大小；(2) 基于Transformer编码器和循环状态的跟踪器模块，融合间接数据包输入与可选直接摄像头输入来估计物体位置
AI.result: 在CARLA模拟器和模拟网络的不同条件下进行广泛实验，GraySense在无法访问原始信号的情况下实现了2.33米跟踪误差（欧几里得距离），在跟踪物体尺寸范围内（4.61m x 1.93m）。这是首次展示这种能力
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了仅使用加密数据包级信息进行地理空间物体跟踪的可行性，扩展了潜在信号在感知中的应用，为隐私保护环境下的环境感知提供了新方法

title: MuSEAgent: A Multimodal Reasoning Agent with Stateful Experiences
summary: Research agents have recently achieved significant progress in information seeking and synthesis across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. In this paper, we introduce MuSEAgent, a multimodal reasoning agent that enhances decision-making by extending the capabilities of research agents to discover and leverage stateful experiences. Rather than relying on trajectory-level retrieval, we propose a stateful experience learning paradigm that abstracts interaction data into atomic decision experiences through hindsight reasoning. These experiences are organized into a quality-filtered experience bank that supports policy-driven experience retrieval at inference time. Specifically, MuSEAgent enables adaptive experience exploitation through complementary wide- and deep-search strategies, allowing the agent to dynamically retrieve multimodal guidance across diverse compositional semantic viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MuSEAgent consistently outperforms strong trajectory-level experience retrieval baselines on both fine-grained visual perception and complex multimodal reasoning tasks. These results validate the effectiveness of stateful experience modeling in improving multimodal agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: MuSEAgent是一个多模态推理智能体，通过状态化经验学习范式提升决策能力，将交互数据抽象为原子决策经验，并通过互补的宽搜索和深搜索策略实现自适应经验利用。
AI.motivation: 研究智能体在异构文本和视觉源的信息搜索与合成方面取得了显著进展，但现有方法主要依赖轨迹级检索。本文旨在通过引入状态化经验学习范式，将交互数据抽象为原子决策经验，从而提升多模态推理智能体的决策能力。
AI.method: 提出状态化经验学习范式，通过后见之明推理将交互数据抽象为原子决策经验，组织成质量过滤的经验库。在推理时支持策略驱动的经验检索，通过互补的宽搜索和深搜索策略实现自适应经验利用，允许智能体跨多样组合语义视角动态检索多模态指导。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MuSEAgent在细粒度视觉感知和复杂多模态推理任务上，始终优于强大的轨迹级经验检索基线方法。这些结果验证了状态化经验建模在改进多模态智能体推理方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MuSEAgent通过状态化经验学习范式显著提升了多模态推理智能体的决策能力，将交互数据抽象为原子决策经验并通过自适应检索策略实现更好的多模态推理性能。

title: 3-D Representations for Hyperspectral Flame Tomography
summary: Flame tomography is a compelling approach for extracting large amounts of data from experiments via 3-D thermochemical reconstruction. Recent efforts employing neural-network flame representations have suggested improved reconstruction quality compared with classical tomography approaches, but a rigorous quantitative comparison with the same algorithm using a voxel-grid representation has not been conducted. Here, we compare a classical voxel-grid representation with varying regularizers to a continuous neural representation for tomographic reconstruction of a simulated pool fire. The representations are constructed to give temperature and composition as a function of location, and a subsequent ray-tracing step is used to solve the radiative transfer equation to determine the spectral intensity incident on hyperspectral infrared cameras, which is then convolved with an instrument lineshape function. We demonstrate that the voxel-grid approach with a total-variation regularizer reproduces the ground-truth synthetic flame with the highest accuracy for reduced memory intensity and runtime. Future work will explore more representations and under experimental configurations.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了体素网格表示与神经网络表示在火焰断层扫描重建中的性能，发现带有总变分正则化的体素网格方法在内存使用和运行时间方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 虽然最近使用神经网络火焰表示的研究表明比经典断层扫描方法有改进，但尚未与使用体素网格表示的相同算法进行严格的定量比较。需要系统评估不同表示方法在火焰断层扫描重建中的性能差异。
AI.method: 比较经典体素网格表示（使用不同正则化器）与连续神经表示在模拟池火断层扫描重建中的性能。两种表示都构建为位置函数来输出温度和成分，然后通过光线追踪求解辐射传输方程，获得高光谱红外相机上的光谱强度，再与仪器线形函数卷积。
AI.result: 带有总变分正则化的体素网格方法在减少内存强度和运行时间的情况下，以最高精度再现了地面真实合成火焰。
AI.conclusion: 体素网格表示配合总变分正则化在火焰断层扫描重建中表现最优，未来研究将探索更多表示方法和实验配置。

title: Wan-R1: Verifiable-Reinforcement Learning for Video Reasoning
summary: Video generation models produce visually coherent content but struggle with tasks requiring spatial reasoning and multi-step planning. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a path to improve generalization, but its effectiveness in video reasoning hinges on reward design -- a challenge that has received little systematic study. We investigate this problem by adapting Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to flow-based video models and training them on maze-solving and robotic navigation tasks. We first show that multimodal reward models fail catastrophically in this setting. To address this, we design verifiable reward functions grounded in objective task metrics. For structured game environments, we introduce a multi-component trajectory reward. For robotic navigation, we propose an embedding-level verifiable reward. Our experiments show that RL fine-tuning with verifiable rewards improves generalization. For example, on complex 3D mazes, our model improves exact match accuracy by 29.1\% over the SFT baseline, and on trap-avoidance tasks by 51.4\%. Our systematic reward analysis reveals that verifiable rewards are critical for stable training, while multimodal reward models could lead to degenerate solutions. These findings establish verifiable reward design as a key enabler for robust video reasoning. Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了视频生成模型在空间推理和多步规划任务中的局限性，通过将GRPO算法应用于基于流的视频模型，并设计可验证的奖励函数来改善强化学习在视频推理中的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型虽然能产生视觉连贯的内容，但在需要空间推理和多步规划的任务上表现不佳。强化学习提供了改善泛化能力的途径，但其在视频推理中的有效性取决于奖励设计，而这一问题尚未得到系统研究。
AI.method: 将Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)算法适配到基于流的视频模型，并在迷宫求解和机器人导航任务上进行训练。针对多模态奖励模型失败的问题，设计了基于客观任务指标的可验证奖励函数：对于结构化游戏环境使用多组件轨迹奖励，对于机器人导航使用嵌入级别的可验证奖励。
AI.result: 使用可验证奖励进行RL微调显著改善了泛化性能：在复杂3D迷宫中，模型相比SFT基线提高了29.1%的精确匹配准确率；在陷阱规避任务中提高了51.4%。实验表明可验证奖励对稳定训练至关重要，而多模态奖励模型可能导致退化解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 可验证奖励设计是实现稳健视频推理的关键推动因素。系统性的奖励分析揭示了可验证奖励对于稳定训练的重要性，为视频推理任务的强化学习应用提供了重要指导。

title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Grounded Decoding for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) frequently suffer from hallucinations, generating content that is inconsistent with visual inputs. Existing methods typically address this problem through post-hoc filtering, additional training objectives, or external verification, but they do not intervene during the decoding process when hallucinations arise. In this work, we introduce SAGE, a Sink-Aware Grounded Decoding framework that mitigates hallucinations by dynamically modulating self-attention during generation. Hallucinations are strongly correlated with attention sink tokens - punctuation or function tokens that accumulate disproportionate attention despite carrying limited semantic content. SAGE leverages these tokens as anchors to monitor grounding reliability in real time. At each sink trigger, the method extracts semantic concepts from the generated sequence, estimates their visual grounding using both self-attention maps and gradient-based attribution, and measures their spatial agreement. Based on this signal, self-attention distributions are adaptively sharpened or broadened to reinforce grounded regions or suppress unreliable ones. Extensive experiments across diverse hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that SAGE consistently outperforms existing decoding strategies, achieving substantial reductions in hallucination while preserving descriptive coverage, without requiring model retraining or architectural modifications. Our method achieves an average relative improvement of 10.65% on MSCOCO and 7.19% on AMBER across diverse VLM architectures, demonstrating consistent gains in hallucination mitigation.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一种解码时干预框架，通过动态调节自注意力来减少视觉语言模型的幻觉，利用注意力汇点标记实时监测视觉基础可靠性，无需重新训练模型。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常在解码后处理幻觉问题，但不在解码过程中干预。视觉语言模型经常产生与视觉输入不一致的幻觉内容，需要一种在生成过程中实时干预的方法。
AI.method: SAGE框架利用注意力汇点标记（标点或功能标记）作为锚点，实时监测基础可靠性。在每个汇点触发时，从生成序列中提取语义概念，使用自注意力图和基于梯度的归因估计其视觉基础，并测量空间一致性。基于此信号，自适应地锐化或拓宽自注意力分布，以增强基础区域或抑制不可靠区域。
AI.result: 在多个幻觉基准测试中，SAGE始终优于现有解码策略，显著减少幻觉同时保持描述覆盖率。在MSCOCO上平均相对改进10.65%，在AMBER上改进7.19%，适用于多种VLM架构。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过解码时动态调节自注意力，有效缓解视觉语言模型的幻觉问题，无需模型重新训练或架构修改，提供了一种实时干预的新方法。

title: Rényi Entropy: A New Token Pruning Metric for Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve state-of-the-art performance but suffer from the $O(N^2)$ complexity of self-attention, making inference costly for high-resolution inputs. To address this bottleneck, token pruning has emerged as a critical technique to accelerate inference. Most existing methods rely on the [CLS] token to estimate patch importance. However, we argue that the [CLS] token can be unreliable in early layers where semantic representations are still immature. As a result, pruning in the early layer often leads to inaccurate importance estimation and unnecessary information loss. In this work, we propose a training-free token importance metric, namely Col-Ln, which is derived from Rényi entropy that enables the identification of informative tokens from the first layer of the network, thereby enabling more reliable pruning in token reduction. Extensive experiments on ViTs and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods across diverse benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Col-Ln的训练免费令牌重要性度量方法，基于Rényi熵从网络第一层识别信息丰富的令牌，解决了早期层使用[CLS]令牌进行剪枝时重要性估计不准确的问题。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformers (ViTs) 虽然性能优异，但自注意力机制的O(N²)复杂度导致高分辨率输入推理成本高昂。现有令牌剪枝方法依赖[CLS]令牌估计补丁重要性，但在早期层中[CLS]令牌的语义表示尚不成熟，导致重要性估计不准确和不必要的信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出Col-Ln方法，这是一种基于Rényi熵的训练免费令牌重要性度量，能够从网络第一层识别信息丰富的令牌，从而实现更可靠的令牌剪枝。
AI.result: 在ViTs和大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)上的广泛实验表明，该方法在多样化基准测试中始终优于最先进的剪枝方法。
AI.conclusion: Col-Ln方法通过从网络早期层准确识别信息丰富的令牌，解决了现有基于[CLS]令牌的剪枝方法在早期层的重要性估计不可靠问题，为加速ViTs推理提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: BINO: Encoder Centric Self Supervised Stereo With Native Pair Input
summary: Stereo needs features that preserve fine cross view correspondence rather than only semantic similarity. Recent self supervised vision models transfer well, but they are not built for this goal, and geometry focused methods often rely on a binocular decoder or another explicit linkage module during pretraining. BINO asks whether strong binocular structure can instead be learned inside a compact encoder. It does this by fusing the rectified pair at the input stage, forming stereo micro cell tokens, and using a row aware patch phase positional encoding. Training uses one view masked token only distillation together with occlusion and view specific appearance mismatch. In a strict low resource setting with pretraining only on KITTI object, BINO gives the best frozen descriptor results under a no linkage probe among all compared baselines on proxy dense stereo, hard negative retrieval, and KITTI Stereo~2012 disparity. With the same lightweight stereo head for every encoder, it stays near CroCo~v2 while using a much smaller encoder. Supplementary transfer experiments on KITTI Stereo~2015 show the same qualitative trend. These results suggest that much of the cross view reasoning often assigned to a separate linkage module can be learned inside a compact and reusable encoder.

AI.tldr: BINO提出了一种紧凑编码器，通过融合立体图像对、使用行感知位置编码和遮挡感知训练，在低资源设置下实现了无需显式双目连接模块的强立体结构学习。
AI.motivation: 立体视觉需要能够保持精细跨视图对应关系的特征，而不仅仅是语义相似性。现有自监督视觉模型虽然迁移性好，但并非为此目标设计，而专注于几何的方法通常依赖显式的双目连接模块。BINO探索是否可以将强双目结构学习嵌入到紧凑编码器中。
AI.method: 1) 在输入阶段融合校正后的立体图像对，形成立体微单元标记；2) 使用行感知补丁相位位置编码；3) 训练采用单视图掩码标记蒸馏，结合遮挡和视图特定外观不匹配；4) 在KITTI对象数据集上进行低资源预训练。
AI.result: 在严格的低资源设置下，BINO在无连接探针评估中，在代理密集立体、困难负样本检索和KITTI Stereo 2012视差任务上均取得最佳冻结描述符结果。使用相同轻量级立体头部时，性能接近CroCo v2但编码器更小。在KITTI Stereo 2015上的补充实验显示相同定性趋势。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通常分配给单独连接模块的大部分跨视图推理能力可以在紧凑且可重用的编码器内部学习，为立体视觉特征学习提供了新的方向。

title: Spatial Orthogonal Refinement for Robust RGB-Event Visual Object Tracking
comment: Joint International Conference on Automation-Intelligence-Safety and International Symposium on Autonomous Systems 2026 (ICAIS and ISAS 2026)
summary: Robust visual object tracking (VOT) remains challenging in high-speed motion scenarios, where conventional RGB sensors suffer from severe motion blur and performance degradation. Event cameras, with microsecond temporal resolution and high dynamic range, provide complementary structural cues that can potentially compensate for these limitations. However, existing RGB-Event fusion methods typically treat event data as dense intensity representations and adopt black-box fusion strategies, failing to explicitly leverage the directional geometric priors inherently encoded in event streams to rectify degraded RGB features. To address this limitation, we propose SOR-Track, a streamlined framework for robust RGB-Event tracking based on Spatial Orthogonal Refinement (SOR). The core SOR module employs a set of orthogonal directional filters that are dynamically guided by local motion orientations to extract sharp and motion-consistent structural responses from event streams. These responses serve as geometric anchors to modulate and refine aliased RGB textures through an asymmetric structural modulation mechanism, thereby explicitly bridging structural discrepancies between two modalities. Extensive experiments on the large-scale FE108 benchmark demonstrate that SOR-Track consistently outperforms existing fusion-based trackers, particularly under motion blur and low-light conditions. Despite its simplicity, the proposed method offers a principled and physics-grounded approach to multi-modal feature alignment and texture rectification. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenEvTracking

AI.tldr: SOR-Track：基于空间正交细化的RGB-事件融合跟踪框架，通过动态引导的正交方向滤波器从事件流中提取几何结构线索，用于修正模糊的RGB特征，在高速运动场景中实现鲁棒跟踪。
AI.motivation: 传统RGB传感器在高速运动场景中易受运动模糊影响，性能下降。事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率和高动态范围，但现有融合方法通常将事件数据视为密集强度表示，未能充分利用事件流中固有的方向几何先验来修正退化的RGB特征。
AI.method: 提出SOR-Track框架，核心是空间正交细化(SOR)模块。该模块使用一组正交方向滤波器，根据局部运动方向动态引导，从事件流中提取锐利且运动一致的结构响应。这些响应作为几何锚点，通过非对称结构调制机制来调制和细化混叠的RGB纹理，显式地桥接两种模态之间的结构差异。
AI.result: 在大型FE108基准测试上的大量实验表明，SOR-Track始终优于现有的基于融合的跟踪器，特别是在运动模糊和低光照条件下。尽管方法简单，但提供了一种基于物理原理的多模态特征对齐和纹理修正方法。
AI.conclusion: SOR-Track通过显式利用事件流中的方向几何先验来修正RGB特征，为高速运动场景下的鲁棒视觉目标跟踪提供了一种有效且物理基础的方法。该方法在运动模糊和低光条件下表现优异，代码将在GitHub上开源。

title: FlashSign: Pose-Free Guidance for Efficient Sign Language Video Generation
summary: Sign language plays a crucial role in bridging communication gaps between the deaf and hard-of-hearing communities. However, existing sign language video generation models often rely on complex intermediate representations, which limits their flexibility and efficiency. In this work, we propose a novel pose-free framework for real-time sign language video generation. Our method eliminates the need for intermediate pose representations by directly mapping natural language text to sign language videos using a diffusion-based approach. We introduce two key innovations: (1) a pose-free generative model based on the a state-of-the-art diffusion backbone, which learns implicit text-to-gesture alignments without pose estimation, and (2) a Trainable Sliding Tile Attention (T-STA) mechanism that accelerates inference by exploiting spatio-temporal locality patterns. Unlike previous training-free sparsity approaches, T-STA integrates trainable sparsity into both training and inference, ensuring consistency and eliminating the train-test gap. This approach significantly reduces computational overhead while maintaining high generation quality, making real-time deployment feasible. Our method increases video generation speed by 3.07x without compromising video quality. Our contributions open new avenues for real-time, high-quality, pose-free sign language synthesis, with potential applications in inclusive communication tools for diverse communities. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/FlashSign.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无姿态的实时手语视频生成框架，通过扩散模型直接映射文本到手语视频，无需中间姿态表示，使用可训练滑动瓦片注意力机制加速推理，生成速度提升3.07倍
AI.motivation: 现有手语视频生成模型依赖复杂的中间表示，限制了灵活性和效率。需要开发更直接、高效的实时手语生成方法
AI.method: 基于扩散模型的无姿态生成框架，直接映射自然语言文本到手语视频；引入可训练滑动瓦片注意力机制，在训练和推理中集成可训练稀疏性，利用时空局部性模式加速
AI.result: 视频生成速度提升3.07倍，不损害视频质量；实现了实时部署可行性；消除了训练-测试差距
AI.conclusion: 该方法为实时、高质量、无姿态的手语合成开辟了新途径，在包容性通信工具中具有应用潜力

title: RehearsalNeRF: Decoupling Intrinsic Neural Fields of Dynamic Illuminations for Scene Editing
comment: Accepted to the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Changyeon Won and Hyunjun Jung contributed equally to this work
summary: Although there has been significant progress in neural radiance fields, an issue on dynamic illumination changes still remains unsolved. Different from relevant works that parameterize time-variant/-invariant components in scenes, subjects' radiance is highly entangled with their own emitted radiance and lighting colors in spatio-temporal domain. In this paper, we present a new effective method to learn disentangled neural fields under the severe illumination changes, named RehearsalNeRF. Our key idea is to leverage scenes captured under stable lighting like rehearsal stages, easily taken before dynamic illumination occurs, to enforce geometric consistency between the different lighting conditions. In particular, RehearsalNeRF employs a learnable vector for lighting effects which represents illumination colors in a temporal dimension and is used to disentangle projected light colors from scene radiance. Furthermore, our RehearsalNeRF is also able to reconstruct the neural fields of dynamic objects by simply adopting off-the-shelf interactive masks. To decouple the dynamic objects, we propose a new regularization leveraging optical flow, which provides coarse supervision for the color disentanglement. We demonstrate the effectiveness of RehearsalNeRF by showing robust performances on novel view synthesis and scene editing under dynamic illumination conditions. Our source code and video datasets will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: RehearsalNeRF：一种在动态光照变化下学习解耦神经辐射场的新方法，利用稳定光照场景（排练阶段）实现几何一致性，通过可学习光照向量解耦光照颜色与场景辐射，支持动态物体重建和场景编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有神经辐射场方法在处理动态光照变化时仍存在问题，场景中物体的辐射与其自身发射的辐射以及光照颜色在时空域中高度纠缠，需要一种有效的方法来在剧烈光照变化下学习解耦的神经场。
AI.method: 提出RehearsalNeRF方法：1）利用稳定光照条件下捕获的场景（排练阶段）强制不同光照条件间的几何一致性；2）使用可学习光照向量表示时间维度上的光照颜色，用于从场景辐射中解耦投射的光照颜色；3）采用现成的交互式掩码重建动态物体的神经场；4）提出基于光流的新正则化方法，为颜色解耦提供粗略监督。
AI.result: RehearsalNeRF在动态光照条件下的新视角合成和场景编辑方面表现出鲁棒性能，能够有效处理剧烈光照变化，并支持动态物体的重建和解耦。
AI.conclusion: RehearsalNeRF是一种有效的动态光照变化下神经场解耦方法，通过利用排练阶段场景和可学习光照向量，成功解决了光照颜色与场景辐射的纠缠问题，同时支持动态物体处理，为复杂光照条件下的场景重建和编辑提供了新解决方案。

title: MathGen: Revealing the Illusion of Mathematical Competence through Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Modern generative models have demonstrated the ability to solve challenging mathematical problems. In many real-world settings, however, mathematical solutions must be expressed visually through diagrams, plots, geometric constructions, and structured symbolic layouts, where correctness depends on precise visual composition. Can generative models still do so when the answer must be rendered visually rather than written in text? To study this problem, we introduce MathGen, a rigorous benchmark of 900 problems spanning seven core domains, each paired with an executable verifier under a Script-as-a-Judge protocol for deterministic and objective evaluation. Experiments on representative open-source and proprietary text-to-image models show that mathematical fidelity remains a major bottleneck: even the best closed-source model reaches only 42.0% overall accuracy, while open-source models achieve just ~ 1-11%, often near 0% on structured tasks. Overall, current T2I models remain far from competent at even elementary mathematical visual generation.

AI.tldr: 论文引入MathGen基准测试，评估生成模型在需要视觉呈现的数学问题上的表现，发现当前文本到图像模型在数学视觉生成方面存在显著瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 研究生成模型在需要视觉表达（如图表、几何构造、符号布局）而非纯文本的数学问题上的能力，因为许多实际数学解决方案需要精确的视觉呈现。
AI.method: 创建MathGen基准测试，包含7个核心领域的900个问题，采用Script-as-a-Judge协议配合可执行验证器进行确定性和客观评估。
AI.result: 实验显示数学保真度是主要瓶颈：最佳闭源模型总体准确率仅42.0%，开源模型仅1-11%，结构化任务上接近0%，当前T2I模型在基础数学视觉生成方面仍远未胜任。
AI.conclusion: 当前文本到图像模型在需要精确视觉呈现的数学问题生成方面能力有限，数学保真度是主要挑战，需要进一步研究改进。

title: ExFusion: Efficient Transformer Training via Multi-Experts Fusion
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models substantially improve performance by increasing the capacity of dense architectures. However, directly training MoE models requires considerable computational resources and introduces extra overhead in parameter storage and deployment. Therefore, it is critical to develop an approach that leverages the multi-expert capability of MoE to enhance performance while incurring minimal additional cost. To this end, we propose a novel pre-training approach, termed ExFusion, which improves the efficiency of Transformer training through multi-expert fusion. Specifically, during the initialization phase, ExFusion upcycles the feed-forward network (FFN) of the Transformer into a multi-expert configuration, where each expert is assigned a weight for later parameter fusion. During training, these weights allow multiple experts to be fused into a single unified expert equivalent to the original FFN, which is subsequently used for forward computation. As a result, ExFusion introduces multi-expert characteristics into the training process while incurring only marginal computational cost compared to standard dense training. After training, the learned weights are used to integrate multi-experts into a single unified expert, thereby eliminating additional overhead in storage and deployment. Extensive experiments on a variety of computer vision and natural language processing tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: ExFusion是一种新颖的预训练方法，通过将Transformer的FFN升级为多专家配置，在训练过程中引入多专家特性，但计算成本仅略高于标准密集训练，最终融合为单一专家以消除存储和部署开销。
AI.motivation: MoE模型通过增加密集架构的容量显著提升性能，但直接训练MoE模型需要大量计算资源，并引入额外的参数存储和部署开销。因此需要开发一种既能利用MoE多专家能力提升性能，又能最小化额外成本的方法。
AI.method: ExFusion在初始化阶段将Transformer的FFN升级为多专家配置，每个专家分配一个权重用于后续参数融合。训练过程中，这些权重允许将多个专家融合成单个统一专家（相当于原始FFN），用于前向计算。训练后，使用学习到的权重将多专家整合为单一专家。
AI.result: 在多种计算机视觉和自然语言处理任务上的广泛实验证明了该方法的有效性。ExFusion在训练过程中引入了多专家特性，但计算成本仅略高于标准密集训练，最终消除了存储和部署的额外开销。
AI.conclusion: ExFusion提供了一种高效利用MoE多专家能力的方法，在保持接近密集训练计算成本的同时提升模型性能，并避免了MoE模型的存储和部署开销问题。

title: Learning Multi-View Spatial Reasoning from Cross-View Relations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive results on single-view vision tasks, but lack the multi-view spatial reasoning capabilities essential for embodied AI systems to understand 3D environments and manipulate objects across different viewpoints. In this work, we introduce Cross-View Relations (XVR), a large-scale dataset designed to teach VLMs spatial reasoning across multiple views. XVR comprises 100K vision-question-answer samples derived from 18K diverse 3D scenes and 70K robotic manipulation trajectories, spanning three fundamental spatial reasoning tasks: Correspondence (matching objects across views), Verification (validating spatial relationships), and Localization (identifying object positions). VLMs fine-tuned on XVR achieve substantial improvements on established multi-view and robotic spatial reasoning benchmarks (MindCube and RoboSpatial). When integrated as backbones in Vision-Language-Action models, XVR-trained representations improve success rates on RoboCasa. Our results demonstrate that explicit training on cross-view spatial relations significantly enhances multi-view reasoning and transfers effectively to real-world robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: XVR是一个大规模跨视图空间推理数据集，用于提升视觉语言模型在多视角3D环境中的空间推理能力，显著改善了机器人操作性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在单视图任务上表现出色，但缺乏多视图空间推理能力，这对于具身AI系统理解3D环境和跨视角操作物体至关重要。
AI.method: 构建了包含10万个视觉-问题-答案样本的XVR数据集，源自1.8万个多样3D场景和7万条机器人操作轨迹，涵盖对应关系、验证和定位三个核心空间推理任务。
AI.result: 在XVR上微调的视觉语言模型在MindCube和RoboSpatial等多视图和机器人空间推理基准测试中取得显著提升；作为视觉-语言-动作模型的骨干网络时，提高了RoboCasa的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 对跨视图空间关系的显式训练能显著增强多视图推理能力，并能有效迁移到真实世界的机器人操作任务中。

title: RetinexDualV2: Physically-Grounded Dual Retinex for Generalized UHD Image Restoration
summary: We propose RetinexDualV2, a unified, physically grounded dual-branch framework for diverse Ultra-High-Definition (UHD) image restoration. Unlike generic models, our method employs a Task-Specific Physical Grounding Module (TS-PGM) to extract degradation-aware priors (e.g., rain masks and dark channels). These explicitly guide a Retinex decomposition network via a novel Physical-conditioned Multi-head Self-Attention (PC-MSA) mechanism, enabling robust reflection and illumination correction. This physical conditioning allows a single architecture to handle various complex degradations seamlessly, without task-specific structural modifications. RetinexDualV2 demonstrates exceptional generalizability, securing 4\textsuperscript{th} place in the NTIRE 2026 Day and Night Raindrop Removal Challenge and 5\textsuperscript{th} place in the Joint Noise Low-light Enhancement (JNLLIE) Challenge. Extensive experiments confirm the state-of-the-art performance and efficiency of our physically motivated approach.

AI.tldr: RetinexDualV2是一个基于物理原理的双分支框架，用于超高分辨率图像恢复，通过任务特定物理基础模块提取退化感知先验，使用物理条件多头自注意力机制指导Retinex分解网络，实现单一架构处理多种复杂退化问题。
AI.motivation: 当前通用模型在处理超高分辨率图像恢复时缺乏对特定退化类型的针对性，需要一种能够统一处理多种复杂退化（如雨滴、低光照噪声等）且具有物理基础的框架。
AI.method: 提出RetinexDualV2框架，包含任务特定物理基础模块(TS-PGM)提取退化感知先验（雨掩码、暗通道等），通过物理条件多头自注意力机制(PC-MSA)指导Retinex分解网络进行反射和光照校正。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 2026日夜间雨滴去除挑战赛中获得第4名，在联合噪声低光照增强挑战赛中获得第5名，实验证明该方法在性能和效率方面达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: RetinexDualV2通过物理基础的双分支框架实现了对多种复杂图像退化问题的统一处理，展示了卓越的泛化能力和实际应用价值。

title: CLIP-AUTT: Test-Time Personalization with Action Unit Prompting for Fine-Grained Video Emotion Recognition
summary: Personalization in emotion recognition (ER) is essential for an accurate interpretation of subtle and subject-specific expressive patterns. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP demonstrate strong potential for leveraging joint image-text representations in ER. However, CLIP-based methods either depend on CLIP's contrastive pretraining or on LLMs to generate descriptive text prompts, which are noisy, computationally expensive, and fail to capture fine-grained expressions, leading to degraded performance. In this work, we leverage Action Units (AUs) as structured textual prompts within CLIP to model fine-grained facial expressions. AUs encode the subtle muscle activations underlying expressions, providing localized and interpretable semantic cues for more robust ER. We introduce CLIP-AU, a lightweight AU-guided temporal learning method that integrates interpretable AU semantics into CLIP. It learns generic, subject-agnostic representations by aligning AU prompts with facial dynamics, enabling fine-grained ER without CLIP fine-tuning or LLM-generated text supervision. Although CLIP-AU models fine-grained AU semantics, it does not adapt to subject-specific variability in subtle expressions. To address this limitation, we propose CLIP-AUTT, a video-based test-time personalization method that dynamically adapts AU prompts to videos from unseen subjects. By combining entropy-guided temporal window selection with prompt tuning, CLIP-AUTT enables subject-specific adaptation while preserving temporal consistency. Our extensive experiments on three challenging video-based subtle ER datasets, BioVid, StressID, and BAH, indicate that CLIP-AU and CLIP-AUTT outperform state-of-the-art CLIP-based FER and TTA methods, achieving robust and personalized subtle ER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CLIP-AU和CLIP-AUTT两种方法，利用动作单元作为结构化文本提示，在CLIP模型中实现细粒度情感识别，并通过测试时个性化适应不同个体的表达模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的情感识别方法要么依赖对比预训练，要么使用LLM生成文本提示，这些方法存在噪声大、计算成本高、无法捕捉细粒度表情的问题，导致性能下降。需要一种能够捕捉细粒度面部表情并适应个体差异的个性化情感识别方法。
AI.method:
1. CLIP-AU：利用动作单元作为结构化文本提示，将可解释的AU语义整合到CLIP中，通过对齐AU提示与面部动态学习通用、主体无关的表征。
2. CLIP-AUTT：基于视频的测试时个性化方法，通过熵引导的时间窗口选择和提示调优，动态调整AU提示以适应未见主体的视频，同时保持时间一致性。
AI.result: 在三个具有挑战性的视频细粒度情感识别数据集（BioVid、StressID、BAH）上的实验表明，CLIP-AU和CLIP-AUTT超越了最先进的基于CLIP的面部表情识别和测试时间适应方法，实现了鲁棒且个性化的细粒度情感识别。
AI.conclusion: 通过将动作单元作为结构化文本提示整合到CLIP中，并引入测试时个性化适应，本文提出的方法能够有效捕捉细粒度面部表情并适应个体差异，为个性化情感识别提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Physically Inspired Gaussian Splatting for HDR Novel View Synthesis
summary: High dynamic range novel view synthesis (HDR-NVS) reconstructs scenes with dynamic details by fusing multi-exposure low dynamic range (LDR) views, yet it struggles to capture ambient illumination-dependent appearance.
