Implicitly supervising HDR content by constraining tone-mapped results fails in correcting abnormal HDR values, and results in limited gradients for Gaussians in under/over-exposed regions. To this end, we introduce PhysHDR-GS, a physically inspired HDR-NVS framework that models scene appearance via intrinsic reflectance and adjustable ambient illumination. PhysHDR-GS employs a complementary image-exposure (IE) branch and Gaussian-illumination (GI) branch to faithfully reproduce standard camera observations and capture illumination-dependent appearance changes, respectively. During training, the proposed cross-branch HDR consistency loss provides explicit supervision for HDR content, while an illumination-guided gradient scaling strategy mitigates exposure-biased gradient starvation and reduces under-densified representations. Experimental results across realistic and synthetic datasets demonstrate our superiority in reconstructing HDR details (e.g., a PSNR gain of 2.04 dB over HDR-GS), while maintaining real-time rendering speed (up to 76 FPS). Code and models are available at https://huimin-zeng.github.io/PhysHDR-GS/.

AI.tldr: PhysHDR-GS：基于物理启发的HDR新视角合成框架，通过内在反射率和可调环境光照建模场景外观，解决现有方法在环境光照依赖外观捕捉方面的不足
AI.motivation: 现有高动态范围新视角合成方法通过融合多曝光低动态范围视图重建场景，但难以捕捉环境光照依赖的外观变化。隐式监督HDR内容的方法无法校正异常HDR值，且在欠/过曝光区域导致高斯分布梯度受限。
AI.method: 提出PhysHDR-GS框架，包含互补的图像曝光分支和高斯光照分支：IE分支忠实再现标准相机观测，GI分支捕捉光照依赖的外观变化。引入跨分支HDR一致性损失提供显式监督，以及光照引导梯度缩放策略缓解曝光偏差梯度饥饿问题。
AI.result: 在真实和合成数据集上的实验表明，该方法在重建HDR细节方面优于现有方法（如比HDR-GS提升2.04 dB PSNR），同时保持实时渲染速度（最高76 FPS）。
AI.conclusion: PhysHDR-GS通过物理启发的内在反射率和可调环境光照建模，有效解决了HDR新视角合成中的环境光照依赖外观捕捉问题，实现了高质量的HDR重建和实时渲染。

title: Efficient Domain Adaptation for Text Line Recognition via Decoupled Language Models
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Machine Intelligence Theory and Applications (MiTA 2026)
summary: Optical character recognition remains critical infrastructure for document digitization, yet state-of-the-art performance is often restricted to well-resourced institutions by prohibitive computational barriers. End-to-end transformer architectures achieve strong accuracy but demand hundreds of GPU hours for domain adaptation, limiting accessibility for practitioners and digital humanities scholars. We present a modular detection-and-correction framework that achieves near-SOTA accuracy with single-GPU training. Our approach decouples lightweight visual character detection (domain-agnostic) from domain-specific linguistic correction using pretrained sequence models including T5, ByT5, and BART. By training the correctors entirely on synthetic noise, we enable annotation-free domain adaptation without requiring labeled target images. Evaluating across modern clean handwriting, cursive script, and historical documents, we identify a critical "Pareto frontier" in architecture selection: T5-Base excels on modern text with standard vocabulary, whereas ByT5-Base dominates on historical documents by reconstructing archaic spellings at the byte level. Our results demonstrate that this decoupled paradigm matches end-to-end transformer accuracy while reducing compute by approximately 95%, establishing a viable, resource-efficient alternative to monolithic OCR architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化检测-校正框架，实现接近SOTA的OCR性能，同时将计算需求降低约95%，支持单GPU训练和无标注领域适应
AI.motivation: 当前端到端Transformer架构在OCR领域虽然准确率高，但需要数百GPU小时进行领域适应，计算成本过高，限制了资源有限的研究者和数字人文学者的使用
AI.method: 采用模块化检测-校正框架：轻量级视觉字符检测（领域无关） + 领域特定语言校正（使用预训练序列模型T5、ByT5、BART）。校正器完全在合成噪声上训练，无需目标图像标注即可实现领域适应
AI.result: 在现代清晰手写体、草书和历史文档上评估，发现架构选择的"帕累托前沿"：T5-Base在标准词汇现代文本上表现优异，而ByT5-Base在字节级别重建古旧拼写的历史文档上占优。该框架匹配端到端Transformer准确率，同时减少约95%计算量
AI.conclusion: 解耦的检测-校正范式为资源受限的OCR应用提供了可行的替代方案，在保持高准确率的同时大幅降低计算需求，使高质量OCR技术更易普及

title: Effort-Based Criticality Metrics for Evaluating 3D Perception Errors in Autonomous Driving
summary: Criticality metrics such as time-to-collision (TTC) quantify collision urgency but conflate the consequences of false-positive (FP) and false-negative (FN) perception errors. We propose two novel effort-based metrics: False Speed Reduction (FSR), the cumulative velocity loss from persistent phantom detections, and Maximum Deceleration Rate (MDR), the peak braking demand from missed objects under a constant-acceleration model. These longitudinal metrics are complemented by Lateral Evasion Acceleration (LEA), adapted from prior lateral evasion kinematics and coupled with reachability-based collision timing to quantify the minimum steering effort to avoid a predicted collision. A reachability-based ellipsoidal collision filter ensures only dynamically plausible threats are scored, with frame-level matching and track-level aggregation. Evaluation of different perception pipelines on nuScenes and Argoverse~2 shows that 65-93% of errors are non-critical, and Spearman correlation analysis confirms that all three metrics capture safety-relevant information inaccessible to established time-based, deceleration-based, or normalized criticality measures, enabling targeted mining of the most critical perception failures.

AI.tldr: 提出基于努力的感知错误关键性度量：FSR（虚假速度降低）量化持续虚假检测导致的累积速度损失，MDR（最大减速率）量化错失物体下的峰值制动需求，LEA（横向规避加速度）量化避免碰撞的最小转向努力。通过可达性椭圆碰撞滤波确保动态可行威胁评分，评估显示65-93%错误非关键，新度量能捕获传统时间/减速率度量无法获取的安全相关信息。
AI.motivation: 传统关键性度量（如碰撞时间TTC）量化碰撞紧迫性，但混淆了假阳性（FP）和假阴性（FN）感知错误的后果。需要更细粒度的度量来区分不同类型感知错误的安全影响，以便有针对性地挖掘最关键感知失败。
AI.method: 提出三个基于努力的度量：1）FSR：计算持续虚假检测导致的累积速度损失；2）MDR：基于恒定加速度模型计算错失物体下的峰值制动需求；3）LEA：结合可达性碰撞时序，从横向规避运动学推导最小转向努力。使用可达性椭圆碰撞滤波确保只评分动态可行的威胁，并进行帧级匹配和轨迹级聚合。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse~2数据集上评估不同感知流水线，发现65-93%的感知错误是非关键的。Spearman相关性分析证实，所有三个新度量都能捕获传统时间基础、减速率基础或归一化关键性度量无法获取的安全相关信息。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于努力的度量（FSR、MDR、LEA）能够有效区分感知错误的关键性，提供传统度量无法获取的安全相关信息，使系统能够有针对性地挖掘最关键感知失败，为感知系统安全评估提供更精细的工具。

title: Event6D: Event-based Novel Object 6D Pose Tracking
summary: Event cameras provide microsecond latency, making them suitable for 6D object pose tracking in fast, dynamic scenes where conventional RGB and depth pipelines suffer from motion blur and large pixel displacements. We introduce EventTrack6D, an event-depth tracking framework that generalizes to novel objects without object-specific training by reconstructing both intensity and depth at arbitrary timestamps between depth frames. Conditioned on the most recent depth measurement, our dual reconstruction recovers dense photometric and geometric cues from sparse event streams. Our EventTrack6D operates at over 120 FPS and maintains temporal consistency under rapid motion. To support training and evaluation, we introduce a comprehensive benchmark suite: a large-scale synthetic dataset for training and two complementary evaluation sets, including real and simulated event datasets. Trained exclusively on synthetic data, EventTrack6D generalizes effectively to real-world scenarios without fine-tuning, maintaining accurate tracking across diverse objects and motion patterns. Our method and datasets validate the effectiveness of event cameras for event-based 6D pose tracking of novel objects. Code and datasets are publicly available at https://chohoonhee.github.io/Event6D.

AI.tldr: EventTrack6D：基于事件相机的6D物体姿态跟踪框架，无需物体特定训练，通过重建任意时间戳的强度和深度，在快速动态场景中实现超过120FPS的实时跟踪。
AI.motivation: 传统RGB和深度管道在快速动态场景中容易受到运动模糊和大像素位移的影响，而事件相机提供微秒级延迟，适合6D物体姿态跟踪，但需要能够泛化到新物体且无需特定训练的方法。
AI.method: 基于事件-深度的跟踪框架，通过双重建从稀疏事件流中恢复密集的光度和几何线索。在最近深度测量的条件下，重建任意时间戳的强度和深度，保持时间一致性。
AI.result: EventTrack6D运行速度超过120FPS，在快速运动下保持时间一致性。仅使用合成数据训练就能有效泛化到真实世界场景，无需微调，在不同物体和运动模式下保持准确跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 该方法验证了事件相机在事件驱动的6D姿态跟踪新物体方面的有效性，提供了公开的代码和数据集，为事件相机在快速动态场景中的物体跟踪应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Drift-AR: Single-Step Visual Autoregressive Generation via Anti-Symmetric Drifting
summary: Autoregressive (AR)-Diffusion hybrid paradigms combine AR's structured semantic modeling with diffusion's high-fidelity synthesis, yet suffer from a dual speed bottleneck: the sequential AR stage and the iterative multi-step denoising of the diffusion vision decode stage. Existing methods address each in isolation without a unified principle design. We observe that the per-position \emph{prediction entropy} of continuous-space AR models naturally encodes spatially varying generation uncertainty, which simultaneously governing draft prediction quality in the AR stage and reflecting the corrective effort required by vision decoding stage, which is not fully explored before. Since entropy is inherently tied to both bottlenecks, it serves as a natural unifying signal for joint acceleration. In this work, we propose \textbf{Drift-AR}, which leverages entropy signal to accelerate both stages: 1) for AR acceleration, we introduce Entropy-Informed Speculative Decoding that align draft--target entropy distributions via a causal-normalized entropy loss, resolving the entropy mismatch that causes excessive draft rejection; 2) for visual decoder acceleration, we reinterpret entropy as the \emph{physical variance} of the initial state for an anti-symmetric drifting field -- high-entropy positions activate stronger drift toward the data manifold while low-entropy positions yield vanishing drift -- enabling single-step (1-NFE) decoding without iterative denoising or distillation. Moreover, both stages share the same entropy signal, which is computed once with no extra cost. Experiments on MAR, TransDiff, and NextStep-1 demonstrate 3.8--5.5$\times$ speedup with genuine 1-NFE decoding, matching or surpassing original quality. Code will be available at https://github.com/aSleepyTree/Drift-AR.

AI.tldr: Drift-AR利用预测熵统一加速AR和扩散混合模型的两个阶段：通过熵引导的推测解码加速AR阶段，通过将熵重新解释为漂移场方差实现单步视觉解码，达到3.8-5.5倍加速且保持质量。
AI.motivation: 现有AR-扩散混合范式存在双重速度瓶颈：AR阶段的顺序生成和扩散视觉解码的多步去噪。传统方法孤立解决这两个问题，缺乏统一设计原则。研究发现连续空间AR模型的预测熵自然编码了空间变化的生成不确定性，这同时影响AR阶段的草稿预测质量和视觉解码阶段所需的校正努力，但这一特性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Drift-AR框架：1) AR加速：引入熵引导的推测解码，通过因果归一化熵损失对齐草稿-目标熵分布，解决导致过度草稿拒绝的熵不匹配问题；2) 视觉解码加速：将熵重新解释为反称漂移场初始状态的物理方差——高熵位置激活更强的向数据流形漂移，低熵位置产生可忽略的漂移——实现单步(1-NFE)解码，无需迭代去噪或蒸馏。两个阶段共享相同的熵信号，计算一次无额外成本。
AI.result: 在MAR、TransDiff和NextStep-1数据集上的实验表明，Drift-AR实现了3.8-5.5倍加速，同时保持单步(1-NFE)解码，匹配或超越了原始模型的质量。
AI.conclusion: 预测熵作为统一信号能够有效加速AR-扩散混合模型的两个主要瓶颈阶段。Drift-AR通过熵引导的推测解码和基于熵的漂移场单步解码，实现了显著的速度提升而不牺牲生成质量，为混合生成模型的高效设计提供了新思路。

title: \textit{4DSurf}: High-Fidelity Dynamic Scene Surface Reconstruction
summary: This paper addresses the problem of dynamic scene surface reconstruction using Gaussian Splatting (GS), aiming to recover temporally consistent geometry. While existing GS-based dynamic surface reconstruction methods can yield superior reconstruction, they are typically limited to either a single object or objects with only small deformations, struggling to maintain temporally consistent surface reconstruction of large deformations over time. We propose ``\textit{4DSurf}'', a novel and unified framework for generic dynamic surface reconstruction that does not require specifying the number or types of objects in the scene, can handle large surface deformations and temporal inconsistency in reconstruction. The key innovation of our framework is the introduction of Gaussian deformations induced Signed Distance Function Flow Regularization that constrains the motion of Gaussians to align with the evolving surface. To handle large deformations, we introduce an Overlapping Segment Partitioning strategy that divides the sequence into overlapping segments with small deformations and incrementally passes geometric information across segments through the shared overlapping timestep. Experiments on two challenging dynamic scene datasets, Hi4D and CMU Panoptic, demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art surface reconstruction methods by 49\% and 19\% in Chamfer distance, respectively, and achieves superior temporal consistency under sparse-view settings.

AI.tldr: 4DSurf是一个用于动态场景表面重建的统一框架，基于高斯泼溅技术，能够处理大变形并保持时间一致性，无需指定场景中物体的数量或类型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯泼溅的动态表面重建方法通常局限于单个物体或小变形场景，难以处理大变形并保持时间一致性，需要一种能处理通用动态场景的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了4DSurf框架，核心创新包括：1) 高斯变形诱导的符号距离函数流正则化，约束高斯运动与演化表面对齐；2) 重叠段分割策略，将序列分成重叠的小变形段，通过共享时间步长传递几何信息。
AI.result: 在Hi4D和CMU Panoptic两个挑战性动态场景数据集上，方法在Chamfer距离上分别优于最先进方法49%和19%，在稀疏视图设置下实现了优越的时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 4DSurf是一个统一的动态表面重建框架，能够处理大变形并保持时间一致性，无需指定场景物体信息，在多个数据集上表现出优越性能。

title: AIBench: Evaluating Visual-Logical Consistency in Academic Illustration Generation
summary: Although image generation has boosted various applications via its rapid evolution, whether the state-of-the-art models are able to produce ready-to-use academic illustrations for papers is still largely unexplored.Directly comparing or evaluating the illustration with VLM is native but requires oracle multi-modal understanding ability, which is unreliable for long and complex texts and illustrations. To address this, we propose AIBench, the first benchmark using VQA for evaluating logic correctness of the academic illustrations and VLMs for assessing aesthetics. In detail, we designed four levels of questions proposed from a logic diagram summarized from the method part of the paper, which query whether the generated illustration aligns with the paper on different scales. Our VQA-based approach raises more accurate and detailed evaluations on visual-logical consistency while relying less on the ability of the judger VLM. With our high-quality AIBench, we conduct extensive experiments and conclude that the performance gap between models on this task is significantly larger than general ones, reflecting their various complex reasoning and high-density generation ability. Further, the logic and aesthetics are hard to optimize simultaneously as in handcrafted illustrations. Additional experiments further state that test-time scaling on both abilities significantly boosts the performance on this task.

AI.tldr: 提出AIBench基准，使用VQA评估学术插图逻辑正确性，用VLM评估美学质量，发现模型在该任务上性能差异显著大于通用任务
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型能否为论文生成可直接使用的学术插图尚未充分探索，直接使用VLM评估存在多模态理解能力不可靠的问题
AI.method: 提出AIBench基准，从论文方法部分总结逻辑图，设计四个层次的问题来评估插图与论文在不同尺度上的对齐程度，使用VQA评估逻辑正确性，VLM评估美学质量
AI.result: 模型在该任务上的性能差异显著大于通用任务，反映了它们不同的复杂推理和高密度生成能力；逻辑和美学难以同时优化；测试时扩展两种能力能显著提升性能
AI.conclusion: AIBench为评估学术插图生成提供了有效基准，揭示了当前模型在该任务上的局限性，并展示了通过测试时扩展提升性能的潜力

title: LogiStory: A Logic-Aware Framework for Multi-Image Story Visualization
summary: Generating coherent and communicative visual sequences, such as image sequences and videos, remains a significant challenge for current multimodal systems. Despite advances in visual quality and the integration of world knowledge, existing models still struggle to maintain logical flow, often resulting in disjointed actions, fragmented narratives, and unclear storylines. We attribute these issues to the lack of attention to visual logic, a critical yet underexplored dimension of visual sequence generation that we define as the perceptual and causal coherence among characters, actions, and scenes over time. To bridge this gap, we propose a logic-aware multi-image story visualization framework, LogiStory. The framework is built around the central innovation of explicitly modeling visual logic in story visualization. To realize this idea, we design a multi-agent system that grounds roles, extracts causal chains, and verifies story-level consistency, transforming narrative coherence from an implicit byproduct of image generation into an explicit modeling objective. This design effectively bridges structured story planning with visual generation, enhancing both narrative clarity and visual quality in story visualization. Furthermore, to evaluate the generation capacity, we construct LogicTale, a benchmark comprising richly annotated stories, emphasizing causal reasoning, and visual logic interpretability. We establish comprehensive automatic and human evaluation protocols designed to measure both visual logic and perceptual quality. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the narrative logic of generated visual stories. This work provides a foundational step towards modeling and enforcing visual logic in general image sequence and video generation tasks.

AI.tldr: LogiStory：一个逻辑感知的多图像故事可视化框架，通过显式建模视觉逻辑来解决现有模型在生成连贯视觉序列时存在的逻辑流断裂问题
AI.motivation: 当前多模态系统在生成图像序列和视频时，虽然视觉质量和世界知识整合有所进步，但仍难以保持逻辑连贯性，导致动作脱节、叙事碎片化和故事情节不清晰。这些问题源于对视觉逻辑这一关键维度的忽视，即角色、动作和场景在时间上的感知和因果连贯性。
AI.method: 提出LogiStory框架，核心创新是显式建模视觉逻辑。设计了一个多智能体系统，该系统能够：1）角色定位；2）提取因果链；3）验证故事级一致性。将叙事连贯性从图像生成的隐式副产品转变为显式建模目标，有效连接结构化故事规划与视觉生成。
AI.result: 构建了LogicTale基准测试集，包含丰富标注的故事，强调因果推理和视觉逻辑可解释性。建立了全面的自动和人工评估协议来衡量视觉逻辑和感知质量。实验表明，该方法显著提高了生成视觉故事的叙事逻辑性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为在通用图像序列和视频生成任务中建模和实施视觉逻辑提供了基础性步骤，通过显式关注视觉逻辑，显著提升了故事可视化的叙事清晰度和视觉质量。

title: GEMS: Agent-Native Multimodal Generation with Memory and Skills
summary: Recent multimodal generation models have achieved remarkable progress on general-purpose generation tasks, yet continue to struggle with complex instructions and specialized downstream tasks. Inspired by the success of advanced agent frameworks such as Claude Code, we propose \textbf{GEMS} (Agent-Native Multimodal \textbf{GE}neration with \textbf{M}emory and \textbf{S}kills), a framework that pushes beyond the inherent limitations of foundational models on both general and downstream tasks. GEMS is built upon three core components. Agent Loop introduces a structured multi-agent framework that iteratively improves generation quality through closed-loop optimization. Agent Memory provides a persistent, trajectory-level memory that hierarchically stores both factual states and compressed experiential summaries, enabling a global view of the optimization process while reducing redundancy. Agent Skill offers an extensible collection of domain-specific expertise with on-demand loading, allowing the system to effectively handle diverse downstream applications. Across five mainstream tasks and four downstream tasks, evaluated on multiple generative backends, GEMS consistently achieves significant performance gains. Most notably, it enables the lightweight 6B model Z-Image-Turbo to surpass the state-of-the-art Nano Banana 2 on GenEval2, demonstrating the effectiveness of agent harness in extending model capabilities beyond their original limits.

AI.tldr: GEMS是一个基于代理的多模态生成框架，通过代理循环、记忆和技能三个核心组件，在通用和下游任务上超越基础模型的能力限制。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态生成模型在复杂指令和专业化下游任务上仍有局限，需要借鉴高级代理框架（如Claude Code）来突破基础模型的能力边界。
AI.method: GEMS包含三个核心组件：1) 代理循环 - 结构化多代理框架，通过闭环优化迭代提升生成质量；2) 代理记忆 - 持久化轨迹级记忆，分层存储事实状态和压缩经验总结；3) 代理技能 - 可扩展的领域专业知识集合，按需加载处理多样化下游应用。
AI.result: 在5个主流任务和4个下游任务上，使用多个生成后端评估，GEMS均取得显著性能提升。最突出的是，它使轻量级6B模型Z-Image-Turbo在GenEval2上超越了最先进的Nano Banana 2。
AI.conclusion: GEMS通过代理机制有效扩展了模型能力，超越了其原始限制，证明了代理框架在提升多模态生成性能方面的有效性。

title: SHARP: Short-Window Streaming for Accurate and Robust Prediction in Motion Forecasting
summary: In dynamic traffic environments, motion forecasting models must be able to accurately estimate future trajectories continuously. Streaming-based methods are a promising solution, but despite recent advances, their performance often degrades when exposed to heterogeneous observation lengths. To address this, we propose a novel streaming-based motion forecasting framework that explicitly focuses on evolving scenes. Our method incrementally processes incoming observation windows and leverages an instance-aware context streaming to maintain and update latent agent representations across inference steps. A dual training objective further enables consistent forecasting accuracy across diverse observation horizons. Extensive experiments on Argoverse 2, nuScenes, and Argoverse 1 demonstrate the robustness of our approach under evolving scene conditions and also on the single-agent benchmarks. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in streaming inference on the Argoverse 2 multi-agent benchmark, while maintaining minimal latency, highlighting its suitability for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新颖的流式运动预测框架，专注于动态交通环境中的演化场景，通过实例感知上下文流式处理和双训练目标，在多种观察长度下保持一致的预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 在动态交通环境中，运动预测模型需要能够连续准确地估计未来轨迹。现有的流式方法虽然很有前景，但在面对异构观察长度时性能往往会下降，因此需要一种能够处理演化场景的鲁棒方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种流式运动预测框架，增量处理输入观察窗口，利用实例感知上下文流式处理来维护和更新潜在智能体表示。采用双训练目标确保在不同观察视野下保持一致的预测准确性。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2、nuScenes和Argoverse 1数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在演化场景条件下具有鲁棒性。在Argoverse 2多智能体基准测试中实现了最先进的流式推理性能，同时保持最小延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效处理动态交通环境中的演化场景，在异构观察长度下保持稳定的预测性能，具有实际部署的适用性，特别适合实时应用。

title: RAWIC: Bit-Depth Adaptive Lossless Raw Image Compression
summary: Raw images preserve linear sensor measurements and high bit-depth information crucial for advanced vision tasks and photography applications, yet their storage remains challenging due to large file sizes, varying bit depths, and sensor-dependent characteristics. Existing learned lossless compression methods mainly target 8-bit sRGB images, while raw reconstruction approaches are inherently lossy and rely on camera-specific assumptions. To address these challenges, we introduce RAWIC, a bit-depth-adaptive learned lossless compression framework for Bayer-pattern raw images. We first convert single-channel Bayer data into a four-channel RGGB format and partition it into patches. For each patch, we compute its bit depth and use it as auxiliary input to guide compression. A bit-depth-adaptive entropy model is then designed to estimate patch distributions conditioned on their bit depths. This architecture enables a single model to handle raw images from diverse cameras and bit depths. Experiments show that RAWIC consistently surpasses traditional lossless codecs, achieving an average 7.7% bitrate reduction over JPEG-XL. Our code is available at https://github.com/chunbaobao/RAWIC.

AI.tldr: RAWIC是一个针对拜耳模式原始图像的无损压缩框架，通过比特深度自适应机制处理不同相机和比特深度的原始图像，相比传统编解码器实现平均7.7%的比特率降低。
AI.motivation: 原始图像保留了线性传感器测量和高比特深度信息，对高级视觉任务和摄影应用至关重要，但其存储面临文件体积大、比特深度变化和传感器依赖特性的挑战。现有学习方法主要针对8位sRGB图像，而原始图像重建方法本质上有损且依赖相机特定假设。
AI.method: 将单通道拜耳数据转换为四通道RGGB格式并分块处理，计算每个块的比特深度作为辅助输入指导压缩，设计比特深度自适应熵模型来估计基于比特深度的块分布，使单一模型能够处理不同相机和比特深度的原始图像。
AI.result: 实验表明RAWIC始终优于传统无损编解码器，相比JPEG-XL实现平均7.7%的比特率降低。
AI.conclusion: RAWIC提供了一个有效的比特深度自适应学习无损压缩框架，能够处理多样化的原始图像，在保持图像质量的同时显著减少存储需求。

title: Contour-Guided Query-Based Feature Fusion for Boundary-Aware and Generalizable Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation
summary: Accurate cardiac ultrasound segmentation is essential for reliable assessment of ventricular function in intelligent healthcare systems. However, echocardiographic images are challenging due to low contrast, speckle noise, irregular boundaries, and domain shifts across devices and patient populations. Existing methods, largely based on appearance-driven learning, often fail to preserve boundary precision and structural consistency under these conditions. To address these issues, we propose a Contour-Guided Query Refinement Network (CGQR-Net) for boundary-aware cardiac ultrasound segmentation. The framework integrates multi-resolution feature representations with contour-derived structural priors. An HRNet backbone preserves high-resolution spatial details while capturing multi-scale context. A coarse segmentation is first generated, from which anatomical contours are extracted and encoded into learnable query embeddings. These contour-guided queries interact with fused feature maps via cross-attention, enabling structure-aware refinement that improves boundary delineation and reduces noise artifacts. A dual-head supervision strategy jointly optimizes segmentation and boundary prediction to enforce structural consistency. The proposed method is evaluated on the CAMUS dataset and further validated on the CardiacNet dataset to assess cross-dataset generalization. Experimental results demonstrate improved segmentation accuracy, enhanced boundary precision, and robust performance across varying imaging conditions. These results highlight the effectiveness of integrating contour-level structural information with feature-level representations for reliable cardiac ultrasound segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出CGQR-Net网络，通过轮廓引导的查询优化实现边界感知的心脏超声分割，在低对比度、噪声等挑战下提升分割精度和边界一致性
AI.motivation: 心脏超声分割对于智能医疗系统中心室功能评估至关重要，但超声图像存在低对比度、斑点噪声、不规则边界以及跨设备和患者群体的域偏移问题。现有基于外观驱动学习的方法在这些条件下往往无法保持边界精度和结构一致性。
AI.method: 提出轮廓引导查询优化网络(CGQR-Net)，整合多分辨率特征表示与轮廓衍生的结构先验。使用HRNet骨干网络保持高分辨率空间细节并捕获多尺度上下文。首先生成粗略分割，从中提取解剖轮廓并编码为可学习查询嵌入。这些轮廓引导的查询通过交叉注意力与融合特征图交互，实现结构感知的细化，改善边界描绘并减少噪声伪影。采用双头监督策略联合优化分割和边界预测以增强结构一致性。
AI.result: 在CAMUS数据集上评估，并在CardiacNet数据集上进行跨数据集泛化验证。实验结果表明分割准确性提高，边界精度增强，在不同成像条件下具有鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: 将轮廓级结构信息与特征级表示相结合，对于实现可靠的心脏超声分割是有效的。该方法在边界精度和结构一致性方面表现出色，能够应对超声图像特有的挑战。

title: Attention Frequency Modulation: Training-Free Spectral Modulation of Diffusion Cross-Attention
summary: Cross-attention is the primary interface through which text conditions latent diffusion models, yet its step-wise multi-resolution dynamics remain under-characterized, limiting principled training-free control. We cast diffusion cross-attention as a spatiotemporal signal on the latent grid by summarizing token-softmax weights into token-agnostic concentration maps and tracking their radially binned Fourier power over denoising. Across prompts and seeds, encoder cross-attention exhibits a consistent coarse-to-fine spectral progression, yielding a stable time-frequency fingerprint of token competition. Building on this structure, we introduce Attention Frequency Modulation (AFM), a plug-and-play inference-time intervention that edits token-wise pre-softmax cross-attention logits in the Fourier domain: low- and high-frequency bands are reweighted with a progress-aligned schedule and can be adaptively gated by token-allocation entropy, before the token softmax. AFM provides a continuous handle to bias the spatial scale of token-competition patterns without retraining, prompt editing, or parameter updates. Experiments on Stable Diffusion show that AFM reliably redistributes attention spectra and produces substantial visual edits while largely preserving semantic alignment. Finally, we find that entropy mainly acts as an adaptive gain on the same frequency-based edit rather than an independent control axis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出注意力频率调制（AFM），一种无需训练、无需提示编辑或参数更新的推理时干预方法，通过傅里叶域编辑交叉注意力来调控文本条件在潜在扩散模型中的空间尺度竞争模式。
AI.motivation: 交叉注意力是文本条件潜在扩散模型的主要接口，但其逐步多分辨率动态特性尚未充分表征，限制了无需训练的原则性控制方法的发展。需要深入理解注意力在去噪过程中的时空演化规律。
AI.method: 将扩散交叉注意力建模为潜在网格上的时空信号，通过将token-softmax权重汇总为token无关的浓度图，并跟踪其在去噪过程中径向分箱的傅里叶功率。基于此结构，提出注意力频率调制（AFM），在傅里叶域编辑token-wise预softmax交叉注意力logits，使用进度对齐的调度重新加权低频和高频带，并可基于token分配熵进行自适应门控。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion上的实验表明，AFM能够可靠地重新分配注意力频谱，产生显著的视觉编辑效果，同时很大程度上保持语义对齐。研究发现熵主要作为相同频率编辑的自适应增益，而非独立的控制轴。
AI.conclusion: 交叉注意力在去噪过程中表现出一致的粗到细频谱进展，形成了稳定的时频指纹。AFM为调控token竞争模式的空间尺度提供了连续的控制手柄，无需重新训练、提示编辑或参数更新，实现了对扩散模型生成过程的精细控制。

title: SVGS: Single-View to 3D Object Editing via Gaussian Splatting
summary: Text-driven 3D scene editing has attracted considerable interest due to its convenience and user-friendliness. However, methods that rely on implicit 3D representations, such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), while effective in rendering complex scenes, are hindered by slow processing speeds and limited control over specific regions of the scene. Moreover, existing approaches, including Instruct-NeRF2NeRF and GaussianEditor, which utilize multi-view editing strategies, frequently produce inconsistent results across different views when executing text instructions. This inconsistency can adversely affect the overall performance of the model, complicating the task of balancing the consistency of editing results with editing efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose a novel method termed Single-View to 3D Object Editing via Gaussian Splatting (SVGS), which is a single-view text-driven editing technique based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Specifically, in response to text instructions, we introduce a single-view editing strategy grounded in multi-view diffusion models, which reconstructs 3D scenes by leveraging only those views that yield consistent editing results. Additionally, we employ sparse 3D Gaussian Splatting as the 3D representation, which significantly enhances editing efficiency. We conducted a comparative analysis of SVGS against existing baseline methods across various scene settings, and the results indicate that SVGS outperforms its counterparts in both editing capability and processing speed, representing a significant advancement in 3D editing technology. For further details, please visit our project page at: https://amateurc.github.io/svgs.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出SVGS方法，基于3D高斯泼溅的单视图文本驱动3D场景编辑技术，通过单视图编辑策略和多视图扩散模型实现高效一致的3D编辑
AI.motivation: 现有基于NeRF等隐式3D表示的文本驱动3D场景编辑方法存在处理速度慢、对场景特定区域控制有限的问题，且多视图编辑策略在不同视角下经常产生不一致的结果，影响模型整体性能
AI.method: 提出SVGS方法：1) 基于3D高斯泼溅的稀疏3D表示提高编辑效率；2) 采用单视图编辑策略，基于多视图扩散模型，仅利用产生一致编辑结果的视图来重建3D场景
AI.result: SVGS在多种场景设置下与现有基线方法比较，在编辑能力和处理速度方面均优于现有方法
AI.conclusion: SVGS方法在3D编辑技术方面取得了显著进展，通过单视图文本驱动编辑实现了高效且一致的3D场景编辑

title: Robust Remote Sensing Image-Text Retrieval with Noisy Correspondence
summary: As a pivotal task that bridges remote visual and linguistic understanding, Remote Sensing Image-Text Retrieval (RSITR) has attracted considerable research interest in recent years. However, almost all RSITR methods implicitly assume that image-text pairs are matched perfectly. In practice, acquiring a large set of well-aligned data pairs is often prohibitively expensive or even infeasible. In addition, we also notice that the remote sensing datasets (e.g., RSITMD) truly contain some inaccurate or mismatched image text descriptions. Based on the above observations, we reveal an important but untouched problem in RSITR, i.e., Noisy Correspondence (NC). To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel Robust Remote Sensing Image-Text Retrieval (RRSITR) paradigm that designs a self-paced learning strategy to mimic human cognitive learning patterns, thereby learning from easy to hard from multi-modal data with NC. Specifically, we first divide all training sample pairs into three categories based on the loss magnitude of each pair, i.e., clean sample pairs, ambiguous sample pairs, and noisy sample pairs. Then, we respectively estimate the reliability of each training pair by assigning a weight to each pair based on the values of the loss. Further, we respectively design a new multi-modal self-paced function to dynamically regulate the training sequence and weights of the samples, thus establishing a progressive learning process. Finally, for noisy sample pairs, we present a robust triplet loss to dynamically adjust the soft margin based on semantic similarity, thereby enhancing the robustness against noise. Extensive experiments on three popular benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed RRSITR significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods, especially in high noise rates. The code is available at: https://github.com/MSFLabX/RRSITR

AI.tldr: 提出RRSITR方法解决遥感图像-文本检索中的噪声对应问题，通过自步学习策略从易到难学习，显著提升高噪声率下的检索性能
AI.motivation: 现有遥感图像-文本检索方法都假设图像-文本对完美匹配，但实际获取大规模对齐良好的数据成本高昂甚至不可行，且现有数据集确实包含不准确或不匹配的描述，因此需要解决噪声对应问题
AI.method: 提出RRSITR范式：1) 基于损失大小将训练样本分为干净、模糊和噪声三类；2) 基于损失值为每对分配权重估计可靠性；3) 设计多模态自步函数动态调节训练顺序和权重；4) 对噪声样本提出基于语义相似度动态调整软边界的鲁棒三元组损失
AI.result: 在三个流行基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RRSITR显著优于最先进方法，特别是在高噪声率下表现突出
AI.conclusion: 提出的RRSITR方法有效解决了遥感图像-文本检索中的噪声对应问题，通过模拟人类认知学习模式的自步学习策略，实现了从易到难的渐进学习，显著提升了模型在噪声环境下的鲁棒性

title: Intelligent Road Condition Monitoring using 3D In-Air SONAR Sensing
summary: In this paper, we investigate the capabilities of in-air 3D SONAR sensors for the monitoring of road surface conditions. Concretely, we consider two applications: Road material classification and Road damage detection and classification. While such tasks can be performed with other sensor modalities, such as camera sensors and LiDAR sensors, these sensor modalities tend to fail in harsh sensing conditions, such as heavy rain, smoke or fog. By using a sensing modality that is robust to such interference, we enable the creation of opportunistic sensing applications, where vehicles performing other tasks (garbage collection, mail delivery, etc.) can also be used to monitor the condition of the road. For these tasks, we use a single dataset, in which different types of damages are annotated, with labels including the material of the road surface. In the material classification task, we differentiate between three different road materials: Asphalt, Concrete and Element roads. In the damage detection and classification task, we determine if there is damage, and what type of damage (independent of material type), without localizing the damage. We are succesful in determining the road surface type from SONAR sensor data, with F1 scores approaching 90% on the test set, but find that for the detection of damages performace lags, with F1 score around 75%. From this, we conclude that SONAR sensing is a promising modality to include in opportunistic sensing-based pavement management systems, but that further research is needed to reach the desired accuracy.

AI.tldr: 研究探索空中3D声纳传感器监测路面状况的能力，包括路面材料分类和路面损坏检测分类两个应用，声纳在恶劣天气条件下比相机和激光雷达更可靠。
AI.motivation: 传统传感器（如相机和激光雷达）在恶劣天气条件（大雨、烟雾、雾）下容易失效，而声纳传感器对这些干扰具有鲁棒性，可以创建机会性传感应用，使执行其他任务的车辆也能监测道路状况。
AI.method: 使用单个数据集，其中标注了不同类型的损坏和路面材料标签。在材料分类任务中区分三种路面材料：沥青、混凝土和元素道路；在损坏检测分类任务中，确定是否存在损坏及损坏类型（不定位损坏位置）。
AI.result: 从声纳传感器数据成功确定路面类型，测试集F1分数接近90%；但损坏检测性能较差，F1分数约为75%。
AI.conclusion: 声纳传感是机会性传感路面管理系统中有前景的模态，但需要进一步研究以达到所需的准确度。

title: Event-Based Method for High-Speed 3D Deformation Measurement under Extreme Illumination Conditions
summary:
Background: Large engineering structures, such as space launch towers and suspension bridges, are subjected to extreme forces that cause high-speed 3D deformation and compromise safety. These structures typically operate under extreme illumination conditions. Traditional cameras often struggle to handle strong light intensity, leading to overexposure due to their limited dynamic range.
  Objective: Event cameras have emerged as a compelling alternative to traditional cameras in high dynamic range and low-latency applications. This paper presents an integrated method, from calibration to measurement, using a multi-event camera array for high-speed 3D deformation monitoring of structures in extreme illumination conditions.
  Methods: Firstly, the proposed method combines the characteristics of the asynchronous event stream and temporal correlation analysis to extract the corresponding marker center point. Subsequently, the method achieves rapid calibration by solving the Kruppa equations in conjunction with a parameter optimization framework. Finally, by employing a unified coordinate transformation and linear intersection, the method enables the measurement of 3D deformation of the target structure.
  Results: Experiments confirmed that the relative measurement error is below 0.08%. Field experiments under extreme illumination conditions, including self-calibration of a multi-event camera array and 3D deformation measurement, verified the performance of the proposed method.
  Conclusions: This paper addressed the critical limitation of traditional cameras in measuring high-speed 3D deformations under extreme illumination conditions. The experimental results demonstrate that, compared to other methods, the proposed method can accurately measure 3D deformations of structures under harsh lighting conditions, and the relative error of the measured deformation is less than 0.1%.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多事件相机阵列的高速3D变形监测方法，适用于极端光照条件下的大型工程结构变形测量。
AI.motivation: 传统相机在极端光照条件下动态范围有限，容易过曝，难以准确监测大型工程结构的高速3D变形。事件相机具有高动态范围和低延迟特性，为解决这一问题提供了新途径。
AI.method: 1. 利用异步事件流特性和时间相关性分析提取标记中心点；2. 通过求解Kruppa方程结合参数优化框架实现快速标定；3. 采用统一坐标变换和线性交会实现目标结构的3D变形测量。
AI.result: 实验验证相对测量误差低于0.08%。在极端光照条件下的现场实验，包括多事件相机阵列自标定和3D变形测量，验证了方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法克服了传统相机在极端光照条件下测量高速3D变形的关键限制。相比其他方法，能够在恶劣光照条件下准确测量结构3D变形，测量变形相对误差小于0.1%。

title: ColorFLUX: A Structure-Color Decoupling Framework for Old Photo Colorization
summary: Old photos preserve invaluable historical memories, making their restoration and colorization highly desirable. While existing restoration models can address some degradation issues like denoising and scratch removal, they often struggle with accurate colorization. This limitation arises from the unique degradation inherent in old photos, such as faded brightness and altered color hues, which are different from modern photo distributions, creating a substantial domain gap during colorization. In this paper, we propose a novel old photo colorization framework based on the generative diffusion model FLUX. Our approach introduces a structure-color decoupling strategy that separates structure preservation from color restoration, enabling accurate colorization of old photos while maintaining structural consistency. We further enhance the model with a progressive Direct Preference Optimization (Pro-DPO) strategy, which allows the model to learn subtle color preferences through coarse-to-fine transitions in color augmentation. Additionally, we address the limitations of text-based prompts by introducing visual semantic prompts, which extract fine-grained semantic information directly from old photos, helping to eliminate the color bias inherent in old photos. Experimental results on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art colorization methods, including closed-source commercial models, producing high-quality and vivid colorization.

AI.tldr: 提出基于FLUX扩散模型的旧照片着色框架，通过结构-颜色解耦、渐进式偏好优化和视觉语义提示，解决旧照片独特退化带来的着色难题
AI.motivation: 现有修复模型能处理去噪、划痕等退化问题，但难以准确着色旧照片。旧照片特有的亮度褪色和色彩变化与现代照片分布存在显著领域差距，导致着色困难
AI.method: 1) 基于FLUX扩散模型的旧照片着色框架；2) 结构-颜色解耦策略，分离结构保持与色彩恢复；3) 渐进式直接偏好优化(Pro-DPO)，通过粗到细的颜色增强学习细微色彩偏好；4) 视觉语义提示，从旧照片提取细粒度语义信息，消除色彩偏差
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进的着色方法，包括闭源商业模型，能生成高质量、生动的着色效果
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于FLUX的旧照片着色框架通过结构-颜色解耦、渐进式偏好优化和视觉语义提示，有效解决了旧照片独特退化带来的着色挑战，实现了准确且生动的色彩恢复

title: ToLL: Topological Layout Learning with Structural Multi-view Augmentation for 3D Scene Graph Pretraining
summary: 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) generation plays a pivotal role in spatial understanding and semantic-affordance perception. However, its generalizability is often constrained by data scarcity. Current solutions primarily focus on cross-modal assisted representation learning and object-centric generation pre-training. The former relies heavily on predicate annotations, while the latter's predicate learning may be bypassed due to strong object priors. Consequently, they could not often provide a label-free and robust self-supervised proxy task for 3DSG fine-tuning. To bridge this gap, we propose a Topological Layout Learning (ToLL) for 3DSG pretraining framework. In detail, we design an Anchor-Conditioned Topological Geometry Reasoning, with a GNN to recover the global layout of zero-centered subgraphs by the spatial priors from sparse anchors. This process is strictly modulated by predicate features, thereby enforcing the predicate relation learning. Furthermore, we construct a Structural Multi-view Augmentation to avoid semantic corruption, and enhancing representations via self-distillation. The extensive experiments on 3DSSG dataset demonstrate that our ToLL could improve representation quality, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出ToLL框架，通过拓扑布局学习进行3D场景图预训练，解决数据稀缺和谓词学习被绕过的问题
AI.motivation: 当前3D场景图生成方法存在数据稀缺问题，现有解决方案要么依赖谓词标注，要么因强对象先验而绕过谓词学习，缺乏无标签的鲁棒自监督代理任务
AI.method: 提出拓扑布局学习框架，包括锚点条件拓扑几何推理（使用GNN通过稀疏锚点的空间先验恢复零中心子图的全局布局），以及结构多视图增强以避免语义损坏并通过自蒸馏增强表示
AI.result: 在3DSSG数据集上的广泛实验表明，ToLL能够提高表示质量，优于最先进的基线方法
AI.conclusion: ToLL框架为3D场景图预训练提供了一种有效的无标签自监督方法，强制进行谓词关系学习，解决了现有方法的局限性

title: Explaining CLIP Zero-shot Predictions Through Concepts
summary: Large-scale vision-language models such as CLIP have achieved remarkable success in zero-shot image recognition, yet their predictions remain largely opaque to human understanding. In contrast, Concept Bottleneck Models provide interpretable intermediate representations by reasoning through human-defined concepts, but they rely on concept supervision and lack the ability to generalize to unseen classes. We introduce EZPC that bridges these two paradigms by explaining CLIP's zero-shot predictions through human-understandable concepts. Our method projects CLIP's joint image-text embeddings into a concept space learned from language descriptions, enabling faithful and transparent explanations without additional supervision. The model learns this projection via a combination of alignment and reconstruction objectives, ensuring that concept activations preserve CLIP's semantic structure while remaining interpretable. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets, CIFAR-100, CUB-200-2011, Places365, ImageNet-100, and ImageNet-1k, demonstrate that our approach maintains CLIP's strong zero-shot classification accuracy while providing meaningful concept-level explanations. By grounding open-vocabulary predictions in explicit semantic concepts, our method offers a principled step toward interpretable and trustworthy vision-language models. Code is available at https://github.com/oonat/ezpc.

AI.tldr: EZPC方法通过将CLIP的联合图像-文本嵌入投影到从语言描述学习的概念空间，在保持CLIP零样本分类准确性的同时提供可解释的概念级解释，无需额外监督。
AI.motivation: 大规模视觉语言模型如CLIP在零样本图像识别方面取得了显著成功，但其预测对人类理解来说仍然不透明。而概念瓶颈模型通过人类定义的概念提供可解释的中间表示，但它们依赖概念监督且缺乏泛化到未见类别的能力。
AI.method: EZPC通过将CLIP的联合图像-文本嵌入投影到从语言描述学习的概念空间，实现可解释性。该方法通过对齐和重构目标的组合学习这种投影，确保概念激活既保留CLIP的语义结构又保持可解释性。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集（CIFAR-100、CUB-200-2011、Places365、ImageNet-100和ImageNet-1k）上的广泛实验表明，该方法在保持CLIP强大零样本分类准确性的同时，提供了有意义的概念级解释。
AI.conclusion: 通过将开放词汇预测建立在明确的语义概念基础上，该方法为实现可解释和可信赖的视觉语言模型迈出了原则性的一步。

title: TerraSky3D: Multi-View Reconstructions of European Landmarks in 4K
summary:
Despite the growing need for data of more and more sophisticated 3D reconstruction pipelines, we can still observe a scarcity of suitable public datasets. Existing 3D datasets are either low resolution, limited to a small amount of scenes, based on images of varying quality because retrieved from the internet, or limited to specific capturing scenarios.
  Motivated by this lack of suitable 3D datasets, we captured TerraSky3D, a high-resolution large-scale 3D reconstruction dataset comprising 50,000 images divided into 150 ground, aerial, and mixed scenes. The dataset focuses on European landmarks and comes with curated calibration data, camera poses, and depth maps. TerraSky3D tries to answer the need for challenging dataset that can be used to train and evaluate 3D reconstruction-related pipelines.

AI.tldr: TerraSky3D是一个高分辨率大规模3D重建数据集，包含150个地面、航空和混合场景的5万张图像，专注于欧洲地标，提供校准数据、相机位姿和深度图。
AI.motivation: 当前3D重建数据集存在分辨率低、场景数量有限、图像质量参差不齐或局限于特定采集场景的问题，缺乏适合训练和评估3D重建流程的高质量数据集。
AI.method: 通过采集欧洲地标场景，构建包含5万张图像的数据集，分为150个地面、航空和混合场景，并提供精心整理的校准数据、相机位姿和深度图。
AI.result: 创建了TerraSky3D数据集，这是一个高分辨率大规模3D重建数据集，专注于欧洲地标，包含多种采集场景，旨在为3D重建相关流程提供训练和评估资源。
AI.conclusion: TerraSky3D试图填补当前3D重建领域缺乏合适数据集的空白，为训练和评估3D重建相关流程提供具有挑战性的数据集资源。

title: Beyond Scanpaths: Graph-Based Gaze Simulation in Dynamic Scenes
summary: Accurately modelling human attention is essential for numerous computer vision applications, particularly in the domain of automotive safety. Existing methods typically collapse gaze into saliency maps or scanpaths, treating gaze dynamics only implicitly. We instead formulate gaze modelling as an autoregressive dynamical system and explicitly unroll raw gaze trajectories over time, conditioned on both gaze history and the evolving environment. Driving scenes are represented as gaze-centric graphs processed by the Affinity Relation Transformer (ART), a heterogeneous graph transformer that models interactions between driver gaze, traffic objects, and road structure. We further introduce the Object Density Network (ODN) to predict next-step gaze distributions, capturing the stochastic and object-centric nature of attentional shifts in complex environments. We also release Focus100, a new dataset of raw gaze data from 30 participants viewing egocentric driving footage. Trained directly on raw gaze, without fixation filtering, our unified approach produces more natural gaze trajectories, scanpath dynamics, and saliency maps than existing attention models, offering valuable insights for the temporal modelling of human attention in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的驾驶员注意力建模方法，将注视建模为自回归动态系统，使用亲和关系变换器处理注视中心图，并通过对象密度网络预测下一步注视分布，在Focus100数据集上验证了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类注意力建模方法通常将注视简化为显著性图或扫描路径，仅隐式处理注视动态。在自动驾驶安全等应用中，需要更准确地建模人类注意力，特别是驾驶员在动态环境中的注视行为。
AI.method: 将注视建模为自回归动态系统，显式地展开原始注视轨迹；使用注视中心图表示驾驶场景，通过亲和关系变换器（ART）处理驾驶员注视、交通对象和道路结构之间的交互；引入对象密度网络（ODN）预测下一步注视分布；基于Focus100数据集（30名参与者观看自我中心驾驶视频的原始注视数据）进行训练。
AI.result: 该方法直接在原始注视数据上训练（无需注视点过滤），相比现有注意力模型，能生成更自然的注视轨迹、扫描路径动态和显著性图，为动态环境中人类注意力的时间建模提供了有价值的见解。
AI.conclusion: 提出的统一方法通过显式建模注视动态和对象中心注意力转移，在驾驶员注意力建模方面取得了显著改进，为计算机视觉应用特别是汽车安全领域提供了更准确的人类注意力建模框架。

title: SFDemorpher: Generalizable Face Demorphing for Operational Morphing Attack Detection
summary: Face morphing attacks compromise biometric security by creating document images that verify against multiple identities, posing significant risks from document issuance to border control. Differential Morphing Attack Detection (D-MAD) offers an effective countermeasure, particularly when employing face demorphing to disentangle identities blended in the morph. However, existing methods lack operational generalizability due to limited training data and the assumption that all document inputs are morphs. This paper presents SFDemorpher, a framework designed for the operational deployment of face demorphing for D-MAD that performs identity disentanglement within joint StyleGAN latent and high-dimensional feature spaces. We introduce a dual-pass training strategy handling both morphed and bona fide documents, leveraging a hybrid corpus with predominantly synthetic identities to enhance robustness against unseen distributions. Extensive evaluation confirms state-of-the-art generalizability across unseen identities, diverse capture conditions, and 13 morphing techniques, spanning both border verification and the challenging document enrollment stage. Our framework achieves superior D-MAD performance by widening the margin between the score distributions of bona fide and morphed samples while providing high-fidelity visual reconstructions facilitating explainability.

AI.tldr: SFDemorpher：一种用于差分形态攻击检测的框架，通过联合StyleGAN潜在空间和高维特征空间进行身份解耦，采用双通道训练策略处理真实和伪造文档，在未见过的身份、采集条件和形态技术上实现最先进的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 面部形态攻击通过创建可验证多个身份的文件图像来危害生物识别安全。现有的差分形态攻击检测方法由于训练数据有限且假设所有输入都是形态图像，缺乏操作泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出SFDemorpher框架，在联合StyleGAN潜在空间和高维特征空间中进行身份解耦；采用双通道训练策略处理真实和伪造文档；利用以合成身份为主的混合语料库增强对未见分布的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在13种形态技术、未见身份和多样化采集条件下实现最先进的泛化性能；在边境验证和具有挑战性的文件注册阶段均表现优异；通过扩大真实样本和形态样本得分分布之间的差距实现卓越的D-MAD性能，并提供高保真视觉重建以促进可解释性。
AI.conclusion: SFDemorpher为面部解形态在差分形态攻击检测中的操作部署提供了一个有效的框架，通过创新的训练策略和空间表示方法，显著提高了对未知攻击的泛化能力和系统可解释性。

title: VistaGEN: Consistent Driving Video Generation with Fine-Grained Control Using Multiview Visual-Language Reasoning
summary: Driving video generation has achieved much progress in controllability, video resolution, and length, but fails to support fine-grained object-level controllability for diverse driving videos, while preserving the spatiotemporal consistency, especially in long video generation. In this paper, we present a new driving video generation technique, called VistaGEN, which enables fine-grained control of specific entities, including 3D objects, images, and text descriptions, while maintaining spatiotemporal consistency in long video sequences. Our key innovation is the incorporation of multiview visual-language reasoning into the long driving video generation. To this end, we inject visual-language features into a multiview video generator to enable fine-grained controllability. More importantly, we propose a multiview vision-language evaluator (MV-VLM) to intelligently and automatically evaluate spatiotemporal consistency of the generated content, thus formulating a novel generation-evaluation-regeneration closed-loop generation mechanism. This mechanism ensures high-quality, coherent outputs, facilitating the creation of complex and reliable driving scenarios. Besides, within the closed-loop generation, we introduce an object-level refinement module to refine the unsatisfied results evaluated from the MV-VLM and then feed them back to the video generator for regeneration. Extensive evaluation shows that our VistaGEN achieves diverse driving video generation results with fine-grained controllability, especially for long-tail objects, and much better spatiotemporal consistency than previous approaches.

AI.tldr: VistaGEN是一个支持细粒度对象级控制的驾驶视频生成技术，通过多视图视觉语言推理和生成-评估-再生的闭环机制，确保长视频序列的时空一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶视频生成技术在可控性、分辨率和长度方面取得了进展，但缺乏对多样化驾驶视频的细粒度对象级控制能力，同时在长视频生成中难以保持时空一致性。
AI.method: 1) 将多视图视觉语言特征注入多视图视频生成器以实现细粒度控制；2) 提出多视图视觉语言评估器(MV-VLM)自动评估生成内容的时空一致性；3) 建立生成-评估-再生的闭环生成机制；4) 在闭环中引入对象级细化模块改进不满意结果。
AI.result: VistaGEN实现了具有细粒度可控性的多样化驾驶视频生成，特别是对于长尾对象，并且在时空一致性方面显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: VistaGEN通过创新的多视图视觉语言推理和闭环生成机制，成功解决了驾驶视频生成中的细粒度对象控制和时空一致性问题，为创建复杂可靠的驾驶场景提供了有效解决方案。

title: SEA: Evaluating Sketch Abstraction Efficiency via Element-level Commonsense Visual Question Answering
summary: A sketch is a distilled form of visual abstraction that conveys core concepts through simplified yet purposeful strokes while omitting extraneous detail. Despite its expressive power, quantifying the efficiency of semantic abstraction in sketches remains challenging. Existing evaluation methods that rely on reference images, low-level visual features, or recognition accuracy do not capture abstraction, the defining property of sketches. To address these limitations, we introduce SEA (Sketch Evaluation metric for Abstraction efficiency), a reference-free metric that assesses how economically a sketch represents class-defining visual elements while preserving semantic recognizability. These elements are derived per class from commonsense knowledge about features typically depicted in sketches. SEA leverages a visual question answering model to determine the presence of each element and returns a quantitative score that reflects semantic retention under visual economy. To support this metric, we present CommonSketch, the first semantically annotated sketch dataset, comprising 23,100 human-drawn sketches across 300 classes, each paired with a caption and element-level annotations. Experiments show that SEA aligns closely with human judgments and reliably discriminates levels of abstraction efficiency, while CommonSketch serves as a benchmark providing systematic evaluation of element-level sketch understanding across various vision-language models.

AI.tldr: SEA是一个无参考的草图评估指标，用于量化草图语义抽象的效率和保留程度，同时提出了CommonSketch数据集作为基准。
AI.motivation: 现有草图评估方法依赖参考图像、低级视觉特征或识别准确率，无法捕捉草图的本质属性——抽象性。需要一种能够量化草图语义抽象效率的方法。
AI.method: 提出SEA指标，基于常识知识提取每个类别的定义性视觉元素，利用视觉问答模型检测这些元素的存在，计算语义保留与视觉经济性的量化分数。同时构建CommonSketch数据集，包含23,100张人工绘制的草图，涵盖300个类别，每张草图都有标题和元素级标注。
AI.result: SEA指标与人类判断高度一致，能够可靠地区分不同抽象效率水平。CommonSketch数据集为各种视觉语言模型提供了系统评估元素级草图理解能力的基准。
AI.conclusion: SEA是首个能够量化草图语义抽象效率的评估指标，CommonSketch数据集填补了语义标注草图数据的空白，为草图理解研究提供了重要工具和基准。

title: AutoCut: End-to-end advertisement video editing based on multimodal discretization and controllable generation
summary: Short-form videos have become a primary medium for digital advertising, requiring scalable and efficient content creation. However, current workflows and AI tools remain disjoint and modality-specific, leading to high production costs and low overall efficiency. To address this issue, we propose AutoCut, an end-to-end advertisement video editing framework based on multimodal discretization and controllable editing. AutoCut employs dedicated encoders to extract video and audio features, then applies residual vector quantization to discretize them into unified tokens aligned with textual representations, constructing a shared video-audio-text token space. Built upon a foundation model, we further develop a multimodal large language model for video editing through combined multimodal alignment and supervised fine-tuning, supporting tasks covering video selection and ordering, script generation, and background music selection within a unified editing framework. Finally, a complete production pipeline converts the predicted token sequences into deployable long video outputs. Experiments on real-world advertisement datasets show that AutoCut reduces production cost and iteration time while substantially improving consistency and controllability, paving the way for scalable video creation.

AI.tldr: AutoCut是一个基于多模态离散化和可控编辑的端到端广告视频编辑框架，通过构建共享的视频-音频-文本标记空间，实现高效、可扩展的视频内容创作。
AI.motivation: 短视频已成为数字广告的主要媒介，但当前的工作流程和AI工具仍然是分散和模态特定的，导致制作成本高、整体效率低。需要一种统一、高效的视频编辑解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 使用专用编码器提取视频和音频特征，通过残差向量量化将其离散化为统一标记，与文本表示对齐，构建共享的视频-音频-文本标记空间；2) 基于基础模型开发多模态大语言模型，通过多模态对齐和监督微调支持视频选择排序、脚本生成、背景音乐选择等任务；3) 完整的生产流水线将预测的标记序列转换为可部署的长视频输出。
AI.result: 在真实广告数据集上的实验表明，AutoCut显著降低了制作成本和迭代时间，同时大幅提高了视频内容的一致性和可控性。
AI.conclusion: AutoCut为可扩展的视频创作铺平了道路，通过统一的多模态编辑框架解决了当前视频制作流程中的效率瓶颈问题。

title: Rethinking Structure Preservation in Text-Guided Image Editing with Visual Autoregressive Models
summary: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models have recently emerged as a promising family of generative models, enabling a wide range of downstream vision tasks such as text-guided image editing. By shifting the editing paradigm from noise manipulation in diffusion-based methods to token-level operations, VAR-based approaches achieve better background preservation and significantly faster inference. However, existing VAR-based editing methods still face two key challenges: accurately localizing editable tokens and maintaining structural consistency in the edited results. In this work, we propose a novel text-guided image editing framework rooted in an analysis of intermediate feature distributions within VAR models. First, we introduce a coarse-to-fine token localization strategy that can refine editable regions, balancing editing fidelity and background preservation. Second, we analyze the intermediate representations of VAR models and identify structure-related features, by which we design a simple yet effective feature injection mechanism to enhance structural consistency between the edited and source images. Third, we develop a reinforcement learning-based adaptive feature injection scheme that automatically learns scale- and layer-specific injection ratios to jointly optimize editing fidelity and structure preservation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior structural consistency and editing quality compared with state-of-the-art approaches, across both local and global editing scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于VAR模型的文本引导图像编辑框架，通过分析中间特征分布，采用粗到细的token定位策略和特征注入机制，结合强化学习优化编辑保真度和结构一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VAR的编辑方法面临两个关键挑战：准确定位可编辑token和保持编辑结果的结构一致性。VAR模型通过token级操作相比基于噪声操作的扩散方法具有更好的背景保留和更快的推理速度，但在编辑精度和结构保持方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 1. 粗到细的token定位策略，平衡编辑保真度和背景保留；2. 分析VAR模型的中间表示，识别结构相关特征，设计简单有效的特征注入机制；3. 开发基于强化学习的自适应特征注入方案，自动学习特定尺度和层的注入比例，联合优化编辑保真度和结构保持。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在局部和全局编辑场景中，相比最先进的方法实现了更优越的结构一致性和编辑质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析VAR模型的中间特征分布，提出的框架有效解决了现有VAR编辑方法在token定位和结构一致性方面的挑战，实现了高质量的文本引导图像编辑。

title: SVH-BD : Synthetic Vegetation Hyperspectral Benchmark Dataset for Emulation of Remote Sensing Images
summary: This dataset provides a large collection of 10,915 synthetic hyperspectral image cubes paired with pixel-level vegetation trait maps, designed to support research in radiative transfer emulation, vegetation trait retrieval, and uncertainty quantification. Each hyperspectral cube contains 211 bands spanning 400--2500 nm at 10 nm resolution and a fixed spatial layout of 64 \times 64 pixels, offering continuous simulated surface reflectance spectra suitable for emulator development and machine-learning tasks requiring high spectral detail. Vegetation traits were derived by inverting Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance using a PROSAIL-based lookup-table approach, followed by forward PROSAIL simulations to generate hyperspectral reflectance under physically consistent canopy and illumination conditions. The dataset covers four ecologically diverse regions -- East Africa, Northern France, Eastern India, and Southern Spain -- and includes 5th and 95th percentile uncertainty maps as well as Sentinel-2 scene classification layers. This resource enables benchmarking of inversion methods, development of fast radiative transfer emulators, and studies of spectral--biophysical relationships under controlled yet realistic environmental variability.

AI.tldr: 该数据集提供了10,915个合成高光谱图像立方体与像素级植被特征图的配对，用于支持辐射传输模拟、植被特征反演和不确定性量化研究。
AI.motivation: 为辐射传输模拟、植被特征反演和不确定性量化研究提供大规模、高质量的合成数据集，以支持机器学习方法在这些领域的开发与基准测试。
AI.method: 使用基于PROSAIL的查找表方法反演Sentinel-2 Level-2A地表反射率获取植被特征，然后通过前向PROSAIL模拟在物理一致的冠层和光照条件下生成高光谱反射率数据。
AI.result: 创建了包含10,915个高光谱图像立方体的数据集，每个立方体包含211个波段（400-2500nm，10nm分辨率），空间布局为64×64像素，覆盖四个生态多样性区域，并包含不确定性图和Sentinel-2场景分类层。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为反演方法基准测试、快速辐射传输模拟器开发以及在受控但真实的环境变异性下研究光谱-生物物理关系提供了有价值的资源。

title: From Pixels to Reality: Physical-Digital Patch Attacks on Real-World Camera
summary: This demonstration presents Digital-Physical Adversarial Attacks (DiPA), a new class of practical adversarial attacks against pervasive camera-based authentication systems, where an attacker displays an adversarial patch directly on a smartphone screen instead of relying on printed artifacts. This digital-only physical presentation enables rapid deployment, removes the need for total-variation regularization, and improves patch transferability in black-box conditions. DiPA leverages an ensemble of state-of-the-art face-recognition models (ArcFace, MagFace, CosFace) to enhance transfer across unseen commercial systems. Our interactive demo shows a real-time dodging attack against a deployed face-recognition camera, preventing authorized users from being recognized while participants dynamically adjust patch patterns and observe immediate effects on the sensing pipeline. We further demonstrate DiPA's superiority over existing physical attacks in terms of success rate, feature-space distortion, and reductions in detection confidence, highlighting critical vulnerabilities at the intersection of mobile devices, pervasive vision, and sensor-driven authentication infrastructures.

AI.tldr: DiPA是一种针对摄像头认证系统的新型数字物理对抗攻击，通过在智能手机屏幕上显示对抗性补丁而非打印实体，实现快速部署并提升黑盒条件下的攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 针对普遍存在的基于摄像头的认证系统存在安全漏洞，传统物理攻击需要打印对抗补丁，部署不便且效果有限，需要更实用、高效的攻击方法。
AI.method: 使用智能手机屏幕直接显示对抗性补丁，利用ArcFace、MagFace、CosFace等先进人脸识别模型的集成来增强攻击的迁移性，无需总变差正则化，支持实时交互调整。
AI.result: DiPA在成功攻击率、特征空间扭曲和降低检测置信度方面优于现有物理攻击方法，能够实时阻止授权用户被识别，展示了商业人脸识别系统的关键漏洞。
AI.conclusion: DiPA揭示了移动设备、普适视觉和传感器驱动认证基础设施交叉领域的安全脆弱性，数字物理对抗攻击比传统方法更实用有效，对实际部署的认证系统构成严重威胁。

title: $R_{dm}$: Re-conceptualizing Distribution Matching as a Reward for Diffusion Distillation
summary: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art generative performance but are fundamentally bottlenecked by their slow iterative sampling process. While diffusion distillation techniques enable high-fidelity few-step generation, traditional objectives often restrict the student's performance by anchoring it solely to the teacher. Recent approaches have attempted to break this ceiling by integrating Reinforcement Learning (RL), typically through a simple summation of distillation and RL objectives. In this work, we propose a novel paradigm by reconceptualizing distribution matching as a reward, denoted as $R_{dm}$. This unified perspective bridges the algorithmic gap between Diffusion Matching Distillation (DMD) and RL, providing several key benefits. (1) Enhanced optimization stability: we introduce Group Normalized Distribution Matching (GNDM), which adapts standard RL group normalization to stabilize $R_{dm}$ estimation. By leveraging group-mean statistics, GNDM establishes a more robust and effective optimization direction. (2) Seamless reward integration: our reward-centric formulation inherently supports adaptive weighting mechanisms, allowing flexible combination of DMD with external reward models. (3) Improved sampling efficiency: by aligning with RL principles, the framework readily incorporates importance sampling (IS), leading to a significant boost in sampling efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GNDM outperforms vanilla DMD, reducing the FID by 1.87. Furthermore, our multi-reward variant, GNDMR, surpasses existing baselines by achieving a strong balance between aesthetic quality and fidelity, reaching a peak HPS of 30.37 and a low FID-SD of 12.21. Overall, $R_{dm}$ provides a flexible, stable, and efficient framework for real-time high-fidelity synthesis. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将分布匹配重构为奖励的新范式，通过GNDM稳定优化并提升扩散模型采样效率，在图像生成质量上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽然生成质量高，但迭代采样过程缓慢。现有蒸馏方法将学生模型限制在教师模型性能内，而简单的RL融合方法效果有限。需要一种能突破性能天花板的新方法。
AI.method: 将分布匹配重构为奖励R_dm，提出GNDM（组归一化分布匹配）稳定奖励估计，支持自适应权重机制，并引入重要性采样提升效率。多奖励变体GNDMR结合外部奖励模型。
AI.result: GNDM比原始DMD降低FID 1.87分；GNDMR在美学质量和保真度间达到最佳平衡，HPS达30.37，FID-SD低至12.21，超越现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: R_dm提供了一个灵活、稳定且高效的框架，能够实现实时高保真合成，为扩散模型加速和性能提升提供了新思路。

title: Post-hoc Self-explanation of CNNs
summary: Although standard Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) can be mathematically reinterpreted as Self-Explainable Models (SEMs), their built-in prototypes do not on their own accurately represent the data. Replacing the final linear layer with a $k$-means-based classifier addresses this limitation without compromising performance. This work introduces a common formalization of $k$-means-based post-hoc explanations for the classifier, the encoder's final output (B4), and combinations of intermediate feature activations. The latter approach leverages the spatial consistency of convolutional receptive fields to generate concept-based explanation maps, which are supported by gradient-free feature attribution maps. Empirical evaluation with a ResNet34 shows that using shallower, less compressed feature activations, such as those from the last three blocks (B234), results in a trade-off between semantic fidelity and a slight reduction in predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 标准CNN可重构为自解释模型，但其内置原型无法准确表征数据。使用k-means分类器替代最终线性层可解决此问题且不损失性能。本文形式化了k-means后验解释方法，并利用卷积感受野的空间一致性生成基于概念的解释图。
AI.motivation: 标准卷积神经网络虽然可以数学重构为自解释模型，但其内置原型无法准确表示数据特征，需要改进解释性方法。
AI.method: 使用k-means分类器替代CNN的最终线性层；形式化了k-means后验解释方法，包括分类器、编码器最终输出和中间特征激活的组合；利用卷积感受野的空间一致性生成概念解释图，并辅以无梯度特征归因图。
AI.result: 在ResNet34上的实验表明，使用较浅层、压缩程度较低的特征激活（如最后三个块B234）需要在语义保真度和轻微预测性能下降之间进行权衡。
AI.conclusion: k-means分类器能有效提升CNN的解释性而不损失性能，通过利用中间特征的空间一致性可以生成概念解释图，为模型可解释性提供了新方法。

title: INSID3: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with DINOv3
summary: In-context segmentation (ICS) aims to segment arbitrary concepts, e.g., objects, parts, or personalized instances, given one annotated visual examples. Existing work relies on (i) fine-tuning vision foundation models (VFMs), which improves in-domain results but harms generalization, or (ii) combines multiple frozen VFMs, which preserves generalization but yields architectural complexity and fixed segmentation granularities. We revisit ICS from a minimalist perspective and ask: Can a single self-supervised backbone support both semantic matching and segmentation, without any supervision or auxiliary models? We show that scaled-up dense self-supervised features from DINOv3 exhibit strong spatial structure and semantic correspondence. We introduce INSID3, a training-free approach that segments concepts at varying granularities only from frozen DINOv3 features, given an in-context example. INSID3 achieves state-of-the-art results across one-shot semantic, part, and personalized segmentation, outperforming previous work by +7.5 % mIoU, while using 3x fewer parameters and without any mask or category-level supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/visinf/INSID3 .

AI.tldr: INSID3是一个无需训练的上下文分割方法，仅使用冻结的DINOv3特征就能在不同粒度上分割任意概念，在多个任务上达到SOTA，参数量减少3倍且无需监督。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文分割方法存在两个问题：1）微调视觉基础模型会损害泛化能力；2）组合多个冻结模型导致架构复杂且分割粒度固定。本文探索能否仅用单个自监督骨干网络同时支持语义匹配和分割。
AI.method: 提出INSID3方法，利用DINOv3的密集自监督特征（具有强空间结构和语义对应性），仅从冻结的DINOv3特征中实现不同粒度的概念分割，无需任何训练或辅助模型。
AI.result: 在一次性语义分割、部件分割和个性化分割任务上达到最先进水平，相比之前工作提升+7.5% mIoU，同时使用3倍更少的参数，且无需掩码或类别级监督。
AI.conclusion: 单个自监督骨干网络（DINOv3）足以支持上下文分割，INSID3展示了自监督特征的强大能力，为简洁高效的视觉理解系统提供了新方向。

title: ConceptWeaver: Weaving Disentangled Concepts with Flow
summary: Pre-trained flow-based models excel at synthesizing complex scenes yet lack a direct mechanism for disentangling and customizing their underlying concepts from one-shot real-world sources. To demystify this process, we first introduce a novel differential probing technique to isolate and analyze the influence of individual concept tokens on the velocity field over time. This investigation yields a critical insight: the generative process is not monolithic but unfolds in three distinct stages. An initial \textbf{Blueprint Stage} establishes low-frequency structure, followed by a pivotal \textbf{Instantiation Stage} where content concepts emerge with peak intensity and become naturally disentangled, creating an optimal window for manipulation. A final concept-insensitive refinement stage then synthesizes fine-grained details. Guided by this discovery, we propose \textbf{ConceptWeaver}, a framework for one-shot concept disentanglement. ConceptWeaver learns concept-specific semantic offsets from a single reference image using a stage-aware optimization strategy that aligns with the three-stage framework. These learned offsets are then deployed during inference via our novel ConceptWeaver Guidance (CWG) mechanism, which strategically injects them at the appropriate generative stage. Extensive experiments validate that ConceptWeaver enables high-fidelity, compositional synthesis and editing, demonstrating that understanding and leveraging the intrinsic, staged nature of flow models is key to unlocking precise, multi-granularity content manipulation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ConceptWeaver框架，通过分析流模型的生成过程发现三阶段模式，实现单样本概念解耦和定制化生成
AI.motivation: 预训练的流模型擅长合成复杂场景，但缺乏从单样本真实世界源中解耦和定制其底层概念的机制。需要理解生成过程的内在结构以实现精确的内容操作。
AI.method: 1. 引入差分探测技术分析概念令牌对速度场的影响；2. 发现生成过程分为蓝图阶段、实例化阶段和细化阶段；3. 提出ConceptWeaver框架，使用阶段感知优化策略学习概念特定语义偏移；4. 开发ConceptWeaver Guidance机制在推理时注入学习到的偏移。
AI.result: 实验验证ConceptWeaver能够实现高保真度的组合合成和编辑，表明理解和利用流模型内在的分阶段性质是实现精确、多粒度内容操作的关键。
AI.conclusion: 流模型的生成过程具有明确的三阶段结构，其中实例化阶段是概念解耦和操作的最佳窗口。ConceptWeaver框架通过阶段感知优化和指导机制，成功实现了单样本概念解耦和精确内容操作。

title: Bridging the Geometry Mismatch: Frequency-Aware Anisotropic Serialization for Thin-Structure SSMs
summary: The segmentation of thin linear structures is inherently topology allowbreak-critical, where minor local errors can sever long-range connectivity. While recent State-Space Models (SSMs) offer efficient long-range modeling, their isotropic serialization (e.g., raster scanning) creates a geometry mismatch for anisotropic targets, causing state propagation across rather than along the structure trajectories. To address this, we propose FGOS-Net, a framework based on frequency allowbreak-geometric disentanglement. We first decompose features into a stable topology carrier and directional high-frequency bands, leveraging the latter to explicitly correct spatial misalignments induced by downsampling. Building on this calibrated topology, we introduce frequency-aligned scanning that elevates serialization to a geometry-conditioned decision, preserving direction-consistent traces. Coupled with an active probing strategy to selectively inject high-frequency details and suppress texture ambiguity, FGOS-Net consistently outperforms strong baselines across four challenging benchmarks. Notably, it achieves 91.3% mIoU and 97.1% clDice on DeepCrack while running at 80 FPS with only 7.87 GFLOPs.

AI.tldr: FGOS-Net通过频率-几何解耦框架解决细长线性结构分割中的拓扑保持问题，利用频率对齐扫描和主动探测策略，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 细长线性结构分割对拓扑保持要求极高，局部微小错误会破坏长程连接性。现有状态空间模型的各向同性序列化（如光栅扫描）与细长结构的各向异性特征不匹配，导致状态传播跨越而非沿着结构轨迹。
AI.method: 提出基于频率-几何解耦的FGOS-Net框架：1）将特征分解为稳定的拓扑载体和方向性高频带，利用高频带显式校正下采样引起的空间错位；2）在标定拓扑基础上引入频率对齐扫描，将序列化提升为几何条件决策，保持方向一致轨迹；3）采用主动探测策略选择性注入高频细节并抑制纹理模糊。
AI.result: 在四个具有挑战性的基准测试中一致优于强基线方法，在DeepCrack上达到91.3% mIoU和97.1% clDice，运行速度80 FPS，仅需7.87 GFLOPs。
AI.conclusion: FGOS-Net通过频率-几何解耦有效解决了细长线性结构分割中的拓扑保持问题，频率对齐扫描和主动探测策略显著提升了分割性能，在精度和效率方面都表现出色。

title: Generalizable Detection of AI Generated Images with Large Models and Fuzzy Decision Tree
summary: The malicious use and widespread dissemination of AI-generated images pose a serious threat to the authenticity of digital content. Existing detection methods exploit low-level artifacts left by common manipulation steps within the generation pipeline, but they often lack generalization due to model-specific overfitting. Recently, researchers have resorted to Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for AIGC detection, leveraging their high-level semantic reasoning and broad generalization capabilities. While promising, MLLMs lack the fine-grained perceptual sensitivity to subtle generation artifacts, making them inadequate as standalone detectors. To address this issue, we propose a novel AI-generated image detection framework that synergistically integrates lightweight artifact-aware detectors with MLLMs via a fuzzy decision tree. The decision tree treats the outputs of basic detectors as fuzzy membership values, enabling adaptive fusion of complementary cues from semantic and perceptual perspectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and strong generalization across diverse generative models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合轻量级伪影感知检测器与多模态大语言模型的AI生成图像检测框架，通过模糊决策树自适应融合语义和感知线索，实现高精度和强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像的恶意使用和广泛传播严重威胁数字内容的真实性。现有检测方法依赖生成流程中的低级伪影，但常因模型特定过拟合而缺乏泛化能力。多模态大语言模型虽具高级语义推理和泛化能力，但对细微生成伪影的感知灵敏度不足，无法作为独立检测器。
AI.method: 提出新颖的AI生成图像检测框架，通过模糊决策树协同整合轻量级伪影感知检测器与多模态大语言模型。决策树将基础检测器的输出视为模糊隶属度值，实现从语义和感知角度自适应融合互补线索。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在多种生成模型中实现了最先进的检测精度和强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过模糊决策树融合轻量级伪影感知检测器和多模态大语言模型，有效解决了AI生成图像检测中的泛化问题和感知灵敏度不足问题，为数字内容真实性验证提供了有效解决方案。

title: GEditBench v2: A Human-Aligned Benchmark for General Image Editing
summary: Recent advances in image editing have enabled models to handle complex instructions with impressive realism. However, existing evaluation frameworks lag behind: current benchmarks suffer from narrow task coverage, while standard metrics fail to adequately capture visual consistency, i.e., the preservation of identity, structure and semantic coherence between edited and original images. To address these limitations, we introduce GEditBench v2, a comprehensive benchmark with 1,200 real-world user queries spanning 23 tasks, including a dedicated open-set category for unconstrained, out-of-distribution editing instructions beyond predefined tasks. Furthermore, we propose PVC-Judge, an open-source pairwise assessment model for visual consistency, trained via two novel region-decoupled preference data synthesis pipelines. Besides, we construct VCReward-Bench using expert-annotated preference pairs to assess the alignment of PVC-Judge with human judgments on visual consistency evaluation. Experiments show that our PVC-Judge achieves state-of-the-art evaluation performance among open-source models and even surpasses GPT-5.1 on average. Finally, by benchmarking 16 frontier editing models, we show that GEditBench v2 enables more human-aligned evaluation, revealing critical limitations of current models, and providing a reliable foundation for advancing precise image editing.

AI.tldr: GEditBench v2是一个包含1200个真实用户查询、覆盖23个任务的图像编辑基准测试，包含开放集类别；同时提出PVC-Judge开源模型用于视觉一致性评估，在VCReward-Bench上表现优于GPT-5.1
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑评估框架落后于技术进步：当前基准测试任务覆盖范围窄，标准指标无法充分捕捉编辑前后图像的视觉一致性（身份、结构和语义连贯性的保持）
AI.method: 1. 引入GEditBench v2基准测试，包含1200个真实用户查询，覆盖23个任务，包含开放集类别；2. 提出PVC-Judge开源成对评估模型，通过两种新颖的区域解耦偏好数据合成管道训练；3. 构建VCReward-Bench使用专家标注的偏好对来评估PVC-Judge与人类判断的一致性
AI.result: PVC-Judge在开源模型中达到最先进的评估性能，平均表现甚至超过GPT-5.1；通过对16个前沿编辑模型的基准测试，GEditBench v2实现了更符合人类判断的评估，揭示了当前模型的关键限制
AI.conclusion: GEditBench v2和PVC-Judge为图像编辑评估提供了更全面、更符合人类判断的框架，为推进精确图像编辑技术奠定了可靠基础

title: Seen2Scene: Completing Realistic 3D Scenes with Visibility-Guided Flow
summary: We present Seen2Scene, the first flow matching-based approach that trains directly on incomplete, real-world 3D scans for scene completion and generation. Unlike prior methods that rely on complete and hence synthetic 3D data, our approach introduces visibility-guided flow matching, which explicitly masks out unknown regions in real scans, enabling effective learning from real-world, partial observations. We represent 3D scenes using truncated signed distance field (TSDF) volumes encoded in sparse grids and employ a sparse transformer to efficiently model complex scene structures while masking unknown regions. We employ 3D layout boxes as an input conditioning signal, and our approach is flexibly adapted to various other inputs such as text or partial scans. By learning directly from real-world, incomplete 3D scans, Seen2Scene enables realistic 3D scene completion for complex, cluttered real environments. Experiments demonstrate that our model produces coherent, complete, and realistic 3D scenes, outperforming baselines in completion accuracy and generation quality.

AI.tldr: Seen2Scene是首个基于流匹配的方法，直接在真实世界不完整的3D扫描数据上训练，用于场景补全和生成，避免了依赖合成完整数据的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖完整但合成的3D数据，无法有效处理真实世界中不完整的3D扫描。需要一种能直接从真实、不完整扫描中学习的方法，以实现对复杂、杂乱真实环境的现实3D场景补全。
AI.method: 提出可见性引导的流匹配方法，显式掩码真实扫描中的未知区域；使用截断有符号距离场（TSDF）体素在稀疏网格中表示3D场景；采用稀疏Transformer高效建模复杂场景结构；以3D布局框作为输入条件信号，并可灵活适应文本或部分扫描等其他输入。
AI.result: 实验表明，该模型能生成连贯、完整且现实的3D场景，在补全准确性和生成质量方面优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Seen2Scene通过直接从真实世界不完整3D扫描中学习，实现了对复杂、杂乱真实环境的现实3D场景补全和生成，为基于真实扫描数据的3D场景理解提供了新方法。

title: MarkushGrapher-2: End-to-end Multimodal Recognition of Chemical Structures
comment: 15 pages, to be published in CVPR 2026
summary: Automatically extracting chemical structures from documents is essential for the large-scale analysis of the literature in chemistry. Automatic pipelines have been developed to recognize molecules represented either in figures or in text independently. However, methods for recognizing chemical structures from multimodal descriptions (Markush structures) lag behind in precision and cannot be used for automatic large-scale processing. In this work, we present MarkushGrapher-2, an end-to-end approach for the multimodal recognition of chemical structures in documents. First, our method employs a dedicated OCR model to extract text from chemical images. Second, the text, image, and layout information are jointly encoded through a Vision-Text-Layout encoder and an Optical Chemical Structure Recognition vision encoder. Finally, the resulting encodings are effectively fused through a two-stage training strategy and used to auto-regressively generate a representation of the Markush structure. To address the lack of training data, we introduce an automatic pipeline for constructing a large-scale dataset of real-world Markush structures. In addition, we present IP5-M, a large manually-annotated benchmark of real-world Markush structures, designed to advance research on this challenging task. Extensive experiments show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art models in multimodal Markush structure recognition, while maintaining strong performance in molecule structure recognition. Code, models, and datasets are released publicly.

AI.tldr: MarkushGrapher-2：一种端到端的多模态化学结构识别方法，专门用于从文档中提取复杂的Markush结构，通过结合文本、图像和布局信息，显著提升了识别精度。
AI.motivation: 化学文献中自动提取化学结构对于大规模分析至关重要。现有方法主要独立处理图像或文本中的分子表示，但对于多模态描述（Markush结构）的识别精度不足，无法用于自动大规模处理。
AI.method: 1. 使用专用OCR模型从化学图像中提取文本；2. 通过视觉-文本-布局编码器和光学化学结构识别视觉编码器联合编码文本、图像和布局信息；3. 采用两阶段训练策略有效融合编码结果，自回归生成Markush结构表示；4. 构建自动流水线生成大规模真实世界Markush结构数据集。
AI.result: 该方法在多模态Markush结构识别方面显著优于现有最先进模型，同时在分子结构识别方面保持强大性能。发布了IP5-M大型人工标注基准数据集。
AI.conclusion: MarkushGrapher-2通过多模态融合和两阶段训练策略，有效解决了Markush结构识别精度不足的问题，为化学文献的大规模自动分析提供了实用工具。代码、模型和数据集均已公开。

title: XSPA: Crafting Imperceptible X-Shaped Sparse Adversarial Perturbations for Transferable Attacks on VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) rely on a shared visual-textual representation space to perform tasks such as zero-shot classification, image captioning, and visual question answering (VQA). While this shared space enables strong cross-task generalization, it may also introduce a common vulnerability: small visual perturbations can propagate through the shared embedding space and cause correlated semantic failures across tasks. This risk is particularly important in interactive and decision-support settings, yet it remains unclear whether VLMs are robust to highly constrained, sparse, and geometrically fixed perturbations. To address this question, we propose X-shaped Sparse Pixel Attack (XSPA), an imperceptible structured attack that restricts perturbations to two intersecting diagonal lines. Compared with dense perturbations or flexible localized patches, XSPA operates under a much stricter attack budget and thus provides a more stringent test of VLM robustness. Within this sparse support, XSPA jointly optimizes a classification objective, cross-task semantic guidance, and regularization on perturbation magnitude and along-line smoothness, inducing transferable misclassification as well as semantic drift in captioning and VQA while preserving visual subtlety. Under the default setting, XSPA modifies only about 1.76% of image pixels. Experiments on the COCO dataset show that XSPA consistently degrades performance across all three tasks. Zero-shot accuracy drops by 52.33 points on OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 and 67.00 points on OpenCLIP ViT-B/16, while GPT-4-evaluated caption consistency decreases by up to 58.60 points and VQA correctness by up to 44.38 points. These results suggest that even highly sparse and visually subtle perturbations with fixed geometric priors can substantially disrupt cross-task semantics in VLMs, revealing a notable robustness gap in current multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: XSPA是一种稀疏像素攻击方法，通过在图像上添加两条交叉对角线的微小扰动，能够显著降低视觉语言模型在零样本分类、图像描述和视觉问答三个任务上的性能，揭示了当前多模态系统的鲁棒性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型依赖共享的视觉-文本表示空间来实现跨任务泛化，但这种共享空间可能引入共同的脆弱性：微小的视觉扰动可能通过共享嵌入空间传播，导致跨任务的语义失败。目前尚不清楚VLMs是否对高度受限、稀疏且几何固定的扰动具有鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出X形稀疏像素攻击(XSPA)，这是一种不可感知的结构化攻击，将扰动限制在两条相交的对角线上。在稀疏支持的基础上，XSPA联合优化分类目标、跨任务语义指导以及扰动幅度和沿线平滑度的正则化，同时保持视觉上的微妙性。
AI.result: 在COCO数据集上的实验表明，XSPA仅修改约1.76%的图像像素，就能在所有三个任务上持续降低性能：OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14的零样本准确率下降52.33点，OpenCLIP ViT-B/16下降67.00点；GPT-4评估的描述一致性下降高达58.60点，VQA正确性下降高达44.38点。
AI.conclusion: 即使高度稀疏且视觉上微妙的固定几何先验扰动，也能显著破坏VLMs中的跨任务语义，揭示了当前多模态系统中存在显著的鲁棒性差距。

title: ELViS: Efficient Visual Similarity from Local Descriptors that Generalizes Across Domains
summary: Large-scale instance-level training data is scarce, so models are typically trained on domain-specific datasets. Yet in real-world retrieval, they must handle diverse domains, making generalization to unseen data critical. We introduce ELViS, an image-to-image similarity model that generalizes effectively to unseen domains. Unlike conventional approaches, our model operates in similarity space rather than representation space, promoting cross-domain transfer. It leverages local descriptor correspondences, refines their similarities through an optimal transport step with data-dependent gains that suppress uninformative descriptors, and aggregates strong correspondences via a voting process into an image-level similarity. This design injects strong inductive biases, yielding a simple, efficient, and interpretable model. To assess generalization, we compile a benchmark of eight datasets spanning landmarks, artworks, products, and multi-domain collections, and evaluate ELViS as a re-ranking method. Our experiments show that ELViS outperforms competing methods by a large margin in out-of-domain scenarios and on average, while requiring only a fraction of their computational cost. Code available at: https://github.com/pavelsuma/ELViS/

AI.tldr: ELViS是一个图像到图像相似度模型，通过在相似度空间而非表示空间操作，利用局部描述符对应关系、最优传输步骤和数据依赖增益来抑制无信息描述符，并通过投票过程聚合强对应关系，实现跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 大规模实例级训练数据稀缺，模型通常在特定领域数据集上训练，但实际检索需要处理多样化领域，因此对未见数据的泛化能力至关重要。
AI.method: 模型在相似度空间而非表示空间操作，利用局部描述符对应关系，通过最优传输步骤和数据依赖增益抑制无信息描述符，通过投票过程聚合强对应关系形成图像级相似度。
AI.result: 在包含地标、艺术品、产品和多领域集合的8个数据集基准测试中，ELViS在跨域场景和平均性能上大幅优于竞争方法，同时仅需其计算成本的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: ELViS通过相似度空间操作和强归纳偏置设计，实现了简单、高效、可解释的跨域泛化图像相似度模型，在未见领域表现优异且计算成本低。

title: Unsafe2Safe: Controllable Image Anonymization for Downstream Utility
