comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 and CVPR 2026 Workshop on Machine Unlearning for Computer Vision
summary: Large-scale image datasets frequently contain identifiable or sensitive content, raising privacy risks when training models that may memorize and leak such information. We present Unsafe2Safe, a fully automated pipeline that detects privacy-prone images and rewrites only their sensitive regions using multimodally guided diffusion editing. Unsafe2Safe operates in two stages. Stage 1 uses a vision-language model to (i) inspect images for privacy risks, (ii) generate paired private and public captions that respectively include and omit sensitive attributes, and (iii) prompt a large language model to produce structured, identity-neutral edit instructions conditioned on the public caption. Stage 2 employs instruction-driven diffusion editors to apply these dual textual prompts, producing privacy-safe images that preserve global structure and task-relevant semantics while neutralizing private content. To measure anonymization quality, we introduce a unified evaluation suite covering Quality, Cheating, Privacy, and Utility dimensions. Across MS-COCO, Caltech101, and MIT Indoor67, Unsafe2Safe reduces face similarity, text similarity, and demographic predictability by large margins, while maintaining downstream model accuracy comparable to training on raw data. Fine-tuning diffusion editors on our automatically generated triplets (private caption, public caption, edit instruction) further improves both privacy protection and semantic fidelity. Unsafe2Safe provides a scalable, principled solution for constructing large, privacy-safe datasets without sacrificing visual consistency or downstream utility.

AI.tldr: Unsafe2Safe是一个自动化管道，通过两阶段多模态扩散编辑检测和重写隐私敏感图像区域，在保护隐私的同时保持图像结构和下游任务效用。
AI.motivation: 大规模图像数据集常包含可识别或敏感内容，训练模型时可能记忆并泄露这些信息，存在隐私风险。需要一种自动化方法来创建隐私安全的数据集，同时保持视觉一致性和下游任务效用。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：第一阶段使用视觉语言模型检测隐私风险，生成成对的私有和公共描述，并通过大语言模型生成结构化编辑指令；第二阶段使用指令驱动的扩散编辑器应用双重文本提示，重写敏感区域。
AI.result: 在MS-COCO、Caltech101和MIT Indoor67数据集上，Unsafe2Safe显著降低了人脸相似度、文本相似度和人口统计可预测性，同时保持与原始数据训练相当的下游模型准确率。在自动生成的三元组上微调扩散编辑器进一步提高了隐私保护和语义保真度。
AI.conclusion: Unsafe2Safe提供了一个可扩展、原则性的解决方案，用于构建大规模隐私安全数据集，无需牺牲视觉一致性或下游效用。该方法通过自动化检测和编辑敏感内容，有效平衡了隐私保护和数据实用性。

title: Divide and Restore: A Modular Task-Decoupled Framework for Universal Image Restoration
summary: Restoring images affected by various types of degradation, such as noise, blur, or improper exposure, remains a significant challenge in computer vision. While recent trends favor complex monolithic all-in-one architectures, these models often suffer from negative task interference and require extensive joint training cycles on high-end computing clusters. In this paper, we propose a modular, task-decoupled image restoration framework based on an explicit diagnostic routing mechanism. The architecture consists of a lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classifier that evaluates the input image and dynamically directs it to a specialized restoration node. A key advantage of this framework is its model-agnostic extensibility: while we demonstrate it using three independent U-Net experts, the system allows for the integration of any restoration method tailored to specific tasks. By isolating reconstruction paths, the framework prevents feature conflicts and significantly reduces training overhead. Unlike monolithic models, adding new degradation types in our framework only requires training a single expert and updating the router, rather than a full system retraining. Experimental results demonstrate that this computationally accessible approach offers a scalable and efficient solution for multi-degradation restoration on standard local hardware. The code will be published upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于诊断路由的模块化图像修复框架，通过轻量级CNN分类器动态分配任务到专用修复节点，避免任务干扰并降低训练开销
AI.motivation: 当前复杂的单体式一体化架构存在负面任务干扰问题，需要大量联合训练计算资源，需要更高效、可扩展的图像修复解决方案
AI.method: 采用任务解耦的模块化框架，包含轻量级CNN分类器作为路由器，动态评估输入图像并分配到专用修复节点（使用三个独立U-Net专家），支持任意修复方法的集成
AI.result: 该框架防止特征冲突，显著减少训练开销，添加新退化类型只需训练单个专家和更新路由器，在标准本地硬件上提供可扩展的高效多退化修复方案
AI.conclusion: 模块化任务解耦框架为多退化图像修复提供了计算可访问、可扩展且高效的解决方案，优于复杂的单体式架构

title: DreamLite: A Lightweight On-Device Unified Model for Image Generation and Editing
summary: Diffusion models have made significant progress in both text-to-image (T2I) generation and text-guided image editing. However, these models are typically built with billions of parameters, leading to high latency and increased deployment challenges. While on-device diffusion models improve efficiency, they largely focus on T2I generation and lack support for image editing. In this paper, we propose DreamLite, a compact unified on-device diffusion model (0.39B) that supports both T2I generation and text-guided image editing within a single network. DreamLite is built on a pruned mobile U-Net backbone and unifies conditioning through in-context spatial concatenation in the latent space. It concatenates images horizontally as input, using a (target | blank) configuration for generation tasks and (target | source) for editing tasks. To stabilize the training of this compact model, we introduce a task-progressive joint pretraining strategy that sequentially targets T2I, editing, and joint tasks. After high-quality SFT and reinforcement learning, DreamLite achieves GenEval (0.72) for image generation and ImgEdit (4.11) for image editing, outperforming existing on-device models and remaining competitive with several server-side models. By employing step distillation, we further reduce denoising processing to just 4 steps, enabling our DreamLite could generate or edit a 1024 x 1024 image in less than 1s on a Xiaomi 14 smartphone. To the best of our knowledge, DreamLite is the first unified on-device diffusion model that supports both image generation and image editing.

AI.tldr: DreamLite是一个紧凑的统一设备端扩散模型（0.39B参数），在单个网络中同时支持文本到图像生成和文本引导的图像编辑，通过4步去噪处理可在手机上1秒内完成1024×1024图像处理。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散模型通常有数十亿参数，导致高延迟和部署挑战。设备端扩散模型主要专注于文本到图像生成，缺乏对图像编辑的支持，因此需要开发一个紧凑的统一模型来同时支持这两种任务。
AI.method: 基于修剪的移动U-Net骨干网络，通过潜在空间中的上下文空间拼接统一条件处理：生成任务使用（目标|空白）配置，编辑任务使用（目标|源）配置。采用任务渐进联合预训练策略，依次针对T2I、编辑和联合任务进行训练，最后通过高质量SFT和强化学习优化。
AI.result: DreamLite在图像生成方面获得GenEval（0.72）分数，在图像编辑方面获得ImgEdit（4.11）分数，优于现有设备端模型，与多个服务器端模型保持竞争力。通过步骤蒸馏将去噪处理减少到仅4步，在小米14手机上1秒内即可生成或编辑1024×1024图像。
AI.conclusion: DreamLite是首个支持图像生成和图像编辑的统一设备端扩散模型，通过紧凑设计（0.39B参数）和高效处理（4步去噪）实现了在移动设备上的快速部署和实时性能。

title: SonoWorld: From One Image to a 3D Audio-Visual Scene
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026, project page: https://humathe.github.io/sonoworld/
summary: Tremendous progress in visual scene generation now turns a single image into an explorable 3D world, yet immersion remains incomplete without sound. We introduce Image2AVScene, the task of generating a 3D audio-visual scene from a single image, and present SonoWorld, the first framework to tackle this challenge. From one image, our pipeline outpaints a 360° panorama, lifts it into a navigable 3D scene, places language-guided sound anchors, and renders ambisonics for point, areal, and ambient sources, yielding spatial audio aligned with scene geometry and semantics. Quantitative evaluations on a newly curated real-world dataset and a controlled user study confirm the effectiveness of our approach. Beyond free-viewpoint audio-visual rendering, we also demonstrate applications to one-shot acoustic learning and audio-visual spatial source separation. Project website: https://humathe.github.io/sonoworld/

AI.tldr: Image2AVScene任务：从单张图像生成3D视听场景，SonoWorld框架实现全景扩展、3D重建、声音锚点放置和空间音频渲染
AI.motivation: 当前视觉场景生成技术已能将单张图像转换为可探索的3D世界，但缺乏声音的沉浸感仍然不完整，需要完整的视听场景生成
AI.method: SonoWorld框架：从单张图像扩展为360°全景图，提升为可导航3D场景，放置语言引导的声音锚点，渲染点源、面源和环境声的空间音频
AI.result: 在新构建的真实世界数据集上的定量评估和受控用户研究证实了方法的有效性，支持自由视点视听渲染、单次声学学习和视听空间源分离
AI.conclusion: 提出了Image2AVScene新任务和首个解决方案SonoWorld，实现了从单张图像生成几何和语义对齐的3D视听场景，拓展了视听生成的应用边界

title: FlowIt: Global Matching for Optical Flow with Confidence-Guided Refinement
summary: We present FlowIt, a novel architecture for optical flow estimation designed to robustly handle large pixel displacements. At its core, FlowIt leverages a hierarchical transformer architecture that captures extensive global context, enabling the model to effectively model long-range correspondences. To overcome the limitations of localized matching, we formulate the flow initialization as an optimal transport problem. This formulation yields a highly robust initial flow field, alongside explicitly derived occlusion and confidence maps. These cues are then seamlessly integrated into a guided refinement stage, where the network actively propagates reliable motion estimates from high-confidence regions into ambiguous, low-confidence areas. Extensive experiments across the Sintel, KITTI, Spring, and LayeredFlow datasets validate the efficacy of our approach. FlowIt achieves state-of-the-art results on the competitive Sintel and KITTI benchmarks, while simultaneously establishing new state-of-the-art cross-dataset zero-shot generalization performance on Sintel, Spring, and LayeredFlow.

AI.tldr: FlowIt：一种用于光流估计的新型架构，通过分层Transformer捕获全局上下文，将流初始化建模为最优传输问题，生成鲁棒的初始流场、遮挡和置信度图，并通过引导细化阶段传播可靠运动估计。
AI.motivation: 传统光流估计方法在处理大像素位移时存在局限性，难以有效建模长距离对应关系。需要一种能够鲁棒处理大位移并产生可靠遮挡和置信度信息的架构。
AI.method: 1. 采用分层Transformer架构捕获全局上下文；2. 将流初始化建模为最优传输问题，生成初始流场、遮挡图和置信度图；3. 通过引导细化阶段将高置信度区域的信息传播到低置信度区域。
AI.result: 在Sintel和KITTI基准测试中达到最先进水平，同时在Sintel、Spring和LayeredFlow数据集上实现了最先进的跨数据集零样本泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: FlowIt通过结合分层Transformer和最优传输公式，有效解决了大位移光流估计问题，在多个基准测试中表现出色，具有优秀的泛化能力。

title: SHOW3D: Capturing Scenes of 3D Hands and Objects in the Wild
summary: Accurate 3D understanding of human hands and objects during manipulation remains a significant challenge for egocentric computer vision. Existing hand-object interaction datasets are predominantly captured in controlled studio settings, which limits both environmental diversity and the ability of models trained on such data to generalize to real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel marker-less multi-camera system that allows for nearly unconstrained mobility in genuinely in-the-wild conditions, while still having the ability to generate precise 3D annotations of hands and objects. The capture system consists of a lightweight, back-mounted, multi-camera rig that is synchronized and calibrated with a user-worn VR headset. For 3D ground-truth annotation of hands and objects, we develop an ego-exo tracking pipeline and rigorously evaluate its quality. Finally, we present SHOW3D, the first large-scale dataset with 3D annotations that show hands interacting with objects in diverse real-world environments, including outdoor settings. Our approach significantly reduces the fundamental trade-off between environmental realism and accuracy of 3D annotations, which we validate with experiments on several downstream tasks. show3d-dataset.github.io

AI.tldr: SHOW3D是一个首个大规模3D手-物体交互数据集，使用无标记多摄像头系统在真实世界环境中采集，解决了环境真实性与3D标注精度之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有手-物体交互数据集主要在受控工作室环境中采集，缺乏环境多样性，导致训练模型难以泛化到真实世界场景。需要一种既能保持3D标注精度，又能在真实野外条件下采集数据的方法。
AI.method: 开发了一种轻量级、背戴式多摄像头系统，与VR头显同步校准。采用ego-exo跟踪流程生成手和物体的3D真实标注，并在多样真实世界环境（包括户外）中采集数据。
AI.result: 创建了SHOW3D数据集，这是首个大规模3D手-物体交互数据集，显著减少了环境真实性与3D标注精度之间的权衡。通过多个下游任务验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种创新的无标记多摄像头系统，能够在真实野外条件下生成精确的3D手-物体交互标注，为计算机视觉研究提供了重要的数据集和工具。

title: HandX: Scaling Bimanual Motion and Interaction Generation
comment: CVPR 2026. Project Page: https://handx-project.github.io. Code: https://github.com/handx-project/HandX
summary: Synthesizing human motion has advanced rapidly, yet realistic hand motion and bimanual interaction remain underexplored. Whole-body models often miss the fine-grained cues that drive dexterous behavior, finger articulation, contact timing, and inter-hand coordination, and existing resources lack high-fidelity bimanual sequences that capture nuanced finger dynamics and collaboration. To fill this gap, we present HandX, a unified foundation spanning data, annotation, and evaluation. We consolidate and filter existing datasets for quality, and collect a new motion-capture dataset targeting underrepresented bimanual interactions with detailed finger dynamics. For scalable annotation, we introduce a decoupled strategy that extracts representative motion features, e.g., contact events and finger flexion, and then leverages reasoning from large language models to produce fine-grained, semantically rich descriptions aligned with these features. Building on the resulting data and annotations, we benchmark diffusion and autoregressive models with versatile conditioning modes. Experiments demonstrate high-quality dexterous motion generation, supported by our newly proposed hand-focused metrics. We further observe clear scaling trends: larger models trained on larger, higher-quality datasets produce more semantically coherent bimanual motion. Our dataset is released to support future research.

AI.tldr: HandX是一个统一的手部运动生成框架，包含数据、标注和评估系统，专注于解决双手交互和精细手指运动的合成问题。
AI.motivation: 当前人体运动合成技术虽然发展迅速，但真实的手部运动和双手交互仍然研究不足。现有全身模型往往忽略了驱动灵巧行为、手指关节、接触时机和双手协调的精细线索，且缺乏捕捉细微手指动态和协作的高质量双手序列数据。
AI.method: 1) 整合和筛选现有数据集以提高质量，并收集新的动捕数据集专注于代表性不足的双手交互；2) 采用解耦标注策略：先提取代表性运动特征（接触事件、手指弯曲等），然后利用大语言模型生成与这些特征对齐的细粒度语义描述；3) 基于所得数据和标注，对扩散模型和自回归模型进行基准测试，支持多种条件模式。
AI.result: 实验展示了高质量的灵巧运动生成，并通过新提出的手部聚焦指标得到支持。观察到明显的扩展趋势：在更大、更高质量数据集上训练的更大模型能够产生更语义连贯的双手运动。
AI.conclusion: HandX提供了一个统一的基础设施来推进手部运动合成研究，特别是双手交互和精细手指动态。数据集已发布以支持未来研究。

title: Gen-Searcher: Reinforcing Agentic Search for Image Generation
summary: Recent image generation models have shown strong capabilities in generating high-fidelity and photorealistic images. However, they are fundamentally constrained by frozen internal knowledge, thus often failing on real-world scenarios that are knowledge-intensive or require up-to-date information. In this paper, we present Gen-Searcher, as the first attempt to train a search-augmented image generation agent, which performs multi-hop reasoning and search to collect the textual knowledge and reference images needed for grounded generation. To achieve this, we construct a tailored data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Gen-Searcher-SFT-10k and Gen-Searcher-RL-6k, containing diverse search-intensive prompts and corresponding ground-truth synthesis images. We further introduce KnowGen, a comprehensive benchmark that explicitly requires search-grounded external knowledge for image generation and evaluates models from multiple dimensions. Based on these resources, we train Gen-Searcher with SFT followed by agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines text-based and image-based rewards to provide more stable and informative learning signals for GRPO training. Experiments show that Gen-Searcher brings substantial gains, improving Qwen-Image by around 16 points on KnowGen and 15 points on WISE. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for search agents in image generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code.

AI.tldr: Gen-Searcher是首个搜索增强的图像生成智能体，通过多跳推理和搜索收集文本知识和参考图像，解决现有模型因冻结内部知识而无法处理知识密集型或需要最新信息的现实场景问题。
AI.motivation: 当前图像生成模型虽然能生成高保真和逼真图像，但受限于冻结的内部知识，在处理需要密集知识或最新信息的现实场景时经常失败。需要开发能够动态获取外部知识的图像生成系统。
AI.method: 构建专门的数据管道，创建两个高质量数据集（Gen-Searcher-SFT-10k和Gen-Searcher-RL-6k），引入KnowGen基准测试，采用SFT后接具有双奖励反馈的智能体强化学习训练Gen-Searcher，结合文本和图像奖励提供更稳定的学习信号。
AI.result: Gen-Searcher带来显著提升，在KnowGen基准上使Qwen-Image提高约16分，在WISE基准上提高15分。作者开源了数据、模型和代码。
AI.conclusion: Gen-Searcher作为首个搜索增强图像生成智能体，通过多跳推理和搜索收集外部知识，显著提升了知识密集型图像生成能力，为搜索增强图像生成领域提供了开放基础。
